CostsIncurredOilAndGasPropertyAcquisitio.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

CostsIncurredInOilAndGasPropertyAcquisit.l: Oil and Gas, Cost Incurred, Property Acquisition, Exploration, and Development [Table]
CostsIncurredInOilAndGasPropertyAcquisit.d: Disclosure of information about property acquisition, exploration, and development costs incurred in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes capitalized cost and cost charged to expense.

CostOfOtherPropertyOperatingExpense.l: Cost of Other Property Operating Expense
CostOfOtherPropertyOperatingExpense.d: Other operating costs incurred during the reporting period and may include amounts paid to maintain the property.

CostsInExcessOfBillingsOnUncompletedCont.d: Amount of receivable reflecting the cost incurred on uncompleted contracts in excess of related billings.

CostsInExcessOfBillingsOnUncompletedCont.l: Costs in Excess of Billings on Uncompleted Contracts or Programs [Abstract]

CreditAvailabilityConcentrationRiskMembe.d: Reflects the percentage that borrowing or credit line availability under commitments from one or more lenders is to a selected benchmark, such as total debt, segment debt. Risk is the materially adverse effects that funds which may be needed for operations or for a specific purpose will not be available on terms that are acceptable to an entity, if at all.

CreditCardOriginationCostsPolicyTextBloc.l: Credit Card Origination Costs, Policy [Policy Text Block]
CreditCardOriginationCostsPolicyTextBloc.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for identifying, measuring and capitalizing costs of obtaining or creating credit card accounts that are not private label credit cards. Includes, but is not limited to, the methodology of amortizing costs, contractual arrangements terms with third-party credit card intermediaries and classification of amounts due from those intermediaries.

CreditCardReceivablesMember.d: Receivable from card issued to user to facilitate payment for purchase of product or service or both paid directly to merchant by card issuer, and later paid by cardholder to card issuer.

CreditConcentrationRiskMember.d: Reflects the percentage that a specified receivable or amount at risk from a counterparty under a contractual arrangement is to a specified benchmark, such as total receivables, net revenues, pretax results. Risk is the materially adverse effects of loss attributable to (a) the failure to collect a significant receivable from a major customer or group of homogeneous accounts, or (b) a failure by a counterparty to perform under terms of a contractual arrangement.

CreditAndDebitCardReceivablesAtCarryingV.l: Cash Equivalent, Credit and Debit Card Receivables, Carrying Value
CreditAndDebitCardReceivablesAtCarryingV.d: Amount due the Entity as a result of customers utilizing point of sale debit or credit cards in exchange transactions with the entity which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition.

AssetBackedSecuritiesSecuritizedLoansAnd.l: Asset-Backed Securities, Securitized Loans and Receivables [Member]
AssetBackedSecuritiesSecuritizedLoansAnd.d: Securities that are primarily serviced with cash flows derived financial assets that are being securitized for example, but not limited to, credit card receivables, car loans, recreational vehicle loans, and mobile home loans. Excludes mortgage-backed securities.

CreditDefaultOptionMember.d: A contract in which one party has the right to claim a payment from another party in the event that a specified credit event occurs over the life of the contract. Also known as credit default agreements.

CreditDefaultSwapMember.d: Credit derivative contract between credit default swap buyer and third party in which credit default swap buyer makes periodic payment to third party and third party guarantees to reimburse credit default swap buyer if original borrower defaults.

CreditRiskDerivativeAssetsAtFairValue.l: Credit Risk Derivative Assets, at Fair Value
CreditRiskDerivativeAssetsAtFairValue.d: Fair value of credit risk derivative asset.

CreditRiskDerivativeLiabilitiesAtFairVal.l: Credit Risk Derivative Liabilities, at Fair Value
CreditRiskDerivativeLiabilitiesAtFairVal.d: Fair value of credit risk derivative liability.

CreditRiskDerivativesAtFairValueNet.l: Credit Risk Derivatives, at Fair Value, Net
CreditRiskDerivativesAtFairValueNet.d: Fair value of credit risk derivative asset after deduction of credit risk derivative liability.

CreditRiskMember.d: The risk that a borrower will fail to pay interest or principal on a loan or debt security when due.

CreditSpreadOptionMember.d: An option on the yield spread on a bond.

CrudeOilAndNaturalGasLiquids.l: Energy Related Inventory, Crude Oil and Natural Gas Liquids
CrudeOilAndNaturalGasLiquids.d: The aggregate carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of unrefined petroleum and the liquid hydrocarbon components recovered from natural gas.

CumulativePreferredStockMember.d: Preferred stock upon which unpaid dividends accumulate until paid to shareholders. Classified within stockholders' equity if nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer. Classified within temporary equity if redemption is outside the control of the issuer.

CumulativeTranslationAdjustmentNetOfTaxP.l: Cumulative Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Period Increase (Decrease)
CumulativeTranslationAdjustmentNetOfTaxP.d: The increase (decrease) in cumulative translation adjustment before transfers included in determining net income.

AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossF.l: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossF.d: Accumulated adjustment, net of tax, that results from the process of translating subsidiary financial statements and foreign equity investments into the reporting currency from the functional currency of the reporting entity, net of reclassification of realized foreign currency translation gains or losses.

CumulativeTranslationAdjustmentSummaryRo.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

CurrencySwapMember.d: Swap involving the exchange of principal and interest in one currency for another currency.

CurrentFederalTaxExpenseBenefit.d: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

CurrentForeignTaxExpenseBenefit.d: Amount of current foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

CurrentIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.d: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

LiabilitiesCurrent.d: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

OtherTaxExpenseBenefit.d: Amount of other income tax expense (benefit).

IntangibleAssetsCurrent.d: The current portion of nonphysical assets, excluding financial assets, if these assets are classified into the current and noncurrent portions.

LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsCu.l: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current
LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsCu.d: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsCu.l: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current [Abstract]

OtherLongTermDebtCurrent.d: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

CurrentStateAndLocalTaxExpenseBenefit.l: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
CurrentStateAndLocalTaxExpenseBenefit.d: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

CustodyFees.d: Those fees charged for services related to holding, advising, and managing customer investment assets. These account fees usually charged annually or semi-annually, on a per security basis, for the costs of services.

CustomerAdvancesNoncurrent.d: The noncurrent portion of prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future.

CustomerAdvancesCurrent.d: The current portion of prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future.

CustomerAdvancesAndDepositsCurrent.d: The current portion of aggregate prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future, as well as the current portion of money or property received from customers that are to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or as partial prepayment for goods or services to be provided in the future.

CustomerAdvancesAndDeposits.d: Refundable consideration, usually cash, held by the entity pending satisfactory completion of the entity's obligations or pending the closing of a contract.

CustomerAdvancesOrDepositsNoncurrent.d: Aggregate noncurrent portion of prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future, as well as the current portion of money or property received from customers that is to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or as partial prepayment for goods or services to be provided in the future.

CustomerAdvancesForConstruction.d: For utilities only, represents the carrying amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date for payments received by a utility from its customers in advance of performing its obligations under terms of its construction agreements.

CustomerAdvancesAndProgressPaymentsForLo.l: Customer Advances and Progress Payments for Long-Term Contracts or Programs
CustomerAdvancesAndProgressPaymentsForLo.d: The amount of the offset related to government or other customer advances received on a contract when the expected advances will be applied in payment to those particular charges of the receivable.

BilledAndUnbilledContractClaimsSubjectTo.l: Billed and Unbilled Contract Claims Subject to Uncertainty [Abstract]

CustomerConcentrationRiskMember.d: Reflects the percentage that revenues in the period from one or more significant customers is to net revenues, as defined by the entity, such as total net revenues, product line revenues, segment revenues. The risk is the materially adverse effects of loss of a significant customer.

CustomerDepositsCurrent.d: The current portion of money or property received from customers which is either to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or applied to customer receivables in accordance with the terms of the contract or the understandings.

CustomerDepositsNoncurrent.d: The noncurrent portion of money or property received from customers that is to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or as partial prepayment for goods or services to be provided in the future.

CustomerFunds.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts received from and refundable to customers unless used by them to obtain goods and services from the entity.

CustomerListsMember.d: Information about customers such as their name and contact information; it may also be an extensive database that includes other information about the customers such as their order history and demographic information.

CustomerReceiptsMember.d: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future.

CustomerRefundLiabilityNoncurrent.d: Noncurrent regulatory liabilities generally represent obligations to make refunds to customers for various reasons including overpayment.

CustomerRefundableFees.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of proceeds that had been received in revenue related transactions that are refundable to the customers and do not meet the criteria for revenue recognition (for example, refundable membership fees).

CustomerRefundableFeesPeriodIncreaseDecr.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in customer refundable fees.

CustomerRelationshipsMember.d: Customer relationship that exists between an entity and its customer, for example, but not limited to, tenant relationships.

CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRight.l: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge, Securities Type [Domain] (Deprecated 2026)
CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRight.d: Description of financial instrument type of customer securities accepted by the entity and re-pledged to counterparties as collateral or sold.

CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRight.l: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge [Axis] (Deprecated 2026)
CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRight.d: Information by type of pledged assets accepted which the entity has the right to sell or repledge.

CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRight.l: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge, Fair Value of Securities Sold or Repledged
CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRight.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of customer securities accepted as collateral by the entity that it has sold or re-pledged to counterparties as collateral.

CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRight.l: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge (Including Securities Sold or Repledged) [Line Items]
CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRight.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRight.l: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge [Table]
CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRight.d: Disclosure of information about customer security accepted and repledged to counterparty as collateral or sold.

DueFromCustomerAcceptances.l: Banker's Acceptance, Due from Customer, after Allowance for Credit Loss
DueFromCustomerAcceptances.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of receivable from customer for banker's acceptance.

CustomersLiabilityForAcceptancesGross.l: Banker's Acceptance, Due from Customer, before Allowance for Credit Loss
CustomersLiabilityForAcceptancesGross.d: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of receivable from customer for banker's acceptance.

CustomersLiabilityForAcceptancesNetAbstr.l: Banker's Acceptance, Due from Customer, after Allowance for Credit Loss [Abstract]

CustomersLiabilityForAcceptancesNet.d: The aggregate of all customer's outstanding debt to the institution that resulted from short-term negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by an institution (also known as banker's acceptance transactions), net of allowance for uncollectible customer's liability for acceptances.

DJIAIndexFutureMember.d: A standardized contract, traded on a futures exchange, to buy or sell Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) Index at a certain date in the future, at a certain price.

DamageFromFireExplosionOrOtherHazardMemb.l: Damage from Fire, Explosion or Other Hazard [Member]
DamageFromFireExplosionOrOtherHazardMemb.d: Risk of loss from uninsured portions of losses resulting from fire, explosion or other hazard.

DamagesFromProductDefectsMember.d: The risk of loss arises with respect to product defects and recalls, or improperly performed services which actually or allegedly resulted in damages suffered by the injured party, excluding major product liability matters.

DatabasesMember.d: Exclusive legal rights granted to the owner or licensee of collections of information stored in electronic form (such as on computer disks or files).

DebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations.d: Amount of short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

DebtCurrent.d: Amount of debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations.d: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentExpirat.l: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Expiration or Due Date
DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentExpirat.d: Expiration, mandatory redemption, or due date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, of the financial instrument issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash or part noncash transaction.

DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentExpirat.l: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Expiration or Due Date, Month and Year
DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentExpirat.d: The expiration, mandatory redemption, or due date, month and year (YYYY-MM), of the financial instrument issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentIssuanc.l: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Issuance Date
DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentIssuanc.d: Date the financial instrument was issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash or part noncash transaction, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentIssuanc.l: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Issuance Date, Month and Year
DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentIssuanc.d: The month and year (YYYY-MM) the financial instrument was issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentRate.d: Dividend or interest rate associated with the financial instrument issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash or part noncash transaction. Noncash are transactions that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments. Part noncash refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments.

DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentType.d: The type of the financial instrument that the original debt is being converted into (for example, new debt, common stock, preferred stock, etc.) in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

DebtConversionOriginalDebtDueDateOfDebtD.l: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Due Date of Debt
DebtConversionOriginalDebtDueDateOfDebtD.d: Date the original debt was scheduled to mature, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

DebtConversionOriginalDebtDueDateOfDebtM.l: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Due Date of Debt, Month and Year
DebtConversionOriginalDebtDueDateOfDebtM.d: The month and year (YYYY-MM) in which the original debt was scheduled to mature.

DebtConversionOriginalDebtInterestRateOf.l: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Interest Rate of Debt
DebtConversionOriginalDebtInterestRateOf.d: The rate of interest that was being paid on the original debt issue that is being converted in the noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

DebtConversionOriginalDebtIssuanceDateOf.l: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Issuance Date of Debt
DebtConversionOriginalDebtIssuanceDateOf.d: Date the original debt was issued, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

DebtConversionOriginalDebtIssuanceDateOf.l: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Issuance Date of Debt, Month and Year (Deprecated 2026)
DebtConversionOriginalDebtIssuanceDateOf.d: The month and year (YYYY-MM) in which the original debt was issued.

DebtConversionOriginalDebtTypeOfDebt.l: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Type of Debt
DebtConversionOriginalDebtTypeOfDebt.d: A textual description providing detail about the type of debt (for example, secured, unsecured, callable, convertible) that is being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. At a minimum, the disclosure includes information sufficient to provide an understanding of the nature and purpose of the debt issuance, as well as its features and the events leading to up to conversion. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments dur

DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis.d: Information by description of debt issuances converted in a noncash or part noncash transaction.

DebtConversionLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

DebtConversionTable.d: Disclosure of information about original debt issuance converted in noncash or part noncash transaction.

DebtConversionNameDomain.d: The name of the original debt issue that has been converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction during the accounting period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

DebtDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for information about short-term and long-term debt arrangements, which includes amounts of borrowings under each line of credit, note payable, commercial paper issue, bonds indenture, debenture issue, own-share lending arrangements and any other contractual agreement to repay funds, and about the underlying arrangements, rationale for a classification as long-term, including repayment terms, interest rates, collateral provided, restrictions on use of assets and activities,

DebtInstrumentAnnualPrincipalPayment.d: Amount of annual principal payment for debt instrument.

DebtInstrumentCallDateEarliest.d: Earliest date before maturity when the issuer can call the outstanding debt instrument for repayment or conversion to equity, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

DebtInstrumentCallDateLatest.d: Latest date before maturity which the issuer can call the outstanding debt instrument for repayment or conversion to equity, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

DebtInstrumentCallFeature.d: Description of a feature that permits the issuer of the debt to repay or convert it before the stated maturity date (early retirement date). The description may include such items as the call price, the period that the issuer can call the debt, including the earliest call date, and other significant terms of the call feature, which may include the debt holders' ability to convert the debt to equity if the call option is exercised and contingent events that trigger the issuer's ability to call th

DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount.d: Amount, before unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but is not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, commercial loans, mortgage loans, convertible debt, subordinated debt and other types of debt.

DebtInstrumentCollateral.d: Discussion of whether the debt instrument is secured or unsecured, and, if secured, a description of the collateral and guarantees required or provided.

DebtInstrumentConvertibleBeneficialConve.l: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Beneficial Conversion Feature
DebtInstrumentConvertibleBeneficialConve.d: Amount of a favorable spread to a debt holder between the amount of debt being converted and the value of the securities received upon conversion. This is an embedded conversion feature of convertible debt issued that is in-the-money at the commitment date.

DebtInstrumentConvertibleNumberOfEquityI.l: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Number of Equity Instruments
DebtInstrumentConvertibleNumberOfEquityI.d: The number of equity instruments that the holder of the debt instrument would receive if the debt was converted to equity.

DebtInstrumentConvertibleTermsOfConversi.l: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Terms of Conversion Feature
DebtInstrumentConvertibleTermsOfConversi.d: Description of conversion terms for debt instrument.

DebtInstrumentConvertibleTypeOfEquitySec.l: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Type of Equity Security
DebtInstrumentConvertibleTypeOfEquitySec.d: Description of the type of equity security or securities into which conversion will be made (for example, common stock or preferred shares).

DebtInstrumentCovenantCompliance.d: States whether the entity was in compliance with the debt covenants throughout the reporting period, and describes facts and circumstances of any compliance failure.

DebtInstrumentCovenantDescription.d: Description of minimum financial levels (for example, tangible net worth and working capital) and achievement of certain financial ratios (for example, working capital ratio and debt service coverage ratio), and adherence to certain clauses which generally require or restrict certain actions (for example, entering into a debt arrangement with equal or greater seniority, and selling or discontinuing a certain business segment or material subsidiary) to be in compliance with the covenant clauses o

DebtInstrumentCreditRating.d: Description of the credit rating indicative of likelihood of repayment of the debt instrument given by a credit rating agency (for example, Standard and Poor's, Moody's, Fitch).

DebtInstrumentCurrency.d: Description of the type of currency in which the debt instrument is required to be repaid.

DebtInstrumentDecreaseForgiveness.d: Decrease for amounts of indebtedness forgiven by the holder of the debt instrument.

DebtInstrumentDescription.d: Identification of the lender and information about a contractual promise to repay a short-term or long-term obligation, which includes borrowings under lines of credit, notes payable, commercial paper, bonds payable, debentures, and other contractual obligations for payment. This may include rationale for entering into the arrangement, significant terms of the arrangement, which may include amount, repayment terms, priority, collateral required, debt covenants, borrowing capacity, call features,

DebtInstrumentFaceAmount.d: Face (par) amount of debt instrument at time of issuance.

DebtInstrumentFairValue.d: Fair value portion of debt instrument payable, including, but not limited to, notes payable and loans payable.

DebtInstrumentFee.d: Description of a fee associated with the debt instrument, including a commitment fee on unborrowed portions of a lender's total contractual commitment.

DebtInstrumentFeeAmount.d: Amount of the fee that accompanies borrowing money under the debt instrument.

DebtInstrumentFrequencyOfFee.d: Description of when a fee associated with a debt instrument is required to be paid (for example, quarterly, annually, or monthly).

DebtInstrumentFrequencyOfPeriodicPayment.l: Debt Instrument, Frequency of Periodic Payment
DebtInstrumentFrequencyOfPeriodicPayment.d: Description of the frequency of periodic payments (monthly, quarterly, annual).

DebtInstrumentIncreaseAccruedInterest.d: Increase for accrued, but unpaid interest on the debt instrument for the period.

DebtInstrumentIncreaseDecreaseForPeriodD.l: Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease) for Period, Description
DebtInstrumentIncreaseDecreaseForPeriodD.d: Description of the increases or decreases in the carrying amount of the debt instrument for the period, and may include a discussion of any significant changes in the authorized and issued amounts of bonds, mortgages and other types of debt during the reporting period.

DebtInstrumentIncreaseDecreaseForPeriodN.d: Net increase or decrease in the carrying amount of the debt instrument for the period.

DebtInstrumentIncreaseDecreaseOtherNet.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in debt instruments, classified as other.

DebtInstrumentInterestRateBasisForEffect.l: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Basis for Effective Rate
DebtInstrumentInterestRateBasisForEffect.d: Description of any adjustments made to the stated rate to determine the effective rate.

DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod.l: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate During Period
DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod.d: The average effective interest rate during the reporting period.

DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePerce.l: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage
DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePerce.d: Effective interest rate for the funds borrowed under the debt agreement considering interest compounding and original issue discount or premium.

DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercenta.l: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage
DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercenta.d: Contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

DebtInstrumentInterestRateTerms.d: Description of the interest rate as being fixed or variable, and, if variable, identification of the index or rate on which the interest rate is based and the number of points or percentage added to that index or rate to set the rate, and other pertinent information, such as frequency of rate resets.

DebtInstrumentIssuer.d: Identification of the contractual issuer of the debt instrument (for example, a subsidiary of the reporting entity).

DebtInstrumentMaturityDate.d: Date when the debt instrument is scheduled to be fully repaid, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

DebtInstrumentMaturityDateDescription.d: Description of the maturity date of the debt instrument including whether the debt matures serially and, if so, a brief description of the serial maturities.

DebtInstrumentNameDomain.d: The name for the particular debt instrument or borrowing that distinguishes it from other debt instruments or borrowings, including draws against credit facilities.

DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms.d: Description of the payment terms of the debt instrument (for example, whether periodic payments include principal and frequency of payments) and discussion about any contingencies associated with the payment.

DebtInstrumentPeriodicPayment.d: Amount of the required periodic payments including both interest and principal payments.

DebtInstrumentPeriodicPaymentInterest.d: Amount of the required periodic payments applied to interest.

DebtInstrumentPeriodicPaymentPrincipal.d: Amount of the required periodic payments applied to principal.

DebtInstrumentPriority.d: Description of the debt instrument's priority, or seniority, for repayment in relation to other obligations of the entity in the event of liquidation.

DebtInstrumentRestrictiveCovenants.d: Description of covenants that limit or prohibit certain actions or activities without the lender's prior consent within a specified period of time or until certain specified targets are achieved for example, reduction of the debt or an increase in net worth to a specified amount).

DebtInstrumentSinkingFundDescription.d: Describes the provision of a debt agreement that requires the borrower to periodically place monies into a fund which is used to retire, typically annually, a portion of the outstanding debt.

DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscount.d: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount.

DebtInstrumentUnamortizedPremium.d: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt premium.

DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityAmo.l: Debt Instrument, Unused Borrowing Capacity, Amount
DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityAmo.d: Amount of unused borrowing capacity under the long-term financing arrangement that is available to the entity as of the balance sheet date.

DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityDes.l: Debt Instrument, Unused Borrowing Capacity, Description
DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityDes.d: Description of unused borrowing capacity under the debt instrument and conditions under which the commitment can be withdrawn by the lender.

DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityFee.l: Debt Instrument, Unused Borrowing Capacity, Fee
DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityFee.d: Amount of commitment fees for the unused borrowing capacity under the long-term financing arrangement that is available to the entity.

DebtInstrumentAxis.d: Information by type of debt instrument, including, but not limited to, draws against credit facilities.

DebtInstrumentLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

DebtInstrumentTable.d: Disclosure of information about long-term debt instrument or arrangement.

PaymentsOfDebtIssuanceCosts.d: The cash outflow paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt.

DebtMember.d: Contractual obligation to pay money on demand or on fixed or determinable dates.

DebtRelatedCommitmentFeesAndDebtIssuance.l: Debt Related Commitment Fees and Debt Issuance Costs
DebtRelatedCommitmentFeesAndDebtIssuance.d: Represents the charge against earnings during the period for commitment fees and debt issuance expenses.

PaymentsOfDebtRestructuringCosts.d: The cash outflow for cost incurred in the modification of term of existing debt agreement in order for the entity to achieve some advantage.

DebtSecuritiesMember.d: Debt instrument issued by corporations, governments and governmental agencies, municipalities, and other institutions.

DebtorInPossessionFinancingFeeOnUnusedBo.l: Debtor-in-Possession Financing, Fee on Unused Borrowings
DebtorInPossessionFinancingFeeOnUnusedBo.d: Percentage of fee on unused borrowings under debtor-in-possession financing arrangement.

DebtorInPossessionFinancingInterestRateO.l: Debtor-in-Possession Financing, Interest Rate on Borrowings Outstanding
DebtorInPossessionFinancingInterestRateO.d: Interest rate on outstanding borrowings under debtor-in-possession financing arrangement.

DebtorInPossessionFinancingLettersOfCred.l: Debtor-in-Possession Financing, Letters of Credit Outstanding
DebtorInPossessionFinancingLettersOfCred.d: Amount of letters of credit outstanding under debtor-in-possession financing arrangement.

DebtorReorganizationItemsDebtorInPossess.l: Debtor Reorganization Items, Debtor-in-Possession Facility Financing Costs
DebtorReorganizationItemsDebtorInPossess.d: Amount of reorganization items related to debtor-in-possession facility financing costs.

DebtorReorganizationItemsDischargeOfClai.l: Debtor Reorganization Items, Discharge of Claims and Liabilities
DebtorReorganizationItemsDischargeOfClai.d: Amount of reorganization items related to discharge of claims and liabilities upon emergence from bankruptcy.

DebtorReorganizationItemsEmployeeRelated.l: Debtor Reorganization Items, Employee Related Charges
DebtorReorganizationItemsEmployeeRelated.d: Amount of reorganization items related to employee related charges.

DebtorReorganizationItemsImpairmentLoss.d: Amount of reorganization items related to impairment loss.

DebtorReorganizationItemsLegalAndAdvisor.l: Debtor Reorganization Items, Legal and Advisory Professional Fees
DebtorReorganizationItemsLegalAndAdvisor.d: Amount of reorganization items related to legal and advisory professional fees related to entities in bankruptcy.

DebtorReorganizationItemsOtherExpenseInc.d: Amount of expense (income) related to reorganization items classified as other.

DebtorReorganizationItemsPensionAndOther.l: Debtor Reorganization Items, Pension and Other Postretirement Related Charges
DebtorReorganizationItemsPensionAndOther.d: Amount of reorganization items related to pension and other postretirement related charges.

DebtorReorganizationItemsProvisionForExp.l: Debtor Reorganization Items, Provision for Expected Allowed Claims
DebtorReorganizationItemsProvisionForExp.d: Amount of expense for claims expected to be incurred by an entity in reorganization.

DebtorReorganizationItemsRetireeRelatedC.l: Debtor Reorganization Items, Retiree Related Charges
DebtorReorganizationItemsRetireeRelatedC.d: Amount of reorganization items related to retiree related charges.

DebtorReorganizationItemsRevaluationOfAs.l: Debtor Reorganization Items, Revaluation of Assets and Liabilities
DebtorReorganizationItemsRevaluationOfAs.d: Amount recognized from the revaluation of assets and liabilities.

DebtorReorganizationItemsWriteOffOfDefer.l: Debtor Reorganization Items, Debt Issuance Cost and Debt Discount, Writeoff
DebtorReorganizationItemsWriteOffOfDefer.d: Amount of write-off of debt issuance costs and debt discounts related to prepetition debt obligations.

DecommissioningFundInvestments.d: Decommission fund to pay for the costs of decontaminating and decommissioning of facilities through collection of revenues derived from utility assessments and government appropriations. Decommission fund investment for the process whereby a power station, at the end of its economic life, is taken permanently out of service and its site made available for other purposes. In the case of a nuclear station this comprises three different states of clearance. Immediately after the final closure, radi

DecommissioningLiabilityNoncurrent.d: Amount of a decommissioning liability associated with a legal obligation that a firm incurs when it constructs or operates an asset that must eventually be withdrawn from active service. This may include operating assets such as nuclear power plants or shipping vessels.

DecommissioningTrustAssetsAmount.d: The fair value of investments held in a trust fund to pay for the costs of decontaminating and decommissioning facilities, whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure on the balance sheet. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements.

RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciationOtherDe.l: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Accumulated Depreciation, Other Deduction
RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciationOtherDe.d: Amount of other deductions to accumulated depreciation, excluding sales, for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

DeferredAdvertisingCosts.d: The costs of direct-response advertising whose primary purpose is to elicit sales to customers who could be shown to have responded specifically to the advertising and that results in probable future benefits and are reported as assets net of accumulated amortization.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Compensation Expense
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: The compensation expense recognized during the period pertaining to the deferred compensation arrangement.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Description
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Description of the deferred compensation arrangement, including fixed amounts and determinable awards, or the method for determining payments and awards, the timing of such payments and awards, and any requisite service or performance criteria, as of the balance sheet date.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Recorded Liability
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: The carrying amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date to an individual under a deferred compensation arrangement. This amount may be the result of periodic accruals made over the period of active employment, or reflect termination benefits resulting contractual terms or a death benefit.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Shares Authorized for Issuance
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: The maximum number of shares authorized for issuance under the deferred compensation arrangement as of the balance sheet date.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Shares Issued
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Number of shares issued pursuant to the terms of a deferred compensation arrangement.

ScheduleOfDeferredCompensationArrangemen.l: Schedule of Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Share-Based Payments [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfDeferredCompensationArrangemen.d: Tabular disclosure of an equity-based arrangement (such as stock or unit options and stock or unit awards) with an individual employee, which is generally an employment contract between the entity and a selected officer or key employee containing a promise by the employer to pay certain equity-based awards at future dates, sometimes including a period after retirement, upon compliance with stipulated requirements. This type of arrangement is distinguished from broader based employee benefit plan

DeferredCompensationLiabilityCurrent.d: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements payable within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer). Represents currently earned compensation under compensation arrangements that is not actually paid until a later date.

DeferredCompensationEquity.d: Value of stock issued under share-based plans to employees or officers which is the unearned portion, accounted for under the fair value method.

DeferredCompensationPlanAssets.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of assets held under deferred compensation agreements.

IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredChargesInvesti.d: The increase (decrease) in noncurrent deferred charges, classified as investing activities.

DeferredCostsCapitalizedPrepaidAndOtherA.l: Deferred Costs, Capitalized, Prepaid, and Other Assets Disclosure [Table Text Block]
DeferredCostsCapitalizedPrepaidAndOtherA.d: Tabular disclosure of the amounts paid in advance for capitalized costs that will be expensed with the passage of time or the occurrence of a triggering event, and will be charged against earnings within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer; the aggregate carrying amount of current assets, not separately presented elsewhere in the balance sheet; and other deferred costs.

DeferredCostsCreditCardOriginationCostsA.l: Deferred Costs, Credit Card Origination Costs, Amount
DeferredCostsCreditCardOriginationCostsA.d: Amount, after accumulated amortization and related credit card fees, of credit card origination costs not related to private label credit cards.

DeferredCostsCreditCardOriginationCostsA.l: Deferred Costs, Credit Card Origination Costs, Amortization
DeferredCostsCreditCardOriginationCostsA.d: Amount of amortization of capitalized credit card origination costs not related to private label credit cards.

DescriptionOfDeferredCostsRelatedToLongT.l: Description of Deferred Costs Related to Long-Term Contracts (Deprecated 2025)
DescriptionOfDeferredCostsRelatedToLongT.d: The description of deferred costs for long-term contracts and programs as of the balance sheet date. Examples include initial tooling and deferred production costs.

PostemploymentBenefitsLiabilityNoncurren.d: For a classified balance sheet, the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement that is payable after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

DeferredFederalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.d: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

DeferredForeignIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.d: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

DeferredFuelCost.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized fuel costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DeferredFuelCostsMember.d: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of fuel costs incurred.

DeferredGasCost.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized gas costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DeferredGasPurchasesCurrent.d: Current liabilities arising from deferral of gas to be purchased.

DeferredIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.d: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

DeferredIncomeTaxLiabilities.d: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

DeferredLeaseRevenueMember.d: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of rental payments received in advance.

DeferredLeasingCommissions.d: Amount of unrecognized fee revenue received at the inception of a lease that is deferred and recognized over the life of the lease.

DeferredCosts.d: Amount of deferred cost, excluding capitalized cost related to contract with customer; classified as noncurrent.

DeferredLongTermLiabilityCharges.d: The total amount of long-term liability charges that are being deferred beyond one year.

DeferredOtherTaxExpenseBenefit.d: Amount of other deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations. For example, but not limited to, acquisition-date income tax benefits or expenses recognized from changes in the acquirer's valuation allowance for its previously existing deferred tax assets resulting from a business combination and adjustments to beginning-of-year balance of a valuation allowance because of a change in circumstance causing a change in judgment about the realizability o

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCosts.d: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized on contract remaining in force.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAdditions.d: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Amortization Expense
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.d: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for deferred policy acquisition costs.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Amortization Expense, Net Investment Gains (Losses)
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.d: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of amortization expense) of deferred policy acquisition costs from realized net investment gain (loss).

IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredPolicyAcquisit.l: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs
IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredPolicyAcquisit.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the balance sheet value of capitalized sales costs that are associated with acquiring a new insurance customers.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsPeriodIncr.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Period Increase (Decrease)
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsPeriodIncr.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred policy acquisition cost.

DeferredProjectCostsMember.d: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of costs incurred for acquired assets or services.

DeferredRentReceivablesNet.d: Amount of excess of rental income recognized over rental payment required by lease.

DeferredRentReceivablesNetNoncurrent.d: Amount of excess of rental income recognized over rental payment required by lease, classified as noncurrent.

DeferredRevenueAdditions.d: Amount of deferred revenue recognized for transactions arising during the current reporting period. Deferred revenue is a liability as of the balance sheet date related to a revenue producing activity for which revenue has not yet been recognized. Generally, an Entity records deferred revenue when it receives consideration from a customer before achieving certain criteria that must be met for revenue to be recognized in conformity with GAAP.

DeferredRevenueArrangementTypeAxis.d: Information by type of deferred revenue arrangement.

DeferredRevenueArrangementTypeDomain.d: Category of obligation arising when an entity receives consideration from a customer before achieving certain criteria that must be met for revenue to be recognized.

DeferredRevenueArrangementLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

DeferredRevenueArrangementByTypeTable.d: Disclosure of information about deferred revenue by type of arrangement.

DeferredRevenueDescription.d: Description of the transaction or nature of business giving rise to deferred revenue or unearned revenue, other than annual membership fees. Deferred revenue is a liability related to a revenue producing activity for which revenue has not yet been recognized. Generally, an entity records deferred revenue when it receives consideration from a customer before achieving certain criteria that must be met for revenue to be recognized in conformity with GAAP.

DeferredRevenueDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for deferred revenues at the end of the reporting period, and description and amounts of significant changes that occurred during the reporting period. Deferred revenue is a liability as of the balance sheet date related to a revenue producing activity for which revenue has not yet been recognized. Generally, an entity records deferred revenue when it receives consideration from a customer before achieving certain criteria that must be met for revenue to be recognized in co

DeferredRevenuePeriodIncreaseDecrease.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred revenue.

DeferredSalesInducementsAdditions.d: Amount of deferred sale inducement cost capitalized.

DeferredSalesInducementsAdjustments.l: Deferred Sales Inducement Cost, Other Increase (Decrease)
DeferredSalesInducementsAdjustments.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred sales inducement cost, classified as other.

DeferredSalesInducementsAmortizationExpe.l: Deferred Sales Inducement Cost, Amortization Expense
DeferredSalesInducementsAmortizationExpe.d: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for deferred sales inducement cost.

DeferredSalesInducementsNet.d: Amount of deferred sale inducement cost capitalized on contract remaining in force.

DeferredCostsCurrent.d: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period that are expected to be charged against earnings within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DeferredStateAndLocalIncomeTaxExpenseBen.l: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
DeferredStateAndLocalIncomeTaxExpenseBen.d: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

DeferredStormAndPropertyReserveDeficienc.l: Deferred Storm and Property Reserve Deficiency, Current
DeferredStormAndPropertyReserveDeficienc.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized storm costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DeferredStormAndPropertyReserveDeficienc.l: Deferred Storm and Property Reserve Deficiency, Noncurrent
DeferredStormAndPropertyReserveDeficienc.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized storm costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DeferredTaxAssetsCapitalLossCarryforward.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Capital Loss Carryforwards
DeferredTaxAssetsCapitalLossCarryforward.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible capital loss carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsCharitableContributionC.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Charitable Contribution Carryforwards
DeferredTaxAssetsCharitableContributionC.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible charitable contribution carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsDeferredGainOnSaleLease.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Deferred Gain on Sale Leaseback Transaction
DeferredTaxAssetsDeferredGainOnSaleLease.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from a gain reported for tax purposes on sale and leaseback transactions in accordance with enacted tax laws.

DeferredTaxAssetsDeferredIncome.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from deferred income.

DeferredTaxAssetsDerivativeInstruments.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from derivative instruments.

DeferredTaxAssetsEquityMethodInvestments.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Equity Method Investments
DeferredTaxAssetsEquityMethodInvestments.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from equity method investments.

DeferredTaxAssetsGross.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsHedgingTransactions.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from hedging transactions.

DeferredTaxAssetsInProcessResearchAndDev.l: Deferred Tax Asset, In-Process Research and Development
DeferredTaxAssetsInProcessResearchAndDev.d: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from in-process research and development cost acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

DeferredTaxAssetsInventory.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from inventory.

DeferredTaxAssetsInvestmentInSubsidiarie.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Investment in Subsidiaries
DeferredTaxAssetsInvestmentInSubsidiarie.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the entity's investment in its wholly-owned subsidiaries.

DeferredTaxAssetsAndLiabilitiesOfInsuran.l: Deferred Tax Assets and Liabilities of Insurance Companies [Abstract]

DeferredTaxAssetsLiabilitiesNet.d: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

DeferredTaxAssetsNet.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance
DeferredTaxAssetsNet.d: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Components [Abstract]
Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Domestic
DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible domestic operating loss carryforwards. Excludes state and local operating loss carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Foreign
DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible foreign operating loss carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, State and Local
DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible state and local operating loss carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsOther.d: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

DeferredTaxAssetsOtherComprehensiveLoss.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Other Comprehensive Loss
DeferredTaxAssetsOtherComprehensiveLoss.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from unrealized losses in other comprehensive income.

DeferredTaxAssetsOtherLossCarryforwards.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Other Loss Carryforwards
DeferredTaxAssetsOtherLossCarryforwards.d: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible loss carryforwards, classified as other.

DeferredTaxAssetsOtherTaxCarryforwards.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Other Tax Carryforwards
DeferredTaxAssetsOtherTaxCarryforwards.d: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible tax carryforwards, classified as other.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxCreditCarryforwards.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxCreditCarryforwards.d: Amount, before allocation of a valuation allowances, of deferred tax assets attributable to deductible tax credit carryforwards including, but not limited to, research, foreign, general business, alternative minimum tax, and other deductible tax credit carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxCreditCarryforwardsA.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards [Abstract]
Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Alternative Minimum Tax
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxCreditCarryforwardsA.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible alternative minimum tax credit carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxCreditCarryforwardsF.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Foreign
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxCreditCarryforwardsF.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible foreign tax credit carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxCreditCarryforwardsG.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, General Business
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxCreditCarryforwardsG.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible general business tax credit carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxCreditCarryforwardsO.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Other
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxCreditCarryforwardsO.d: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible tax credit carryforwards, classified as other.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxCreditCarryforwardsR.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Research
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxCreditCarryforwardsR.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible research tax credit carryforwards.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpense.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpense.d: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowances, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences from reserves and accruals, compensation and benefit costs, and other provisions, reserves, and allowances.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseAbstr.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense [Abstract]

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensation and benefits costs.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits [Abstract]
Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Compensated Absences
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensated absences (includes, but not limited to, sick and personal days).

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Benefits
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.d: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee benefits, classified as other.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Bonuses
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee bonuses.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Compensation
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee compensation.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Other
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.d: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensation and benefits, classified as other.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Pensions
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from pension benefits.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Postretirement Benefits
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from postretirement benefits.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Severance Payments
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from severance costs.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Share-Based Compensation Cost
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseCompe.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from share-based compensation.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseOther.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Other
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseOther.d: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from provisions, reserves, allowances, and accruals, classified as other.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseReser.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseReser.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves and accruals.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseReser.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals [Abstract]
Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Accrued Liabilities
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseReser.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from accrued liabilities.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseReser.l: Deferred Tax Asset, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserve and Accrual, Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseReser.d: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseReser.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from asset retirement obligations.
