ExplorationExpense.d: Exploration expenses (including prospecting) related to oil and gas producing entities and would be included in operating expenses of that entity. Costs incurred in identifying areas that may warrant examination and in examining specific areas that are considered to have prospects of containing oil and gas reserves, including costs of drilling exploratory wells and exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells. Exploration costs may be incurred both before acquiring the related property (sometimes r

ExplorationAndProductionEquipmentMember.d: Equipment used in the process of surveying, preparing land for the extraction of natural resources and extracting natural resources.

ExplosionMember.d: Release of mechanical, chemical, or nuclear energy in a sudden and often violent manner.

ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualWarranties.l: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase for Warranties Issued
ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualWarranties.d: Amount of increase in the extended product warranty accrual from warranties issued. Excludes standard product warranties.

ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrual.d: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate extended product warranty liability. Does not include the ending balance for the standard product warranty liability.

ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualCurrent.d: Amount at end of the reporting period of the aggregate extended product warranty liability that is expected to be paid within one year of the balance sheet date or normal operating cycle, if longer. Does not include the balance for the standard product warranty liability.

ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualAdditionsF.l: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase from Business Combination
ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualAdditionsF.d: Amount of increase in liability for extended product warranty acquired in business combination. Excludes liability for standard warranty acquired in business combination.

ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualNoncurrent.d: Amount at end of the reporting period of the aggregate extended product warranty liability that is expected to be paid after one year from the balance sheet date or normal operating cycle, if longer. Does not include the balance for the standard product warranty liability.

ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualPeriodIncr.l: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualPeriodIncr.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in the extended product warranty liability. Excludes standard product warranties.

ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualPreexistin.l: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties
ExtendedProductWarrantyAccrualPreexistin.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in the extended product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties. Excludes standard product warranties.

ExtendedProductWarrantyDescription.d: Describes the nature of the extended product warranties, which generally require additional fees to be paid by the buyer, and other guarantee contracts excluded from the initial recognition and initial measurement requirements. Does not include disclosures for standard product warranties, which typically have substantially shorter periods of time or provide less coverage, or both.

ExtendedProductWarrantyPolicy.l: Extended Product Warranty, Policy [Policy Text Block]
ExtendedProductWarrantyPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for extended product warranties and other guarantee contracts including the methodology for measuring the liability.

ExtinguishmentOfDebtGainLossIncomeTax.l: Extinguishment of Debt, Gain (Loss), Income Tax
ExtinguishmentOfDebtGainLossIncomeTax.d: Current period income tax expense or benefit pertaining to a gain (loss) on an extinguishment of debt.

ExtinguishmentOfDebtGainLossNetOfTax.l: Extinguishment of Debt, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax
ExtinguishmentOfDebtGainLossNetOfTax.d: The difference between the reacquisition price and the net carrying amount of the extinguished debt recognized currently as a component of income in the period of extinguishment, net of tax.

ExtinguishmentOfDebtGainLossPerShareNetO.l: Extinguishment of Debt, Gain (Loss), Per Share, Net of Tax
ExtinguishmentOfDebtGainLossPerShareNetO.d: Per share impact of the gain (loss) on the extinguishment of debt, net of applicable taxes.

ExtinguishmentOfDebtAxis.d: Information by type of debt extinguished.

ExtinguishmentOfDebtLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ScheduleOfExtinguishmentOfDebtTable.d: Disclosure of information about debt extinguishment. Includes, but is not limited to, gain (loss) on extinguished debt, income tax effect on gain (loss), and gain (loss) after income tax.

DischargeOfDebtMember.l: Reorganization, Chapter 11, Discharge of Debt Adjustment [Member]
DischargeOfDebtMember.d: Extinguishment of liabilities subject to compromise (under the plan of reorganization) including cash payments, issuance of new debt, issuance of new stock, and gain on debt discharge.

ExtinguishmentOfDebtNatureOfRestrictions.l: Extinguishment of Debt, Nature of Restrictions on Assets Set Aside for Scheduled Payments
ExtinguishmentOfDebtNatureOfRestrictions.d: Describes restrictions on any assets set aside solely for the purpose of satisfying scheduled payments of a specific obligation, thus freeing the obligor of the responsibility for making payments.

CommitmentsToCompleteContractsInProcess.l: Commitments to Complete Contracts in Process (Deprecated 2026)
CommitmentsToCompleteContractsInProcess.d: General description of commitments which may be required in performing under a construction-type contract which are outside the ordinary course of business at the balance sheet date.

FederalHousingAdministrationLoanMember.d: Loans obtained through the Federal Housing Administration, which typically require a lower down payment and lower credit rating than conventional loans.

FIFOInventoryAmount.d: The amount of FIFO (first in first out) inventory present at the reporting date when inventory is also valued using different valuation methods.

FairValueOfAssetsAcquired.d: The fair value of assets acquired in noncash investing or financing activities.

FairValueOfFinancialInstrumentsPolicy.l: Fair Value of Financial Instruments, Policy [Policy Text Block]
FairValueOfFinancialInstrumentsPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining the fair value of financial instruments.

FairValueHedgeAssetsAtFairValue.d: Fair value of all derivative assets designated as fair value hedging instruments.

FairValueHedgeIneffectivenessIsImmateria.l: Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness is Immaterial Assertion (Deprecated 2025)
FairValueHedgeIneffectivenessIsImmateria.d: Entity discloses that the amount of fair value hedge ineffectiveness is immaterial.

FairValueHedgeLiabilitiesAtFairValue.d: Fair value of all derivative liabilities designated as fair value hedging instruments.

FairValueHedgesAtFairValueNet.d: Net fair value of all derivative instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments.

FairValueOfSecuritiesReceivedAsCollatera.l: Fair Value of Securities Received as Collateral that Can be Resold or Repledged
FairValueOfSecuritiesReceivedAsCollatera.d: Fair value of collateral permitted, by contact or custom, to be sold or re-pledged.

FairValueOfSecuritiesReceivedAsCollatera.l: Fair Value of Securities Received as Collateral that Have Been Resold or Repledged
FairValueOfSecuritiesReceivedAsCollatera.d: Fair value of the collateral, or portion thereof, that has been re-pledged, delivered, or otherwise used.

FavorableRegulatoryActionMember.d: A potential favorable financial consequence resulting from a change in rules or regulations, excluding tax matters.

FederalFundsPurchasedAndSecuritiesSoldUn.l: Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
FederalFundsPurchasedAndSecuritiesSoldUn.d: Amount after offset of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank and securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

FederalFundsPurchasedAndSecuritiesSoldUn.l: Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase [Abstract]

FederalFundsPurchased.d: Amount of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank.

FederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesPurchasedUn.l: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
FederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesPurchasedUn.d: Includes: (1) the amount outstanding of funds lent to other depository institutions, securities brokers, or securities dealers in the form of Federal Funds sold; for example, immediately available funds lent under agreements or contracts that mature in one business day or roll over under a continuing contract, regardless of the nature of the transaction or the collateral involved, excluding overnight lending for commercial and industrial purposes. Also include Federal Funds sold under agreements

FederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesPurchasedUn.l: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell [Abstract]

FederalFundsSold.d: The amount outstanding of funds lent to other depository institutions, securities brokers, or securities dealers in the form of Federal Funds sold; for example, immediately available funds lent under agreements or contracts that mature in one business day or roll over under a continuing contract, regardless of the nature of the transaction or the collateral involved, excluding overnight lending for commercial and industrial purposes. Also include Federal Funds sold under agreements to resell on

SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.l: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.d: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes purchases of participations in pools of securities that are subject to a resale agreement, assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesActivityForYe.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Activity for Year [Abstract]
Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Activity for Year, Average Balance of Agreements Outstanding
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesActivityForYe.d: The calculated average balance outstanding for the year for all Federal Home Loan Bank advances as of the Balance Sheet date.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesActivityForYe.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Activity for Year, Average Interest Rate for Year
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesActivityForYe.d: The calculated weighted average interest rate for Federal Home Loan Bank advances for the period ended as of the Balance Sheet date.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesActivityForYe.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Activity for Year, Average Interest Rate at Period End
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesActivityForYe.d: The calculated weighted average interest rate for Federal Home Loan Bank advances outstanding as of the Balance Sheet date.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesActivityForYe.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Activity for Year, Maximum Outstanding at any Month End
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesActivityForYe.d: The maximum balance outstanding at any month end during the period as of the Balance Sheet date.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesDisclosureTex.l: Federal Home Loan Bank Advances, Disclosure [Text Block]
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesDisclosureTex.d: The entire disclosure for borrowing from the Federal Home Loan Bank, including: (i) general description; (ii) title and nature of obligation; (iii) interest rate; (iv) payment terms; (v) maturity dates by year; (vi) collateral requirements; (vii) restrictive covenants; (viii) priority; (ix) conversion or redemption features; (x) carrying value of assets pledged as collateral; (xi) combined aggregate maturities for next five years; (xii) unused or available balances.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Disclosures [Abstract]
Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Amount of Available, Unused Funds
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.d: Amount of advances or credit lines available from the Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Disclosures, Conversion Features
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.d: Describes the conversion features of Federal Home Loan Bank advances as of the Balance Sheet date. Such features may include conversion from fixed to floating interest rates, from short to intermediate maturities, etc.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Disclosures, Description of Collateral Pledged
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.d: Describes the collateral pledged in support of Federal Home Loan Bank advances outstanding as of the Balance Sheet date.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Disclosures, General Description of Terms
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.d: Describes the general term and nature of the advances from the Federal Home Loan Bank outstanding as of the Balance Sheet date.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Disclosures, Interest Rate at Period End
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.d: States the interest rate applicable to Federal Home Loan Bank advances outstanding as of the Balance Sheet date.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Maximum Amount Available
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.d: Amount of maximum advances or credit lines available from the Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesLongTerm.l: Long-Term Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesLongTerm.d: Including both current and noncurrent portions, Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings initially due beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Advance from Federal Home Loan Bank, Fiscal Year Maturity [Abstract]
Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, after Year Five
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, Year Five
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, Year Two
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, Year Four
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, Year Three
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, Year One
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Advance from Federal Home Loan Bank, by Interest Rate Type, by Maturity [Abstract]
Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, after Year Five [Abstract]
Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, Fixed Rate
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) advances which have fixed interest.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Fixed Rate, after Year Five
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with fixed interest rate maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Fixed Rate, after Year One Through Five
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with fixed interest rate maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Fixed Rate, Year One
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with fixed interest rate maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, Floating Rate
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) advances which have floating interest rates.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Floating Rate, after Year Five
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with floating interest rate maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Floating Rate, after Year One Through Five
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with floating interest rate maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Floating Rate, Year One
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with floating interest rate maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, after Year One Through Five
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, after Year One Through Five [Abstract]
Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, after Year Five
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year Five
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year Two
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year Four
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year Three
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year One
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturitiesSum.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMember.d: Borrowings from the Federal Home Loan Bank, which are primarily used to cover shortages in the required reserve balance and also in times of liquidity shortages. The member institution executes a promissory note, which is generally collateralized by government securities to the Federal Reserve or loans.

ScheduleOfFederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesByB.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Branch of FHLBank [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfFederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesByB.d: Tabular disclosure of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesBranchOfFHLBB.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Branch of FHLBank, Amount
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesBranchOfFHLBB.d: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesBranchOfFHLBB.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Branch of FHLBank, Interest Rate
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesBranchOfFHLBB.d: Rate of interest applicable on advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesBranchOfFHLBB.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Branch of FHLBank [Line Items]
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesBranchOfFHLBB.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ScheduleOfFederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesByB.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Branch of FHLBank [Table]
ScheduleOfFederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesByB.d: Disclosure of information about advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

FederalHomeLoanBankStock.d: Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock represents an equity interest in a FHLB. It does not have a readily determinable fair value because its ownership is restricted and it lacks a market (liquidity).

DomesticCountryMember.d: Designated federal jurisdiction entitled to levy and collect income tax in country of domicile. Includes, but is not limited to, national jurisdiction for non-U.S. jurisdiction.

FeeIncomeOnAcceptancesExecuted.d: Amount of amortization to income from discounts on short-term negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by an institution (also known as Banker's Acceptances).

AgriculturalRelatedInventoryFeedAndSuppl.l: Agricultural Related Inventory, Feed and Supplies
AgriculturalRelatedInventoryFeedAndSuppl.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of materials capitalized as inventory because of their use in the growth and maintenance of animals and crops.

PaymentsForFees.d: Amount of cash outflow for fees classified as other.

FeesPaidOnAcceptancesResold.d: Represents the amortization to expense from discounts on short-term negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by an institution (also known as Banker's Acceptances) which have been resold in the secondary market.

ProceedsFromFeesReceived.d: Cash received for fees during the current period. This element excludes cash proceeds from license fees.

FinancialStandbyLetterOfCreditMember.d: An irrevocable undertaking (typically by a financial institution) to guarantee payment of a specified financial obligation if defined events occur or fail to occur.

FinancialStatementPresentationWhileInCha.l: Financial Statement Presentation While in Chapter 11 [Abstract]

PaymentsOfFinancingCosts.d: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.

FinancingInterestExpense.d: This element represents interest incurred for borrowed money which was used to produce goods or render services.

InventoryFinishedGoodsAndWorkInProcess.l: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Gross
InventoryFinishedGoodsAndWorkInProcess.d: Amount before valuation reserves of merchandise or goods held by the entity that are readily available for sale and items held by the entity which are partially complete or in the process of being readied for sale.

InventoryFinishedGoodsAndWorkInProcessAb.l: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Gross [Abstract]

InventoryFinishedHomes.d: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of homes that have been finished and are ready for sale, net of valuation allowance and impairment loss.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAmortizationM.d: Description of method used to amortize finite-lived intangible asset.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorClassA.d: Information by class of finite-lived intangible asset.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsFutureAmortiz.l: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, after Accumulated Amortization, Estimated Amortization Expense, Fiscal Year Maturity [Abstract]

FireMember.d: Oxidation process that releases energy in the form of light and heat (flames) and often creates smoke.

FirstMortgageMember.d: Loan secured by real property that has a first (highest) lien on such property in the event of default by the borrower.

FixedIncomeSecuritiesMember.d: Investment that provides a return in the form of fixed periodic payments and eventual return of principal at maturity.

FixedRateResidentialMortgageMember.d: Loan to purchase or refinance residential real estate such as a home, in which the real estate itself serves as collateral for the loan and in which the interest rate and the amount of each payment remain constant throughout the life of the loan.

FlightEquipmentMember.d: Equipment used in the in-flight operation of the aircraft.

FloodMember.d: Overflowing of a body of water.

FloorBrokerage.d: Broker-dealers often use other brokers to execute trades on their behalf. The trading broker-dealer becomes a customer of the executing broker-dealer and pays a floor brokerage fee. Such fees are paid periodically either directly to the executing broker-dealer or through a clearing house.

FloorBrokeragePolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for the recognition and recording of fees paid to other broker dealers for executing trades. Broker-dealers often use other brokers to execute trades on their behalf. The trading broker-dealer becomes a customer of the executing broker-dealer and pays a floor brokerage fee. Such fees are paid periodically either directly to the executing broker-dealer or through a clearinghouse. These include fees paid to clearing brokers and market specialists.

FloorBrokerageExchangeAndClearanceFees.l: Floor Brokerage, Exchange and Clearance Fees
FloorBrokerageExchangeAndClearanceFees.d: The amount of expense during the period for floor brokerage fees paid to other broker-dealers to execute trades on their behalf, stock exchange fees, order flow fees, and clearance fees.

FloorBrokerageExchangeAndClearanceFeesAb.l: Floor Brokerage, Exchange and Clearance Fees [Abstract]

ForeignCurrencyCashFlowHedgeAssetAtFairV.l: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Asset at Fair Value
ForeignCurrencyCashFlowHedgeAssetAtFairV.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivative assets designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

ForeignCurrencyCashFlowHedgeDerivativeAt.l: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net
ForeignCurrencyCashFlowHedgeDerivativeAt.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

ForeignCurrencyCashFlowHedgeIneffectiven.l: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness is Immaterial (Deprecated 2025)
ForeignCurrencyCashFlowHedgeIneffectiven.d: Assertion that the amount of foreign currency cash flow hedge ineffectiveness is immaterial.

ForeignCurrencyCashFlowHedgeLiabilityAtF.l: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Liability at Fair Value
ForeignCurrencyCashFlowHedgeLiabilityAtF.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivative liabilities designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

ForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstrumentsNotD.l: Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments [Abstract]
Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Asset at Fair Value
ForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstrumentsNotD.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivative assets not designated as hedging instruments.

ForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstrumentsNotD.l: Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments at Fair Value, Net
ForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstrumentsNotD.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

ForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstrumentsNotD.l: Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Liability at Fair Value
ForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstrumentsNotD.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivative liabilities not designated as hedging instruments.

ForeignCurrencyDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for foreign currency transactions and translation. This may include description of foreign currency transactions, foreign currency gains and losses, explanation of change in cumulative translation adjustment, description of effect of subsequent foreign currency exchange rate change, cumulative translation adjustment movement, foreign currency translation adjustment by component movement, translation adjustment for net investment hedge movement, adjustment for long-term inte

ForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeAssetAtFair.l: Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Asset at Fair Value
ForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeAssetAtFair.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative assets designated as foreign currency fair value hedging instruments.

ForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeDerivativeA.l: Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net
ForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeDerivativeA.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivatives designated as foreign currency fair value hedging instruments.

ForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeLiabilityAt.l: Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Liability at Fair Value
ForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeLiabilityAt.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities designated as foreign currency fair value hedging instruments.

ForeignCurrencyTransactionsAndTranslatio.l: Foreign Currency Transactions and Translations Policy [Policy Text Block]
ForeignCurrencyTransactionsAndTranslatio.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for (1) transactions denominated in a currency other than the reporting enterprise's functional currency, (2) translating foreign currency financial statements that are incorporated into the financial statements of the reporting enterprise by consolidation, combination, or the equity method of accounting, and (3) remeasurement of the financial statements of a foreign reporting enterprise in a hyperinflationary economy.

ForeignCurrencyTranslationAdjustmentByCo.l: Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, by Component [Abstract]

ForeignGovernmentDebtSecuritiesMember.d: Debt security issued by government not domiciled in United States of America (US).

ForeignExchangeFutureMember.d: A standardized contract, traded on a futures exchange, to buy or sell a certain currency, at a specified future date, at a fixed exercise rate (expressed as an exchange).

ForeignExchangeOptionMember.d: An option that allows the holder to buy (if call) or sell (if put) an underlying currency at a fixed exercise rate, expressed as an exchange, during a specified period (an American option) or at a specified date (a European option).

ForeignCountryMember.d: Designated foreign jurisdiction entitled to levy and collect income tax outside country of domicile.

ForeignReinsuranceTransactions.d: Explanation of the reinsurance purpose, transaction type and accounting treatment of reinsurance transactions executed outside the United States. Information provided may include the nature of the contingent liability in connection with insurance ceded and the nature and effect of material nonrecurring reinsurance transactions.

ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsClaimsAddi.l: Foreign Reinsurance Transactions, Claims Additions to Underwriting Balances
ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsClaimsAddi.d: The amount for insured risks paid or due and owing to the ceding entity, recorded as additions to net premiums written minus net losses paid minus the sum of loss adjustment expenses and underwriting costs and expenses on insurance ceded to companies outside the United States.

ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsClaimsReco.l: Foreign Reinsurance Transactions, Claims Recognized as Income
ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsClaimsReco.d: Amounts for insured risks on policies that have been ceded to entities outside the United States and for which claims income is paid or due and owing to the ceding entity.

ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsExpenseAdd.l: Foreign Reinsurance Transactions, Expense Additions to Underwriting Balances
ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsExpenseAdd.d: The amount of expenses on insured risks paid or due and owing to the ceding entity, recorded as additions to net premiums written minus net losses paid minus the sum of loss adjustment expenses and underwriting costs and expenses on insurance ceded to companies outside the United States.

ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsExpenseRec.l: Foreign Reinsurance Transactions, Expense Recognized as Income
ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsExpenseRec.d: The amount of insurance policy expenses on insurance that has been ceded to companies outside the United States and for which amounts are paid or due and owing from those foreign companies.

ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsPremiumAdd.l: Foreign Reinsurance Transactions, Premium Additions to Underwriting Balances
ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsPremiumAdd.d: The amount recorded as additions to net premiums written minus net losses paid minus the sum of loss adjustment expenses and underwriting costs and expenses on insurance ceded to companies outside the United States.

ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsPremiumsRe.l: Foreign Reinsurance Transactions, Premiums Recognized as Income
ForeignReinsuranceTransactionsPremiumsRe.d: The amount recorded as income on insurance ceded to companies outside the United States.

ForeignReinsuranceUnderOpenYearMethodAbs.l: Foreign Reinsurance under Open Year Method [Abstract]

ForeignReinsuranceUnderOpenYearMethodCom.l: Foreign Reinsurance under Open Year Method Comment (Deprecated 2025)
ForeignReinsuranceUnderOpenYearMethodCom.d: Methodology and assumptions regarding insurance assumed by insurance entities outside the United States for which the open year method of accounting for these contracts is being used (premiums are included in the underwriting account when they become reasonably determinable).

ForeignReinsuranceUnderOpenYearMethodExp.l: Foreign Reinsurance under Open Year Method, Expense
ForeignReinsuranceUnderOpenYearMethodExp.d: Amount of foreign reinsurance expenses accounted for under the open year method in the underwriting account.

ForeignReinsuranceUnderOpenYearMethodPre.l: Foreign Reinsurance under Open Year Method, Premiums
ForeignReinsuranceUnderOpenYearMethodPre.d: Amount of foreign reinsurance premiums accounted for under the open year method in the underwriting account.

ForeignReinsuranceUnderOpenYearMethodCla.l: Foreign Reinsurance under Open Year Method, Claims
ForeignReinsuranceUnderOpenYearMethodCla.d: Amount of foreign reinsurance claims accounted for under the open year method in the underwriting account.

ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquityTyp.l: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Type [Axis]
ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquityTyp.d: Information by type of forward contract issued by the entity, that is indexed to, and potentially settled in an entity's own stock.

ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquityLin.l: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity [Line Items]
ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquityLin.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquityTab.l: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity [Table]
ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquityTab.d: Disclosure of information about forward contract issued and indexed to issuer's own equity. Includes, but is not limited to, forward contract rate, number of shares, indexed share, settlement date, settlement alternative, classification, and redemption requirement.

ForwardContractsMember.d: Contracts negotiated between two parties to purchase and sell a specific quantity of a financial instrument, foreign currency, or commodity at a price specified at origination of the contract, with delivery and settlement at a specified future date.

FossilFuelPlantMember.d: Plant used in connection with the fossil fuel generation of electricity.

FranchiseRightsMember.d: Rights, generally of limited duration, that the entity has obtained through a franchise arrangement to operate a business using another company's name, merchandise, services, methodologies, promotional support, marketing and supplies.

FreshStartAdjustmentsTypeOfFreshStartAdj.d: Information by adjustment for effect of reorganization under Chapter 11 of Bankruptcy Code. Includes, but is not limited to, adjustment for reorganization plan effect and adoption of fresh-start reporting.

FreshStartAdjustmentsTable.d: Disclosure of information about reorganization under Chapter 11 of Bankruptcy Code.

TypeOfFreshStartAdjustmentDomain.d: Adjustment for effect of reorganization under Chapter 11 of Bankruptcy Code. Includes, but is not limited to, adjustment for reorganization plan effect and adoption of fresh-start reporting.

FundsHeldUnderReinsuranceAgreementsLiabi.l: Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements, Liability
FundsHeldUnderReinsuranceAgreementsLiabi.d: Amount of funds held as security for payments to be received under reinsurance contracts.

AssetsHeldInTrustCurrent.d: The amount of cash, securities, or other assets held by a third-party trustee pursuant to the terms of an agreement which assets are available to be used by beneficiaries to that agreement only within the specific terms thereof and which agreement is expected to terminate within one year of the balance sheet date (or operating cycle, if longer) at which time the assets held-in-trust will be released or forfeited.

AssetsHeldInTrustNoncurrent.d: The amount of cash, securities, or other assets held by a third-party trustee pursuant to the terms of an agreement which assets are available to be used by beneficiaries to that agreement only within the specific terms thereof and which agreement is expected to terminate more than one year from the balance sheet date (or operating cycle, if longer) at which time the assets held-in-trust will be released or forfeited.

AssetsHeldInTrust.d: The total amount of cash and securities held by third party trustees pursuant to terms of debt instruments or other agreements as of the date of each statement of financial position presented, which can be used by the trustee only to pay the noncurrent portion of specified obligations.

FurnitureAndFixturesGross.d: Amount before accumulated depreciation of equipment commonly used in offices and stores that have no permanent connection to the structure of a building or utilities. Examples include, but are not limited to, desks, chairs, tables, and bookcases.

FurnitureAndFixturesMember.d: Equipment commonly used in offices and stores that have no permanent connection to the structure of a building or utilities. Examples include, but are not limited to, desks, chairs, tables, and bookcases.

FutureMember.d: Futures contracts are forward-based contracts to make or take delivery of a specified financial instrument, foreign currency, or commodity at a specified future date or during a specified period at as specified price or yield. Futures are standardized contracts traded on an organized exchange.

IncreaseDecreaseInFuturePolicyBenefitRes.l: Increase (Decrease) in Future Policy Benefit Reserves
IncreaseDecreaseInFuturePolicyBenefitRes.d: The change in the future policy benefit reserve balance on the balance sheet.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsMethodol.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Methodology and Assumptions
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsMethodol.d: Methodology and assumptions for accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events, and can be viewed as either (a) the present value of future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and expenses less the present value of future net premiums payable under the insurance contracts or (b) the accumulated amount of net premiums already collected less the accumulated amount of benefits and expenses already paid to or on behalf of policyholders.

FuturePolicyBenefitsLiabilityPolicy.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit [Policy Text Block]
FuturePolicyBenefitsLiabilityPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for liability for future benefit to be paid to or on behalf of policyholder. Includes, but is not limited to, input, judgment, assumption, and method used in measuring liability and change in input, judgment, and assumption.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefits.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, before Reinsurance
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefits.d: Amount, before effect of reinsurance, of present value of future benefit to be paid to or on behalf of policyholder and related expense less present value of future net premium receivable under insurance contract.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsDisabili.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Disability and Accident Benefits (Deprecated 2024)
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsDisabili.d: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under disability and accident insurance contracts.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsAndUnpai.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefits and Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsAndUnpai.d: The aggregate amount of policy reserves (provided for future obligations including unpaid claims and claims adjustment expenses) and policy benefits (liability for future policy benefits) as of the balance sheet date; grouped amount of all the liabilities associated with the company's insurance policies.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsIndividu.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Individual and Group Annuities and Supplementary Contracts (Deprecated 2024)
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsIndividu.d: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under individual and group annuities and supplementary insurance contracts.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsLife.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Life (Deprecated 2024)
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsLife.d: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under long-term life insurance contracts.

MovementInLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefi.l: Movement in Liability for Future Policy Benefits [Roll Forward]
MovementInLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefi.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsOtherCon.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Other Contracts (Deprecated 2024)
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsOtherCon.d: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under other insurance contracts.

GainContingenciesByNatureAxis.d: Information by nature of gain contingency.

GainContingenciesLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

GainContingenciesTable.d: Disclosure of information about existing condition, situation, or set of circumstances involving uncertainty as to possible gain that will ultimately be resolved when one or more future events occur or fail to occur.

GainContingencyNatureDomain.d: Describes any existing condition, situation, or set of circumstances involving uncertainty as of the balance sheet date (or before issuance of the financial statements) that might result in a gain, typically reflecting care to avoid misleading implications as to the likelihood of realization.

FormerGainContingencyRecognizedInCurrent.l: Former Gain Contingency, Recognized in Current Period
FormerGainContingencyRecognizedInCurrent.d: Amount of gain recognized in the period that had been disclosed in prior periods as a contingent gain.

GainContingencyUnrecordedAmount.d: The amount or range of possible amounts of gain that could be realized upon the resolution of a contingency.

GainFromComponentsExcludedFromAssessment.l: Gain from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness
GainFromComponentsExcludedFromAssessment.d: The gain relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

GainFromComponentsExcludedFromAssessment.l: Gain from Components Excluded from Assessment of Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness
GainFromComponentsExcludedFromAssessment.d: Gain relating to components of the gain (loss) on the fair value hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

GainFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyin.l: Gain from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge
GainFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyin.d: Amount of gain recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as a fair value hedge.

GainLossOnCondemnation.d: The gain (loss) is the pre-tax difference between the net condemnation award and the entity's adjusted basis of the condemned property.

GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax.l: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments, Net, Pretax
GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax.d: Aggregate net gain (loss) on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets.l: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment, Excluding Oil and Gas Property and Timber Property
GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets.d: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, excluding oil and gas property and timber property.

GainLossOnSaleOfOilAndGasProperty.l: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas Property
GainLossOnSaleOfOilAndGasProperty.d: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of proven and unproven oil and gas properties.

GainLossFromComponentsExcludedFromAssess.l: Gain (Loss) from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness, Net
GainLossFromComponentsExcludedFromAssess.d: The net gain (loss) relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

GainLossFromComponentsExcludedFromAssess.l: Gain (Loss) from Components Excluded from Assessment of Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness, Net
GainLossFromComponentsExcludedFromAssess.d: Net gain (loss) relating to components of the gain (loss) on the fair value hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

GainLossFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQuali.l: Gain (Loss) from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge, Net
GainLossFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQuali.d: Amount of net gain (loss) recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as a fair value hedge.

GainLossFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQuali.l: Gain (Loss) from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge, Net (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQuali.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings when hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as foreign currency fair value hedge.

GainLossFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQuali.l: Gain (Loss) from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge, Net (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQuali.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as an interest rate fair value hedge.

GainLossFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQuali.l: Gain (Loss) from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Price Risk Fair Value Hedge, Net (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQuali.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings when hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as price risk fair value hedge.

GainLossOnDispositionOfIntangibleAssets.l: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Intangible Assets
GainLossOnDispositionOfIntangibleAssets.d: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of intangible assets.

GainLossOnInvestments.d: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

GainLossOnCashFlowHedgeIneffectivenessNe.l: Gain (Loss) on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness, Net (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnCashFlowHedgeIneffectivenessNe.d: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

UnrealizedGainLossOnCashFlowHedgingInstr.l: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Cash Flow Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2025)
UnrealizedGainLossOnCashFlowHedgingInstr.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments, recorded in results of operations to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be ineffective.

GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.l: Gain (Loss) on Components Excluded from Assessment of Credit Risk Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.d: Amount of gain (loss) excluded from the assessment of hedge effectiveness for credit risk hedging instruments.

GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.l: Gain (Loss) on Components Excluded from Assessment of Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.d: Amount of gain (loss) of foreign currency cash flow hedge excluded from assessment of effectiveness and recognized in earnings.

GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.l: Gain (Loss) on Components Excluded from Assessment of Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.d: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period relating to components of the gain (loss) on foreign currency fair value hedging instruments excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness.

GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.l: Gain (Loss) on Components Excluded from Assessment of Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.d: The net gain (loss) included in earnings for the period relating to components of the gain (loss) on interest rate cash flow hedging instruments excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness.

GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.l: Gain (Loss) on Components Excluded from Assessment of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.d: The net gain (loss) included in earnings for the period relating to components of the gain (loss) on interest rate fair value hedging instruments excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness.

GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.l: Gain (Loss) on Components Excluded from Assessment of Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.d: Amount of gain (loss) of price risk cash flow hedge excluded from assessment of effectiveness and recognized in earnings.

GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.l: Gain (Loss) on Components Excluded from Assessment of Price Risk Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.d: The net gain (loss) relating to components of the gain (loss) on price risk fair value hedging instruments excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.l: Gain (Loss) on Components Excluded from Assessment of Price Risk Hedge Effectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnComponentsExcludedFromAssessme.d: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period relating to components of the gain (loss) on price risk hedging instruments excluded from the assessment of hedge effectiveness.

GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowHedge.l: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net
GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowHedge.d: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfForeignCurren.l: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfForeignCurren.d: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings when foreign currency cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfInterestRateC.l: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfInterestRateC.d: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings when interest rate cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfPriceRiskCash.l: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnDiscontinuationOfPriceRiskCash.d: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings when price risk cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

GainLossOnFairValueHedgeIneffectivenessN.l: Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness, Net (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnFairValueHedgeIneffectivenessN.d: Amount of gain (loss)recognized in the income statement from the hedging ineffectiveness of a fair value hedge.

GainLossOnFairValueHedgesRecognizedInEar.l: Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedges Recognized in Earnings
GainLossOnFairValueHedgesRecognizedInEar.d: Total amount of gain (loss) derived from fair value hedges recognized in earnings in the period.

GainLossOnForeignCurrencyCashFlowHedgeIn.l: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnForeignCurrencyCashFlowHedgeIn.d: The net gain (loss) during the reporting period due to ineffectiveness in foreign currency cash flow hedges. Recognized in earnings.

GainLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstr.l: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
GainLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstr.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

UnrealizedGainLossOnForeignCurrencyDeriv.l: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives, Net, before Tax
UnrealizedGainLossOnForeignCurrencyDeriv.d: Amount of net unrealized gain (loss) related to the change in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments. Recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

GainLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivativesReco.l: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives Recorded in Earnings, Net
GainLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivativesReco.d: Aggregate impact of foreign currency derivatives on earnings for the period. Includes impact of foreign currency cash flow hedge ineffectiveness and the ineffectiveness of fair value hedging derivatives and full change in fair value of the foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

GainLossOnForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeD.l: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Derivatives
GainLossOnForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeD.d: Amount of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedge recognized in earnings and from related hedged item to extent that fair value hedge was determined to be effective.

GainLossOnForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeI.l: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnForeignCurrencyFairValueHedgeI.d: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the period due to the ineffectiveness on foreign currency fair value hedges.

GainLossOnInterestRateCashFlowHedgeIneff.l: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnInterestRateCashFlowHedgeIneff.d: Amount of gain (loss) of interest rate cash flow hedge excluded from assessment of effectiveness and recognized in earnings.

GainLossOnInterestRateDerivativeInstrume.l: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
GainLossOnInterestRateDerivativeInstrume.d: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of interest rate derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

GainLossOnInterestRateFairValueHedgeInef.l: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnInterestRateFairValueHedgeInef.d: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the period due to the ineffectiveness on interest rate fair value hedges.

UnrealizedGainLossOnPriceRiskCashFlowDer.l: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Cash Flow Derivatives, before Tax
UnrealizedGainLossOnPriceRiskCashFlowDer.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) arising from the change in fair value of price risk derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income in the period, before taxes, to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

GainLossOnPriceRiskCashFlowHedgeIneffect.l: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnPriceRiskCashFlowHedgeIneffect.d: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the period due to ineffectiveness in price risk cash flow hedges.

GainLossOnPriceRiskDerivativeInstruments.l: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
GainLossOnPriceRiskDerivativeInstruments.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of price risk derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

GainLossOnPriceRiskDerivativesNet.l: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Derivatives, Net
GainLossOnPriceRiskDerivativesNet.d: The aggregate net gain (loss) on price risk derivatives included in earnings in the period.

UnrealizedGainLossOnPriceRiskFairValueHe.l: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Fair Value Hedging Instruments
UnrealizedGainLossOnPriceRiskFairValueHe.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of price risk derivatives instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

GainLossOnPriceRiskFairValueHedgeIneffec.l: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnPriceRiskFairValueHedgeIneffec.d: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the reporting period due to the ineffectiveness of price risk fair value hedges.

GainLossOnPriceRiskHedgeIneffectiveness.l: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainLossOnPriceRiskHedgeIneffectiveness.d: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the reporting period due to the ineffectiveness on price risk cash flow and fair value hedges.

GainLossOnSaleOfNotesReceivable.l: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Financing Receivable
GainLossOnSaleOfNotesReceivable.d: Amount of gain (loss) from sale of financing receivable, including, but not limited to, lease receivable.

GainLossOnSaleOfInterestInProjects.l: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Interest in Projects
GainLossOnSaleOfInterestInProjects.d: Gain (loss) included in earnings resulting from the sale of interest in projects.

GainLossOnSaleOfAccountsReceivable.l: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Accounts Receivable
GainLossOnSaleOfAccountsReceivable.d: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of accounts receivable.

GainLossFromPriceRiskManagementActivity.l: Gain (Loss) from Price Risk Management Activity
GainLossFromPriceRiskManagementActivity.d: Gain (loss) incurred in risk management activities.

GainLossRecognizedOnAssetsTransferredToS.l: Gain (Loss) Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account [Abstract]
Gain (Loss) Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account
GainLossRecognizedOnAssetsTransferredToS.d: Amount of net gains or losses recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

GainLossRelatedToLitigationSettlement.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in settlement of litigation and insurance claims. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyPlantEquipment.l: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment
GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyPlantEquipment.d: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOperationGai.l: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal
DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOperationGai.d: Amount before tax of gain (loss) recognized on the sale or disposal of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

GainLossOnSecuritizationOfFinancialAsset.l: Gain (Loss) on Securitization of Financial Assets
GainLossOnSecuritizationOfFinancialAsset.d: A gain (loss) realized on a transfer, accounted for as a sale, of all or a portion of financial assets in which the transferor surrenders control and receives consideration other than a beneficial interest in the assets transferred. Reflects the amount of sales proceeds in excess of, or deficient from, the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs.

GainOnCashFlowHedgeIneffectiveness.l: Gain on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainOnCashFlowHedgeIneffectiveness.d: The gain recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

GainOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowHedgeDueT.l: Gain on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring
GainOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowHedgeDueT.d: The amount of gain reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

GainOnFairValueHedgeIneffectiveness.l: Gain on Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
GainOnFairValueHedgeIneffectiveness.d: Amount of gain recognized in the income statement from the hedging ineffectiveness of a fair value hedge.

UnrealizedGainOnForeignCurrencyDerivativ.l: Unrealized Gain on Foreign Currency Derivatives, before Tax
UnrealizedGainOnForeignCurrencyDerivativ.d: Amount of unrealized gain related to the increase in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments. Recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

UnrealizedGainOnPriceRiskCashFlowDerivat.l: Unrealized Gain on Price Risk Cash Flow Derivatives, before Tax
UnrealizedGainOnPriceRiskCashFlowDerivat.d: Amount of unrealized gain from the increase in fair value of price risk derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income in the period, before taxes, to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

GainRecognizedOnAssetsTransferredToSepar.l: Gain Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account, Gross
GainRecognizedOnAssetsTransferredToSepar.d: Amount of gain recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebt.d: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

GasDistributionMember.d: System used for the primary purpose of distributing a gas to the consumer.

GasGatheringAndProcessingEquipmentMember.d: Equipment for gathering and processing natural gas.

GasTransmissionMember.d: System used for the primary purpose of transmitting a gas product to the customer.

GasTransmissionEquipmentMember.d: Long lived, depreciable assets used for the primary purpose of transmitting and distributing gas product to the consumer.

GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.d: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

GeneralAndAdministrativeExpenseMember.d: Primary financial statement caption encompassing general and administrative expense.

GeneralBusinessMember.d: Tax credit carryforwards which include, but are not limited to, investment, alcohol fuels, low income housing, alternative fuels, alternative motor vehicles, hurricane relief, disabled access, renewable resources electricity production, employer social security, orphan drug, new markets, employer provided child care facilities and services, biodiesel fuels, low sulfur diesel fuel production, distilled spirits and the advanced nuclear power facilities credit.

GeneralDiscussionOfDerivativeInstruments.l: General Discussion of Derivative Instruments and Hedging Activities
GeneralDiscussionOfDerivativeInstruments.d: Disclosure that addresses (a) how and why an entity uses derivative instruments, (b) how derivative instruments and related hedged items are accounted for, and (c) how derivative instruments affect an entity's financial position, results of operations, and cash flows.

GeneralDiscussionOfDerivativeInstruments.l: General Discussion of Derivative Instruments and Hedging Activities [Abstract]

GeneralDiscussionOfPensionAndOtherPostre.d: Description of nature and type of retirement benefits.

GeneralLiabilityMember.d: Type of business insurance which provides insurance coverage for a wide variety of liability exposures including, but not limited to, contractual liability, product liability and personal injury liability.

GeneralPartnerDistributions.d: Distributions from earnings to the general partner of a partnership included in the consolidated financial statements.

GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountDescription.l: General Partners' Capital Account, Description of Units (Deprecated 2026)
GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountDescription.d: Description of the various rights, preferences, and privileges of the general partners' ownership units including: redemption, conversion, liquidation, tax status of distribution per unit and the sharing in distributions.

GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsOutsta.l: General Partners' Capital Account, Units Outstanding
GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsOutsta.d: The number of general partner units outstanding.

GeneralPartnersCumulativeCashDistributio.d: Aggregate cumulative cash distributions made to the general partner.

GeneralPartnersCumulativeNetIncome.d: Aggregate cumulative earnings allocated to the general partner based on the sharing of income or losses between general and limited partners as specified in the partnership agreement, excluding any priority income allocations resulting from incentive distributions or any special earnings allocations.

GeneralPartnersCapitalAccount.d: The amount of the general partner's ownership interest.

GeographicConcentrationRiskMember.d: Reflects the percentage that a specified dollar value on the balance sheet or income statement in the period from one or more specified geographic areas is to a corresponding consolidated, segment, or product line amount. Risk is the materially adverse effects of economic decline or antagonistic political actions resulting in loss of assets, sales volume, labor supply, or source of materials and supplies in a US state or a specified country, continent, or region such as EMEA (Europe, Middle East

GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsGoodwillPolic.l: Goodwill and Intangible Assets, Goodwill, Policy [Policy Text Block]
GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsGoodwillPolic.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for goodwill. This accounting policy also may address how an entity assesses and measures impairment of goodwill, how reporting units are determined, how goodwill is allocated to such units, and how the fair values of the reporting units are determined.

GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsIntangibleAss.l: Goodwill and Intangible Assets, Intangible Assets, Policy [Policy Text Block]
GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsIntangibleAss.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for intangible assets. This accounting policy may address both intangible assets subject to amortization and those that are not. The following also may be disclosed: (1) a description of intangible assets (2) the estimated useful lives of those assets (3) the amortization method used (4) how the entity assesses and measures impairment of such assets (5) how future cash flows are estimated (6) how the fair values of such asset are determined.

IntangibleAssetsFiniteLivedPolicy.l: Intangible Assets, Finite-Lived, Policy [Policy Text Block]
IntangibleAssetsFiniteLivedPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for finite-lived intangible assets. This accounting policy also might address: (1) the amortization method used; (2) the useful lives of such assets; and (3) how the entity assesses and measures impairment of such assets.

GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsIntangibleAss.l: Goodwill and Intangible Assets, Intangible Assets, Indefinite-Lived, Policy [Policy Text Block]
GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsIntangibleAss.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for indefinite-lived intangible assets (that is, those intangible assets not subject to amortization). This accounting policy also may address how the entity assesses whether events and circumstances continue to support an indefinite useful life and how the entity assesses and measures impairment of such assets.

GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsPolicyTextBlo.l: Goodwill and Intangible Assets, Policy [Policy Text Block]
GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsPolicyTextBlo.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for goodwill and intangible assets. This accounting policy also may address how an entity assesses and measures impairment of goodwill and intangible assets.

GoodwillLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ScheduleOfGoodwillTable.d: Disclosure of information about goodwill, including, but not limited to, change from acquisition, sale, impairment, and other reason.

GovernmentContractsConcentrationRiskMemb.d: Reflects the percentage that revenues in the period from one or more significant customers is to net revenues, as defined by the entity, such as total net revenues, product line revenues, segment revenues. Risk is the materially adverse effects of termination of a significant contract or group of contracts or from future loss of a significant portion of business with a specified political body or unit thereof, such as Department of Defense, US Navy, New York City.

GrantsReceivable.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts due under the terms of governmental, corporate, or foundation grants.

RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciation.l: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Accumulated Depreciation
RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciation.d: Amount of accumulated depreciation pertaining to real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

RealEstateGrossAtCarryingValue.l: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Gross
RealEstateGrossAtCarryingValue.d: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of real estate investment by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate. Excludes real estate not held as investment or interest.

GrossProfit.d: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

AgriculturalRelatedInventoryGrowingCrops.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of agricultural goods that are not yet mature and thus have not yet been harvested.

GuaranteeOfBusinessRevenueMember.d: Contracts that contingently require the indemnifying party (guarantor) to make payments to the indemnified party (guaranteed party) the amount by which the revenue of a specified business (or a specific portion of a business or for a specified product) for a specified period of time is less than a specified amount.

GuaranteeOfIndebtednessOfOthersMember.d: Agreements (contracts) that contingently require the guarantor to make payments of principal and interest to a lender on another party's debt if that party fails to comply with the terms of the borrowing arrangement.

GuaranteeOfScheduledContractualCashFlows.l: Guarantee of Scheduled Contractual Cash Flows from Assets of Transferee [Member]
GuaranteeOfScheduledContractualCashFlows.d: The guarantee of the collection of the scheduled contractual cash flows from individual financial assets held by a transferee.

GuaranteedBenefitLiabilityGrossPeriodInc.l: Liabilities for Guarantees on Long-Duration Contracts, Guaranteed Benefit Liability, Gross, Period Increase (Decrease)
GuaranteedBenefitLiabilityGrossPeriodInc.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in the liability for guaranteed minimum benefits on long-duration contracts.

GuaranteedBenefitLiabilityNet.d: Sum of the amount of expected guaranteed benefits in excess of the projected account balances for minimum guaranteed benefit contracts, as of the balance sheet date, net of reinsurance recoverables, for all guaranteed benefit types.

GuaranteedInterestContracts.d: The amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date pertaining to the guarantee given by the insurance entity to contract holders of a specified rate of return (a guaranteed yield) on their investments for a specified period.

GuaranteedLifetimeWithdrawalBenefitMembe.d: Feature in an insurance contract that allows the contract holder to, at a minimum, withdraw a fixed percentage of the annuity premiums on a periodic basis regardless of market performance for the life of the contract holder.

GuaranteedMinimumAccumulationBenefitMemb.d: Feature in an insurance contract that guarantees a minimum contract value.

GuaranteedMinimumDeathBenefitMember.d: Feature in an insurance contract that guarantees a minimum amount that will be payable upon the death of the insured.
