GuaranteedMinimumIncomeBenefitMember.d: Feature in an insurance contract that provides a guaranteed minimum amount available for annuitization after a specified period, which is in addition to a guaranteed minimum annuity rate.

GuaranteedMinimumWithdrawalBenefitMember.d: Feature in an insurance contract that allows the contract holder to, at a minimum, withdraw a fixed percentage of the annuity premiums on a periodic basis regardless of market performance until the premium is recovered.

GuaranteesIndemnificationsAndWarrantiesP.l: Guarantees, Indemnifications and Warranties Policies [Policy Text Block]
GuaranteesIndemnificationsAndWarrantiesP.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for guarantees, indemnifications and product warranties, and methodologies used in determining the amount of such liabilities.

DerivativeInstrumentsInHedgesAssetsAtFai.l: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Assets, at Fair Value
DerivativeInstrumentsInHedgesAssetsAtFai.d: Aggregate fair value of all derivative assets designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

HedgeDesignationsUsedForForeignCurrencyD.l: Hedge Designations Used for Foreign Currency Derivatives (Deprecated 2025)
HedgeDesignationsUsedForForeignCurrencyD.d: Description of the types of hedge designations that are used for foreign currency derivatives, such as cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, hedge of net investment in foreign operations, or no hedge designation.

HedgeDesignationsUsedForPriceRiskDerivat.l: Hedge Designations Used for Price Risk Derivatives (Deprecated 2025)
HedgeDesignationsUsedForPriceRiskDerivat.d: Description of the types of hedge designations that are used for price risk derivatives, such as cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, hedge of net investment in foreign operations, or no hedge designation.

DerivativeInstrumentsInHedgesLiabilities.l: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Liabilities, at Fair Value
DerivativeInstrumentsInHedgesLiabilities.d: Aggregate fair value of all derivative liabilities designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

DerivativeInstrumentsInHedgesAtFairValue.l: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, at Fair Value, Net
DerivativeInstrumentsInHedgesAtFairValue.d: Aggregate net fair value of all derivative instruments designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

HedgingAssetsCurrent.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from a financial instrument or a contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

HedgingAssetsNoncurrent.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from a financial instrument or a contract used to hedge price changes in underlying assets, and which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

HomeEquityMember.d: Revolving, open-end loan extended under a line of credit and secured by the borrower's residential property.

HurricaneMember.d: Tropical windstorm with sustained winds of 74 miles per hour (119 kilometers per hour).

HybridInstrumentsAtFairValueNet.l: Hybrid Instruments at Fair Value, Net
HybridInstrumentsAtFairValueNet.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of hybrid instruments.

IPOMember.d: First sale of stock by a private company to the public.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentIncomeStatement.l: Property, Plant and Equipment Income Statement Disclosures (Deprecated 2026)
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentIncomeStatement.d: Disclosure of property, plant and equipment income statement elements which may include depreciation, depletion and amortization expense and gains and losses on disposition of long lived assets used in the production of revenue.

GoodwillImpairedFactsAndCircumstancesLea.l: Goodwill, Impaired, Facts and Circumstances Leading to Impairment
GoodwillImpairedFactsAndCircumstancesLea.d: Description of the underlying cause of impairment of goodwill, such as a significant and more than temporary reduction in sales of a business unit.

GoodwillImpairedMethodForFairValueDeterm.l: Goodwill, Impaired, Method for Fair Value Determination
GoodwillImpairedMethodForFairValueDeterm.d: Description of how the fair value of the impaired goodwill of the reporting unit was determined for goodwill valuation purposes.

ImpairedIntangibleAssetFactsAndCircumsta.l: Impaired Intangible Asset, Facts and Circumstances Leading to Impairment (Deprecated 2026)
ImpairedIntangibleAssetFactsAndCircumsta.d: Description of the underlying cause of impairment of the intangible asset, such as loss of value due to technological obsolescence.

ImpairedIntangibleAssetIncomeStatementCl.l: Impaired Intangible Asset, Income Statement Classification (Deprecated 2024)
ImpairedIntangibleAssetIncomeStatementCl.d: The name of the income statement line item caption that includes the intangible asset impairment charge.

ImpairedIntangibleAssetMethodForFairValu.l: Intangible Asset, Impairment, Method for Fair Value Determination
ImpairedIntangibleAssetMethodForFairValu.d: Description of the method used by the entity to determine the fair value of the impaired intangible asset.

ImpairedIntangibleAssetSegmentClassifica.d: The reportable segment in which the impaired intangible asset (excluding goodwill) resides.

ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForUse.l: Long-Lived Asset, Held and Used, Impairment Loss
ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForUse.d: Amount of impairment loss for long-lived asset held and used. Includes, but is not limited to, impairment loss for long-lived asset to be disposed of other than by sale.

ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.l: Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, Amount of Impairment Loss (Deprecated 2026)
ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.d: Loss recognized as a result of the initial and subsequent write-down of a long-lived asset's carrying amount to fair value.

ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.l: Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, Asset Name [Domain]
ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.d: The name of the impaired asset to be disposed of by a method other than sale.

ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.l: Long-Lived Asset, Impaired, to be Disposed of Other than by Sale, Amount
ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.d: Amount of impaired long-lived asset to be disposed of other than by sale. Excludes long-lived asset held for sale and disposed of.

ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.l: Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, Facts and Circumstances Leading to Impairment (Deprecated 2026)
ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.d: A description of the facts and circumstances leading to the impairment of the long-lived asset to be disposed of by a method other than sale.

ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.l: Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, Method for Determining Fair Value (Deprecated 2026)
ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.d: A description of how an entity determined the fair value of the long-lived asset being disposed of by a method other than sale, for example, whether based on a quoted market price, prices for similar assets, or another valuation technique.

ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.l: Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, Segment Classification (Deprecated 2026)
ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.d: The segment in which the impaired long-lived asset being disposed of by a method other than sale is reported.

ImpairmentLossesRelatedToRealEstatePartn.l: Impairment Losses Related to Real Estate Partnerships
ImpairmentLossesRelatedToRealEstatePartn.d: Impairment losses measured as the amount by which the carrying amount of the business or real estate partnerships exceeds the fair value of the business or partnership.

ImpairmentChargeOnReclassifiedAssets.l: Long-Lived Asset, Change to Plan of Sale, Reclassification from Held-for-Sale to Held-and-Used, Impairment Loss
ImpairmentChargeOnReclassifiedAssets.d: Amount of impairment loss for long-lived asset reclassified from held-for-sale to held-and-used due to decision not to sell.

GoodwillImpairmentLoss.d: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

ImpairmentOfInvestments.l: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments
ImpairmentOfInvestments.d: The amount by which the fair value of an investment is less than the amortized cost basis or carrying amount of that investment at the balance sheet date and the decline in fair value is deemed to be other than temporary, before considering whether or not such amount is recognized in earnings or other comprehensive income.

ImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAndUsedAssetN.l: Impaired Long-Lived Assets Held and Used, Asset Name [Domain]
ImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAndUsedAssetN.d: The name of the impaired assets to be held and used by the entity.

ImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAndUsedFactsA.l: Impaired Long-Lived Assets Held and Used, Facts and Circumstances Leading to Impairment (Deprecated 2026)
ImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAndUsedFactsA.d: A description of the facts and circumstances leading to the impairment of the long-lived asset held and used.

ImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAndUsedIncome.l: Impaired Long-Lived Assets Held and Used, Income Statement Classification (Deprecated 2026)
ImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAndUsedIncome.d: Caption in the income statement or the statement of activities that includes the impairment loss for the long-lived asset held and used.

ImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAndUsedMethod.l: Long-Lived Asset, Held and Used, Impairment, Fair Value, Measurement Method
ImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAndUsedMethod.d: Description of method used to measure fair value of long-lived asset held and used to determine impairment.

ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoo.l: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, Impairment Loss
ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoo.d: Amount of impairment loss for finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsToBeDisposedO.l: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets to be Disposed of
ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsToBeDisposedO.d: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long-lived assets held for abandonment, exchange or sale.

ImpairmentOrDisposalOfLongLivedAssetsPol.l: Long-Lived Asset, Excluding Intangible Asset and Goodwill, Impairment and Disposal [Policy Text Block]
ImpairmentOrDisposalOfLongLivedAssetsPol.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for recognizing and measuring the impairment of long-lived assets. An entity also may disclose its accounting policy for long-lived assets to be sold. This policy excludes goodwill and intangible assets.

ImpairmentOfRealEstate.d: The charge against earnings in the period to reduce the carrying amount of real property to fair value.

ImpairmentOrDisposalOfTangibleAssetsDisc.l: Impairment or Disposal of Tangible Assets Disclosure [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

ImpairmentOfTangibleAssetsOtherDescripto.l: Impairment of Tangible Assets, Other Descriptors (Deprecated 2026)
ImpairmentOfTangibleAssetsOtherDescripto.d: Voluntary or miscellaneous disclosures regarding impairment of long-lived assets.

RealEstateImprovements.l: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Improvements
RealEstateImprovements.d: Amount of increase in real estate investments related to improvements for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

InProcessResearchAndDevelopmentPolicy.l: In Process Research and Development, Policy [Policy Text Block]
InProcessResearchAndDevelopmentPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for costs assigned to identifiable tangible and intangible assets of an acquired entity to be used in the research and development activities of the combined enterprise. An entity also may disclose the appraisal method or significant assumptions used to value acquired research and development assets.

IncentiveDistributionDate.d: Date the limited liability company (LLC) managing member or a limited partnership (LP) general partner receives payment of an incentive obligation in cash, stock or units, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

IncentiveDistributionDistributionPerUnit.d: Per-share or per-unit amount of incentive dividend declared and paid to managing member or general partner.

IncentiveDistributionDistributionPerYear.d: Amount of incentive obligation paid in cash or stock during the period to a limited liability corporation managing member or limited partnership general partner.

IncentiveDistributionPaymentsMadeAndMini.l: Incentive Distribution, Payments Made and Minimum Distribution Level (Deprecated 2025)
IncentiveDistributionPaymentsMadeAndMini.d: Incentive distribution payments made to managing members or general partners on a percentage scale, based on amounts in excess of distributions to Limited Liability Corporation or Limited Partnership members or limited partners.

IncentiveDistributionRecipientDomain.d: The managing member or general partner receiving the distribution.

IncentiveDistributionMadeToManagingMembe.d: Information by managing member or partner type.

IncentiveDistributionMadeToManagingMembe.l: Incentive Distribution Made to Managing Member or General Partner [Line Items]
IncentiveDistributionMadeToManagingMembe.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ScheduleOfIncentiveDistributionMadeToMan.l: Partners' Capital, Managing Member or General Partner, Incentive Distribution [Table]
ScheduleOfIncentiveDistributionMadeToMan.d: Disclosure of information about incentive payment in cash, stock, or unit paid to managing member or general partner of limited liability corporation (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

IncentiveDistributionManagingMemberOrGen.l: Incentive Distribution, Managing Member or General Partner [Abstract]

IncentiveDistributionPolicyManagingMembe.l: Incentive Distribution Policy, Managing Member or General Partner, Description [Policy Text Block]
IncentiveDistributionPolicyManagingMembe.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for an incentive policy and the associated accounting for a plan in a limited liability corporation or limited partnership that includes the payment of cash or stock or units to the managing member or general partner.

IncentiveFeeDescription.d: Description of the nature of the payments to managing member or general partner for incentive rights held including the fee rate, basis of calculation, relevant accounting period, whether the fee is paid to an entity other than the managing member or general partner, or if the fee is waived.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperations.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperations.d: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsAbstra.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerDil.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Diluted Share
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerDil.d: The amount of net income (loss) derived from continuing operations during the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerBas.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic Share
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerBas.d: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.l: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.d: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.l: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]
Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.d: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.l: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.d: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.l: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, before Income Tax
DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.d: Amount before tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.l: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, before Income Tax
DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.d: Amount before tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until its disposal.

RealEstatePartnershipInvestmentSubsidiar.l: Real Estate Partnership Investment Subsidiaries, Net Income (Loss) before Tax
RealEstatePartnershipInvestmentSubsidiar.d: Amount, before tax, of net income (loss) derived from real estate held for development and sale, and related investments.

ReinsuranceCostsAndRecoveriesNet.l: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Assumed and Ceded
ReinsuranceCostsAndRecoveriesNet.d: Amount of recovery (expense) related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for policies assumed and ceded.

IncomeTaxCreditsAndAdjustments.d: A credit or adjustment for government or taxing authority authorized decrease in taxes owed as a result of meeting certain tax policy conditions.

IncomeTaxUncertaintiesPolicy.l: Income Tax Uncertainties, Policy [Policy Text Block]
IncomeTaxUncertaintiesPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for tax positions taken in the tax return filed or to be filed for which it is more likely than not that the tax position will not be sustained upon examination by taxing authorities and other types of contingencies related to income taxes.

IncomeTaxContingencyLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

IncomeTaxContingencyTable.d: Disclosure of information about tax positions taken in the tax returns filed or to be filed for which it is more likely than not that the tax position will not be sustained upon examination by taxing authorities and other income tax contingencies. Includes, but is not limited to, interest and penalties, reconciliation of unrecognized tax benefits, unrecognized tax benefits that would affect the effective tax rate, tax years that remain subject to examination by tax jurisdictions, and information

IncomeTaxExaminationIncreaseDecreaseInLi.l: Income Tax Examination, Increase (Decrease) in Liability from Prior Year
IncomeTaxExaminationIncreaseDecreaseInLi.d: The amount the liability recorded for the income tax examination increased or decreased in the current year/accounting period.

IncomeTaxExaminationInterestExpense.d: The amount of estimated interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

IncomeTaxExaminationInterestAccrued.d: The amount of estimated interest accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

IncomeTaxExaminationLiabilityRefundAdjus.l: Income Tax Examination, Liability (Refund) Adjustment from Settlement with Taxing Authority
IncomeTaxExaminationLiabilityRefundAdjus.d: The amount of the additional liability or refund received or expected based on a final settlement with a taxing authority.

IncomeTaxExaminationLikelihoodOfUnfavora.l: Income Tax Examination, Likelihood of Unfavorable Settlement
IncomeTaxExaminationLikelihoodOfUnfavora.d: Description of the likelihood that an uncertainty in income taxes will not be sustained as a result of the examination by the taxing authority.

IncomeTaxExaminationPenaltiesExpense.d: The amount of estimated penalties recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

IncomeTaxExaminationPenaltiesAccrued.d: The amount of estimated penalties accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

IncomeTaxExaminationPenaltiesAndInterest.l: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Expense
IncomeTaxExaminationPenaltiesAndInterest.d: The sum of the amounts of estimated penalties and interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

IncomeTaxExaminationPenaltiesAndInterest.l: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Expense [Abstract]
Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Accrued
IncomeTaxExaminationPenaltiesAndInterest.d: The amount of estimated penalties and interest accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

IncomeTaxExaminationPenaltiesAndInterest.l: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Accrued [Abstract]

IncomeTaxExaminationLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

IncomeTaxExaminationTable.d: Disclosure of information about income tax examination currently in progress or completed during current period by tax authority. Includes, but is not limited to, description of examination, jurisdiction conducting examination, tax year under examination, likelihood of unfavorable settlement, range of possible loss, liability recorded, increase (decrease) of liability from prior period, and penalty and interest incurred or accrued.

FederalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuing.l: Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
FederalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuing.d: Amount of current and deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

ForeignIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuing.l: Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
ForeignIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuing.d: Amount of current and deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations.

OtherIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuingOp.l: Other Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
OtherIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuingOp.d: Amount of other current and other deferred income tax expense (benefit) attributable to continuing operations.

StateAndLocalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitCont.l: State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
StateAndLocalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitCont.d: Amount of current and deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOfDisconti.l: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Discontinued Operation
DiscontinuedOperationTaxEffectOfDisconti.d: Amount of tax expense (benefit) related to a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, tax expense (benefit) related to income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) on disposal, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and tax expense (benefit) related to adjustments of a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

IncomeTaxEffectsAllocatedDirectlyToEquit.l: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity
IncomeTaxEffectsAllocatedDirectlyToEquit.d: The sum of the tax effects of all items occurring during the period that have been charged or credited directly to other comprehensive income or to related components of shareholders' equity.

IncomeTaxEffectsAllocatedDirectlyToEquit.l: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity [Abstract]
Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Cumulative Effect of Change in Accounting Principle
IncomeTaxEffectsAllocatedDirectlyToEquit.d: Amount of cumulative tax effect on beginning retained earnings from change in accounting principle.

IncomeTaxEffectsAllocatedDirectlyToEquit.l: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Other
IncomeTaxEffectsAllocatedDirectlyToEquit.d: The tax effect of items occurring during the period that have been charged or credited directly to components of shareholders' equity and are not otherwise defined.

IncomeTaxEffectsAllocatedDirectlyToEquit.l: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Prior Period Adjustment
IncomeTaxEffectsAllocatedDirectlyToEquit.d: The tax effect of correction of an error charged or credited directly to the opening balance of retained earnings.

IncomeTaxEffectsAllocatedDirectlyToEquit.l: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Equity Transactions
IncomeTaxEffectsAllocatedDirectlyToEquit.d: The tax effect of an increase or decrease in contributed capital (for example, deductible expenditures reported as a reduction of the proceeds from issuing capital stock) during the period charged or credited directly to shareholders' equity.

IncomeTaxHolidayTerminationDate.d: The date on which the special tax status will terminate.

IncomeTaxHolidayIncomeTaxBenefitsPerShar.l: Income Tax Holiday, Income Tax Benefits Per Share
IncomeTaxHolidayIncomeTaxBenefitsPerShar.d: Per share amount effect of the income tax benefit resulting from the income tax holidays granted by taxing jurisdictions.

IncomeTaxHolidayLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

IncomeTaxHolidayTable.d: Disclosure of information about income tax exemption and reduction granted by tax authority for specified period. Includes, but is not limited to, description of factual circumstance for income tax exemption and reduction, date when special tax status terminates, and aggregate dollar and per share effect of tax benefit from income tax exemption and reduction.

IncomeTaxDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for income tax.

UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltie.l: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties Expense
UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltie.d: Amount of expense for penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltie.l: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties Accrued
UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltie.d: Amount of statutory penalties accrued for a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed by the entity, in its tax return.

UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltie.l: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Expense
UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltie.d: Amount of expense for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltie.l: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Accrued
UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltie.d: Amount accrued for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltie.l: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Accrued [Abstract]
Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Expense [Abstract]

IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for income taxes, which may include its accounting policies for recognizing and measuring deferred tax assets and liabilities and related valuation allowances, recognizing investment tax credits, operating loss carryforwards, tax credit carryforwards, and other carryforwards, methodologies for determining its effective income tax rate and the characterization of interest and penalties in the financial statements.

IncomeTaxReceivable.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of income taxes previously overpaid to tax authorities (such as U.S. Federal, state and local tax authorities) representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes. Also called income tax refund receivable.

IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuingOperati.l: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Amount [Abstract]

IncomeTaxReconciliationChangeInEnactedTa.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationChangeInEnactedTa.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to increase (decrease) in the income tax rates.

IncomeTaxReconciliationDeductions.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationDeductions.d: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction. Includes, but is not limited to, dividend deduction, deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy deduction, and other deductions.

IncomeTaxReconciliationDeductionsAbstrac.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Amount [Abstract]

IncomeTaxReconciliationDeductionsDividen.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Dividends, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationDeductionsDividen.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend.

IncomeTaxReconciliationDeductionsExtrate.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Extraterritorial Income Exclusion, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationDeductionsExtrate.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for extraterritorial income exclusion.

IncomeTaxReconciliationDeductionsMedicar.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationDeductionsMedicar.d: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy.

IncomeTaxReconciliationDeductionsOther.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Other, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationDeductionsOther.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other deductions.

IncomeTaxReconciliationDispositionOfAsse.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Asset, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationDispositionOfAsse.d: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to disposition of asset. Includes, but is not limited to, intra-entity transfer of asset other than inventory.

IncomeTaxReconciliationDispositionOfBusi.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Business, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationDispositionOfBusi.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the disposition of a business not qualifying as a discontinued operation.

IncomeTaxReconciliationEquityInEarningsL.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Equity in Earnings (Losses) of Unconsolidated Subsidiary, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationEquityInEarningsL.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to equity in earnings (loss) of unconsolidated subsidiaries exempt from income taxes.

IncomeTaxReconciliationForeignIncomeTaxR.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationForeignIncomeTaxR.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax expense (benefit).

IncomeTaxReconciliationIncomeTaxExpenseB.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationIncomeTaxExpenseB.d: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

IncomeTaxReconciliationMinorityInterestI.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Noncontrolling Interest Income (Loss), Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationMinorityInterestI.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to noncontrolling interest income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amount [Abstract]
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amortization, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible amortization.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Charitable Contributions, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible charitable contributions expense.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depletion, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible depletion.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depreciation, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible depreciation.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depreciation and Amortization, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible depreciation and amortization.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depreciation and Amortization, Amount [Abstract]
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Impairment Losses, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible impairment loss.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Leases, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible lease expense.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Life Insurance, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible life insurance expense.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Meals and Entertainment, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible meals and entertainment expense.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Research and Development, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible research and development expense.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Restructuring Charges, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible restructuring charges.

IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationNondeductibleExpe.d: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

IncomeTaxReconciliationOtherAdjustments.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationOtherAdjustments.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

IncomeTaxReconciliationPriorYearIncomeTa.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Prior Year Income Taxes, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationPriorYearIncomeTa.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income tax expense (benefit).

IncomeTaxReconciliationRepatriationOfFor.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Repatriation of Foreign Earnings, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationRepatriationOfFor.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to repatriation of foreign earnings.

IncomeTaxReconciliationStateAndLocalInco.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationStateAndLocalInco.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax expense (benefit).

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxContingencies.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxContingencies.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in income tax contingencies. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxContingenciesA.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount [Abstract]

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxContingenciesD.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Domestic, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxContingenciesD.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in domestic income tax contingency.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxContingenciesF.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Foreign, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxContingenciesF.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in foreign income tax contingency.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxContingenciesO.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Other, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxContingenciesO.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in other income tax contingencies.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxContingenciesS.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, State and Local, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxContingenciesS.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in state and local income tax contingency.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxCredits.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxCredits.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not limited to, research credit, foreign tax credit, investment tax credit, and other tax credits.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxCreditsAbstrac.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Amount [Abstract]

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxCreditsForeign.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxCreditsForeign.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxCreditsInvestm.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Investment, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxCreditsInvestm.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to investment tax credit.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxCreditsOther.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Other, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxCreditsOther.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other tax credits.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxCreditsResearc.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Research, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxCreditsResearc.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to research tax credit.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxExemptIncome.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Exempt Income, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxExemptIncome.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxHolidays.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Holiday, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxHolidays.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income exempt from income tax because of a tax holiday.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxSettlements.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxSettlements.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax settlements. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax settlement, foreign tax settlement, state and local tax settlement, and other tax settlements.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxSettlementsAbs.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Amount [Abstract]

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxSettlementsDom.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Domestic, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxSettlementsDom.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to domestic income tax settlement.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxSettlementsFor.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Foreign, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxSettlementsFor.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax settlement.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxSettlementsOth.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Other, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxSettlementsOth.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other income tax settlements.

IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxSettlementsSta.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, State and Local, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxSettlementsSta.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax settlement.

IncomeTaxesPaidNetAbstract.l: Income Tax Paid, after Refund Received [Abstract]

IncomeTaxesPaidNet.l: Income Tax Paid, after Refund Received
IncomeTaxesPaidNet.d: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

IncomeTaxesReceivable.d: Carrying amount due within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefunds.d: Amount of income tax refund received from tax jurisdiction.

IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivableFrom.l: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable from Securitization
IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivableFrom.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entity by counterparties in securitized loan transactions.

IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedInvestmentIncom.l: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Investment Income Receivable
IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedInvestmentIncom.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in investment income that has been earned but not yet received in cash.

PaymentsForProceedsFromPreviousAcquisiti.d: The net cash inflow or outflow associated with the aggregate amount of adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromAffiliatesCurre.l: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Affiliates, Current
IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromAffiliatesCurre.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current receivables (due within one year or one operating cycle) to be collected from an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

IncreaseDecreaseDueFromOfficersAndStockh.l: Increase (Decrease) Due from Officers and Stockholders
IncreaseDecreaseDueFromOfficersAndStockh.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables to be collected from the reporting entity's executives and owners.

IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromOfficersAndStoc.l: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Officers and Stockholders, Current
IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromOfficersAndStoc.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current receivables (due within one year or one operating cycle) to be collected from the reporting entity's executives and owners.

IncreaseDecreaseInDueToOfficersAndStockh.l: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Officers and Stockholders, Current
IncreaseDecreaseInDueToOfficersAndStockh.d: The increase (decrease) in current obligations (due within one year or one operating cycle) owed to reporting entity's executives and owners.

IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredElectricCost.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in carrying amount of capitalized electric costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

PaymentsForProceedsFromDelayedTaxExemptE.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Delayed Tax Exempt Exchange
PaymentsForProceedsFromDelayedTaxExemptE.d: Net cash outflow or inflow from a property which is traded for the promise to provide a replacement like-kind property in the near future also known as tax deferred exempt exchange.

PaymentsForProceedsFromDepositsOnRealEst.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposits on Real Estate Acquisitions
PaymentsForProceedsFromDepositsOnRealEst.d: Net cash outflow or inflow from the amount given in advance to show intention to complete the acquisition piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

IncreaseDecreaseInDividendsReceivable.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in cash disbursements due from investments, representing the shareholders' portion of profits.

PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBa.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBa.d: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) from acquisition (sale) of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) stock.

PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBa.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Home Loan Bank Stock [Abstract]

PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeInvestingAct.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Investing Activities
PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeInvestingAct.d: The cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedSalaries.d: The increase (decrease) during the period in accrued salaries.

IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromEmployeeCurrent.l: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Employee, Current
IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromEmployeeCurrent.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from employees for floats, allowances and loans (generally evidenced by promissory notes).

IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredLiabilities.d: Change during the period in carrying value for all deferred liabilities due within one year or operating cycle.

IncreaseDecreaseInInsuranceSettlementsRe.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in insurance settlements receivable, which are amounts due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy. The expectation is that such reimbursement will be received within one year of the balance sheet date.

IncreaseDecreaseInNotesReceivableCurrent.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of amounts due within one year (or one business cycle) from note holders for outstanding loans.

IncreaseDecreaseInOtherEmployeeRelatedLi.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in employer-related costs classified as other and current.

IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingAssets.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

IncreaseDecreaseInLeaseAcquisitionCosts.d: The increase (decrease) in the balance of capitalized lease acquisition costs during the period. The cost usually covers a variety of administrative costs, such as the cost of obtaining a credit report, verifying insurance coverage, lease commission charges, checking the accuracy and completeness of the lease documentation, and entering the lease in data processing and accounting systems.

PaymentsForProceedsFromLifeInsurancePoli.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Life Insurance Policies
PaymentsForProceedsFromLifeInsurancePoli.d: The net cash outflow or inflow for net proceeds and payments derived from carrying life insurance policies for which the entity is the beneficiary.

PaymentsForProceedsFromLimitedPartnershi.d: Net cash outflow or inflow from limited partnership investments held by the entity for investment purposes.

ProceedsFromPaymentsForLongTermLoansForR.l: Proceeds from Collection of (Payments to Fund) Long-Term Loans to Related Parties
ProceedsFromPaymentsForLongTermLoansForR.d: The cash inflow or outflow associated with long-term loans for related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party, including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from (Payments for) Advances to Affiliates.

PaymentsToAcquireRoyaltyInterestsInMinin.l: Payments to Acquire Royalty Interests in Mining Properties
PaymentsToAcquireRoyaltyInterestsInMinin.d: The cash outflow from the purchase of royalty interests in mining properties is the amount of cash the mineral producer pays the owner of the mine or mineral resource.

PaymentsForProceedsFromMortgageDeposits.d: Net cash outflow or inflow from the amount given in advance to show intention to complete the mortgage.

PaymentsForProceedsFromNuclearFuel.d: The net cash inflow or outflow from any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherInterestEarn.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Interest Earning Assets
PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherInterestEarn.d: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in other interest earning assets not separately disclosed.

PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherRealEstatePa.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Real Estate Partnerships
PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherRealEstatePa.d: The net cash inflow or outflow from other real estate partnerships not otherwise defined in the taxonomy (buyouts, other agreements).

RestructuringCosts.d: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

PaymentsForProceedsFromRemovalCosts.d: The net cash inflow or outflow from the costs of disposing of plant, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

IncreaseDecreaseOfRestrictedInvestments.d: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

PaymentsForProceedsFromTenantAllowance.d: Net cash outflow or inflow from monetary allowance granted by the landlord to a tenant to entice tenant to move into landlords building which will enable the tenant to prepare the leased premises for tenants occupancy.

IncreaseDecreaseInTradingSecurities.l: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
IncreaseDecreaseInTradingSecurities.d: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt and equity securities, measured at fair value with changes in fair value recognized in net income.

IncreaseDecreaseInFinanceReceivables.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in outstanding loans including accrued interest.

PaymentsToAcquireMortgageServicingRights.l: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)
PaymentsToAcquireMortgageServicingRights.d: The cash outflow to obtain servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable

IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToAcc.l: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Accelerated Share Repurchase Agreements
IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToAcc.d: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of accelerated share repurchase agreements. An accelerated share repurchase program is a combination of transactions that permits an entity to purchase a targeted number of shares immediately with the final purchase price of those shares determined by an average market price over a fixed period of time.

IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToCal.l: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Call Options and Warrants
IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToCal.d: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of call options and warrants using the treasury stock method.

IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToCon.l: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Contingently Issuable Shares
IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToCon.d: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of contingently issuable shares. Contingently issuable shares are those shares that are issuable for little or no cash contingent on certain conditions being met.

IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToCon.l: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Conversion of Debt Securities
IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToCon.d: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of convertible debt securities using the if-converted method.

IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToEqu.l: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Equity Forward Agreements
IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToEqu.d: Additional shared included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of equity forward arrangements using the reverse treasury stock method.

IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToEqu.l: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Equity Unit Purchase Agreements
IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToEqu.d: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of equity unit purchase agreements using the treasury stock method.

IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToSha.l: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Share-Based Payment Arrangements
IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToSha.d: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToWri.l: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Written Put Options
IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToWri.d: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of outstanding written put options using the reverse treasury stock method.

LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustm.l: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred but Not Reported (IBNR) Claims, Amount
LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustm.d: Estimated costs as of the balance sheet date of settling insured claims and costs incurred in the claims settlement process for claims that have not yet been submitted to the insurance company for reimbursement.

LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustm.l: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims [Abstract]

IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsByMajorCl.d: Information by class of indefinite-lived intangible asset.
Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

IndemnificationGuaranteeMember.d: An agreement (contract) that contingently requires the guarantor to make payments to the guaranteed party in compensation for that party's or parties' loss or injury attributable to specified events or actions, such as a patent infringement action against an entity that relied on certain representations as to ownership rights made by a software vendor.

IndirectGuaranteeOfIndebtednessMember.d: An indirect guarantee of the indebtedness of another party arises under an agreement that obligates one entity to transfer funds to a second entity upon the occurrence of specified events, under conditions whereby (a) the funds become legally available to creditors of the second entity and (b) those creditors may enforce the second entity's claims against the first entity under the agreement. Examples of indirect guarantees include agreements to advance funds if a second entity's net income, cov

IneffectivenessOnForeignCurrencyFairValu.l: Ineffectiveness on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedges is Immaterial (Deprecated 2025)
IneffectivenessOnForeignCurrencyFairValu.d: Assertion that the amount of foreign currency fair value hedge ineffectiveness is immaterial.

IneffectivenessOnInterestRateFairValueHe.l: Ineffectiveness on Interest Rate Fair Value Hedges is Immaterial (Deprecated 2026)
IneffectivenessOnInterestRateFairValueHe.d: Assertion that the amount of fair value hedge ineffectiveness is immaterial.

IneffectivenessOnPriceRiskFairValueHedge.l: Ineffectiveness on Price Risk Fair Value Hedges is Immaterial (Deprecated 2025)
IneffectivenessOnPriceRiskFairValueHedge.d: Entity discloses that the amount of price risk fair value hedge ineffectiveness is immaterial.

IneffectivenessOnPriceRiskHedgesIsImmate.l: Ineffectiveness on Price Risk Hedges is Immaterial (Deprecated 2025)
IneffectivenessOnPriceRiskHedgesIsImmate.d: Assertion that the amount of price risk cash flow and fair value hedge ineffectiveness is immaterial.

InformationAboutSourcesAndUsesOfCollater.l: Information about Sources and Uses of Collateral that is Received Through Resale Agreements and Securities Borrowing Agreements
InformationAboutSourcesAndUsesOfCollater.d: This describes information about the sources and uses of collateral that is acquired through resale agreements and securities borrowing agreements that the entity is permitted by contract or custom to sell or repledge.

InsuranceCommissions.d: The expense incurred by an insurance company to persons or entities for generating or placing insurance or investment contracts with the company, usually determined as a percentage of policy or contract premiums. Excludes advances or draws to be applied against commissions earned.

InsuranceDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for the types of coverages and products sold, and the assets, obligations, recorded liabilities, revenues and expenses arising therefrom, and the amounts of and methodologies and assumptions used in determining the amounts of such items.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsAndUnpai.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefits and Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense [Abstract]
Liability for Future Policy Benefits and Unpaid Claims Disclosure [Text Block]
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsAndUnpai.d: The entire disclosure for liabilities related to future policy benefits and unpaid claims and claim adjustments.

ProceedsFromInsurancePremiumsCollected.d: Cash received as payments for insurance premiums during the current period.

InsurancePremiumsRevenueRecognitionPolic.l: Insurance Premiums Revenue Recognition, Policy [Policy Text Block]
InsurancePremiumsRevenueRecognitionPolic.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for revenue recognition of insurance premium. Includes, but is not limited to, basis for measurement and timing of recognition of revenue from insurance premium received from contract holder and method used in performing premium deficiency testing.

InsuranceReceivableForMalpractice.d: The amount receivable from insurance and similar arrangements for reimbursement and payment of malpractice claims and litigation costs.

InsuranceReceivableForMalpracticeCurrent.d: The current portion of the amount receivable from insurance and similar arrangements for reimbursement and payment of malpractice claims and litigation costs.

InsuranceReceivableForMalpracticeNoncurr.d: The noncurrent portion of the receivable from insurance and similar arrangements for reimbursement and payment of malpractice claims and litigation costs.

InsuranceTax.d: Represents total insurance tax expense reflected in the income statement for each period presented.

IntangibleAssetsAmortizationPeriodMember.d: A revision in the estimated economic useful life of a finite-lived intangible asset (the period of time over which the asset is projected to benefit operations).

FiniteLivedCoreDepositsGross.d: Bank deposits belonging to an acquired bank that can be counted on as a stable source of lending funds. These deposits have the following attributes: predictable costs and low sensitivity to interest rates. This intangible asset is usually amortized over its estimated useful life.

IntangibleAssetsNetExcludingGoodwill.l: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, after Accumulated Amortization
IntangibleAssetsNetExcludingGoodwill.d: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

IntangibleAssetsNetExcludingGoodwillAbst.l: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, after Accumulated Amortization [Abstract]

FiniteLivedContractualRightsGross.d: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of an intangible asset that arises from a contractual arrangement with a third party (not including franchise rights and license agreements).

FiniteLivedCustomerListsGross.d: Amount, before amortization, of finite-lived asset representing customer list acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation.

FiniteLivedCustomerRelationshipsGross.d: Amount, before amortization, of finite-lived asset representing customer relationship acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsGross.l: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, before Accumulated Amortization
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsGross.d: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsGrossAbstract.l: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, before Accumulated Amortization [Abstract]

FiniteLivedLicenseAgreementsGross.d: Gross carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of certain rights acquired to exercise a certain privilege or pursue a particular business or occupation and which is deemed to have a finite economic life.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsNet.l: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, after Accumulated Amortization
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsNet.d: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsNetAbstract.l: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, after Accumulated Amortization [Abstract]

FiniteLivedNoncompeteAgreementsGross.d: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of payments made to third parties in exchange for their agreement not to engage in specified competitive practices in specified geographic territories for a specified period of time.

OtherFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsGross.d: Amount before accumulated amortization of finite-lived intangible assets classified as other.

FiniteLivedPatentsGross.d: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of the costs pertaining to the exclusive legal rights granted to the owner of the patent to exploit an invention or a process for a period of time specified by law. Such costs may have been expended to directly apply and receive patent rights, or to acquire such rights.

FiniteLivedTradeNamesGross.d: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of the rights acquired through registration of a trade name to gain or protect exclusive use thereof for a reasonably expected period of economic benefit.

Goodwill.d: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

IndefiniteLivedContractualRights.d: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date of rights with an indefinite period of benefit that arose from a contractual arrangement with a third party (not including franchise rights and license agreements).

IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsExcluding.d: Amount of indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

IndefiniteLivedFranchiseRights.d: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through a franchise arrangement having an indefinite period of benefit.

IndefiniteLivedLicenseAgreements.d: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the capitalized costs to acquire rights under a license arrangement (for example, to sell specified products in a specified territory) having an indefinite period of benefit.

OtherIndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssets.d: Amount after impairment of indefinite-lived intangible assets classified as other. Excludes financial assets and goodwill.

IndefiniteLivedTradeNames.d: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trade name to gain or protect exclusive use thereof for a projected indefinite period of benefit.

IndefiniteLivedTrademarks.d: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style for a projected indefinite period of benefit.

IntercompanyAgreementsDescription.d: Description of product support, consulting, business, or other advisory service agreements entered into between the managing member or general partner and the LLC or LP, affiliate of the managing member or general partner, or affiliate of the LLC or LP. Includes a description of the key provisions of such agreements and the amount of compensation for such services during the accounting period.

IntercompanyForeignCurrencyBalanceAmount.d: Amount of intra-entity foreign currency transaction that is considered to be long-term investment with settlement not planned or anticipated in foreseeable future.

IntercompanyForeignCurrencyBalanceNameDo.d: Foreign entity for which intra-entity foreign currency transaction that is considered to be long-term-investment with settlement not planned or anticipated in foreseeable future, exists.

IntercompanyForeignCurrencyBalanceByDesc.l: Intra-Entity Foreign Currency Balance by Description [Axis]
IntercompanyForeignCurrencyBalanceByDesc.d: Information by foreign entity for which intra-entity foreign currency transaction that is considered to be long-term investment with settlement not planned or anticipated in foreseeable future, exists.
