LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitByProduct.d: The assumed interest rate used to determine present value of future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and related expenses less the present value of future net premiums using assumptions such as estimates of expected investment yields, mortality, morbidity, terminations and expenses, applicable at the time the insurance contracts are made and unpaid claim costs relating to insurance contracts including estimates of costs relating to incurred but not reported claims based on th

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitByProduct.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit by Product Segment, Policy Issue Year Range
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitByProduct.d: Span of years during which policies were issued containing estimated present value of future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and related expenses less the present value of future net premiums using assumptions such as estimates of expected investment yields, mortality, morbidity, terminations and expenses, applicable at the time the insurance contracts are made and unpaid claim costs relating to insurance contracts including estimates of costs relating to incurred but not re

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitByProduct.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, by Product Segment [Line Items]
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitByProduct.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitByProduct.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, by Product Segment [Table]
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitByProduct.d: Reflects the carrying amount of and other relevant, pertinent information about the liability as of the balance sheet date for future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and related expenses less the present value of future net premiums by major product line segment.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsInterest.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Interest Rate Assumption
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsInterest.d: Relevant interest rate assumptions that are an integral part of the methodology used in calculating the future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and related expenses less the present value of future net premiums using assumptions such as estimates of expected investment yields, mortality, morbidity, terminations and expenses, applicable at the time the insurance contracts are made and cost of settling insured claims and cost incurred in the claim settlement process.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsAndPolic.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefits and Policyholder Contract Deposits, Assumptions [Abstract]

LiabilityForPolicyholderContractDeposits.l: Liability for Policyholder Contract Deposits, Assumptions [Abstract]
Liability for Policyholder Contract Deposits, General Assumptions
LiabilityForPolicyholderContractDeposits.d: General assumptions associated with the liability for estimated reserve for cumulative deposits plus credited interest and fund performance, less withdrawals, expenses and cost of insurance charges, as applicable.

RefundableGasCosts.d: Gas costs of a regulated entity that are refundable through future rate adjustments. Such costs are a form of a regulatory liabilities and are expected to be refunded in less than one year through rate adjustments.

LiabilityReserveEstimatePolicy.l: Liability Reserve Estimate, Policy [Policy Text Block]
LiabilityReserveEstimatePolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for estimating its liability as of the balance sheet date for the ultimate cost of settling reported and unreported claims incurred and claims adjustment expenses (including effects of inflation and other societal and economic factors).

TaxesOther.d: Amount of tax expense classified as other.

LicensingAgreementsMember.d: Rights, generally of limited duration, under a license arrangement (for example, to sell or otherwise utilize specified products or processes in a specified territory).

LifePremiumsAsPercentageOfGrossPremiums.l: Life Premiums as Percentage of Gross Premiums
LifePremiumsAsPercentageOfGrossPremiums.d: Ratio with total life insurance premiums in numerator and total GAAP premiums in the denominator.

ContingentLiabilityReserveEstimatePolicy.l: Contingent Liability Reserve Estimate, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2026)
ContingentLiabilityReserveEstimatePolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for the claims loss reserve for insurance contracts with a life contingency (permanent life, some term life, accident and health, some annuities), describing the loss exposures and bases and methodologies for making the relevant accounting estimates.

LifeInsuranceAssumedRatio.d: Ratio of life insurance assumed from another insurer to gross life insurance in force.

LifeInsuranceSegmentMember.d: Contract providing insurance coverage for death benefit.

LifeSettlementContractsDisclosureTextBlo.d: The entire disclosure for life settlement contracts including the accounting policy for life settlement contracts and the classification of cash receipts and cash disbursements in the statement of cash flows and, as applicable, for (1) life settlement contracts accounted for under the investment method based on the remaining life expectancy for each of the first five succeeding years from the date of the statement of financial position and thereafter, as well as in the aggregate: (a) the number

LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodCh.l: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Change in Expectations
LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodCh.d: This element represents discussion of the reasons for changes in the Company's expectation of the timing of the realization of the investments in life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method. This includes disclosing significant changes to the amounts disclosed including number of contracts, carrying value, and face value.

LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodGa.l: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Gain (Loss)
LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodGa.d: This item represents the gains or losses recognized and realized during the period on investments in life settlement contracts sold during the period.

LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodUn.l: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodUn.d: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of investments in life settlement contracts held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodVa.l: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Valuation Method
LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodVa.d: This item represents discussion of the method or methods and significant assumptions used to estimate the fair value of investments in life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method, including any mortality assumptions.

LifeSettlementContractsInvestmentMethodC.l: Life Settlement Contracts, Investment Method, Carrying Amount
LifeSettlementContractsInvestmentMethodC.d: Carrying amount of life settlement contracts accounted for under the investment method.

LifeSettlementContractsInvestmentMethodF.l: Life Settlement Contracts, Investment Method, Face Value
LifeSettlementContractsInvestmentMethodF.d: Face value (death benefits) of the life insurance policies underlying the life settlement contracts accounted for under the investment method.

LifeSettlementContractsInvestmentMethodN.l: Life Settlement Contracts, Investment Method, Number of Contracts
LifeSettlementContractsInvestmentMethodN.d: Number of life settlement contracts accounted for under the investment method.

LimitedLiabilityCompaniesLLCsAndLimitedP.l: Limited Liability Companies (LLCs) and Limited Partnerships (LPs) [Abstract]

LimitedPartnersCapitalAccountDescription.l: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Description of Units (Deprecated 2026)
LimitedPartnersCapitalAccountDescription.d: Description of the various rights, preferences, and privileges of the limited partners' ownership units including: redemption, conversion, liquidation, tax status of distribution per unit and the sharing in distributions.

LimitedPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsAuthor.l: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Authorized
LimitedPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsAuthor.d: The number of limited partner units authorized to be issued.

LimitedPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsIssued.l: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Issued
LimitedPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsIssued.d: The number of limited partner units issued.

LimitedPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsOutsta.l: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Outstanding
LimitedPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsOutsta.d: The number of limited partner units outstanding.

LimitedPartnersCumulativeCashDistributio.d: Aggregate cumulative cash distributions made to the limited partners.

LimitedPartnersCumulativeNetIncome.d: Aggregate cumulative earnings allocated to the limited partners based on the sharing of income or losses between general and limited partners as specified in the partnership agreement, excluding any priority income allocations resulting from incentive distributions or special earnings allocations.

LimitedPartnersCapitalAccount.d: The amount of the limited partners' ownership interests.

MinorityInterestInLimitedPartnerships.d: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling partners of a limited partnership included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.

LinesOfCreditCurrent.d: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current portion of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before

LineOfCreditFacilityAffiliatedBorrower.l: Line of Credit Facility, Affiliated Borrower
LineOfCreditFacilityAffiliatedBorrower.d: Identification of each affiliate who is permitted to utilize the line of credit (for example, a subsidiary of the reporting entity) and description of its relationship to the reporting entity.

LineOfCreditFacilityAnnualPrincipalPayme.l: Line of Credit Facility, Annual Principal Payment
LineOfCreditFacilityAnnualPrincipalPayme.d: Amount of decrease in debt under credit facility arrangement from principal payment.

LineOfCreditFacilityAssetRestrictions.l: Line of Credit Facility, Asset Restrictions
LineOfCreditFacilityAssetRestrictions.d: Description of restrictions on the entity's other assets as required by the terms of the credit facility.

LineOfCreditFacilityBorrowingCapacityDes.l: Line of Credit Facility, Borrowing Capacity, Description
LineOfCreditFacilityBorrowingCapacityDes.d: Description of the credit facility's borrowing capacity including discussion of how the borrowing capacity is determined (for example, borrowing capacity based on the amount of current assets).

LineOfCreditFacilityCollateral.d: Discussion of whether the borrowings under the credit facility are secured or unsecured and, if secured, a description of collateral (for example, accounts receivable less than 120 days old, finished goods inventory).

LineOfCreditFacilityCollateralFees.l: Line of Credit Facility, Collateral Fees
LineOfCreditFacilityCollateralFees.d: Description of fees associated with providing collateral for the credit facility.

LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount.l: Line of Credit Facility, Commitment Fee Amount
LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount.d: Amount of the fee for available but unused credit capacity under the credit facility.

LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeDescrip.l: Line of Credit Facility, Commitment Fee Description
LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeDescrip.d: Description of the fees for amounts available, but unused under the credit facility.

LineOfCreditFacilityCovenantCompliance.l: Line of Credit Facility, Covenant Compliance
LineOfCreditFacilityCovenantCompliance.d: Identification of whether the entity has been in compliance with any credit facility debt covenants during the period.

LineOfCreditFacilityCovenantTerms.l: Line of Credit Facility, Covenant Terms
LineOfCreditFacilityCovenantTerms.d: Description of the conditions for borrowing under the credit facility including the nature of any restrictions.

LineOfCreditFacilityCurrency.d: If other than borrowings in the currency of the country of domicile, identification of the currency in which borrowings are made.

LineOfCreditFacilityCurrentBorrowingCapa.l: Line of Credit Facility, Current Borrowing Capacity
LineOfCreditFacilityCurrentBorrowingCapa.d: Amount of current borrowing capacity under the credit facility considering any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed (for example, borrowings may be limited by the amount of current assets), but without considering any amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

LineOfCreditFacilityDescription.d: Description of the terms of a credit facility arrangement. Terms typically include interest rate, collateral required, guarantees required, repayment requirements, and restrictions on use of assets and activities of the entity.

LineOfCreditFacilityDividendRestrictions.l: Line of Credit Facility, Dividend Restrictions
LineOfCreditFacilityDividendRestrictions.d: Description of restrictions on the entity's ability to pay dividends as required by the terms of the credit facility.

LineOfCreditFacilityFairValueOfAmountOut.l: Line of Credit Facility, Fair Value of Amount Outstanding
LineOfCreditFacilityFairValueOfAmountOut.d: Fair value of the amount outstanding under the credit facility.

LineOfCreditFacilityFairValueBasisForMea.l: Line of Credit Facility, Fair Value, Basis for Measurement
LineOfCreditFacilityFairValueBasisForMea.d: Description of the method(s) used to measure fair value of the amount outstanding under the credit facility and any significant assumptions used in the fair value measurement.

LineOfCreditFacilityFrequencyOfCommitmen.l: Line of Credit Facility, Frequency of Commitment Fee Payment
LineOfCreditFacilityFrequencyOfCommitmen.d: Description of when the fee for available but unused credit capacity is required to be paid (for example, annually, quarterly, or monthly).

LineOfCreditFacilityFrequencyOfPaymentAn.l: Line of Credit Facility, Frequency of Payment and Payment Terms
LineOfCreditFacilityFrequencyOfPaymentAn.d: Description of the frequency of the required periodic payments of interest, principal, or both, and the amount, if set, or a description of a formula upon which payment is based.

LineOfCreditFacilityFrequencyOfPayments.l: Line of Credit Facility, Frequency of Payments
LineOfCreditFacilityFrequencyOfPayments.d: Description of the frequency of periodic payments, which may be presented in a variety of ways (for example, monthly, quarterly, annually).

LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseAccruedInter.l: Line of Credit Facility, Increase, Accrued Interest
LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseAccruedInter.d: Increase for accrued, but unpaid interest on the credit facility for the period.

LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseDecreaseForP.l: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease), Net
LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseDecreaseForP.d: Amount of increase (decrease) of the credit facility.

LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseDecreaseOthe.l: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease), Other, Net
LineOfCreditFacilityIncreaseDecreaseOthe.d: Amount of increase (decrease), classified as other, of the credit facility.

LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateDescript.l: Line of Credit Facility, Interest Rate Description
LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateDescript.d: Description of interest rate for borrowing under credit facility. Includes, but is not limited to, terms and method for determining interest rate.

LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateDuringPe.l: Line of Credit Facility, Interest Rate During Period
LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateDuringPe.d: The effective interest rate during the reporting period.

LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateAtPeriod.l: Line of Credit Facility, Interest Rate at Period End
LineOfCreditFacilityInterestRateAtPeriod.d: The effective interest rate at the end of the reporting period.

LineOfCreditFacilityLenderDomain.d: Identification of the lender, which may be a single entity (for example, a bank, pension fund, venture capital firm) or a group of entities that participate in the line of credit, including a letter of credit facility.

LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapa.l: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Borrowing Capacity
LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapa.d: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

LineOfCreditFacilityPeriodicPayment.l: Line of Credit Facility, Periodic Payment
LineOfCreditFacilityPeriodicPayment.d: Amount of the required periodic payments of both interest and principal.

LineOfCreditFacilityPeriodicPaymentInter.l: Line of Credit Facility, Periodic Payment, Interest
LineOfCreditFacilityPeriodicPaymentInter.d: Amount of the required periodic payment applied to interest.

LineOfCreditFacilityPeriodicPaymentPrinc.l: Line of Credit Facility, Periodic Payment, Principal
LineOfCreditFacilityPeriodicPaymentPrinc.d: Amount of the required periodic payment applied to principal.

LineOfCreditFacilityPriority.d: Description of the credit facility's priority for repayment in relation to other obligations of the entity in the event of liquidation.

LineOfCreditFacilityRationaleForClassifi.l: Line of Credit Facility, Rationale for Classification as Long-Term Debt (Deprecated 2026)
LineOfCreditFacilityRationaleForClassifi.d: Justification for treatment of borrowings under the line of credit as noncurrent.

LineOfCreditFacilityRemainingBorrowingCa.l: Line of Credit Facility, Remaining Borrowing Capacity
LineOfCreditFacilityRemainingBorrowingCa.d: Amount of borrowing capacity currently available under the credit facility (current borrowing capacity less the amount of borrowings outstanding).

LineOfCreditFacilityRevolvingCreditConve.l: Line of Credit Facility, Revolving Credit Conversion to Term Loan, Description
LineOfCreditFacilityRevolvingCreditConve.d: Describes when borrowings outstanding under a line of credit will convert to a term loan, and describes the repayment terms, collateral, and priority (seniority) of the term loan.

LineOfCreditFacilityAxis.d: Information by name of lender, which may be a single entity (for example, but not limited to, a bank, pension fund, venture capital firm) or a group of entities that participate in the line of credit.

LineOfCreditFacilityLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

LineOfCreditFacilityTable.d: Disclosure of information about short-term and long-term contractual arrangements with lender under which borrowing can occur up to maximum amount. Includes, but is not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit, and revolving credit arrangement.

LongTermLineOfCredit.d: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the noncurrent portion of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms bef

LineOfCreditMember.d: A contractual arrangement with a lender under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time, and under which borrowings outstanding may be either short-term or long-term, depending upon the particulars.

LineOfCredit.d: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current and noncurrent portions of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specif

LegalFees.d: The amount of expense provided in the period for legal costs incurred on or before the balance sheet date pertaining to resolved, pending or threatened litigation, including arbitration and mediation proceedings.

LitigationReserve.d: Aggregate carrying amount of the estimated litigation liability for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs.

PaymentsOfLoanCosts.d: The cash outflow for loan origination associated cost which is usually collected through escrow.

LoanOriginationCommitmentsMember.d: Commitments to borrowers or third party investors for the origination of a loan.

LoanPortfolioExpense.d: The loan servicing fees paid to third parties that relate to loan expenses for a portfolio containing the entire group of loans owned by the company.

LoanPurchaseCommitmentsMember.d: Commitment to purchase loans from a third party.

LoansReceivableHeldForSaleAmount.d: Amount, before valuation allowance, of financing receivable classified as held-for-sale.

LoansReceivableHeldForSaleNetReconciliat.l: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance, Reconciliation to Cash Flow [Roll Forward]
LoansReceivableHeldForSaleNetReconciliat.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

LoansReceivableHeldForSaleReconciliation.l: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Addition to Held-for-Sale
LoansReceivableHeldForSaleReconciliation.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of addition to financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

LoansReceivableHeldForSaleReconciliation.l: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Period Increase (Decrease)
LoansReceivableHeldForSaleReconciliation.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of increase (decrease) in financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

LoansReceivableHeldForSaleReconciliation.l: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Deduction from Held-for-Sale
LoansReceivableHeldForSaleReconciliation.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of deduction to financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

LoansAndFinanceReceivablesMember.d: Contractual rights to receive money on demand or on fixed or determinable dates that is recognized as an asset in the creditor's statement of financial position.

ProceedsFromRepaymentOfLoansByEmployeeSt.l: Proceeds from Repayment of Loans by Employee Stock Ownership Plans
ProceedsFromRepaymentOfLoansByEmployeeSt.d: The cash inflow from the financed defined contribution plan to acquire shares of the entity. The plan initially holds the shares in a suspense account, which is collateral for the loan. As the plan makes payment on the debt, the shares are released from the suspense account and become available to be allocated to participant accounts.

InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansAndLeases.l: Interest and Fee Income, Financing Receivable
InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansAndLeases.d: The aggregate interest and fee income generated by: (1) loans the Entity has positive intent and ability to hold for the foreseeable future, or until maturity or payoff, including commercial and consumer loans, whether domestic or foreign, which may consist of: (a) industrial and agricultural; (b) real estate; and (c) real estate construction loans; (d) trade financing; (e) lease financing; (f) home equity lines-of-credit; (g) automobile and other vehicle loans; and (h) credit card and other rev

InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansAndLeasesAbstra.l: Interest and Fee Income, Financing Receivable [Abstract]

InterestAndFeeIncomeNonmortgageLoansAndL.l: Interest and Fee Income, Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Nonmortgage
InterestAndFeeIncomeNonmortgageLoansAndL.d: Amount of interest and fee income earned from loans held-for-sale, including interest earned from direct financing and sales-type leases held-for-sale, but excluding mortgage loans held-for sale.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableAllowanceForLoan.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance for Loan Losses Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2025)
LoansAndLeasesReceivableAllowanceForLoan.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for estimating the allowance for losses on loans and lease receivables. The disclosure may include (a) how the entity determines each element of the allowance, (b) which loans are evaluated individually and which loans are evaluated as a group, (c) how the entity determines both the allocated and unallocated portions of the allowance, (d) how the entity determines the loss factors applied to graded loans in order to develop a general allowance, and (e) what self-c

LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommitmentsFixed.l: Financing Receivable, Commitment with Fixed Rate, Amount
LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommitmentsFixed.d: Amount of financing receivable commitment with fixed rate of interest.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommitmentsToPur.l: Financing Receivable, Commitment to Purchase or Sell, Amount
LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommitmentsToPur.d: Amount of financing receivable commitment to purchase or sell.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommitmentsVaria.l: Financing Receivable, Commitment with Variable Rate, Amount
LoansAndLeasesReceivableCommitmentsVaria.d: Amount of financing receivable commitment with variable rate of interest.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableFeesEarnedButExc.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Fees Earned but Excluded from Yield (Deprecated 2026)
LoansAndLeasesReceivableFeesEarnedButExc.d: Reflects the amount of fees recognized as income related to loan originations, commitments or servicing which are not included in interest income and that exceed 1 percent of the aggregate of total interest income and other income.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableGainLossOnSalesN.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gain (Loss) on Sales, Net (Deprecated 2026)
LoansAndLeasesReceivableGainLossOnSalesN.d: Reflects the net positive or negative amount derived from subtracting from net proceeds of sale and the carrying amounts, net of allocated reserves, of financial assets transferred to third parties in transactions that qualify for sales treatment.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedDescript.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Description (Deprecated 2025)
LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedDescript.d: Describes the policies and procedures for identifying and measuring losses on loans when the present value of expected cash flows discounted at the loan's effective interest rate, or, alternatively, a loan's observable market price or fair value of the underlying collateral is less than the carrying amount of the loan, and sets forth the amount of the loss. Also sets forth material facts pertaining to significant loan modifications in a troubled debt restructuring, describes the method for valui

LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedCommitme.l: Financing Receivable, Modified, Commitment to Lend
LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedCommitme.d: Amount of commitment to lend additional funds to debtor experiencing financial difficulty for which creditor has modified terms of financing receivable.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedInterest.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Interest Lost on Nonaccrual Loans
LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedInterest.d: Reflects the amount of additional interest income that would have been recorded if impaired or nonperforming loans were instead current, in compliance with their original terms, and outstanding throughout the reporting period or since origination (if held for part of the period).

LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedNonperfo.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Nonperforming, Accrual of Interest
LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedNonperfo.d: Reflects the carrying amount of loans deemed to be questionable as to collection on which interest is continuing to be earned or accrued.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedNonperfo.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Nonperforming, Nonaccrual of Interest
LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedNonperfo.d: Reflects the carrying amount of loans deemed to be questionable as to collection on which no interest is continuing to be recognized.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedTroubled.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Troubled Debt, Interest Income
LoansAndLeasesReceivableImpairedTroubled.d: The gross interest income that would have been recorded in the period on troubled debt restructurings, if the loans had been current in accordance with their original terms and had been outstanding throughout the period or since origination, if held for part of the period.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableLeaseFinancingPo.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Lease Financing, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2026)
LoansAndLeasesReceivableLeaseFinancingPo.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for recording, valuing, and reporting amounts due from lessees pursuant to contractual arrangements, which are secured, at a minimum, by the asset being rented, and in measuring certain revenues, expenses and gains and losses arising from creating, acquiring, collecting, terminating, modifying and holding lease agreements.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableMortgageBankingA.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for the lending, securitization, sales, transfers and servicing practices for mortgage banking activities.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableNonaccrualLoanAn.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Nonaccrual Loan and Lease Status, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2025)
LoansAndLeasesReceivableNonaccrualLoanAn.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for when a loan ceases to accrue interest or other revenue because the borrower is in financial difficulty. May also describe the treatment of previously earned but uncollected interest income on loans in nonaccrual status, how cash received from borrowers is recorded on loans that are in nonaccrual status, and the policy for resuming accrual of interest. Also includes the policy for charging off uncollectible loans and trade receivables, and the policy for determ

LoansAndLeasesReceivableNonmortgageLoanV.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining the lower of cost or market value of loans that are unsecured or secured by collateral other than real property, and whether the method is applied to an individual loan or to an aggregate portfolio of loans.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableNonperformingLoa.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Nonperforming Loan and Lease, Policy [Policy Text Block]
LoansAndLeasesReceivableNonperformingLoa.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for deeming amounts due from a borrower as not being in compliance with principal and interest payment terms, describes the method for valuing a loan in such status, and indicates whether interest contractually accruing thereon is being recognized as income.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableOriginationFeesD.l: Financing Receivable, Fee and Interest Income [Policy Text Block]
LoansAndLeasesReceivableOriginationFeesD.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for method for recognizing interest income and amortizing deferred fee or cost of financing receivable. Includes, but is not limited to, treatment of fee, cost, premium and discount.

LoansAndLeasesReceivablePastDueStatusPol.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Past Due Status, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2025)
LoansAndLeasesReceivablePastDueStatusPol.d: Disclosure of the accounting policy for past due status of loans and leases receivable.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableRatioOfNonperfor.l: Financing Receivable, Nonperforming Loan to Total Loans, Percentage
LoansAndLeasesReceivableRatioOfNonperfor.d: Percentage of nonperforming loan to total loans.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableRealEstateAcquir.l: Financing Receivable, Real Estate Acquired Through Foreclosure [Policy Text Block]
LoansAndLeasesReceivableRealEstateAcquir.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for real estate acquired through foreclosure.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedPartiesDe.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties, Description (Deprecated 2026)
LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedPartiesDe.d: Describes transactions with related parties, including directors, officers and key employees, including: (1) the aggregate amount of related party loans if they exceed 5 percent of shareholders' equity at the balance sheet date or at any time during the latest fiscal year, (2) an analysis of activity with respect to such loans for the latest fiscal year (i.e., beginning balance, new loans, repayments, other changes and ending balance), (3) the aggregate amount of any significant nonaccrual of in

LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedPartiesAd.l: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Addition from New Loan
LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedPartiesAd.d: Amount of increase in financing receivable from new loan. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedParties.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties (Deprecated 2026)
LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedParties.d: For an unclassified balance sheet, reflects the carrying amount of unpaid loan amounts due from related parties at the balance sheet date.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedPartiesRo.l: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedPartiesRo.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedPartiesPe.l: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedPartiesPe.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableRelatedPartiesDi.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties Disclosure [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

LoansAndLeasesReceivableTroubledDebtRest.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for troubled debt restructuring.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetOfDeferredInc.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net of Deferred Income
LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetOfDeferredInc.d: Amount before allowance and after deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetOfDeferredInc.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net of Deferred Income [Abstract]

LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmo.d: Amount before allowance of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

LoansInsurancePolicy.d: Amount before allowance of loans made to policy and contract holders using their life insurance contracts' cash value or separate accounts as collateral. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums over and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableDeferredIncome.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Deferred Income
LoansAndLeasesReceivableDeferredIncome.d: Amount of deferred interest and fee income, unamortized costs incurred to originate loans and leases, unamortized loan commitments and loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of acquired loans. Excludes amounts for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

LongTermLoansPayable.d: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

LoansManagedOrSecuritizedAbstract.l: Loans Managed, Securitized or Asset-Backed Financing Arrangement [Abstract]

LoansMember.d: When a lender gives money or property over other debt securities sold by the issuer. In the event the issuer goes bankrupt, senior debt holders receive priority for [must receive] repayment [prior] relative to junior and unsecured (general) creditors.

LoansPayable.d: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

LoansPayableToBankCurrent.d: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of current portion of long-term loans payable to bank due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

LongTermLoansFromBank.d: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans from a bank with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer, excluding current portion.

LoansPayableCurrent.d: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of portion of long-term loans payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

LoansPayableMember.d: Borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

LoansPayableToBank.d: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans from a bank with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

OriginationOfLoansToEmployeeStockOwnersh.l: Origination of Loans to Employee Stock Ownership Plans
OriginationOfLoansToEmployeeStockOwnersh.d: The cash outflow to finance the entity's defined contribution plan to acquire shares of the entity. The plan initially holds the shares in a suspense account, which is collateral for the loan. As the plan makes payment on the debt, the shares are released from the suspense account and become available to be allocated to participant accounts.

LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.l: Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions by Product and Guarantee, Discount Rate
LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.d: Percentage discount rate used to calculate present value of an expected stream of future payments, which is included in the calculation of the amount of the specified guaranteed benefit obligation as of the balance sheet date.

LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.l: Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions by Product and Guarantee, Estimated Average Investment Yield
LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.d: Estimated average rate of return on investments which is included in the calculation of the amount of the specified guaranteed benefit obligation as of the balance sheet date.

LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.l: Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions by Product and Guarantee, Lapse Rate
LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.d: Anticipated rate of future terminations of contracts in force as of the balance sheet date, which is included in determining the amount of the specified guaranteed benefit obligation as of the balance sheet date.

LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.l: Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions by Product and Guarantee, Mortality Rate
LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.d: Actuarially determined death rate of policyholders, which is included in determining the amount of the specified guaranteed benefit obligation as of the balance sheet date.

LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.l: Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions by Product and Guarantee, Other Rate
LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.d: Anticipated rate, classified as other, for assumptions included in determining the amount of the specified guaranteed benefit obligation.

LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.l: Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions by Product and Guarantee, Volatility Rate
LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.d: Percentage rate that is indicative of an expected degree of movement against a base line index, and which is included in determining the amount of the specified guaranteed benefit obligation as of the balance sheet date.

LongDurationContractsPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for long-duration insurance products (whole life, universal life, variable annuities, guaranteed renewable term, and title insurance contracts), including the basis for recognizing and determining amounts of revenues and policyholder funds pertaining to long-duration contracts, the general nature of and basis of presentation for separate accounts of contract holders, the practices and methods of allocating fees to policyholders' and contract holders' accounts, the

LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.l: Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions by Product and Guarantee [Line Items]
LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.l: Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions, by Product and Guarantee [Table]
LongDurationContractsAssumptionsByProduc.d: Explanation of the underlying assumptions and percentages or rates used in determining the fair value of guarantee obligations for each type of long-duration contract.

LongDurationContractsAssumptionsSupporti.l: Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions Supporting Guarantee Obligations [Abstract]

LongDurationContractsAssumptionsUnderlyi.l: Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions Underlying Guarantee Obligations [Text Block]
LongDurationContractsAssumptionsUnderlyi.d: The entire disclosure for long duration contract assumptions underlying guarantee obligations. This may include the explanation of the underlying assumptions and percentages or rates used in determining the fair value of each guarantee obligation for each type of long-duration contract.

LongDurationContractsHedgingStrategies.d: Description of the objectives of the strategies used to mitigate various types of risks of loss that may be incurred to meet future policy benefit obligations under long-duration contracts as they become due, and to offset possible losses arising from adverse movements in assumptions underlying reserve estimates, including assumed investment yields.

LongDurationContractsRevenueRecognitionP.l: Long-Duration Contracts Revenue Recognition, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2025)
LongDurationContractsRevenueRecognitionP.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for revenue recognition for long-duration contracts, including the timing of revenue recognition and the basis for determining the amount of revenue recognized, excluding fees earned on separate accounts.

RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligation.d: Amount of the recorded obligation to transfer funds in the future for fixed or minimum amounts or quantities of goods or services at fixed or minimum prices (for example, as in take-or-pay contracts or throughput contracts).

RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationD.l: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationD.d: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationD.l: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationD.d: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationD.l: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationD.d: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationD.l: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationD.d: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationD.l: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationD.d: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

UnconditionalPurchaseObligationCategoryO.l: Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Category of Goods or Services Acquired [Domain]
UnconditionalPurchaseObligationCategoryO.d: General description of the goods or services to be purchased from the counterparty to the unconditional purchase arrangement.

RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationB.l: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation by Category of Item Purchased [Axis]
RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationB.d: Information by category of product and service for recorded unconditional purchase arrangement to acquire product or service or both.

RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationL.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationT.d: Disclosure of information about recorded unconditional purchase obligation arrangement to purchase product and service. Includes, but is not limited to, information about asset pledged to secure payment and payment due in each of next five years and thereafter.

LongTermContractsOrProgramsDisclosureTex.l: Long-Term Contracts or Programs Disclosure [Text Block]
LongTermContractsOrProgramsDisclosureTex.d: The entire disclosure for long-term contracts or programs.

InterestExpenseLongTermDebtAndCapitalSec.l: Interest Expense, Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities
InterestExpenseLongTermDebtAndCapitalSec.d: Total interest expense on long-term debt and capital securities.

InterestExpenseLongTermDebtAndCapitalSec.l: Interest Expense, Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities [Abstract]

LongTermDebtContingentPaymentOfPrincipal.l: Long-Term Debt, Contingent Payment of Principal or Interest
LongTermDebtContingentPaymentOfPrincipal.d: Description of conditions, facts and circumstances that would trigger a payment of principal or interest which was not otherwise immediately due and payable.

LongTermDebtCurrent.d: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

LongTermDebtDescription.d: Description of long-term debt arrangements, which are debt arrangements that originally require full repayment more than twelve months after issuance or greater than the normal operating cycle of the company, if longer, and disclosures pertaining to the underlying arrangements, including repayment terms, conversion features, interest rates, restrictions on assets and activities, debt covenants, and other matters important to users of the financial statements. Types of long-term debt arrangements

LongTermDebtMaturingInYearsFourAndFive.l: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four and Five
LongTermDebtMaturingInYearsFourAndFive.d: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth and fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

LongTermDebtMaturingInYearsTwoAndThree.l: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two and Three
LongTermDebtMaturingInYearsTwoAndThree.d: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second and third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

LongTermDebtMaturitiesRepaymentTerms.d: Disclosure of timing of required repayments, sinking fund requirements, and other redeemable securities at fixed or determinable prices and dates in the five years immediately following the date of the latest balance sheet presented in the financial statements, and the amount thereafter to fully repay the principal of long-term debt. These disclosures may be made either on an individual debt or security basis, by type of debt or security basis, or on a combined basis.

LongTermDebtMaturitiesRepaymentsOfPrinci.l: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, after Year Five
LongTermDebtMaturitiesRepaymentsOfPrinci.d: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

LongTermDebtNoncurrent.d: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

LongTermDebtPercentageBearingFixedIntere.l: Long-Term Debt, Percentage Bearing Fixed Interest, Percentage Rate
LongTermDebtPercentageBearingFixedIntere.d: The interest rate applicable to the portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a set, unchanging rate.

LongTermDebtPercentageBearingVariableInt.l: Long-Term Debt, Percentage Bearing Variable Interest, Percentage Rate
LongTermDebtPercentageBearingVariableInt.d: The interest rate applicable to the portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a rate subject to change from time to time.

LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.l: Long-Term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power, Amount of Long-Term Debt or Lease Obligation Outstanding
LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.d: Under long-term contracts with public utility districts, cooperatives or other organizations, a utility company receives a portion of the output of a production plant constructed and financed by the district or cooperative. The utility has only a nominal or no investment at all in the plant but pays a proportionate part of the plant's costs, including debt service.

LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.l: Long-Term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power, Annual Minimum Debt Service Payment Required
LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.d: Under long-term contracts with public utility districts, cooperatives or other organizations, a utility company receives a portion of the output of a production plant constructed and financed by the district or cooperative. The utility has only a nominal or no investment at all in the plant but pays a proportionate part of the plant's costs, including debt service. If the utility is obligated to pay certain minimum amounts which cover debt service requirements whether or not the plant is operati

LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.l: Long-Term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power, Date of Contract Expiration
LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.d: Date of contract expiration of long-term contract to purchase electricity from a production plant, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.l: Long-Term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power, Description
LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.d: Description of the arrangement to purchase electricity from a production plant constructed and financed by a public utility district, cooperative, or other organization with an expiration date longer than one year from the balance sheet date, including its form and substance.

LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.l: Long-Term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power, Estimated Annual Cost
LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.d: Estimated annual cost to purchase electricity under a long-term contract from a production plant constructed and financed by a public utility district, cooperative, or other organization.

LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.l: Long-Term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power, Share of Plant Output Being Purchased
LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.d: Share of plant output being purchased under a long-term contract to purchase electricity from a production plant constructed and financed by a public utility district, cooperative, or other organization.

LongDurationInsuranceContractsDisclosure.d: The entire disclosure for long duration contracts. This may include the information pertinent to an understanding of the types of traditional and nontraditional insurance and investment contracts sold and serviced, including the nature and amount of estimated guaranteed obligations pertaining to such contracts and the assumptions underlying such estimated amounts, hedging strategies, and sales inducements offered.

LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.l: Long-Term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power [Axis]
LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.d: Information by contract related to purchases of electric power.

LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.l: Long-Term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power [Domain]
LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.d: Name of long-term contract for purchase of electric power.

LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.l: Long-Term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power [Line Items]
LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

LongTermDebt.d: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

LongTermInvestments.d: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle).

LongTermInvestmentsAndReceivablesNet.d: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle) and amount due to the Entity from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such investments and receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.

RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationD.l: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationD.d: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

PaymentsForLossesAndLossAdjustmentExpens.l: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid
PaymentsForLossesAndLossAdjustmentExpens.d: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle insured claims and pay costs incurred in the claims settlement process.

LossContingenciesByNatureOfContingencyAx.d: Information by type of existing condition, situation, or set of circumstances involving uncertainty as to possible loss to an enterprise that will ultimately be resolved when one or more future events occur or fail to occur.

LossContingenciesLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

LossContingenciesTable.d: Disclosure of information about loss contingency. Excludes environmental contingency, warranty, and unconditional purchase obligation.

LossContingencyAccrualCarryingValueCurre.d: Amount of loss contingency liability expected to be resolved within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

LossContingencyAccrualCarryingValuePerio.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in loss contingency liability.

LossContingencyAccrualCarryingValueNoncu.d: Amount of loss contingency liability expected to be resolved after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

LossContingencyBalanceSheetCaption.d: Identifies the line item(s) of the balance sheet that reflect the loss contingency liabilities.

LossContingencyActionsTakenByCourtArbitr.l: Loss Contingency, Actions Taken by Court, Arbitrator or Mediator
LossContingencyActionsTakenByCourtArbitr.d: Describes important rulings or decisions made by the judge, arbitrator or mediator in the legal matter that could impact the outcome of the case.

LossContingencyActionsTakenByDefendant.l: Loss Contingency, Actions Taken by Defendant
LossContingencyActionsTakenByDefendant.d: Describe actions taken by the defendant in the legal matter.

LossContingencyActionsTakenByPlaintiff.l: Loss Contingency, Actions Taken by Plaintiff
LossContingencyActionsTakenByPlaintiff.d: Describes actions taken or threatened by the plaintiff in the legal matter.

LossContingencyActionsTakenByPlaintiffsR.l: Loss Contingency, Actions Taken by Plaintiff's Representative (Deprecated 2024)
LossContingencyActionsTakenByPlaintiffsR.d: Describes actions taken or threatened by the lead plaintiff, who represents a larger group or class of plaintiffs in a legal matter.

LossContingencyAllegations.d: Presents an assertion of a fact by a plaintiff in a pleading or complaint, which the plaintiff claims it will prove upon presentation of evidence at the proceeding.

LossContingencyClaimsSettledAndDismissed.l: Loss Contingency, Claims Settled and Dismissed, Number
LossContingencyClaimsSettledAndDismissed.d: The number of claims settled and dismissed during the period.

LossContingencyDamagesSought.d: Describes the form and magnitude of the award the plaintiff seeks in the legal matter, which may include an unspecified amount of money.

LossContingencyDomicileOfLitigation.d: Identifies the domicile or jurisdiction of the court of law, arbitration or mediation proceeding.

LossContingencyEstimateOfPossibleLoss.l: Loss Contingency, Estimate of Possible Loss
LossContingencyEstimateOfPossibleLoss.d: Reflects the estimated amount of loss from the specified contingency as of the balance sheet date.

LossContingencyEstimatedRecoveryFromThir.l: Loss Contingency, Estimated Recovery from Third Party
LossContingencyEstimatedRecoveryFromThir.d: If estimable, describe the recovery that could be expected to result from a right to proceed against a third party such as an insurer or co-defendant.

LossContingencyExpectedTrialCommencement.d: If determined, state the month and year in which the contingent legal matter will be considered in a court of law or other jurisdiction.

LossContingencyInestimableLoss.d: Explanation as to why an estimate of a specified contingent loss cannot be made, resulting in disclosure without accrual.

LossContingencyLawsAffected.d: Specifies the laws, rules or regulations, or accepted industry practices or procedures that were alleged to have been violated by the defendant.

LossContingencyLawsuitFilingDate.d: States the date the complaint was formally filed in a court of law, in arbitration or mediation.

LossContingencyInformationAboutLitigatio.l: Loss Contingency, Information about Litigation Matters [Abstract]

LossContingencyManagementsAssessmentAndP.l: Loss Contingency, Management's Assessment and Process
LossContingencyManagementsAssessmentAndP.d: Describes management's process to evaluate the contingency matter and to estimate the impact on the financial statements and ongoing operations, such as added credit risk or loss of customers, including pertinent information to adequately disclose the matter and significant assumptions underlying the estimates.

LossContingencyAccrualRollForward.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

MovementInLossContingencyRelatedReceivab.l: Movement in Loss Contingency Receivable, Increase (Decrease) [Roll Forward]
MovementInLossContingencyRelatedReceivab.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

LossContingencyTrialOrAlternativeDispute.l: Loss Contingency, Trial or Alternative Dispute Resolution (Deprecated 2024)
LossContingencyTrialOrAlternativeDispute.d: Identifies whether the action is pursued in a court of law, an arbitration or mediation, and whether a decision by the Trier of fact in a nontrial proceeding is binding or nonbinding.

LossContingencyNameOfDefendant.d: Identifies the named defendant in a lawsuit.

LossContingencyNameOfPlaintiff.d: Identifies the plaintiff in the lawsuit.

LossContingencyNatureDomain.d: An existing condition, situation, or set of circumstances involving uncertainty as to possible loss to an enterprise that will ultimately be resolved when one or more future events occur or fail to occur. Resolution of the uncertainty may confirm the incurrence of a loss or impairment of an asset or the incurrence of a liability.

LossContingencyNewClaimsFiledNumber.l: Loss Contingency, New Claims Filed, Number
LossContingencyNewClaimsFiledNumber.d: The total number of new claims filed pertaining to a loss contingency during the period.

LossContingencyPendingClaimsNumber.d: Number of pending claims pertaining to a loss contingency.

LossContingencyPeriodOfOccurrence.d: States when the existing condition, situation, or set of circumstances involving uncertainty occurred.

LossContingencyRelatedReceivableCarrying.d: Amount of increase (decrease) of receivables pertaining to a loss contingency.

LossContingencyRequestForInformation.d: Describes the type of information that the parties to the litigation have sought or provided, and when it was provided.

LossContingencySettlementAgreementCounte.l: Loss Contingency, Settlement Agreement, Counterparty's Name (Deprecated 2024)
LossContingencySettlementAgreementCounte.d: Name of the other party to the settlement agreement.

LossContingencySettlementAgreementCourt.d: Identify the name of the court, if applicable, which approved the terms of the settlement agreement resolving the legal matter.

LossContingencySettlementAgreementDate.d: The effective date of a duly executed litigation settlement agreement.

LossContingencySettlementAgreementTerms.d: Description of the terms of a settlement agreement which resolved the legal matter, including the nature of the consideration, timing of payment, and the nature of rights obtained or lost (for example, but not limited to, patent, trademark, copyright, license and franchise rights).

LossFromCatastrophesMember.d: Risk of loss from natural disasters and major man-made disasters, often insured by property and casualty insurers and reinsurers subject to deductibles and policy exclusions.

LossFromComponentsExcludedFromAssessment.l: Loss from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness
LossFromComponentsExcludedFromAssessment.d: The loss relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

LossFromComponentsExcludedFromAssessment.l: Loss from Components Excluded from Assessment of Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness
LossFromComponentsExcludedFromAssessment.d: Loss relating to components of the gain (loss) on the fair value hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

LossFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyin.l: Loss from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge
LossFromHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyin.d: Amount of loss recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as a fair value hedge.

LossOnCashFlowHedgeIneffectiveness.l: Loss on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
LossOnCashFlowHedgeIneffectiveness.d: The loss recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

LossOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowHedgeDueT.l: Loss on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring
LossOnDiscontinuationOfCashFlowHedgeDueT.d: The amount of loss reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

LossOnFairValueHedgeIneffectiveness.l: Loss on Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness (Deprecated 2025)
LossOnFairValueHedgeIneffectiveness.d: Amount of recognized loss from the hedging ineffectiveness of a fair value hedge.

UnrealizedLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivativ.l: Unrealized Loss on Foreign Currency Derivatives, before Tax
UnrealizedLossOnForeignCurrencyDerivativ.d: Amount of unrealized loss recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income pertaining to the decrease in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments to the extent that a cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

UnrealizedLossOnPriceRiskCashFlowDerivat.l: Unrealized Loss on Price Risk Cash Flow Derivatives, before Tax
UnrealizedLossOnPriceRiskCashFlowDerivat.d: Amount of unrealized loss related to the decrease in fair value of price risk derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income in the period, before taxes, to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

LossOnReacquiredDebtMember.d: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of loss incurred on reacquisition or refinancing of debt.

LossRecognizedOnAssetsTransferredToSepar.l: Loss Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account, Gross
LossRecognizedOnAssetsTransferredToSepar.d: Amount of loss recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

MortgageServicingRightsMSRImpairmentReco.d: The adjustment to the carrying value of the rights retained or purchased to service mortgages. These adjustments are made when the estimate of the fair value is changed. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

MachineryAndEquipmentMember.d: Tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

MalpracticeInsuranceAnnualCoverageLimit.d: Annual coverage limit provided by the insurance arrangement for malpractice claims.

MalpracticeInsuranceCoverageFloor.d: Amount at the low end of the range in which the insurance begins to cover losses and costs associated with malpractice claims.

MalpracticeInsuranceMaximumCoveragePerIn.l: Malpractice Insurance, Maximum Coverage Per Incident
MalpracticeInsuranceMaximumCoveragePerIn.d: Maximum coverage per malpractice claim provided by the insurance arrangement.

MalpracticeInsuranceOccurrenceOrClaimsMa.l: Malpractice Insurance, Occurrence or Claims-made [Fixed List]
MalpracticeInsuranceOccurrenceOrClaimsMa.d: Indicates type of malpractice insurance arrangement. Acceptable values are "Occurrence" and "Claims-made".

MalpracticeInsuranceOwnershipInCaptiveIn.l: Malpractice Insurance, Ownership in Captive Insurer [Fixed List]
MalpracticeInsuranceOwnershipInCaptiveIn.d: Indicates whether captive insurer is used to address malpractice loss exposure. Acceptable values are "Yes" and "No".

MalpracticeInsurancePercentageOfOwnershi.l: Malpractice Insurance, Percentage of Ownership in Captive Insurer
MalpracticeInsurancePercentageOfOwnershi.d: State the entity's ownership interest in the captive insurer.

MalpracticeInsurancePercentageOfPremiums.l: Malpractice Insurance, Percentage of Premiums Paid to Captive Insurer
MalpracticeInsurancePercentageOfPremiums.d: Amount of the premiums paid by the entity to a partially-owned captive insurer. Express as a percentage of total premiums received by the captive insurer from all sources.

MalpracticeInsuranceSelfInsuredStatus.l: Malpractice Insurance, Self Insured Status [Fixed List]
MalpracticeInsuranceSelfInsuredStatus.d: Indicates whether self-insured for malpractice claim. Acceptable values are "Yes" and "No".

MalpracticeInsuranceThirdPartyCoverage.d: Indicates whether insurance coverage for malpractice claim was obtained from unrelated third-party. Acceptable values are "Yes" and "No".

TypeAndTierIdentifierDomain.d: Name of the type of insurance coverage or layer of insurance that covers malpractice claims.

ScheduleOfMalpracticeInsuranceTypeAndTie.d: Information by type of insurance coverage or layer of insurance that covers malpractice claims.

MalpracticeInsuranceDescription.d: Description of insurance coverage used by the entity to manage the financial risk of malpractice claims (including general and professional liability). Disclosure may include a discussion of the entity's risk management policies, a description of the insurance arrangements (including type, coverage, coverage limits, deductible), description of the insurer, and whether the entity is self insured or retains significant self-insurance risk.

MalpracticeInsuranceLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ScheduleOfMalpracticeInsuranceTable.d: Disclosure of information about insurance coverage used to manage financial risk of malpractice claim.

MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualUndisco.d: Amount of the accrued liability on an undiscounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability) at the end of the accounting period.

MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualUndisco.l: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual, Undiscounted, Current
MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualUndisco.d: Amount of the current portion of the accrued liability on an undiscounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability).

MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualDiscoun.d: Amount of the accrued liability on a discounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability).

MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualDiscoun.l: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual, Discounted, Current
MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualDiscoun.d: Amount of the current portion of the accrued liability on a discounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability).

MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualDiscoun.l: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual, Discounted, Noncurrent
MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualDiscoun.d: Amount of the noncurrent portion of the accrued liability on a discounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability).

MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualUndisco.l: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Accrual, Undiscounted, Noncurrent
MalpracticeLossContingencyAccrualUndisco.d: Amount of the noncurrent portion of the accrued liability on an undiscounted basis for malpractice claims (including general and professional liability).

MalpracticeLossContingencyPeriodCostNetR.l: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Period Cost, Net, Recognized in Income Statement [Abstract]

MalpracticeLossContingencyDisclosureText.d: The entire disclosure for the accrual for malpractice loss contingencies (general and professional liability) which may include the policy used for accruing the loss contingency, the nature and amount of any accrual, and any significant estimate used to determine the accrual.

MalpracticeLossContingencyDiscountRate.d: The interest rate used to discount the estimated cash flows associated with the payment of malpractice claims.

MalpracticeLossContingencyInsuranceRecov.d: Amount of insurance recoveries recognized from insurance and similar arrangements for reimbursement and payment of malpractice claims recognized during an accounting period.

MalpracticeLossContingencyLettersOfCredi.l: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Letters of Credit and Surety Bonds
MalpracticeLossContingencyLettersOfCredi.d: Amount of letters of credit and other surety bonds that are available for the future payment of malpractice claims.

MalpracticeLossContingencyPeriodIncrease.d: The increase (decrease) in the accrued liability for malpractice claims during an accounting period.

MalpracticeLossContingencyNumberOfClaims.l: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Number of Claims
MalpracticeLossContingencyNumberOfClaims.d: Number of malpractice claims outstanding at the end of the accounting period.

MalpracticeLossContingencyPeriodCost.d: Amount of costs associated with malpractice claims, including costs associated with litigating and settling claims, incurred during an accounting period.

MalpracticeLossContingencyClaimsIncurred.l: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Claims Incurred, Net
MalpracticeLossContingencyClaimsIncurred.d: Amount of costs associated with malpractice claims and insurance premiums incurred during an accounting period, less insurance recoveries and returns of previously paid premiums.

MalpracticeLossContingencyPolicy.l: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Policy [Policy Text Block]
MalpracticeLossContingencyPolicy.d: Disclosure of the accounting policy for malpractice loss contingencies accrual (general and professional liability) which may include the method for calculating incurred but not reported (IBNR) claims, the use of actuarial and individual case-based assumptions, whether the accrual has been discounted, the types of costs included in the accrual (for example, legal costs) and other significant estimates used to determine the accrued liability.

MalpracticeLossContingencyPremiumCosts.d: Amount of costs incurred that are associated with obtaining malpractice insurance and other risk transferring arrangements during an accounting period.

MalpracticeLossContingencyReturnOfPremiu.l: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Return of Premiums
MalpracticeLossContingencyReturnOfPremiu.d: Amount received during the period representing a return of premiums previously paid, generally under a retrospectively rated policy.

ManagementFeeDescription.d: Description of the nature of payments to managing member or general partner for management of the day-to-day business functions of the limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP), including the fee rate, basis of calculation, relevant accounting period, whether the fee is paid to an entity other than the managing member or general partner, or whether the fee is waived.

ManagementAndInvestmentAdvisoryFeesPolic.l: Management and Investment Advisory Fees, Policy [Policy Text Block]
ManagementAndInvestmentAdvisoryFeesPolic.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for the recognition of fees for investment advise, research, administrative and investment account management services provided to customers by broker dealers. This fee is generally based on the net assets of the fund or the account.

ManagingMemberOrGeneralPartnerSubsequent.l: Managing Member or General Partner, Subsequent Distribution Amount (Deprecated 2026)
ManagingMemberOrGeneralPartnerSubsequent.d: Amount of cash or stock or unit payment to a limited liability corporation managing member or limited partnership general partner after the end of the accounting period.

ManagingMemberOrGeneralPartnerSubsequent.l: Managing Member or General Partner, Subsequent Distribution Date (Deprecated 2026)
ManagingMemberOrGeneralPartnerSubsequent.d: Date of payment to a limited liability company (LLC) managing member or limited partnership (LP) general partner, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

CommonStockSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionM.l: Common Stock Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member]
