CommonStockSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionM.d: Shares that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur, that represent equity ownership in a corporation, provide voting rights, entitle the holder to a share of the company's success through dividends and/or capital appreciation and, in the event of liquidation, provide rights to a company's assets only after bondholders, other debt holders, a

ConvertiblePreferredStockSubjectToMandat.l: Convertible Preferred Stock Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member]
ConvertiblePreferredStockSubjectToMandat.d: Shares that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets upon an event that is certain to occur.

CumulativePreferredStockSubjectToMandato.l: Cumulative Preferred Stock Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member]
CumulativePreferredStockSubjectToMandato.d: Shares that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur, which 1) provide a specific dividend that is paid before any dividends are paid to common stock holders, 2) take precedence over common stock in the event of a liquidation, 3) do not enjoy any of the voting rights of common stockholders and 4 have a provision stipulating that if one or mor

DebenturesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMe.d: A type of debt instrument that embodies an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur, that is not secured by physical assets or other collateral. Debentures are backed only by the general creditworthiness and reputation of the issuer. Both corporations and governments frequently issue this type of bond to secure capital. Like other types of bonds, debenture

NoncumulativePreferredStockSubjectToMand.l: Noncumulative Preferred Stock Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member]
NoncumulativePreferredStockSubjectToMand.d: Shares that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur, which provide a specific dividend that is paid before any dividends are paid to common stock holders, which take precedence over common stock in the event of a liquidation, which do not enjoy any of the voting rights of common stockholders and which do not accrue unpaid dividends.

ParticipatingPreferredStockSubjectToMand.l: Participating Preferred Stock Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member]
ParticipatingPreferredStockSubjectToMand.d: Shares that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur. These shares 1) provide a specific dividend that is paid before dividends are paid to common stock holders, 2) take precedence over common stock in the event of a liquidation, 3) do not enjoy any of the voting rights of common stockholders, and 4) pay an additional dividend (the participat

SecuritiesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMe.d: Securities issued in the form of shares that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur.

SubordinatedDebenturesSubjectToMandatory.l: Subordinated Debentures Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Member]
SubordinatedDebenturesSubjectToMandatory.d: A debt instrument that embodies an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur. This instrument is not secured by physical assets or other collateral and is backed only by the general creditworthiness and reputation of the issuer. Subordinated debentures are debt securities with a current interest rate that is senior in liquidation preference to all equit

ManufacturingFacilityMember.d: Structure used in the manufacturing of goods.

MarginDepositAssets.d: The amount of cash or securities placed with a broker or counterparty as security for a trading or derivatives securities position which was partially obtained with funds provided by the broker dealer.

MaritimeEquipmentMember.d: Equipment used for the primary purpose of water transportation.

StockMarketPriceGuaranteeMember.d: A guarantee of the market price of the common stock of the guaranteed party.

MarketValueGuaranteeMember.d: Guarantee of fair value of financial or nonfinancial asset owned by the guaranteed party.

MarketableSecuritiesCurrent.d: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as current.

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesCurrent.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesCurrent.d: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

MarketableSecurities.d: Amount of investment in marketable security.

HeldToMaturitySecurities.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, before Allowance for Credit Loss
HeldToMaturitySecurities.d: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesNoncurrent.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesNoncurrent.d: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

MarketableSecuritiesNoncurrent.d: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as noncurrent.

MarketingExpense.d: Expenditures for planning and executing the conception, pricing, promotion, and distribution of ideas, goods, and services. Costs of public relations and corporate promotions are typically considered to be marketing costs.

SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.l: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Amount of Unrecorded Benefit
SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.d: The amount of the unrecognized tax benefit of a position taken for which it is reasonably possible that the total amount thereof will significantly increase or decrease within twelve months of the balance sheet date.

SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.l: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Estimated Range Not Possible
SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.d: A statement that a range of reasonably possible change cannot be made for a tax position taken for which it is reasonably possible that the total amount of unrecognized tax benefit will significantly increase or decrease within 12 months of the balance sheet date.

SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.l: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Nature of Uncertainty [Domain]
SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.d: The nature of the uncertainty for which it is reasonably possible that the total amount of the unrecognized tax benefit will significantly increase or decrease within twelve months of the balance sheet date.

SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.l: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Other Information
SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.d: Other information relative to a tax position which it is reasonably possible that the total amount of the unrecognized tax benefit will significantly increase or decrease within twelve months of the balance sheet date.

ReasonablyPossibleSignificantChangeInUnr.d: Information by nature of uncertainty related to unrecognized tax benefits.

SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.l: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible [Line Items]
SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.l: Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefit, Reasonably Possible [Table]
SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.d: Disclosure of information about unrecognized tax benefit for which significant change is reasonably possible within 12 months. Includes, but is not limited to, nature of uncertainty, nature of event that could cause significant change within 12 months, and estimate of range of reasonably possible change or statement of fact that estimate of range cannot be made.

TimeSharingTransactionsAggregateMaturiti.l: Time-Sharing Transactions, Aggregate Maturities of Notes Receivable, Gross
TimeSharingTransactionsAggregateMaturiti.d: Amount of notes receivable related to time share sales, before allowance for uncollectible accounts and deferred profit.

TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.l: Time-Sharing Transaction, Notes Receivable, Maturity, after Year Five
TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.d: Amount, before allowance for uncollectible account, of notes receivable for time-sharing transaction maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.l: Time-Sharing Transaction, Notes Receivable, Maturity, Year Five
TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.d: Amount, before allowance for uncollectible account, of notes receivable for time-sharing transaction maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.l: Time-Sharing Transaction, Notes Receivable, Maturity, Year Four
TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.d: Amount, before allowance for uncollectible account, of notes receivable for time-sharing transaction maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.l: Time-Sharing Transaction, Notes Receivable, Maturity, Year One
TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.d: Amount, before allowance for uncollectible account, of notes receivable for time-sharing transaction maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.l: Time-Sharing Transaction, Notes Receivable, Maturity, Year Three
TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.d: Amount, before allowance for uncollectible account, of notes receivable for time-sharing transaction maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.l: Time-Sharing Transaction, Notes Receivable, Maturity, Year Two
TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.d: Amount, before allowance for uncollectible account, of notes receivable for time-sharing transaction maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

MaturitiesOfSeniorDebt.d: The cash outflow for the settlement of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, as it matures.

MaturitiesOfSubordinatedDebt.d: The cash outflow for a long-term borrowing where lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets as it matures.

MaturitiesOfTimeDepositsDescription.d: Description of time deposit maturities, including certificates of deposit.

TimeDepositsNoncurrentByMaturityAbstract.l: Time Deposit Maturities, after Year One [Abstract]

MediaContentMember.d: Information and entertainment created for consumption by end users or audiences.

InterestExpenseMediumTermNotes.d: Amount of interest expense incurred on medium-term note.

MediumTermNotesMember.d: Debt instruments with maturities ranging from five to ten years.

MediumTermNotes.d: Amount of debt instrument classified as medium-term.

MembershipsInExchangesOwned.d: Amount of capitalized cost for obtaining membership with right to do business on trading exchange.

RetailRelatedInventoryMerchandise.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of merchandise inventory purchased by a retailer, wholesaler or distributor and held for future sale.

PaymentsOfMergerRelatedCostsFinancingAct.l: Payments of Merger Related Costs, Financing Activities
PaymentsOfMergerRelatedCostsFinancingAct.d: The cash outflow for financing costs associated with business combinations.

MethodOfDeterminingImpairmentsOfPresentV.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Impairment, Description (Deprecated 2025)
MethodOfDeterminingImpairmentsOfPresentV.d: Description of fact and circumstance leading to impairment of present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

MineDevelopmentMember.d: Components used to prepare a mine for its intended use including, but not limited to, labor, materials, and equipment.

MineReclamationAndClosingLiabilityNoncur.l: Mine Reclamation and Closing Liability, Noncurrent
MineReclamationAndClosingLiabilityNoncur.d: Amount of a reclamation and mine closing liability that is associated with a legal obligation for the closure and reclamation of a mine including the removal of buildings, equipment, machinery and other physical remnants of mining, closure of tailings impoundments, leach pads and other mine features, and contouring, covering and revegetation of waste rock piles and other disturbed areas.

MineralPropertiesGross.d: Carrying amount at the balance sheet date of mineral properties, gross of adjustments.

MineralRights.d: Carrying amount at the balance sheet date of mineral rights, or rights to extract a mineral from the earth or to receive payment in the form of a royalty for the extraction of minerals, net of amortization.

MinimumGuaranteesPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for minimum guarantees, including the nature of each guarantee given to contract holders under long-duration contracts, and the methods of determining the amounts of the guarantees reflected as liabilities in the balance sheet or disclosed.

MinimumGuaranteesNetAmountAtRiskAbstract.l: Minimum Guarantees, Net Amount at Risk [Abstract]

MinimumGuaranteesNetAmountAtRiskDisclosu.l: Minimum Guarantees, Net Amount at Risk Disclosure [Text Block]
MinimumGuaranteesNetAmountAtRiskDisclosu.d: The entire disclosure for contracts with guaranteed benefits in excess of the current account balance. Disclose the amount of liability reported for additional insurance benefits, annuitization benefits and other minimum guarantees; the net amount at risk; and the weighted average attained age of contract holders, by type of guarantee and by type of benefit, as of the most recent balance sheet date.

MinimumLeasePaymentsSaleLeasebackTransac.l: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Thereafter (Deprecated 2026)
MinimumLeasePaymentsSaleLeasebackTransac.d: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

MinimumLeasePaymentsSaleLeasebackTransac.l: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Five Years (Deprecated 2026)
MinimumLeasePaymentsSaleLeasebackTransac.d: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

MinimumLeasePaymentsSaleLeasebackTransac.l: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Four Years (Deprecated 2026)
MinimumLeasePaymentsSaleLeasebackTransac.d: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

MinimumLeasePaymentsSaleLeasebackTransac.l: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Next 12 Months (Deprecated 2026)
MinimumLeasePaymentsSaleLeasebackTransac.d: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

MinimumLeasePaymentsSaleLeasebackTransac.l: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Three Years (Deprecated 2026)
MinimumLeasePaymentsSaleLeasebackTransac.d: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

MinimumLeasePaymentsSaleLeasebackTransac.l: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Two Years (Deprecated 2026)
MinimumLeasePaymentsSaleLeasebackTransac.d: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

MinorityInterest.d: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

MinorityInterestAmountRepresentedByPrefe.l: Noncontrolling Interest, Amount Represented by Preferred Stock
MinorityInterestAmountRepresentedByPrefe.d: The amount of noncontrolling interest in subsidiary represented by preferred securities issued by the subsidiary.

MinorityInterestDividendRequirementsOfPr.l: Noncontrolling Interest, Dividend Requirements of Preferred Stock
MinorityInterestDividendRequirementsOfPr.d: Description of the rate or terms of the dividend requirements of preferred securities issued by the subsidiary and held by noncontrolling interest owners.

MinorityInterestExplanationOfIncreaseDec.d: Explanation of the reasons for the increase or decrease in the reported noncontrolling interest balance during the period.

MinorityInterestDescription.d: Description of noncontrolling interest which might include background information, terms of the ownership arrangement, and type and terms of equity interest owned by the noncontrolling interest holders.

MinorityInterestOwnershipPercentageByNon.d: The equity interest of noncontrolling shareholders, partners or other equity holders in consolidated entity.

MinorityInterestOwnershipPercentageByPar.d: The parent entity's interest in net assets of the subsidiary, expressed as a percentage.

MinorityInterestDecreaseFromDistribution.l: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Distributions to Noncontrolling Interest Holders
MinorityInterestDecreaseFromDistribution.d: Decrease in noncontrolling interest balance from payment of dividends or other distributions by the non-wholly owned subsidiary or partially owned entity, included in the consolidation of the parent entity, to the noncontrolling interest holders.

MinorityInterestLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

MinorityInterestDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for noncontrolling interest in consolidated subsidiaries, which could include the name of the subsidiary, the ownership percentage held by the parent, the ownership percentage held by the noncontrolling owners, the amount of the noncontrolling interest, the location of this amount on the balance sheet (when not reported separately), an explanation of the increase or decrease in the amount of the noncontrolling interest, the noncontrolling interest share of the net Income or

MinorityInterestPeriodIncreaseDecrease.d: Net Increase or Decrease in balance of noncontrolling interest in the subsidiary during the reporting period.

MovementInMinorityInterestRollForward.l: Equity, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Roll Forward]
MovementInMinorityInterestRollForward.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

MinorityInterestInNetIncomeLossOfConsoli.l: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

MinorityInterestRepresentedByPreferredSt.l: Noncontrolling Interest Represented by Preferred Stock [Abstract]

MinorityInterestTable.d: Disclosure of information about noncontrolling interest, including, but not limited to, name of subsidiary, ownership percentage held by parent, ownership percentage held by noncontrolling owner, amount of noncontrolling interest and its location in statement of financial position, explanation of increase (decrease) in noncontrolling interest, noncontrolling interest share of net income (loss) of subsidiary and its location in statement of income, amount of noncontrolling interest represented by

MoneyMarketFundsMember.d: Fund that invests in short-term money-market instruments, for example, but not limited to, commercial paper, banker's acceptances, repurchase agreements, government securities, certificates of deposit, and other highly liquid securities.

MoneyMarketFundsAtCarryingValue.l: Cash Equivalent, Money Market Fund, Carrying Value
MoneyMarketFundsAtCarryingValue.d: Investment in short-term money-market instruments (such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances, repurchase agreements, government securities, certificates of deposit, and so forth) which are highly liquid (that is, readily convertible to known amounts of cash) and so near their maturity that they present an insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify as cash equivalents by def

MortalityMorbidityAndSurrenderRateAssump.l: Mortality, Morbidity and Surrender Rate Assumption
MortalityMorbidityAndSurrenderRateAssump.d: Relevant mortality and surrender rate assumptions that are an integral part of the methodology used in calculating the reserve for future benefits to be paid to or on behalf of policyholders and related expenses less the present value of future net premiums using assumptions such as estimates of expected investment yields, mortality, morbidity, terminations and expenses, applicable at the time the insurance contracts are made and cost of settling insured claims and cost incurred in the claim set

MortgagesMember.d: A loan to finance the purchase of real estate where the lender has a lien on the property as collateral for the loan.

MovementAnalysisOfDeferredPolicyAcquisit.l: Movement Analysis of Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs [Roll Forward]
MovementAnalysisOfDeferredPolicyAcquisit.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

AccrualForEnvironmentalLossContingencies.l: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies [Roll Forward]
AccrualForEnvironmentalLossContingencies.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

MovementInLiabilityForAsbestosAndEnviron.l: Movement in Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims [Abstract]

MovementInCustomerRefundableFeesRollForw.l: Movement in Customer Refundable Fees [Roll Forward]
MovementInCustomerRefundableFeesRollForw.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

MovementInDeferredRevenueRollForward.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

MovementInExtendedProductWarrantyAccrual.l: Movement in Extended Product Warranty Accrual [Roll Forward]
MovementInExtendedProductWarrantyAccrual.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePeriodIncr.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

MovementInMalpracticeLossContingencyRoll.l: Movement in Malpractice Loss Contingency [Roll Forward]
MovementInMalpracticeLossContingencyRoll.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

ClosedBlockDividendObligationAssumptions.d: Methodology and assumptions underlying the calculations of the excess of the cumulative actual closed block earnings over the expected (actuarially determined) closed block earnings for the period. The excess will result in future dividends to closed block policyholders, unless offset by less favorable than expected future performance of the closed block.

MovementInClosedBlockDividendObligationR.l: Movement in Closed Block Dividend Obligation [Roll Forward]
MovementInClosedBlockDividendObligationR.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

MovementInPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceP.l: Movement in Present Value of Future Insurance Profits [Roll Forward]
MovementInPresentValueOfFutureInsuranceP.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

MovementInStandardAndExtendedProductWarr.l: Movement in Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) [Roll Forward]
MovementInStandardAndExtendedProductWarr.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

MovementInStandardProductWarrantyAccrual.l: Movement in Standard Product Warranty Accrual [Roll Forward]
MovementInStandardProductWarrantyAccrual.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

MovementInMortgageLoansOnRealEstateRollF.l: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Movement in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate [Roll Forward]
MovementInMortgageLoansOnRealEstateRollF.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

MunicipalDebtSecuritiesAtCarryingValue.l: Cash Equivalent, Municipal Debt Security, Carrying Value
MunicipalDebtSecuritiesAtCarryingValue.d: Bonds or similar securities issued by state, city, or local governments or the agencies operated by state, city, or local governments which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means origi

MunicipalInvestmentAgreements.d: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the obligations arising from contracts specifying rights and responsibilities of a host municipality in the structure or operation of an investment project. For example, proceeds from a revenue bond may be invested temporarily in contracts until disbursements are required for construction of a major project. There is little or no insurance risk for the entity.

NASDAQIndexFutureMember.d: A standardized contract, traded on a futures exchange, to buy or sell National Association of Securities Dealers Automated (NASDAQ) index at a certain date in the future, at a certain price.

NaturalDisastersAndOtherCasualtyEventsMe.l: Natural Disasters and Other Casualty Events [Member]
NaturalDisastersAndOtherCasualtyEventsMe.d: Natural calamity or fire, flood or other hazards resulting in damages.

EnergyRelatedInventoryNaturalGasLiquids.l: Energy Related Inventory, Natural Gas Liquids
EnergyRelatedInventoryNaturalGasLiquids.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of liquid hydrocarbon components recovered from natural gas.

NaturalGasProcessingPlantMember.d: Plant used in connection with natural gas operations.

NaturalGasTransitionCostMember.d: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of natural gas transition costs.

NatureOfCommonOwnershipOrManagementContr.l: Nature of Common Ownership or Management Control Relationships
NatureOfCommonOwnershipOrManagementContr.d: This element represents a description of the nature of common ownership or management control relationships with other entities, regardless of there being transactions between the entities, when the existence of that control could result in operating results or financial position of the reporting entity significantly different from that which would have been obtained if the entities' were autonomous.

RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAx.d: Information by related and nonrelated parties. Related party includes, but is not limited to, affiliate, other entity for which investment is accounted for under equity method, trust for benefit of employee, principal owner, management, and member of immediate family, and other party that may be prevented from pursuing separate interests because of control, significant influence, or ownership interest.

NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeGene.l: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, General Account Value
NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeGene.d: Value of the general accounts corresponding to the specified product, guarantee type and subset of the guarantee.

NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeNetA.l: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Net Amount at Risk
NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeNetA.d: Net amount at risk, representing the guaranteed benefit in excess of the current account balance corresponding to the specified product, guarantee type and subset of the guarantee.

NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeSepa.l: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Separate Account Value
NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeSepa.d: Value of the separate accounts corresponding to the specified product, guarantee type and subset of the guarantee.

NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeLine.l: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee [Line Items]
NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeLine.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeTabl.l: Net Amount at Risk, by Product and Guarantee [Table]
NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeTabl.d: For contracts with guaranteed benefits in excess of the current account balance, sets forth the amounts of such excesses (the net amounts at risk) and other pertinent information by type of guarantee by type of insurance product), as of the most recent balance sheet date.

RealEstateHeldForDevelopmentAndSaleNet.l: Real Estate Held for Development and Sale, Net
RealEstateHeldForDevelopmentAndSaleNet.d: For banks, amount of real estate assets held for development or sale, net of associated liabilities.

NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.l: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Continuing Operation
NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity attributable to continuing operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.l: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Continuing Operation [Abstract]

NetCashProvidedByUsedInDiscontinuedOpera.l: Cash Provided by (Used in) Discontinued Operation
NetCashProvidedByUsedInDiscontinuedOpera.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating, investing, and financing activities; attributable to discontinued operation.

NetCashProvidedByUsedInDiscontinuedOpera.l: Cash Provided by (Used in) Discontinued Operation [Abstract]

NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActiviti.l: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActiviti.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActiviti.l: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation [Abstract]

NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActiviti.l: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActiviti.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActiviti.l: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation [Abstract]

NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.l: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation
NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.l: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation [Abstract]

NetChangeAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertifica.l: Net Change Annuities and Investment Certificates
NetChangeAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertifica.d: The cash inflow or outflow for an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.

NetChangeAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertifica.l: Net Change Annuities and Investment Certificates [Abstract]

PaymentsForProceedsFromDepositOnLoan.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposit on Loan
PaymentsForProceedsFromDepositOnLoan.d: The net cash inflow or outflow from resulting from payment, receipt or drawdown of cash deposit to guarantee a loan during the period.

IncreaseDecreaseInTimeDepositsOf100000Or.l: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits of $100,000 or more
IncreaseDecreaseInTimeDepositsOf100000Or.d: The increase (decrease) in time deposits equal to or greater than $100,000 per account.

IncreaseDecreaseInTimeDepositsOfLessThan.l: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits of Less than $100,000
IncreaseDecreaseInTimeDepositsOfLessThan.d: The increase (decrease) in time deposits less than $100,000 per account.

IncreaseDecreaseInOtherTimeDeposits.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in time deposits classified as other.

NetChangeContractHoldersFunds.d: The cash inflow or outflow for a segregated fund account during the period.

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfDebt.d: The net cash inflow or outflow in aggregate debt due to repayments and proceeds from additional borrowings.

IncreaseDecreaseInDeposits.d: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period deposits balances.

ProceedsFromPaymentsForDepositsAppliedTo.l: Proceeds from (Payments for) Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements
ProceedsFromPaymentsForDepositsAppliedTo.d: The net cash inflow or outflow from payments to deposit account and application of deposits to retire or pay down debt during the period.

ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfEquity.d: The net cash inflow or outflow resulting from the entity's share transaction.

IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPurchased.d: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund borrowed from other financial institution arising from the insufficient reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.

IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPurchasedA.l: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Net
IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPurchasedA.d: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash inflow or outflow from investment sold under the agreement to reacquire such investment.

IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPurchasedA.l: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Net [Abstract]

IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsSold.d: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.

ProceedsFromPaymentsForFederalFundsSoldA.l: Proceeds from (Payments for) Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Net
ProceedsFromPaymentsForFederalFundsSoldA.d: The cash flow from the funds lent to and (borrowed from) other financial reporting institutions arising from excess or shortfall in reserve deposited at the Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirements. This lending and borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash outflow or inflow from investments purchased under the agreement to resell such investment.

ProceedsFromPaymentsForFederalFundsSoldA.l: Proceeds from (Payments for) Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Net [Abstract]

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfFirstMortgageBon.l: Proceeds from (Repayments of) First Mortgage Bond
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfFirstMortgageBon.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property.

PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeFinancingAct.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Financing Activities
PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeFinancingAct.d: The net cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

ProceedsFromPaymentsForInInterestBearing.l: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Interest-Bearing Deposits in Banks
ProceedsFromPaymentsForInInterestBearing.d: The net cash inflow or outflow in Interest-bearing Deposits by banks in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits.

NetChangeInterestBearingDepositsDomestic.d: The increase (decrease) in interest-bearing deposits domestic.

NetChangeInterestBearingDepositsForeign.d: The increase (decrease) in interest bearing deposits foreign.

IncreaseDecreaseInInterestAndDividendsRe.l: Increase (Decrease) in Interest and Dividends Receivable
IncreaseDecreaseInInterestAndDividendsRe.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount due to the entity in the form of unpaid interest and dividends.

IncreaseDecreaseInInterestAndDividendsRe.l: Increase (Decrease) in Interest and Dividends Receivable [Abstract]

NetChangeInterestAndNoninterestBearingDe.l: Net Change Interest and Noninterest-Bearing Deposits, Domestic
NetChangeInterestAndNoninterestBearingDe.d: The increase (decrease) in domestic interest and noninterest bearing deposits.

NetChangeInterestAndNoninterestBearingDe.l: Net Change Interest and Noninterest-Bearing Deposits, Domestic [Abstract]
Net Change Interest and Noninterest-Bearing Deposits, Foreign
NetChangeInterestAndNoninterestBearingDe.d: The increase (decrease) in foreign interest and noninterest bearing deposits.

NetChangeInterestAndNoninterestBearingDe.l: Net Change Interest and Noninterest-Bearing Deposits, Foreign [Abstract]

IncreaseDecreaseInOutstandingChecksOpera.l: Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Operating Activities
IncreaseDecreaseInOutstandingChecksOpera.d: The change in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in outstanding checks, the liability that represents checks that have been issued but that have not cleared. The entity may classify these cash flows as financing or operating activities. Another element, Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Financing Activities, represents cash flows from outstanding checks classified as financing activities.

IncreaseDecreaseInLoansHeldForSale.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of loan held with intention to sell or be securitized in near future.

PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansAndLeases.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans and Leases
PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansAndLeases.d: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period of loan and lease balances which are not originated or purchased specifically for resale. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansAndLeasesAbs.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans and Leases [Abstract]

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLongTermDebtAndC.l: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLongTermDebtAndC.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLongTermDebtAndC.l: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities [Abstract]

IncreaseDecreaseInDemandDeposits.d: The net cash inflow or outflow in the total of all demand deposits, including checking and negotiable order of withdrawal (NOW) accounts, classified as cash flows from financing activities.

NetChangeNoninterestBearingDepositsDomes.d: The increase (decrease) in domestic noninterest bearing deposits.

NetChangeNoninterestBearingDepositsForei.d: The increase (decrease) in foreign noninterest bearing deposits.

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfNotesPayable.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherDebt.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) for debt classified as other.

IncreaseDecreaseInOtherDeposits.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in deposit liabilities classified as other.

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDeb.l: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Long-Term Debt
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDeb.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from other long-term debt.

IncreaseDecreaseInOutstandingChecksFinan.l: Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Financing Activities
IncreaseDecreaseInOutstandingChecksFinan.d: The change in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in outstanding checks, the liability that represents checks that have been issued but that have not cleared. The entity may classify these cash flows as financing or operating activities.

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfPollutionControl.l: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Pollution Control Bond
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfPollutionControl.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from a long-term debt instrument issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities, sewage, or solid waste disposal facilities.

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt.l: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Related Party Debt
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt by a related party. Related parties, include, but are not limited to, affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, and pension trusts.

IncreaseDecreaseInSavingsDeposits.d: The net cash inflow or outflow in the total of all savings account deposits, which may include passbook, statement savings accounts and money-market deposit accounts (MMDAs), classified as cash flows from financing activities.

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfSecuredDebt.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes tax exempt secured debt.

ProceedsFromPaymentsForSecuritiesPurchas.l: Proceeds from (Payments for) Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
ProceedsFromPaymentsForSecuritiesPurchas.d: The net cash flow from purchases followed by sales of securities under terms of reverse repurchase agreements.

ProceedsFromPaymentsForInSecuritiesSoldU.l: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
ProceedsFromPaymentsForInSecuritiesSoldU.d: The cash flow from investments sold under the agreement to repurchase such investment.

IncreaseDecreaseInTimeDeposits.d: Net cash inflow (outflow) of time deposits.

IncreaseDecreaseInUndisbursedLoanFunds.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in undistributed cash for loans that have been granted but not entirely funded.

ForeclosedAssets.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of all assets obtained in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement through foreclosure proceedings or defeasance; includes real and personal property; equity interests in corporations, partnerships, and joint ventures; and beneficial interests in trusts.

GainLossOnSaleOfMortgageLoans.l: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Mortgage Loans
GainLossOnSaleOfMortgageLoans.d: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans made to finance real estate acquisitions. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

GainLossOnSalesOfConsumerLoans.l: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Consumer Loans
GainLossOnSalesOfConsumerLoans.d: The gains (losses) included in earning that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of consumer loans. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

GainLossOnSaleOfLoansAndLeases.l: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Loans and Leases
GainLossOnSaleOfLoansAndLeases.d: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

GainLossOnSaleOfLoansAndLeasesAbstract.l: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Loans and Leases [Abstract]

NetIncomeLoss.d: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholde.l: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholde.d: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

InterestIncomeExpenseNet.d: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating.

NetInvestmentHedgeDerivativeAssetsAtFair.l: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Net Investment in Foreign Operations, Assets, Fair Value
NetInvestmentHedgeDerivativeAssetsAtFair.d: Fair value of all derivative assets designated as hedges of net investment in foreign operations.

NetInvestmentHedgeDerivativeLiabilitiesA.l: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Net Investment in Foreign Operations, Liabilities, Fair Value
NetInvestmentHedgeDerivativeLiabilitiesA.d: Fair value of all derivative liabilities designated as hedges of net investment in foreign operations.

NetInvestmentHedgeDerivativesAtFairValue.l: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Net Investment in Foreign Operations, Assets, Fair Value, Net
NetInvestmentHedgeDerivativesAtFairValue.d: Net fair value of all derivatives designated as hedges of net investment in foreign operations.

NetInvestmentIncome.d: Amount, after investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

ProceedsFromLoanAndLeaseOriginationsAndP.l: Proceeds from Loan and Lease Originations and Principal Collections [Abstract]

LoansAndLeasesReceivableAllowance.d: Amount of allowance to cover probable credit losses on loans and leases. Includes carryover of or adjustments to the allowance for loan losses in connection with business combinations. Excludes allowance for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesRealEstate.l: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Real Estate
AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesRealEstate.d: The reserve to cover probable credit losses related to specifically identified fixed maturity real estate loans as well as probable credit losses inherent in the remainder of that loan portfolio.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmoun.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount
LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmoun.d: Amount after allowance and deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements and loans held for sale.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmoun.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount [Abstract]

MortgageLoansOnRealEstateCommercialAndCo.l: Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Commercial and Consumer, Net
MortgageLoansOnRealEstateCommercialAndCo.d: The balance represents the amount of loans that are secured by real estate mortgages, offset by the reserve to cover probable credit losses on the loan portfolio.

MortgageLoansOnRealEstateCommercialAndCo.l: Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Commercial and Consumer, Net, (Investment Based Operations Presentation) [Abstract]

PremiumsEarnedNetAccidentAndHealth.l: Premiums Earned, Net, Accident and Health (Deprecated 2025)
PremiumsEarnedNetAccidentAndHealth.d: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of accident and health premiums earned.

PremiumsEarnedNetLife.d: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of life premiums earned.

PremiumsEarnedNetPropertyAndCasualty.l: Premiums Earned, Net, Property and Casualty (Deprecated 2025)
PremiumsEarnedNetPropertyAndCasualty.d: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of property and casualty premiums earned.

ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageServicingRight.l: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)
ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageServicingRight.d: The cash inflow from the sale of servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Va

ProceedsFromStockPlans.d: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the stock plan during the period.

NetRegulatoryAssets.d: The net amount of all regulatory assets less all regulatory liabilities as of the end of the period.

MinimumNetWorthRequiredForCompliance.l: Banking Regulation, Mortgage Banking, Net Worth, Minimum
MinimumNetWorthRequiredForCompliance.d: Amount of minimum net worth required for mortgage banking as defined by regulatory framework.

PremiumsWrittenNet.d: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums written.

NewAccountingPronouncementsOrChangeInAcc.l: New Accounting Pronouncements or Change in Accounting Principle [Line Items]
NewAccountingPronouncementsOrChangeInAcc.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

NewAccountingPronouncementOrChangeInAcco.d: Disclosure related to a new accounting pronouncement or a change in accounting principle, including the nature and reason for the change and the effect of the change on prior periods and the current period.

NewAccountingPronouncementOrChangeInAcco.l: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Indirect Effects
NewAccountingPronouncementOrChangeInAcco.d: Description of the indirect effects of a change in accounting principle, including the amounts that have been recognized in the current period and related per share (or unit) amounts, if applicable. Indirect changes are any changes to current or future cash flows of an entity that result from making a change in accounting principle that is applied retrospectively. NewAccountingPronouncementsAndChangesInA.l: Accounting Standards Update and Change in Accounting Principle [Abstract]

ScheduleOfNewAccountingPronouncementsAnd.d: Tabular disclosure of changes in accounting principles, including adoption of new accounting pronouncements, that describes the new methods, amount and effects on financial statement line items.

NewAccountingPronouncementsOrChangeInAcc.l: Accounting Standards Update and Change in Accounting Principle [Table]
NewAccountingPronouncementsOrChangeInAcc.d: Disclosure of information about change in accounting principle or amendment to accounting standards or both. Includes, but is not limited to, nature, reason, and method of adopting amendment to accounting standards and other change in accounting principle.

NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesDome.d: Amount of domestic noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity, which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.

NoninterestBearingDomesticDepositBrokere.d: Amount of noninterest-bearing domestic third-party deposits placed by or through the assistance of a deposit broker, also known as brokered deposit liabilities.

NoninterestBearingDomesticDepositCheckin.d: Amount of noninterest-bearing domestic checking deposit liabilities.

NoninterestBearingDomesticDepositDemand.d: Amount of money in noninterest-bearing domestic accounts that entitle the depositor to withdraw funds at any time without prior notice, also known as demand deposits.

NoninterestBearingDomesticDepositDescrip.d: Description of noninterest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities, which may include methodology, assumptions and the types and amounts of domestic deposit liabilities.

NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesDome.l: Noninterest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic, by Component [Abstract]

NoninterestBearingDomesticDepositRetail.d: Amount of noninterest-bearing domestic retail deposit liabilities.

NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesFore.d: Amount of foreign noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.

NoninterestBearingForeignDepositLiabilit.d: Description of noninterest-bearing deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices, which may include methodology, assumptions and the types and amounts of foreign deposit liabilities.

NoncumulativePreferredStockMember.d: Preferred stock upon which unpaid dividends do not accrue.

NonsoftwareLicenseArrangementMember.d: Category of deferred revenue by arrangement wherein certain rights are granted under a license agreement to exploit one or more non-software products (such as proprietary drugs, goods, or business process), under which fees received are taken into income as revenue recognition criteria are met.

NonsoftwareServiceSupportAndMaintenanceA.l: Nonsoftware Service, Support and Maintenance Arrangement [Member]
NonsoftwareServiceSupportAndMaintenanceA.d: Category of deferred revenue by arrangement wherein an entity agrees to debug, revise and maintain one or more specified products, under which fees are taken into income as performance occurs.

NondebtorReorganizationItemsLegalAndAdvi.l: Nondebtor Reorganization Items, Legal and Advisory Professional Fees
NondebtorReorganizationItemsLegalAndAdvi.d: Amount of reorganization items related to legal and advisory professional fees related to entities not in bankruptcy.

BusinessDevelopment.d: Business development involves the development of products and services, their delivery, design and their implementation. Business development includes a number of techniques designed to grow an economic enterprise. Such techniques include, but are not limited to, assessments of marketing opportunities and target markets, intelligence gathering on customers and competitors, generating leads for possible sales, follow-up sales activity, formal proposal writing and business model design. Business d

CommunicationsAndInformationTechnology.d: The amount of expense in the period for communications and data processing expense.

CommunicationsInformationTechnologyAndOc.d: The aggregate amount of communications, data processing and occupancy expenses.

FederalDepositInsuranceCorporationPremiu.l: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Premium Expense
FederalDepositInsuranceCorporationPremiu.d: Amount of expense for Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance.

LoanProcessingFee.d: Expenses paid for obtaining loans which includes expenses such as application and origination fees.

OccupancyNet.d: Amount of net occupancy expense that may include items, such as depreciation of facilities and equipment, lease expenses, property taxes and property and casualty insurance expense.

OtherNoninterestExpense.d: Amount of noninterest expense classified as other.

PostageExpense.d: Amount of expense associated with postage.

SuppliesExpense.d: Amount of expense associated with supplies that were used during the current accounting period.

SuppliesAndPostageExpense.d: The aggregate amount of expenses directly related to the supplies and postage.

NoninterestIncome.d: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.

BankOwnedLifeInsuranceIncome.d: Earnings on or other increases in the value of the cash surrender value of bank owned life insurance policies.

ConversionGainsAndLossesOnForeignInvestm.l: Conversion Gains and Losses on Foreign Investments
ConversionGainsAndLossesOnForeignInvestm.d: Represents gains or losses resulting from transactions conducted in foreign currencies.

GainsLossesOnSalesOfAssets.l: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets for Financial Service Operations
GainsLossesOnSalesOfAssets.d: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets utilized in financial service operations.

GainsLossesOnSalesOfAssetsAbstract.l: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets for Financial Service Operations [Abstract]

GainsLossesOnSalesOfCreditCardPortfolio.l: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Credit Card Portfolio
GainsLossesOnSalesOfCreditCardPortfolio.d: The gain (loss) resulting from the sale of credit card receivables (portfolios).

GainsLossesOnSalesOfOtherRealEstate.l: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Real Estate
GainsLossesOnSalesOfOtherRealEstate.d: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of other real estate owned, increases (decreases) in the valuation allowance for foreclosed real estate, and write-downs of other real estate owned after acquisition or physical possession.

InsuranceCommissionsAndFees.d: Income from agency and brokerage operations (includes sales of annuities and supplemental contracts); service charges, commissions, and fees from the sale of insurance and related services; and management fees from separate accounts, deferred annuities, and universal life products.

InsuranceServicesRevenue.d: Revenue from insurance services, including net premiums earned, gain on sale of insurance block, agency management fees and insurance contract fees and commissions.

InvestmentBankingAdvisoryBrokerageAndUnd.l: Investment Banking, Advisory, Brokerage, and Underwriting Fees and Commissions
InvestmentBankingAdvisoryBrokerageAndUnd.d: Amount of fees and commissions from banking, advisory, brokerage, and securities underwriting activities. Activities include, but are not limited to, underwriting securities, private placements of securities, investment advisory and management services, merger and acquisition services, sale and servicing of mutual funds, and other related consulting fees.

InvestmentBankingAdvisoryBrokerageAndUnd.l: Investment Banking, Advisory, Brokerage, and Underwriting Fees and Commissions, Alternative Presentation for Banks [Abstract]

GainLossOnSaleOfCapitalLeasesNet.l: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Capital Leases, Net (Deprecated 2026)
GainLossOnSaleOfCapitalLeasesNet.d: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's transactions involving the sale, transfer, or termination of financing agreements classified as capital leases.

GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNet.l: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Loans, Net
GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNet.d: The net gain (loss) resulting from a sale of loans, including adjustments to record loans classified as held-for-sale at the lower-of-cost-or-market and fair value adjustments to loan held for investment purposes.

GainLossOnSaleOfLeasedAssetsNetOperating.l: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Leased Assets, Net, Operating Leases
GainLossOnSaleOfLeasedAssetsNetOperating.d: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's sale of assets held- or available-for-lease under contractual arrangements classified as operating leases.

VentureCapitalGainsLossesNet.d: Amount of gain (loss) on venture capital activities. Includes venture capital revenue, fair value adjustments, interest and dividends, investment gain (loss) and fee or other income from venture capital activities.

NoninterestIncomeOther.d: Represents the total of noninterest income derived from certain activities and assets including (for example): (1) venture capital investments; (2) bank owned life insurance; (3) foreign currency transactions; and (4) mortgage servicing rights.

NoninterestIncomeOtherOperatingIncome.d: Amount of revenue earned, classified as other, excluding interest income.

ProfitLossFromRealEstateOperations.d: The net cost of operation of other real estate (including provisions for real estate losses, rental income, and gains and losses on sales of real estate).

PrincipalTransactionsRevenue.d: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) resulting from the difference between acquisition price and selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, and from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, including, but not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

NonoperatingIncomeExpense.d: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

InterestAndDebtExpense.d: Interest and debt related expenses associated with nonoperating financing activities of the entity.

InvestmentIncomeNonoperating.d: The aggregate amount of income from investments (for example, dividends) not considered a component of the entity's core operations.

NoncashInvestingAndFinancingActivitiesRe.l: Noncash Investing and Financing Activities Related Text
NoncashInvestingAndFinancingActivitiesRe.d: Additional textual information about significant noncash (or part noncash) investing and financing activities required to be supplementally disclosed. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

OtherNoncashExpense.d: Amount of expense or loss included in net income that result in no cash flow, classified as other.

NoncompeteAgreementsMember.d: Agreement in which one party agrees not to pursue a similar trade in competition with another party.

AssetsNoncurrent.d: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

InventoryNoncurrent.d: Inventories not expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within the normal operating cycle.

LiabilitiesNoncurrent.d: Amount of obligation due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

LongTermAccountsNotesAndLoansReceivableN.l: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent [Abstract]

NoninterestExpenseCommissionExpense.d: Amount of fees incurred for commissions on mutual funds and insurance products.

NoninterestExpenseDirectorsFees.d: Amount of expense for service provided by entity's director.

ExpenseRelatedToDistributionOrServicingA.l: Expense Related to Distribution or Servicing and Underwriting Fees
ExpenseRelatedToDistributionOrServicingA.d: Expense related to distribution, servicing and underwriting fees.

ForeclosedRealEstateExpense.d: Amount of expense recognized during the period for the foreclosure on real estate assets.

NoninterestExpenseInvestmentAdvisoryFees.d: Amount of expense for investment advisory service, including, but not limited to, managing money in fund.

MarketingAndAdvertisingExpense.d: The total expense recognized in the period for promotion, public relations, and brand or product advertising.

NoninterestExpenseOfferingCost.d: Amount of expense for cost associated with issuance of security by investment company. Includes, but is not limited to, legal fee pertaining to share offered for sale, registration fee, underwriting, printing prospectus, and initial fee for listing on exchange.

NoninterestExpenseRelatedToPerformanceFe.l: Noninterest Expense Related to Performance Fees
NoninterestExpenseRelatedToPerformanceFe.d: Incentive fees which are compensation paid to a trading advisor or to any practitioner who achieves investment results above a specified contractual level.

NoninterestExpensePrintingAndFulfillment.d: Amounts expended for printing of marketing and compliance communications and fulfillment services.

ProfessionalFees.d: A fee charged for services from professionals such as doctors, lawyers and accountants. The term is often expanded to include other professions, for example, pharmacists charging to maintain a medicinal profile of a client or customer.

NoninterestExpenseTransferAgentAndCustod.d: Amount of expense for transfer agent and custodian services. Includes, but is not limited to, fee paid for maintaining investor record, account balance, and company's stock transaction and fee paid for holding and safeguarding assets of individual, mutual fund, and investment company.

SubadvisoryFeesForMutualFunds.d: Subadvisory fees that the funds adviser pays for out of the management fee, which it receives from the fund.

NonmonetaryTransactionAmountOfBarterTran.l: Nonmonetary Transaction, Amount of Barter Transaction (Deprecated 2026)
NonmonetaryTransactionAmountOfBarterTran.d: The amount of revenue and expenses for the services received and provided in a nonmonetary arrangement.

NonmonetaryTransactionTypeDomain.d: Identifies the nature of the nonmonetary transaction or group of similar transactions, such as a barter or exchange.

OtherNonrecurringIncomeExpense.d: Amount of other expense (income) that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

NoteWarrantMember.d: A note that entitles the holder to buy stock of the company at a specified price, which is much higher than the stock price at the time of issue.

NotesAndLoansPayable.d: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

LongTermNotesAndLoans.d: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

NotesAndLoansPayableCurrent.d: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of all long-term notes and loans payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

NotesPayableCurrent.d: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of long-term notes payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

LongTermNotesPayable.d: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of notes payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

NotesPayableOtherPayablesMember.d: A written promise to pay a note to a third party.

NotesAndLoansReceivableGrossNoncurrent.d: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

NotesAndLoansReceivableNetNoncurrent.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

NotesAndLoansReceivableGrossCurrent.l: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
NotesAndLoansReceivableGrossCurrent.d: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

NuclearPlantMember.d: Plant used in connection with the generation of nuclear energy.

NumberOfCreditRiskDerivativesHeld.l: Number of Credit Risk Derivatives Held
NumberOfCreditRiskDerivativesHeld.d: Number of credit risk derivative instruments held.

NumberOfForeignCurrencyDerivativesHeld.l: Number of Foreign Currency Derivatives Held

NumberOfInterestRateDerivativesHeld.l: Number of Interest Rate Derivatives Held
NumberOfInterestRateDerivativesHeld.d: Number of interest rate derivative instruments held by the entity at the reporting date.

NumberOfPriceRiskDerivativesHeld.l: Number of Price Risk Derivatives Held
NumberOfPriceRiskDerivativesHeld.d: Number of price risk derivative instruments held by the entity at the reporting date.

ObjectivesForUsingFairValueHedgingInstru.d: Textual description of the reasons for holding or issuing derivative instruments and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments. Includes discussion of the objectives for holding the instruments, the context needed to understand those objectives, and the strategies for achieving those objectives. ObjectivesForUsingNetInvestmentHedgingIn.d: Description of the reasons for holding or issuing derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation. OfferingCostsPartnershipInterests.d: Costs incurred in connection with the offering and selling of additional partner interest.

OfficeEquipmentMember.d: Tangible personal property used in an office setting. Examples include, but are not limited to, computers, copiers and fax machine.

ExploratoryDrillingCostsCapitalizationAn.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for capitalization of exploratory drilling costs, including the criteria management applies in evaluating whether costs incurred meet the criteria for initial capitalization, continued capitalization, impairment, and how often such evaluations are made.

GasBalancingArrangementsPolicy.l: Oil and Gas, Gas-Balancing Arrangement [Policy Text Block]

OtherNotesPayableCurrent.d: Amount of long-term notes classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

OtherLongTermNotesPayable.d: Amount of long-term notes classified as other, payable after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

OtherOilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMe.l: Oil and Gas, Successful Efforts Method, Property and Equipment, Other
OtherOilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMe.d: Amount of oil and gas properties accounted for using the successful effort method, classified as other.

OtherOwnershipInterestsCapitalAccount.d: Capital account balance of the other unit holders in a limited partnership or master limited partnership. Does not include limited or general partners' ownership interests.

OtherOwnershipInterestsCumulativeCashDis.l: Other Ownership Interests, Cumulative Cash Distributions
OtherOwnershipInterestsCumulativeCashDis.d: Aggregate cumulative cash distributions made to the other unit holders in a limited partnership or master limited partnership. Does not include limited or general partners' ownership interests.

OtherOwnershipInterestsCumulativeNetInco.d: The amount of aggregate cumulative earnings allocated to the other unit holders in a limited partnership or master limited partnership. Does not include limited or general partners' ownership interests.

OtherOwnershipInterestsNameDomain.d: Description of the ownership interest, which details special or unusual rights. Does not include limited or general partners' ownership interests.

OtherOwnershipInterestsUnitsAuthorized.d: The number of units of other ownership interest authorized to be issued in a limited partnership or master limited partnership. Does not include limited or general partners' ownership interests.

OtherOwnershipInterestsUnitsIssued.d: The number of units of other ownership interests issued in a limited partnership or master limited partnership. Does not include limited or general partners' ownership interests.

OtherOwnershipInterestsUnitsOutstanding.d: The number of units of other ownership interests outstanding in a limited partnership or master limited partnership. Does not include limited or general partners' ownership interests.

OtherOwnershipInterestsValue.d: The amount of capital contributed by other unit holders.

OtherOwnershipInterestsByNameAxis.d: Information by ownership interests about other units or shares or classes of ownership in a partnership. Excludes limited or general partners' ownership interests.

OtherOwnershipInterestsLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ScheduleOfOtherOwnershipInterestsTable.d: Disclosure of information about other ownership interest in partnership. Includes, but is not limited to, description of ownership interest, capital contributed, capital account balance, unit of other ownership interest authorized to be issued, issued, and outstanding, cumulative cash distribution made, and cumulative net income shared by other unit holder in partnership. Excludes general and limited partners' ownership interests.

OtherParentCompanyDisclosures.d: Other registrant disclosures related to the condensed financial information of the parent company. May include disclosure of any change in accounting practice that affects comparability between periods.

OtherPlantInServiceMember.d: Plant used for the processing, transmission, or distribution of materials, classified as other.

OtherPolicyholderFunds.d: Amount due to policyholders for funds held that are returnable under the terms of insurance contracts, classified as other.

IncreaseDecreaseInOtherPolicyholderFunds.d: The change in other policyholder funds recorded on the balance sheet, which is needed to adjust net income to arrive at net cash flows provided by or used in operations.

OtherPostretirementBenefitPlansDefinedBe.d: Plan designed to provide other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Excludes pension benefits.

OtherPostretirementBenefitsPayments.d: Amount of cash outflow for other postretirement benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes pension benefit.

OtherPrepaidExpenseCurrent.d: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for other costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

PaymentsToAcquireOtherPropertyPlantAndEq.l: Payments to Acquire Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
PaymentsToAcquireOtherPropertyPlantAndEq.d: Amount of cash outflow from the acquisition of or improvements to long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

OtherRealEstate.d: Carrying amount of other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This does not include real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

OtherReceivables.d: Amount due from parties in nontrade transactions, classified as other.

ResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseSoftwareExc.l: Research and Development Expense, Software (Excluding Acquired in Process Cost)
ResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseSoftwareExc.d: Research and development expense during the period related to the costs of developing and achieving technological feasibility of a computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed.

OtherRestrictedAssetsCurrent.d: Amount of current assets that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions, classified as other.

OtherRestrictionsOnPaymentOfDividends.l: Other Restrictions on Payment of Dividends
OtherRestrictionsOnPaymentOfDividends.d: Description of restrictions, classified as other, on the ability to pay dividends.
