OtherRestructuringCosts.d: Amount of other expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

OtherRevenueExpenseFromRealEstateOperati.l: Other Revenue (Expense) from Real Estate Operations
OtherRevenueExpenseFromRealEstateOperati.d: Amount of other revenue (expense) derived from real estate investments partnerships.

OtherSellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpe.l: Other Selling, General and Administrative Expense
OtherSellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpe.d: Amount of selling, general and administrative expense classified as other.

OtherShortTermBorrowings.d: Amount of borrowings classified as other, maturing within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

OtherShortTermInvestments.d: Amount of short-term investments classified as other.

OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionConsid.l: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Consideration Given
OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionConsid.d: The noncash (or part noncash) consideration given (for example, liability, equity) in a transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionConsid.l: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Consideration Received
OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionConsid.d: The noncash (or part noncash) consideration received in a transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionNameDo.d: The name of other significant noncash (or part noncash) investing and financing activities required to be supplementally disclosed to enable users of the financial information to fully understand the period cash flows of the Entity in relation to the statements of financial position, income statement, and statement of changes in shareholders' equity. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to tha

OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionsByUni.d: Information by other significant noncash transactions.

OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionsLineI.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionsTable.d: Disclosure of information about other noncash or part noncash transaction.

RetailRelatedInventoryPackagingAndOtherS.l: Retail Related Inventory, Packaging and Other Supplies
RetailRelatedInventoryPackagingAndOtherS.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of items used in storage, presentation or transportation of physical goods that are targeted for sale to end users.

LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustm.l: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid [Abstract]

ParticipatingMortgageLoanNameDomain.d: Name of mortgage that gives the lender the right to share in the appreciation of fair value or results of operations of the mortgaged real estate project.

ParticipatingMortgageLoansAppreciationIn.l: Participating Mortgage Loans, Description of Terms
ParticipatingMortgageLoansAppreciationIn.d: Description of terms of mortgage that gives the lender the right to share in the appreciation of fair value or results of operations of the mortgaged real estate project.

ParticipatingMortgageLoansAxis.d: Information by description of participating mortgage loan.

ParticipatingMortgageLoansUnamortizedDeb.l: Participating Mortgage Loans, Unamortized Debt Discount, Amount
ParticipatingMortgageLoansUnamortizedDeb.d: The amount of the related debt discount at the end of the accounting period.

ParticipatingMortgageLoansExtinguishment.d: States the amount of gain (loss) resulting from a participating loan extinguished before its due date.

ParticipatingMortgageLoansLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ParticipatingMortgageLoansMortgageObliga.l: Participating Mortgage Loans, Mortgage Obligations, Amount
ParticipatingMortgageLoansMortgageObliga.d: The aggregate amount of the participating mortgage obligation at the end of the accounting period.

ParticipatingMortgageLoansParticipationL.l: Participating Mortgage Loans, Participation Liabilities, Amount
ParticipatingMortgageLoansParticipationL.d: The aggregate amount of the participation liability at the end of the accounting period.

ParticipatingMortgageLoansTable.d: Disclosure of information about participating mortgage obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, aggregate amount of participating mortgage obligation and terms of participation by lender.

ParticipatingMortgagesMember.d: Mortgage that gives the lender the right to share in the appreciation of fair value or results of operations of the mortgaged real estate project.

PartnersCapital.d: The amount of ownership interest of different classes of partners in limited partnership.

PartnersCapitalAccountAcquisitions.d: Change in the different classes of partners' capital accounts during the year due to acquisitions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

PartnerTypeOfPartnersCapitalAccountAxis.d: Information by type or class of partner's capital account. Examples of classes of partners include, but not limited to, general partners, limited partners, preferred partners, and other ownership interests.

PartnersCapitalAccountContributions.d: Total contributions made by each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

PartnersCapitalAccountDeferredCompensati.d: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to deferred compensation. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountDescriptionOfPartn.l: Partners' Capital Account, Description of Partnership Interest (Deprecated 2026)
PartnersCapitalAccountDescriptionOfPartn.d: Description of the shares of ownership of the different classes of partners, which are represented by units.

PartnersCapitalAccountDescriptionOfUnits.l: Partners' Capital Account, Description of Units Sold
PartnersCapitalAccountDescriptionOfUnits.d: Description of the units sold during the year of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountDistributionPerUni.l: Partners' Capital Account, Distribution Per Unit of Limited Partner Interest
PartnersCapitalAccountDistributionPerUni.d: The amount of the distribution per unit of limited partner interest.

PartnersCapitalAccountDistributions.d: Total distributions to each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

PartnersCapitalAccountExchangesAndConver.l: Partners' Capital Account, Exchanges and Conversions
PartnersCapitalAccountExchangesAndConver.d: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to exchanges and conversions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountPeriodIncreaseDecr.d: Changes in the ownership interest during the period of each class of partners. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountOptionExercise.d: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to option exercise. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

PartnerTypeOfPartnersCapitalAccountNameD.l: Partner Type of Partners' Capital Account, Name [Domain]
PartnerTypeOfPartnersCapitalAccountNameD.d: Capital accounts of each type or class of partner. Examples of classes of partners include, but are not limited to, general partners, limited partners, preferred partners, and other ownership interests.

PartnersCapitalAccountPrivatePlacementOf.l: Partners' Capital Account, Private Placement of Units
PartnersCapitalAccountPrivatePlacementOf.d: Monetary value of the issuance of new units of limited partnership interest in a private placement.

PartnersCapitalAccountPublicSaleOfUnits.l: Partners' Capital Account, Public Sale of Units
PartnersCapitalAccountPublicSaleOfUnits.d: Monetary value of the issuance of new units of limited partnership interest in a public offering.

PartnersCapitalAccountPublicSaleOfUnitsN.l: Partners' Capital Account, Public Sale of Units Net of Offering Costs
PartnersCapitalAccountPublicSaleOfUnitsN.d: Amount, after offering cost, from issuance of new unit of limited partnership interest in public offering.

PartnersCapitalAccountRedemptions.d: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to redemptions and adjustments to redemption value. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountReturnOfCapital.l: Partners' Capital Account, Return of Capital
PartnersCapitalAccountReturnOfCapital.d: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the return of partner's capital. That is, excess distributions over earnings to partners. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountSaleOfUnits.l: Partners' Capital Account, Sale of Units
PartnersCapitalAccountSaleOfUnits.d: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the sale of units. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountTreasuryUnitsPurch.l: Partners' Capital Account, Treasury Units, Purchased
PartnersCapitalAccountTreasuryUnitsPurch.d: Value of units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.

PartnersCapitalAccountUnitBasedCompensat.l: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
PartnersCapitalAccountUnitBasedCompensat.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital account for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountUnits.d: The number of each class of partnership units outstanding at the balance sheet date. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsContributed.d: Units contributed by each class of partners during the year. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsConverted.d: The number of units converted into shares of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsPeriodIncreas.l: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Period Increase (Decrease)
PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsPeriodIncreas.d: Total net change in the units of each class of partners' capital accounts during the year. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsRedeemed.d: The number of units redeemed during the year of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSoldInPrivate.l: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sold in Private Placement
PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSoldInPrivate.d: The number of units sold in a private placement of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSoldInPublicO.l: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sold in Public Offering
PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsSoldInPublicO.d: The number of units sold in a public offering of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

PartnersCapitalAllocatedForIncomeTaxAndO.l: Partners' Capital Allocated for Income Tax and Other Withdrawals
PartnersCapitalAllocatedForIncomeTaxAndO.d: Amount of partnership capital allocated for income tax and other withdrawals.

PartnersCapitalDistributionAmountPerShar.l: Partners' Capital, Distribution Amount Per Share
PartnersCapitalDistributionAmountPerShar.d: The distribution amount per share for all classes of units.

PartnersCapitalDistributionsPolicies.d: Description of distribution policies and requirements by unit class including dates and amounts of required payments, methods for determining distribution amounts such as an allocation percentage of net income, and other details of distributions.

PartnersCapitalNotesDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for the formation, structure, control and ownership of the partnership. Disclosures related to accounts comprising partners' capital. Includes balances of general partners' capital account, limited partners' capital account, preferred partners' capital account and total partners' capital account and units outstanding; accumulated other comprehensive income; amount and nature of changes to amount of partner's capital and units outstanding by class, rights and privileges for

PartnersCapitalRedemptionAndConversionPo.l: Partners' Capital, Redemption and Conversion Policies
PartnersCapitalRedemptionAndConversionPo.d: Description of redemption or conversion features by unit class including when redemption can occur, at whose option, and the redemption or conversion price per unit.

ProceedsFromPartnershipContribution.d: The cash inflow from the capital received in cash from a partner in a partnership during the period.

PatentsMember.d: Exclusive legal right granted by the government to the owner of the patent to exploit an invention or a process for a period of time specified by law.

PolicyholderDividendsPayable.d: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liability for dividends that are payable to the policyholders based upon the terms of the underlying insurance contracts.

AssumedLiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaims.l: Assumed Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
AssumedLiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaims.d: Liability as of the balance sheet date for the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims and claim adjustment expense relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date for those liabilities owed to another party as a result of assuming another insurer's primary obligation.

PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock.l: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock.d: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

PaymentsOfDividends.d: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

PaymentsOfDividendsMinorityInterest.l: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Noncontrolling Interest
PaymentsOfDividendsMinorityInterest.d: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends provided by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to noncontrolling interests.

PaymentsOfDividendsPreferredStockAndPref.l: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
PaymentsOfDividendsPreferredStockAndPref.d: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to preferred shareholders of the parent entity.

PaymentsForRepurchaseOfEquity.d: The cash outflow to reacquire common and preferred stock.

RepaymentsOfFederalHomeLoanBankBorrowing.l: Payments of FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
RepaymentsOfFederalHomeLoanBankBorrowing.d: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

PaymentsForAdvanceToAffiliate.d: The cash outflow from advancing money to an affiliate (an entity that is related but not strictly controlled by the entity).

PaymentsForProceedsFromLifeInsurancePoli.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Life Insurance Policies [Abstract]

PaymentsForOriginationOfMortgageLoansHel.l: Payment for Origination, Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale
PaymentsForOriginationOfMortgageLoansHel.d: The amount of cash paid for the origination of mortgages that are held for sale.

PaymentsForLegalSettlements.d: The amount of cash paid for the settlement of litigation or for other legal issues during the period.

RepaymentsOfMediumTermNotes.d: The cash outflow to pay off borrowing used to receive debt funding on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

PaymentsToExploreAndDevelopOilAndGasProp.l: Payments to Explore and Develop Oil and Gas Properties
PaymentsToExploreAndDevelopOilAndGasProp.d: The cash outflow for exploration and development of oil and gas properties. It includes cash payments related to development of oil and gas wells drilled at previously untested geologic structures (to determine the presence of oil or gas) and wells drilled at sites where the presence of oil or gas has already been established (to extract the oil or gas).

PaymentsForRepurchaseOfOtherEquity.l: Payments for Repurchase of Other Equity
PaymentsForRepurchaseOfOtherEquity.d: Amount of cash outflow to reacquire equity classified as other.

PensionContributions.d: Amount of cash outflow for pension benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes other postretirement benefit.

PensionExpense.d: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitExpe.l: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)
PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitExpe.d: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitExpe.l: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost) [Abstract]

PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitsDis.d: The entire disclosure for retirement benefits.

PensionPlansDefinedBenefitMember.d: Plan designed to provide participant with pension benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

PercentageOfAmountAmortizedDuringNextFiv.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Percentage, Next Five Years [Abstract]

PercentageOfDebtHedgedByInterestRateDeri.l: Percentage of Debt Hedged by Interest Rate Derivatives
PercentageOfDebtHedgedByInterestRateDeri.d: Percentage of an entity's outstanding debt that is designated as a hedged item in cash flow, fair value, or net investment hedge.

PercentageOfFIFOInventory.d: The percentage of FIFO (first in first out) inventory to total inventory as of the balance sheet date if other than 100 percent.

PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.l: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposit Liabilities to Deposit Liabilities [Abstract]
Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits
PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.d: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.l: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Brokered
PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.d: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic brokered deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.l: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Certificates of Deposit
PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.d: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic certificates of deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.l: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Checking
PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.d: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic checking demand deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.l: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Demand
PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.d: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic demand deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.l: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Money Market
PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.d: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.l: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Notice of Withdrawal
PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.d: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic notice of withdrawal demand deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.l: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Other Time Deposit
PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.d: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic time deposit liabilities other than certificates of deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.l: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Retail
PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.d: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic retail deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.l: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Savings
PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.d: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic savings deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.l: Percentage of Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Time Deposits
PercentageOfInterestBearingDomesticDepos.d: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic time deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

PercentageOfLIFOInventory.d: The percentage of LIFO (last in first out) inventory to total inventory as of the balance sheet date if other than 100 percent.

PercentageOfWeightedAverageCostInventory.l: Percentage of Weighted Average Cost Inventory
PercentageOfWeightedAverageCostInventory.d: The percentage of weighted average cost inventory present at the reporting date when inventory is valued using different valuation methods.

WorkforceSubjectToCollectiveBargainingAr.d: The number of employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement as of the balance sheet date, when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

PerformanceGuaranteeMember.d: An agreement (contract) that requires the guarantor to make payments to a guaranteed party based on another entity's failure to perform under an obligating agreement. This may include the issuance of a performance standby letter of credit which requires the guarantor to make payments if a specified party fails to perform under a nonfinancial contractual obligation.

FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedP.l: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, Physical Commodities Sold
FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedP.d: Fair value of obligations arising from physical commodities sold short.

PipelinesMember.d: Assets used for transporting gas and liquids through interconnected tubing, generally underground, for many miles.

DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedBenefitObli.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedBenefitObli.d: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to employee service rendered, excluding assumptions about future compensation level.

DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOnPlanAsse.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss)
DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOnPlanAsse.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) determined by change in fair value of plan assets adjusted for contributions, benefit payments, and other expenses.

DefinedBenefitPlanAlternativeMethodUsedT.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Alternative Method Used to Amortize Gain (Loss), Description
DefinedBenefitPlanAlternativeMethodUsedT.d: Description of alternative method used to amortize gain (loss) for defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanAlternativeMethodUsedT.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Alternative Method Used to Amortize Prior Service Cost, Description
DefinedBenefitPlanAlternativeMethodUsedT.d: Description of alternative method used to amortize prior service cost (credit) for defined benefit plan. Includes, but is not limited to, straight-line amortization over average remaining service period of employees expected to receive benefits.

DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfGainsLos.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Gain (Loss)
DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfGainsLos.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit of defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfPriorSer.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Prior Service Cost (Credit)
DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfPriorSer.d: Amount of prior service cost (credit) recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanAmountOfEmployerAndRel.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Employer, Related Party, Amount
DefinedBenefitPlanAmountOfEmployerAndRel.d: Amount of employer security in which defined benefit plan asset is invested. Includes, but is not limited to, security issued or managed by related party of employer.

DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsRecognizedInBal.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Amounts for Asset (Liability) Recognized in Statement of Financial Position
DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsRecognizedInBal.d: Amount of asset (liability), recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherCompre.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax [Abstract]

DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsRecognizedInBal.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Amounts for Asset (Liability) Recognized in Statement of Financial Position [Abstract]

DefinedBenefitPlanAmountsThatWillBeAmort.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization, Next Fiscal Year [Abstract]

DefinedBenefitPlanAssumedHealthCareCostT.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumed Health Care Cost Trend Rates [Abstract]

DefinedBenefitPlanBusinessCombinationsAn.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Business Combination
DefinedBenefitPlanBusinessCombinationsAn.d: Amount of increase in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from business combination.

DefinedBenefitPlanBusinessCombinationsAn.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Business Combination
DefinedBenefitPlanBusinessCombinationsAn.d: Amount of increase in plan assets of defined benefit plan from business combination.

DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligationPerio.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Period Increase (Decrease)
DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligationPerio.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInBenefitObligat.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Change in Benefit Obligation [Roll Forward]
DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInBenefitObligat.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

DefinedBenefitPlanFairValueOfPlanAssetsP.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)
DefinedBenefitPlanFairValueOfPlanAssetsP.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInFairValueOfPla.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Change in Fair Value of Plan Assets [Roll Forward]
DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInFairValueOfPla.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

DefinedBenefitPlanNetPeriodicBenefitCost.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit) [Abstract]

DefinedBenefitPlanContributionsByEmploye.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Employer
DefinedBenefitPlanContributionsByEmploye.d: Amount of contribution received by defined benefit plan from employer which increases plan assets.

PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBene.d: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as current.

DefinedBenefitPlanCurtailments.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Curtailment
DefinedBenefitPlanCurtailments.d: Amount of (increase) decrease in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from event reducing expected years of future service of present employees or eliminating accrual of benefits for some or all future services of present employees.

DefinedBenefitPlanDescriptionOfAnySubsta.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Substantive Commitment Used as Basis for Accounting for Benefit Obligation, Description
DefinedBenefitPlanDescriptionOfAnySubsta.d: Description of substantive commitment used as basis for accounting for benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Includes, but is not limited to, past practice or history of regular benefit increases.

DefinedBenefitPlanDescriptionOfDirection.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumed Health Care Cost Trend Rate, Description
DefinedBenefitPlanDescriptionOfDirection.d: Description of direction and pattern of change in assumed health care cost trend rate used to measure expected cost of benefits for defined benefit postretirement plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanDescriptionOfNatureOfE.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Special and Contractual Termination Benefits, Description
DefinedBenefitPlanDescriptionOfNatureOfE.d: Description of nature of event resulting in defined benefit plan providing special or contractual termination benefits.

DefinedBenefitPlanAssumptionsUsedCalcula.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Discount Rate
DefinedBenefitPlanAssumptionsUsedCalcula.d: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanDivestituresBenefitObl.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Divestiture
DefinedBenefitPlanDivestituresBenefitObl.d: Amount of decrease in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from disposal or classification as held-for-sale.

DefinedBenefitPlanDivestituresPlanAssets.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Divestiture
DefinedBenefitPlanDivestituresPlanAssets.d: Amount of decrease in plan assets of defined benefit plan from disposal or classification as held-for-sale.

DefinedBenefitPlanEffectOfOnePercentageP.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One-Percentage-Point Change in Assumed Health Care Cost Trend Rate [Abstract]
Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One-Percentage-Point Increase on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation
DefinedBenefitPlanEffectOfOnePercentageP.d: Amount of increase in accumulated postretirement benefit obligation from one-percentage-point increase in assumed health care cost trend rate.

DefinedBenefitPlanEffectOfOnePercentageP.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One-Percentage-Point Increase on Service and Interest Cost Components
DefinedBenefitPlanEffectOfOnePercentageP.d: Amount of increase in service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement benefit cost from one-percentage-point increase in assumed health care cost trend rate.

DefinedBenefitPlanEstimatedFutureBenefit.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment [Abstract]

DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedReturnOnPlanAs.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Return (Loss) on Plan Assets
DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedReturnOnPlanAs.d: Amount of expected return (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit, calculated based on expected long-term rate of return and market-related value of plan assets of defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanExplanationOfSignifica.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Changes in Benefit Obligation and Plan Assets, Description
DefinedBenefitPlanExplanationOfSignifica.d: Description of reason for changes in benefit obligation and plan assets of defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanFairValueOfPlanAssets.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Amount
DefinedBenefitPlanFairValueOfPlanAssets.d: Amount of asset segregated and restricted to provide benefit under defined benefit plan. Asset includes, but is not limited to, stock, bond, other investment, earning from investment, and contribution by employer and employee.

DefinedBenefitPlanForeignCurrencyExchang.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
DefinedBenefitPlanForeignCurrencyExchang.d: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanFundedStatusOfPlan.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded (Unfunded) Status of Plan
DefinedBenefitPlanFundedStatusOfPlan.d: Amount of funded (unfunded) status of defined benefit plan, measured as difference between fair value of plan assets and benefit obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, overfunded (underfunded) status.

DefinedBenefitPlanInformationAboutPlanAs.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Information about Plan Assets [Abstract]

DefinedBenefitPlanInterestCost.d: Amount of cost recognized for passage of time related to defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanInvestmentPoliciesAndS.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Investment Policy and Strategy, Description
DefinedBenefitPlanInvestmentPoliciesAndS.d: Description of investment policy and strategy for defined benefit plan asset. Includes, but is not limited to, investment allocation decision and factor pertinent to understanding investment policy and strategy for plan asset. Factor includes, but is not limited to, investment goal, risk management practice, permitted and prohibited investment including use of derivative, diversification, and relationship between plan asset and obligation.

DefinedBenefitPlanNarrativeDescriptionOf.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Expected Long-Term Rate-of-Return, Description
DefinedBenefitPlanNarrativeDescriptionOf.d: Description of basis used to determine overall expected long-term rate-of-return assumption for plan asset of defined benefit plan. Includes, but is not limited to, approach used, and extent approach was based on historical return and adjustment made to reflect expectation of future return.

DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherCompre.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Gain (Loss), before Tax
DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherCompre.d: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

DefinedBenefitPlanNetPeriodicBenefitCost.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
DefinedBenefitPlanNetPeriodicBenefitCost.d: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanNumberOfSharesOfEquity.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Employer, Related Party, Number of Shares
DefinedBenefitPlanNumberOfSharesOfEquity.d: Number of shares of employer stock in which defined benefit plan asset is invested. Includes, but is not limited to, stock issued or managed by related party of employer.

DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAmendments.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Plan Amendment
DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAmendments.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from change in terms of existing plan or initiation of new plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanAssumptionsUsedInCalcu.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used in Calculations [Abstract]
Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used in Calculation, Description
DefinedBenefitPlanAssumptionsUsedInCalcu.d: Description of assumption used to determine benefit obligation and net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan. Includes, but is not limited to, discount rate, rate of compensation increase, expected long-term rate of return on plan assets and interest crediting rate.

DefinedBenefitPlanPlansWithBenefitObliga.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Project Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets [Abstract]

DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherCompre.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Prior Service Cost (Credit), before Tax
DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherCompre.d: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

DefinedBenefitPlanAssumptionsUsedCalcula.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Rate of Compensation Increase
DefinedBenefitPlanAssumptionsUsedCalcula.d: Weighted average rate increase of compensation, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanRecognizedNetGainLossD.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Curtailment
DefinedBenefitPlanRecognizedNetGainLossD.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from event reducing expected years of future service of present employees or eliminating accrual of defined benefits for some or all future services of present employees.

DefinedBenefitPlanServiceCost.d: Amount of cost for actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanSettlementsBenefitObli.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Settlement
DefinedBenefitPlanSettlementsBenefitObli.d: Amount of (increase) decrease to benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Includes, but is not limited to, lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for right to receive specified benefits, purchase of nonparticipating annuity contract and change from remeasurement.

DefinedBenefitPlanSettlementsAndCurtailm.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Settlement and Curtailment [Abstract]

DefinedBenefitPlanSettlementsPlanAssets.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Payment for Settlement
DefinedBenefitPlanSettlementsPlanAssets.d: Amount of payment, which decreases plan assets of defined benefit plan, for irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Transaction constituting settlement includes, but is not limited to, making lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for their rights to receive specified benefits and purchasing nonparticipating annuity contract.

DefinedBenefitPlanSpecialTerminationBene.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Special and Contractual Termination Benefits
DefinedBenefitPlanSpecialTerminationBene.d: Amount of increase in benefit obligation for benefits provided to employees payable from defined benefit plan or payable upon retirement.

DefinedBenefitPlanAssetsTargetAllocation.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Allocations [Abstract]

DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherCompre.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Transition Asset (Obligation), before Tax
DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherCompre.d: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

DefinedBenefitPlanWeightedAverageAssumpt.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Weighted Average Assumptions Used in Calculating Benefit Obligation [Abstract]
Defined Benefit Plan, Weighted Average Assumptions Used in Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost [Abstract]

DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligation.d: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanDisclosureLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

PlanOfReorganizationAmountOfPrepetitionO.l: Plan of Reorganization, Amount of Prepetition Obligations to be Settled in Cash
PlanOfReorganizationAmountOfPrepetitionO.d: Amount of prepetition liabilities to be settled in cash.

PlanOfReorganizationDescriptionOfDebtSec.l: Plan of Reorganization, Description of Debt Securities Issued or to be Issued
PlanOfReorganizationDescriptionOfDebtSec.d: Description of the terms of debt securities to be issued to prepetition creditors in accordance with the plan of reorganization including the amount.

PlanOfReorganizationDescriptionOfEquityS.l: Plan of Reorganization, Description of Equity Securities Issued or to be Issued
PlanOfReorganizationDescriptionOfEquityS.d: Description of the terms of equity securities to be issued or to be issued to prepetition creditors in accordance with the plan of reorganization, including the amount and impact, if any, on diluted earnings per share.

PlanOfReorganizationTermsOfPlan.l: Plan of Reorganization, Terms of Plan
PlanOfReorganizationTermsOfPlan.d: Description of terms of the plan of reorganization. Does not include a description of debt and equity securities issued or expected to be issued.

ScheduleOfDefinedBenefitPlansDisclosures.d: Disclosure of information about individual defined benefit pension plan or other postretirement defined benefit plan. It may be appropriate to group certain similar plans. Also includes schedule for fair value of plan assets by major categories of plan assets by the level within the fair value hierarchy in which the fair value measurements in their entirety fall, segregating fair value measurements using quoted prices in active markets for identical assets or liabilities (Level 1), Significant o

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentPlannedMajorMai.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Planned Maintenance Activity [Policy Text Block]
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentPlannedMajorMai.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for planned maintenance activity for property, plant, and equipment.

PlantHeldForFutureUseAmount.l: Plant Held for Future Use Amount
PlantHeldForFutureUseAmount.d: Discloses the period end amount of plants held for future use and whether such amount is included in the utility's rate base.

AgriculturalRelatedInventoryPlantMateria.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of products that are used in the growth of plant goods (examples would include seeds, soil, fertilizers and other products).

PledgedFinancialInstrumentsNotSeparately.l: Pledged Financial Instruments and Other Assets, Not Separately Reported on Statement of Financial Position, Description (Deprecated 2026)
PledgedFinancialInstrumentsNotSeparately.d: Description of financial instruments which are owned but transferred to serve as collateral to fully or partially secure a debt obligation, repurchase agreement or other current or potential obligation, and, because the secured party does not have the right by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge the financial instruments, are not reclassified and separately reported in the statement of financial position. Also sets forth the carrying amount and classification of pledged financial instruments

PolicyLoansMember.d: Loan issued by an insurance company, collateralized by the cash value of the borrower's life insurance policy.

PolicyLoansReceivable.d: Carrying amount of loans made to policyholders against the cash surrender value (CSV) or other policyholder funds, and secured by the CSV, policyholder funds or the death benefit provided by the insurance contracts.

PolicyholderAccountsPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for contracts reported in separate accounts, including the extent and terms of minimum guarantees, basis of presentation for separate account assets and liabilities and related separate account activity, the liability valuation method and assumptions used in valuing each type of policyholder and contract holder account maintained by the entity.

PolicyholderBenefitsAndClaimsIncurredNet.l: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net, by Business Type [Abstract] (Deprecated 2024)

ClosedBlockDividendObligationChangeInUnr.l: Closed Block Dividend Obligation, Change in Unrealized Investment Gain (Loss)
ClosedBlockDividendObligationChangeInUnr.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in the closed block dividend obligation from the unrealized gain (loss) on investments allocated to the closed block.

PolicyholdersDividendPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for method of allocating earnings and dividends to policyholder. Includes, but is not limited to, policyholder in participating insurance contract.

LongTermPollutionControlBond.d: Noncurrent portion of a debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

PositiveOutcomeOfLitigationMember.d: A potential favorable result upon resolution of a litigation matter, whether through trial, arbitration, mediation, or settlement of a legal threat made to another party, which results in collection of a damages award in cash or in other tangible or intangible assets.

OtherPostretirementBenefitExpense.l: Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)
OtherPostretirementBenefitExpense.d: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for other postretirement benefits. Excludes pension benefits.

PostemploymentBenefitPlansPolicy.l: Postemployment Benefit Plans, Policy [Policy Text Block]
PostemploymentBenefitPlansPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for postemployment benefits. Postemployment benefits are benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement, except for: a) benefits provided through a pension or postretirement benefit plan, b) individual deferred compensation arrangements, c) special or contractual termination benefits, and d) stock compensation plans.

PostretirementMedicalPlansWithPrescripti.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Postretirement Medical Plan with Prescription Drug Benefits [Abstract]

InvestmentsInPowerAndDistributionProject.l: Investments in Power and Distribution Projects
InvestmentsInPowerAndDistributionProject.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of investments in power and distribution projects that are expected to be realized after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

PreOpeningCosts.d: Expenditures associated with opening new locations which are noncapital in nature and expensed as incurred.

PreferredClassBMember.d: Outstanding nonredeemable preferred class B stock or outstanding preferred class B stock. Classified within stockholders' equity if nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer. Classified within temporary equity if redemption is outside the control of the issuer.

PreferredClassAMember.d: Outstanding nonredeemable preferred class A stock or outstanding convertible preferred class A stock. Classified within stockholders' equity if nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer. Classified within temporary equity if redemption is outside the control of the issuer.

PreferredStockAmountOfPreferredDividends.l: Preferred Stock, Amount of Preferred Dividends in Arrears
PreferredStockAmountOfPreferredDividends.d: Aggregate amount of cumulative preferred dividends in arrears.

PreferredStockCapitalSharesReservedForFu.l: Preferred Stock, Capital Shares Reserved for Future Issuance
PreferredStockCapitalSharesReservedForFu.d: Aggregate number of nonredeemable preferred shares reserved for future issuance.

PreferredStockContractTerms.d: Significant terms of contract to issue additional shares or sinking fund requirements.

PreferredStockDividendPaymentRateVariabl.l: Preferred Stock, Dividend Payment Rate, Variable
PreferredStockDividendPaymentRateVariabl.d: Description of basis of dividend, such as adjustable rate. Excludes percentage rate dividend payments or fixed dollar amounts per share.

PreferredStockDividendPaymentTerms.d: Specific information regarding dividend payment dates or timing and whether or not dividends are paid on a cumulative basis.

PreferredStockDividendPreferenceOrRestri.l: Preferred Stock, Dividend Preference or Restrictions
PreferredStockDividendPreferenceOrRestri.d: Priority of payment of dividends and restrictions on the payment of dividends, indicating the source, pertinent provisions and amount of retained earnings or net income restricted or free of restrictions.

PreferredStockPerShareAmountsOfPreferred.l: Preferred Stock, Per Share Amounts of Preferred Dividends in Arrears
PreferredStockPerShareAmountsOfPreferred.d: Per share amount of cumulative preferred dividends in arrears.

PreferredStockShareSubscriptions.l: Preferred Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued
PreferredStockShareSubscriptions.d: The number of nonredeemable preferred stock (shares) (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) allocated to investors to buy shares of a new issue of preferred stock before they are offered to the public. When stock is sold on a subscription basis, the issuer does not initially receive the total proceeds. In general, the issuer does not issue the shares to the investor until it receives the entire proceeds.

PreferredStockSharesAuthorized.d: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

PreferredStockSharesIssued.d: Number of shares issued for nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred shares issued, repurchased, and held as treasury shares. Excludes preferred shares classified as debt.

PreferredStockSharesOutstanding.d: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

PreferredStockVotingRights.d: Description of voting rights of nonredeemable preferred stock. Includes eligibility to vote and votes per share owned. Include also, if any, unusual voting rights.

OtherPreferredStockDividendsAndAdjustmen.l: Other Preferred Stock Dividends and Adjustments
OtherPreferredStockDividendsAndAdjustmen.d: Amount of preferred stock dividends and adjustments classified as other.

PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustmen.l: Preferred Stock Dividends and Other Adjustments
PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustmen.d: The aggregate value of preferred stock dividends and other adjustments necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustmen.l: Preferred Stock Dividends and Other Adjustments [Abstract]

PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare.l: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare.d: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

MinorityInterestInPreferredUnitHolders.l: Noncontrolling Interest in Preferred Unit Holders
MinorityInterestInPreferredUnitHolders.d: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling preferred unit holders in an entity included in the reporting entity's consolidated financial statements.

PreferredUnitsCumulativeCashDistribution.d: Aggregate cumulative cash distributions made to the preferred partners.

PreferredUnitsCumulativeNetIncome.d: The amount of aggregate cumulative earnings allocated to preferred partners.

PreferredUnitsPreferredPartnersCapitalAc.l: Preferred Units, Preferred Partners' Capital Accounts
PreferredUnitsPreferredPartnersCapitalAc.d: The amount of the preferred partners' ownership interests.

PreferredUnitsAuthorized.d: The number of preferred units authorized to be issued.

PreferredUnitsIssued.d: The number of preferred units issued.

PreferredUnitsOutstanding.d: The number of preferred units outstanding.

PreferredUnitsByNameAxis.d: Information by type or class of preferred units or special units.

PreferredUnitsLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ScheduleOfPreferredUnitsTable.l: Partners' Capital, Master Limited Partnership, Preferred Unit [Table]
ScheduleOfPreferredUnitsTable.d: Disclosure of information about preferred unit of master limited partnership (MLP) that has priority over limited partner unit in liquidation, redemption, conversion, tax status of distribution, and sharing of distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, description of preferred unit, preferred unit authorized, issued, and outstanding, cumulative cash distribution made to preferred partner, cumulative net income shared by preferred partner, and aggregate account balance of preferred partner.

AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsPremiumsAndO.l: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Premiums and Other Receivables
AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsPremiumsAndO.d: The valuation allowance as of the balance sheet date to reduce the gross amount of receivables to estimated net realizable value, which would be presented in parentheses on the face of the balance sheet.

PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.l: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.d: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the estimated valuation allowance to reduce gross premiums receivable to net realizable value.

PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.l: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.l: Premiums Receivable, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Estimation Methodology, Policy [Policy Text Block]
PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining the estimated allowance for doubtful accounts for premium amounts due from policyholders, insureds, and other insurance entities. May include factors that management considered, such as historical loss experience and current economic and competitive conditions.

PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.l: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on premium receivable.

PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.l: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.d: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on premium receivable from recovery.

PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.l: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.d: Amount of writeoff of premium receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

PremiumsReceivableBasisOfAccountingPolic.l: Premiums Receivable, Basis of Accounting, Policy [Policy Text Block]
PremiumsReceivableBasisOfAccountingPolic.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining the gross carrying amount of premiums due from policyholders, insureds, and other insurance entities.

PremiumsReceivableAtCarryingValue.d: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due the entity from (a) agents and insureds, (b) uncollected premiums and (c) others, net of the allowance for doubtful accounts.

IncreaseDecreaseInPremiumsReceivable.d: The change in the premium receivable balance on the balance sheet.

RevenueRecognitionPremiumsEarnedPolicy.l: Revenue Recognition, Premiums Earned, Policy [Policy Text Block]
RevenueRecognitionPremiumsEarnedPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining revenue and timing of recognition as revenue of premiums received from policyholders, insureds and other insurance entities (the effects of ceding and assuming insurance policy risks) for the entity's insurance products.

PremiumsReceivableGainLossOnSaleOfReceiv.l: Premiums Receivable, Gain (Loss) on Sale of Receivables
PremiumsReceivableGainLossOnSaleOfReceiv.d: The aggregate amount of gains or losses on transfers of premium receivables reported as sales by an insurance entity.

PremiumsReceivableGross.d: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, due the entity from (a) agents and insureds, (b) uncollected premiums and (c) others, before deducting the allowance for doubtful accounts.

PremiumsReceivableNote.d: The entire disclosure for premium amounts receivable by an insurance entity.

PremiumsReceivableProceedsFromSaleOfRece.l: Premiums Receivable, Proceeds from Sale of Receivables
PremiumsReceivableProceedsFromSaleOfRece.d: The amount of proceeds from the transfer of premium receivables reported as sales by an insurance entity.

PremiumsWrittenAndEarnedMethodologyAndAs.l: Premiums Written and Earned, Methodology and Assumptions
PremiumsWrittenAndEarnedMethodologyAndAs.d: Methodology and assumptions regarding premiums written and earned directly by insurer for all insurance and before adding contracts assumed from other insurers or subtracting any amounts ceded to other insurers.

PrepaidAdvertising.d: Amount of consideration paid in advance for advertising that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

PrepaidExpenseOtherNoncurrent.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts paid in advance which will be charged against earnings in periods after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

PrepaidExpenseCurrent.d: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

PrepaidExpenseNoncurrent.d: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of amounts paid in advance for expenses which will be charged against earnings in periods after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

PrepaidTaxes.d: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

PrepaidInsurance.d: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for insurance that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

PrepaidRoyalties.d: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for royalties that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

PrepaidMineralRoyaltiesNoncurrent.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized amounts paid for mineral royalties which will be charged against earnings after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

PrepaidReinsurancePremiums.d: The unexpired portion of premiums ceded on policies in force as of the balance sheet date.

IncreaseDecreaseInPrepaidReinsurancePrem.d: The change in prepaid reinsurance premiums recorded on the balance sheet, which is needed to adjust net income to arrive at net cash flows provided by or used in operations.

PrepaidRent.d: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for rent that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

PrepaymentRiskMember.d: The risk associated with the early unscheduled return of principal on a loan or debt security.

PreproductionCostsRelatedToLongTermSuppl.l: Preproduction Costs Related to Long-Term Supply Arrangements [Abstract]
Preproduction Costs Related to Long-Term Supply Arrangements, Asset for Molds Dies and Tools Not Owned
PreproductionCostsRelatedToLongTermSuppl.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of molds, dies, and other tools that the entity does not own which are or will be used in producing goods under a long-term supply arrangement, and for which there is a noncancelable right of use during such arrangement.

PreproductionCostsRelatedToLongTermSuppl.l: Preproduction Costs Related to Long-Term Supply Arrangements, Asset for Molds Dies and Tools Owned
PreproductionCostsRelatedToLongTermSuppl.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of molds, dies, and other tools that will be used in producing products under a long-term supply arrangement.

PreproductionCostsRelatedToLongTermSuppl.l: Preproduction Costs Related to Long-Term Supply Arrangements, Costs Capitalized
PreproductionCostsRelatedToLongTermSuppl.d: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized preproduction costs incurred on long-term supply arrangements, including recoverable costs to design and develop products.

PrerequisitesForBillingLongTermContracts.d: General description of the prerequisites for billing under the terms of long-term contracts.

PrescriptionDrugBenefitSubsidyEffectNotD.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Prescription Drug Benefit Subsidy, Effect Not Determined [true false]
PrescriptionDrugBenefitSubsidyEffectNotD.d: Indicates (true false) whether Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvement, and Modernization Act exists and accumulated postretirement benefit obligation or net periodic postretirement benefit cost (credit) does not reflect amount associated with government subsidy for prescription drug benefit because employer is unable to conclude whether benefit provided by plan is actuarially equivalent to Medicare Part D under Act.

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAbst.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits [Abstract]

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAddi.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Addition from Acquisition
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAddi.d: Amount of addition for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

PresentValueOfFutureMinimumLeasePayments.l: Present Value of Future Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions (Deprecated 2026)
PresentValueOfFutureMinimumLeasePayments.d: Present value of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

PriceRiskCashFlowHedgeAssetAtFairValue.l: Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Asset, at Fair Value
PriceRiskCashFlowHedgeAssetAtFairValue.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivative assets designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

PriceRiskCashFlowHedgeDerivativeAtFairVa.l: Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Derivative, at Fair Value, Net
PriceRiskCashFlowHedgeDerivativeAtFairVa.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

PriceRiskCashFlowHedgeIneffectivenessIsI.l: Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness is Immaterial (Deprecated 2025)
PriceRiskCashFlowHedgeIneffectivenessIsI.d: Assertion that the amount of price risk cash flow hedge ineffectiveness is immaterial.

PriceRiskCashFlowHedgeLiabilityAtFairVal.l: Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Liability, at Fair Value
PriceRiskCashFlowHedgeLiabilityAtFairVal.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivative liabilities designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

PriceRiskDerivativeAssetsAtFairValue.l: Price Risk Derivative Assets, at Fair Value
PriceRiskDerivativeAssetsAtFairValue.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of price risk derivative assets, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized as assets on the balance sheet.

PriceRiskDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesigna.l: Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments [Abstract]
Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments Asset, at Fair Value
PriceRiskDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesigna.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivative assets not designated as hedging instruments.

PriceRiskDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesigna.l: Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, at Fair Value, Net
PriceRiskDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesigna.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

PriceRiskDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesigna.l: Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments Liability, at Fair Value
PriceRiskDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesigna.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivative liabilities not designated as hedging instruments.

PriceRiskDerivativeLiabilitiesAtFairValu.l: Price Risk Derivative Liabilities, at Fair Value
PriceRiskDerivativeLiabilitiesAtFairValu.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of price risk derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized as liabilities on the balance sheet.

PriceRiskDerivativesAtFairValueNet.l: Price Risk Derivatives, at Fair Value, Net
PriceRiskDerivativesAtFairValueNet.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of price risk derivative assets, net of price risk derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized on the balance sheet.

PriceRiskFairValueHedgeAssetAtFairValue.l: Price Risk Fair Value Hedge Asset, at Fair Value
PriceRiskFairValueHedgeAssetAtFairValue.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivative assets designated as fair value hedging instruments.

PriceRiskFairValueHedgeDerivativeAtFairV.l: Price Risk Fair Value Hedge Derivative, at Fair Value, Net
PriceRiskFairValueHedgeDerivativeAtFairV.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivatives designated as fair value hedging instruments.

PriceRiskFairValueHedgeLiabilityAtFairVa.l: Price Risk Fair Value Hedge Liability, at Fair Value
PriceRiskFairValueHedgeLiabilityAtFairVa.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivative liabilities designated as fair value hedging instruments.

MortgageLoansOnRealEstateAmortizationOfP.l: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Amortization of Premium
MortgageLoansOnRealEstateAmortizationOfP.d: Amount of decrease in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from amortization of premium.

MortgageLoansOnRealEstate.l: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate
MortgageLoansOnRealEstate.d: Amount of investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate.

MortgageLoansOnRealEstateCostOfMortgages.l: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Cost of Mortgage Sold
MortgageLoansOnRealEstateCostOfMortgages.d: Amount of decrease in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from sale.

MortgageLoansOnRealEstateForeclosures.l: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Foreclosure
MortgageLoansOnRealEstateForeclosures.d: Amount of decrease in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from foreclosure.

MortgageLoansOnRealEstateNewMortgageLoan.l: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, New Mortgage Loan
MortgageLoansOnRealEstateNewMortgageLoan.d: Amount of increase in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from new investment.

MortgageLoansOnRealEstateOtherAdditions.l: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Other Addition
MortgageLoansOnRealEstateOtherAdditions.d: Amount of addition to investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, classified as other.

MortgageLoansOnRealEstatePeriodIncreaseD.l: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Period Increase (Decrease)
MortgageLoansOnRealEstatePeriodIncreaseD.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate.

PrincipalAmountOutstandingOfLoansHeldInP.d: This is the result of the principal amount outstanding of total loans managed or securitized less securitized loans and loans that are in the process of being securitized.

PrincipalAmountOutstandingOnLoansHeldFor.l: Loan, Held-for-Sale or Securitization or Asset-Backed Financing Arrangement, Principal Outstanding
PrincipalAmountOutstandingOnLoansHeldFor.d: This is the principal amount outstanding for loans which are in the process of being securitized as of the date of the statement of financial position (across all types of loans).

PrincipalAmountOutstandingOnLoansManaged.l: Loan, Managed and Securitized or Asset-Backed Financing Arrangement, Principal Outstanding
PrincipalAmountOutstandingOnLoansManaged.d: This is the sum of principal amount outstanding for both securitized and unsecuritized loans of all types.

PrincipalAmountOutstandingOnLoansSecurit.l: Loan, Securitized or Asset-Backed Financing Arrangement, Principal Outstanding
PrincipalAmountOutstandingOnLoansSecurit.d: This is the principal amount outstanding for securitized loans only (across all types of loans).

ProceedsFromPrincipalRepaymentsOnLoansAn.l: Proceeds from Principal Repayment, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment
ProceedsFromPrincipalRepaymentsOnLoansAn.d: The cash inflow from repayments of the balance excluding interest (principal) on loans receivable and leases held for investment purposes.

ScheduleOfPrincipalTransactionsRevenueTe.l: Schedule of Principal Transactions Revenue [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfPrincipalTransactionsRevenueTe.d: Tabular disclosure of revenue by reporting categories or types of financial instruments, including derivatives but excluding dividends and interests, from trading for own account by broker dealers.

NameOfReportingCategoryDomain.d: Name of reporting category or type of financial instrument.

PrincipleTransactionRevenueDescriptionOf.l: Principal Transaction Revenue, Description of Reporting Category [Axis] (Deprecated 2026)
PrincipleTransactionRevenueDescriptionOf.d: Information by reporting category or type of financial instruments related to a group of items that represent revenue.

PrincipleTransactionRevenueLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

PrincipleTransactionRevenueTable.d: Disclosure of information about revenue from trading for broker-dealer's own account by reporting category or type of financial instrument, including, but not limited to, derivative. Excludes dividend and interest.

PrivatePlacementMember.d: A private placement is a direct offering of securities to a limited number of sophisticated investors such as insurance companies, pension funds, mezzanine funds, stock funds and trusts.

ProceedsFromAdvancesForConstruction.l: Proceeds from Advance for Construction, Investing Activity
ProceedsFromAdvancesForConstruction.d: Amount of cash inflow from advance for construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, borrowing from developer, builder, government agency, and municipality.

ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfAvailableFo.l: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfAvailableFo.d: Amount of cash inflow from sale, maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

ProceedsFromBankDebt.d: The cash inflow from bank borrowing during the year.

ProceedsFromShortTermCapitalLeaseObligat.l: Proceeds from Short-Term Capital Lease Obligations (Deprecated 2026)
ProceedsFromShortTermCapitalLeaseObligat.d: The cash inflow from proceeds received from lessor related to capital lease obligation.

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInConso.l: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Consolidated Subsidiaries
ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInConso.d: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or the sale of investment in consolidated subsidiaries (generally greater than 50 percent).

ProceedsFromConstructionLoansPayable.d: The cash inflow from borrowings to finance the cost of construction.

ProceedsFromContributionInAidOfConstruct.l: Proceeds from Contribution in Aid of Construction, Investing Activity
ProceedsFromContributionInAidOfConstruct.d: Amount of cash inflow from contribution in aid of construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, contribution from developer, builder, government agency, and municipality.

ProceedsFromConvertibleDebt.d: The cash inflow from the issuance of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankBorrowing.l: Proceeds from FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankBorrowing.d: Amount of cash inflow from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfFirstMortgageBond.l: Proceeds from Issuance of First Mortgage Bond
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfFirstMortgageBond.d: The cash inflow from amounts received from a long-term debt instrument secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property. The lender has the highest claim on the property in case of default.

ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfTrustPreferredSe.l: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Trust Preferred Securities [Abstract]

ProceedsFromCollectionOfAdvanceToAffilia.l: Proceeds from Collection of Advance to Affiliate
ProceedsFromCollectionOfAdvanceToAffilia.d: The cash inflow from the collection of money previously advanced to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

ProceedsFromContributionsFromParent.d: The cash inflow from parent as a source of financing that is recorded as additional paid in capital.

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesNetOf.l: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses, Net of Cash Divested
ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesNetOf.d: This element represents the cash inflow during the period from the sale of a component of the entity.

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesNetOf.l: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses, Net of Cash Divested [Abstract]

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInSubsi.l: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInSubsi.d: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInSubsi.l: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates [Abstract]

ProceedsFromOtherEquity.d: Amount of cash inflow from the issuance of equity classified as other.

ProceedsFromRepaymentOfLoansToPurchaseCo.l: Proceeds from Repayment of Loans to Purchase Common Stock
ProceedsFromRepaymentOfLoansToPurchaseCo.d: Cash inflow from repayment of loans for purchasing common stock.

ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfAvailableFo.l: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale [Abstract]

ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfHeldToMatur.l: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Held-to-Maturity Securities [Abstract]
Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Held-to-Maturity Securities
ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfHeldToMatur.d: Amount of cash inflow from the sale or maturity of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementInvesting.l: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Investing Activities
ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementInvesting.d: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as investing activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as operating activities.

ProceedsFromAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertif.l: Proceeds from Annuities and Investment Certificates
ProceedsFromAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertif.d: The cash inflow from an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonLimitedPartn.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Limited Partners Units
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonLimitedPartn.d: The cash inflow from the issuance of common limited partners units during the period.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock.d: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMandatoryRedeemabl.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Mandatory Redeemable Capital Securities
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMandatoryRedeemabl.d: The cash inflow from issuance of an equity security that embodies an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the security by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) that is (or are) initially more than one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date, or upon an event that is certain to occur beyond one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfConvertiblePreferr.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Convertible Preferred Stock
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfConvertiblePreferr.d: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument, typically the entity's common stock.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOrSaleOfEquity.l: Proceeds from Issuance or Sale of Equity
ProceedsFromIssuanceOrSaleOfEquity.d: The cash inflow from the issuance of common stock, preferred stock, treasury stock, stock options, and other types of equity.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOrSaleOfEquityAbstra.l: Proceeds from Issuance or Sale of Equity [Abstract]

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfFinancialServicesO.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Financial Services Obligations
