ProceedsFromIssuanceOfFinancialServicesO.d: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing issued by the entity involved in financial services operations.

ProceedsFromIssuanceInitialPublicOfferin.l: Proceeds from Issuance Initial Public Offering
ProceedsFromIssuanceInitialPublicOfferin.d: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMediumTermNotes.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Medium-Term Note
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMediumTermNotes.d: The cash inflow from a debt funding received on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

ProceedsFromMinorityShareholders.d: Amount of cash inflow from a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, purchase of additional shares or other increase in noncontrolling interest ownership.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommercialPaper.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Commercial Paper
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommercialPaper.d: The cash inflow from borrowing by issuing commercial paper.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfOtherLongTermDebt.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Other Long-Term Debt
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfOtherLongTermDebt.d: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of long-term debt classified as other.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredLimitedPa.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Limited Partners Units
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredLimitedPa.d: The cash inflow from the issuance of preferred limited partners units during the period.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredStockAndP.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredStockAndP.d: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholders and which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePlacement.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Private Placement
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePlacement.d: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's raising of capital via private rather than public placement.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfRedeemableConverti.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfRedeemableConverti.d: The cash inflow from issuance of callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security at the option of the issuer or the holder.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfRedeemablePreferre.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Preferred Stock
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfRedeemablePreferre.d: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stock that is classified as callable.

ProceedsFromSaleOfTreasuryStock.l: Proceeds from Sale of Treasury Stock
ProceedsFromSaleOfTreasuryStock.d: The cash inflow from the issuance of an equity stock that has been previously reacquired by the entity.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfWarrants.d: The cash inflow from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at predetermined price (usually issued together with corporate debt).

ProceedsFromLifeInsurancePolicies.d: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

ProceedsFromLinesOfCredit.d: Amount of cash inflow from contractual arrangement with the lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

ProceedsFromLongTermLinesOfCredit.l: Proceeds from Long-Term Lines of Credit
ProceedsFromLongTermLinesOfCredit.d: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

ProceedsOfOtherLoansAndLeasesHeldForInve.l: Proceeds from Sale or Securitization, Loan and Lease, Other, Held-for-Investment
ProceedsOfOtherLoansAndLeasesHeldForInve.d: Amount of cash inflow from loans and leases held-for-investment, classified as other.

ProceedsFromLongTermCapitalLeaseObligati.l: Proceeds from Long-Term Capital Lease Obligations (Deprecated 2026)
ProceedsFromLongTermCapitalLeaseObligati.d: The cash inflow from proceeds received from lessor related to a long-term capital lease obligation.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebt.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebt.d: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebtAbstra.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt [Abstract]

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebtAndCap.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities, Net
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebtAndCap.d: Amount of cash inflow from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebtAndCap.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities, Net [Abstract]

ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfMarketableS.l: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Marketable Securities
ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfMarketableS.d: The cash inflow associated with the aggregate amount received by the entity through sale or maturity of marketable securities (held-to-maturity or available-for-sale) during the period.

ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.l: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale
ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.d: Amount of cash inflow from maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.l: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Held-to-Maturity Securities
ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.d: The cash inflow associated with the maturity, prepayments and calls (requests for early payments) of debt securities designated as held-to-maturity.

ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.l: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS)
ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.d: The cash inflow from the maturity (principal due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of a loan financed by home mortgage payments classified as held to maturity.

ProceedsFromNotesPayable.d: The cash inflow from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

ProceedsFromOtherDebt.d: Amount of cash inflow from debt classified as other.

ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfOtherInvest.l: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Other Investments
ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfOtherInvest.d: The cash inflow associated with the sale and maturity (principal being due) of other investments, prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

ProceedsFromPaymentsToMinorityShareholde.d: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from (to) a noncontrolling interest. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfTrustPreferredSe.l: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Trust Preferred Securities
ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfTrustPreferredSe.d: The cash inflow from issuance of trust preferred securities, net of the cash outflow for repurchasing trust preferred securities, by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

ProceedsFromPollutionControlBond.d: The cash inflow from amounts received from a long-term debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.l: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Other Investments
ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.d: The cash inflow associated with the maturity (principal being due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

ProceedsFromCollectionOfNotesReceivable.l: Proceeds from Collection of Notes Receivable
ProceedsFromCollectionOfNotesReceivable.d: The cash inflow associated with principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

ProceedsFromRelatedPartyDebt.d: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing made from related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances from Affiliates.

ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfRedeemablePrefer.l: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Redeemable Preferred Stock
ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfRedeemablePrefer.d: Cash inflows (outflows) from issuing and redeeming redeemable preferred stock; includes convertible and nonconvertible redeemable preferred stock.

ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfRedeemablePrefer.l: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Redeemable Preferred Stock [Abstract]

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinesses.d: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a portion of the company's business, for example a segment, division, branch or other business, during the period.

ProceedsFromDecommissioningFund.l: Proceeds from Decommissioning Trust Fund Assets
ProceedsFromDecommissioningFund.d: The cash inflow from the sale of assets held in a decommissioning trust fund.

ProceedsFromSaleOfProductiveAssets.l: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
ProceedsFromSaleOfProductiveAssets.d: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

ProceedsFromSaleOfProductiveAssetsAbstra.l: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets [Abstract]

ProceedsFromSaleOfEquityMethodInvestment.l: Proceeds from Sale of Equity Method Investments
ProceedsFromSaleOfEquityMethodInvestment.d: The cash inflow associated with the sale of equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

ProceedsFromSaleOfInsuranceInvestments.l: Proceeds from Sale of Insurance Investments
ProceedsFromSaleOfInsuranceInvestments.d: The cash inflow associated with the sale of insurance policy investment assets during the period.

ProceedsFromSaleOfHeldToMaturitySecuriti.l: Proceeds from Sale of Held-to-Maturity Securities
ProceedsFromSaleOfHeldToMaturitySecuriti.d: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities that had been designated as held-to-maturity. Excludes proceeds from maturities, prepayments and calls by the issuer.

ProceedsFromSaleOfIntangibleAssets.l: Proceeds from Sale of Intangible Assets
ProceedsFromSaleOfIntangibleAssets.d: The cash inflow from disposal of asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInJoint.l: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Joint Venture
ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInJoint.d: The cash inflow from the sale of an investment interest in a joint venture that the reporting entity has not previously accounted for using consolidation or the equity method of accounting.

ProceedsFromSaleOfLeaseReceivables.l: Proceeds from Sale of Lease Receivables
ProceedsFromSaleOfLeaseReceivables.d: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansReceivable.l: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Receivable
ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansReceivable.d: The cash inflow associated with the sale of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfMortgageN.l: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Mortgage Notes Receivable
ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfMortgageN.d: The cash inflow from proceeds from sale of receivables arising from the mortgage note on real estate; includes collections on mortgage notes receivable that are not classified as operating cash flows.

ProceedsFromSaleOfOilAndGasPropertyAndEq.l: Proceeds from Sale of Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
ProceedsFromSaleOfOilAndGasPropertyAndEq.d: The cash inflow to dispose of long-lived, physical assets and mineral interests in oil and gas properties used for normal oil and gas operations.

ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherProductiveAssets.l: Proceeds from Sale of Other Productive Assets
ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherProductiveAssets.d: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of tangible or intangible assets used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherReceivables.l: Proceeds from Sale of Other Receivables
ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherReceivables.d: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of receivables classified as other.

ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherInvestments.l: Proceeds from Sale of Other Investments
ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherInvestments.d: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of investments classified as other.

ProceedsFromSaleOfInvestmentProjects.l: Proceeds from Sale of Investment Projects
ProceedsFromSaleOfInvestmentProjects.d: The cash inflow from the sale of investment projects held by an entity in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyHeldForSale.d: The cash inflow from the sale of formerly productive land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyPlantAndEquipm.l: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyPlantAndEquipm.d: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyPlantAndEquipm.l: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment [Abstract]

ProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstate.l: Proceeds from Sale of Real Estate
ProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstate.d: Cash received for the sale of real estate that is not part of an investing activity during the current period.

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfRealEstatePartn.l: Proceeds from Divestiture of Real Estate Partnership
ProceedsFromDivestitureOfRealEstatePartn.d: The cash inflow from the sale of interest in partnership during the period.

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfReceivabl.l: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Receivables
ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfReceivabl.d: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale and collection of receivables during the period.

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfReceivabl.l: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Receivables [Abstract]

ProceedsFromSaleOfRestrictedInvestments.l: Proceeds from Sale of Restricted Investments
ProceedsFromSaleOfRestrictedInvestments.d: The cash inflow associated with the sale of investments that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions during the period.

ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetainedInterest.l: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables
ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetainedInterest.d: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of receivables.

ProceedsFromSaleOfShortTermInvestments.l: Proceeds from Sale of Short-Term Investments
ProceedsFromSaleOfShortTermInvestments.d: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfTrustPreferredSecu.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Trust Preferred Securities
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfTrustPreferredSecu.d: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

ProceedsFromSaleOfWaterSystems.l: Proceeds from Sale of Water Systems
ProceedsFromSaleOfWaterSystems.d: The cash inflow from sale of a facility and equipment that provides water supply which includes wells, reservoirs, pumping stations, and control facilities.

ProceedsFromSaleOfForeclosedAssets.l: Proceeds from Sale of Foreclosed Assets
ProceedsFromSaleOfForeclosedAssets.d: The cash inflow from the sale assets received in full or partial satisfaction of a receivable including real and personal property; equity interests in corporations, partnerships, and joint ventures; and beneficial interests in trusts. Foreclosed assets also include loans that are treated as if the underlying collateral had been foreclosed because the institution has taken possession of the collateral, even though legal foreclosure or repossession proceedings have not taken place.

ProceedsFromLeasesHeldForInvestment.d: The cash inflow from the sale of a lease held for investment, which may be a lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForInvestment.d: Amount of cash inflow from sale of loan held for investment.

ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForSale.d: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization.

ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansAndLeasesHeldForI.l: Proceeds from Sale, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment
ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansAndLeasesHeldForI.d: The net cash inflow from (a) sales of loans held-for-investment, (b) sales of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both. Includes proceeds from securitizations of loans.

ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansAndLeasesHeldForI.l: Proceeds from Sale, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment [Abstract]

ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageBackedSecuriti.l: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-Sale
ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageBackedSecuriti.d: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstate.l: Proceeds from Sale of Other Real Estate
ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstate.d: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

ProceedsFromSaleOfWhollyOwnedRealEstateA.l: Proceeds from Sale of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans
ProceedsFromSaleOfWhollyOwnedRealEstateA.d: The cash inflow from proceeds From Sales of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredDebt.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Debt
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredDebt.d: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt secured debt.

ProceedsFromSecuredLinesOfCredit.l: Proceeds from Secured Lines of Credit
ProceedsFromSecuredLinesOfCredit.d: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

ProceedsFromSecuredNotesPayable.d: The cash inflow from borrowings supported by a written promise to pay an obligation that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredTaxExemptDe.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Tax Exempt Debt
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredTaxExemptDe.d: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term tax exempt debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral.

ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfConsumerLoa.l: Proceeds from Securitizations of Consumer Loans
ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfConsumerLoa.d: The cash inflow from the securitization of receivables for loans to consumers. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfCreditCards.l: Proceeds from Securitizations of Credit Cards
ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfCreditCards.d: The cash inflow from the securitization of credit card receivables. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfLoansHeldFo.d: The cash inflow from the securitization of loans held for investment. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

ProceedsFromShortTermDebt.d: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

ProceedsFromOtherShortTermDebt.d: Amount of cash inflow from short-term debt classified as other.

ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised.d: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

ProceedsFromSubordinatedShortTermDebt.d: The cash inflow from an obligation which places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior loan) in liquidation of the entity's assets scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfUnsecuredDebt.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Debt
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfUnsecuredDebt.d: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt unsecured debt.

ProceedsFromUnsecuredLinesOfCredit.l: Proceeds from Unsecured Lines of Credit
ProceedsFromUnsecuredLinesOfCredit.d: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

ProceedsFromUnsecuredNotesPayable.d: The cash inflow from borrowings supported by a written promise to pay an obligation that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

ProductConcentrationRiskMember.d: Reflects the percentage that revenues during the period from a specified product are to a specified benchmark, such as total net revenues, segment revenues or product line revenues. May also reflect the percentage contribution the product made to operating results. Risk is materially adverse effects of a loss of sales of a significant product or line of products, which could occur upon loss of rights to sell, distribute or license others; loss of patent or copyright protection; or technological

ProductWarrantyAccrualWarrantiesIssued.l: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase for Warranties Issued
ProductWarrantyAccrualWarrantiesIssued.d: Amount of increase in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from warranties issued.

ProductWarrantyAccrualBalanceSheetClassi.l: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Balance Sheet Classification [Abstract]

ProductWarrantyAccrual.l: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual
ProductWarrantyAccrual.d: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers.

ProductWarrantyAccrualAdditionsFromBusin.l: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase from Business Combination
ProductWarrantyAccrualAdditionsFromBusin.d: Amount of increase in liability for standard and extended product warranty acquired in business combination.

ProductWarrantyAccrualPeriodIncreaseDecr.l: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
ProductWarrantyAccrualPeriodIncreaseDecr.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard and extended product warranty liability.

ProductWarrantyAccrualPayments.l: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Decrease for Payments
ProductWarrantyAccrualPayments.d: Amount of decrease in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from payments made in cash or in kind to satisfy claims under the terms of the standard and extended product warranty.

ProductWarrantyAccrualPreexistingIncreas.l: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties
ProductWarrantyAccrualPreexistingIncreas.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties.

ProductWarrantyDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for standard and extended product warranties and other product guarantee contracts, including a tabular reconciliation of the changes in the guarantor's aggregate product warranty liability for the reporting period.

ProductionRelatedImpairmentsOrCharges.d: Nonrecurring impairment charges related to the write-off of production-related equipment and inventory. This tag is used when an Entity charges this cost to cost of goods sold.

ProfessionalAndContractServicesExpense.d: Amount of expense for professional and contracted services.

ProfessionalMalpracticeLiabilityMember.d: Business insurance coverage for professionals, such as doctors, lawyers, insurance agents, accountants, real estate agents, veterinarians, and others. This liability coverage insures losses for claims arising from mistakes and errors or omissions in the course of professional activities.

ProgressPaymentsNettedAgainstInventoryFo.l: Progress Payments Netted Against Inventory for Long-Term Contracts or Programs
ProgressPaymentsNettedAgainstInventoryFo.d: Amount of advances received from customers under long-term contracts which have been offset against inventories accounts at the balance sheet date.

ProceedsFromCustomersForProgressPayments.l: Proceeds from Customers for Progress Payments
ProceedsFromCustomersForProgressPayments.d: Cash received from customers as progress payments on projects that have been partially completed.

EnergyRelatedInventoryPropaneGas.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of product derived from petroleum during the processing of oil or natural gas which is then used as a heat source or fuel.

PropertyLiabilityAndCasualtyInsuranceSeg.l: Property, Liability and Casualty Insurance Product Line [Member]
PropertyLiabilityAndCasualtyInsuranceSeg.d: Contract providing insurance coverage against property-related loss. Includes, but is not limited to, damage, theft, or legal liability for personal injury.

PropertyLiabilityReserveEstimatePolicy.l: Property Liability Reserve Estimate, Policy [Policy Text Block] (Deprecated 2024)
PropertyLiabilityReserveEstimatePolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy amounts needed to provide for the estimated ultimate cost of settling property insurance claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before a particular date (ordinarily, the statement of financial position date).

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentBasisOfValuatio.l: Property, Plant and Equipment, Basis of Valuation
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentBasisOfValuatio.d: Describes the basis at which an entity records its property, plant and equipment (for example at cost, fair value).

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentCostCapitalizat.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Cost Capitalization
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentCostCapitalizat.d: Describes the types of costs an entity capitalizes as part of property, plant and equipment, including the accounting treatment for costs incurred for repairs and maintenance activities.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentDispositions.d: Describes an entity's accounting treatment for disposals of property, plant and equipment, including gains and losses related thereto.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGross.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, before Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGross.d: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentImpairment.l: Property, Plant and Equipment, Impairment [Policy Text Block]
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentImpairment.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for assessing and recognizing impairments of its property, plant and equipment.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentInterestCapital.l: Property, Plant and Equipment, Interest Capitalization (Deprecated 2026)
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentInterestCapital.d: Describes whether an entity has capitalized interest cost as part of its basis in property, plant and equipment and the method by which such amount is calculated.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, after Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet.d: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentPolicyTextBlock.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment [Policy Text Block]
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentPreproductionDe.l: Property, Plant and Equipment, Preproduction Design and Development Costs [Policy Text Block]
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentPreproductionDe.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for the preproduction design and development costs it incurs related to long-term supply arrangements, including whether such costs are capitalized or expensed as incurred. The entity also may disclose the aggregate amount of (1) assets recognized for agreements that contractually reimburse the entity for its pre-production design and development costs (2) assets recognized for molds, dies and other tools that the entity owns and (3) assets recognized for molds, d

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAdditionalDiscl.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Additional Disclosures (Deprecated 2026)
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAdditionalDiscl.d: Additional information disclosed pertaining to property, plant and equipment.

ProvedOilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortM.l: Oil and Gas, Successful Efforts Method, Property and Equipment, Proved Property, before Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization, and Impairment
ProvedOilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortM.d: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and impairment, of oil and gas properties with proved reserve accounted for under successful efforts method.

DiscontinuedOperationProvisionForLossGai.l: Discontinued Operation, Provision for Loss (Gain) on Disposal, before Income Tax
DiscontinuedOperationProvisionForLossGai.d: Amount before tax of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts.d: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

ProvisionForLossOnContracts.d: Cumulative provision for contract losses not offset against related costs accumulated on the balance sheet.

ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLosses.l: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses
ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLosses.d: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLossesAbstr.l: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses [Abstract]

TaxAdjustmentsSettlementsAndUnusualProvi.l: Tax Adjustments, Settlements, and Unusual Provisions
TaxAdjustmentsSettlementsAndUnusualProvi.d: Amount of increase (decrease) to previously recorded tax expense. Includes, but is not limited to, significant settlements of income tax disputes, and unusual tax positions or infrequent actions taken by the entity, including tax assessment reversal, and IRS tax settlement.

ProvisionForLoanAndLeaseLosses.l: Provision for Loan and Lease Losses
ProvisionForLoanAndLeaseLosses.d: Amount of expense related to estimated loss from loan and lease transactions.

ProvisionForLoanAndLeaseLossesAbstract.l: Provision for Loan and Lease Losses [Abstract]

ProvisionForLoanLossesExpensed.d: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) for financing receivable.

ProvisionForOtherCreditLosses.d: Amount of expense related to credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions.

ProvisionForOtherLosses.d: Amount of expense related to other loss.

EmissionCreditsOrAllowancesPolicy.l: Emission Credits or Allowances, Policy [Policy Text Block]
EmissionCreditsOrAllowancesPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for emission credits or allowances. Such accounting policy has generally been based on an inventory or intangible asset model.

IntercompanyProfitToRegulatedAffiliatesP.l: Intra-Entity Profit to Regulated Affiliate [Policy Text Block]
IntercompanyProfitToRegulatedAffiliatesP.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for intra-entity profit on sale to regulated affiliate.

PublicUtilitiesPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for public utilities. Examples include a discussion about the scope criteria and appropriateness for and extent of the application of generally accepted accounting principles related to accounting for the effects of certain types of regulation (may include identification of specific business units). Other examples of the disclosures may include: descriptions of the form and economic effects of regulation (for example, but not limited to, recording of regulatory as

RegulatoryIncomeTaxesPolicy.l: Regulatory Income Taxes, Policy [Policy Text Block]
RegulatoryIncomeTaxesPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for income taxes, including investment tax credits, and the related regulatory treatment (for example, whether deferred income tax accounting - normalization - is allowed in rate making).

PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.l: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Interest
PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.d: Amount capitalized of allowance for funds used during construction.

PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.l: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Description
PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.d: Information pertaining to allowance for funds used during construction (AFUDC) for utilities (for example, description of projects, computation, amounts, rates, accounting, recovery period, noncash income). Allowance for funds used during construction represents the estimated costs of debt and equity financings necessary to finance the construction of regulated assets. May also indicate the financial statement captions that are affected by AFUDC, such as construction work in progress, other reve

PublicUtilitiesAmountOfAllowanceForEarni.l: Public Utilities, Amount of Allowance for Earnings on Equity Capitalized for Rate Making Purposes
PublicUtilitiesAmountOfAllowanceForEarni.d: Discloses the amount of any allowance for earnings on shareholders' investment capitalized for rate making purposes but not for the financial statements.

AmountOfEmbeddedRegulatoryAsset.d: Discloses amount of embedded regulatory assets within the plant accounts. This may result when the regulatory depreciable life is longer than the depreciable life generally used for nonregulatory accounting.

AmountOfEmbeddedRegulatoryLiability.d: Discloses amount of embedded regulatory liabilities within the plant accounts. This may result when the regulatory depreciable life is shorter than the depreciable life generally used for nonregulatory accounting.

AmountOfImpairmentToCarryingAmountOfRegu.l: Amount of Impairment to Carrying Amount of Regulatory Assets
AmountOfImpairmentToCarryingAmountOfRegu.d: Discloses the amount of any reduction to the carrying amounts of regulated assets that result from impairment (for example, rate actions of a regulator).

AmountOfRegulatoryCostsNotYetApproved.l: Amount of Regulatory Costs Not yet Approved
AmountOfRegulatoryCostsNotYetApproved.d: Amount of regulatory costs not yet approved by the regulatory authority.

PlantConstructionUsingIntermediaryPolicy.l: Plant Construction Using Intermediary, Policy [Policy Text Block]
PlantConstructionUsingIntermediaryPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for a utility company's accounting treatment when it uses an intermediary for plant construction. The intermediary's work in progress is included by the utility in an appropriate caption under the utility plant. The related debt is included in long term liabilities and disclosed on the balance sheet or in a note.

AllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionP.l: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Policy [Policy Text Block]
AllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionP.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for AFUDC (for example, component of PPE, credit to income statement), information regarding the inclusion in rates (only capitalized if its inclusion in rates is probable) and description of AFUDC (for example, represents the cost of capital used during construction).

RegulatoryDepreciationAndAmortizationPol.l: Regulatory Depreciation and Amortization, Policy [Policy Text Block]
RegulatoryDepreciationAndAmortizationPol.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for systematically allocating capitalized costs to periods that benefit from the use thereof. Includes, but is not limited to, methods used, such as composite depreciation, descriptions of regulatory treatment for estimated removal and disposal costs, and description of amortization of plant-related regulatory assets.

OutageCostsPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for reporting outage costs, including the creation of regulatory assets or regulatory liabilities.

RegulatoryAssetsAndLiabilitiesRecognitio.l: Regulatory Assets and Liabilities, Recognition Criteria
RegulatoryAssetsAndLiabilitiesRecognitio.d: Describes the entity's criteria for recording regulatory assets and regulatory liabilities only because they are included in the rate-setting process, and rate-related accruals and deferrals, such as amounts receivable from (or due to) customers under fuel adjustment clauses and interim rates collected prior to regulatory approval.

DescriptionOfRegulatoryCostsNotYetApprov.l: Description of Regulatory Costs Not yet Approved
DescriptionOfRegulatoryCostsNotYetApprov.d: Describes regulatory costs not yet approved by the regulatory authority. May also include the accounting (for example, not included in regulated assets, recorded in other assets).

PublicUtilitiesDescriptionOfRegulatorySc.l: Public Utilities, Description of Regulatory Scope
PublicUtilitiesDescriptionOfRegulatorySc.d: Describes the general scope of regulation, including which regulatory bodies are officially authorized to oversee operations.

DescriptionOfSpecificRegulatoryAssets.d: Describes a specific regulatory asset. May include such items as what is included in the asset, components, dates and amounts.

PublicUtilitiesDescriptionOfSpecificRegu.l: Public Utilities, Description of Specific Regulatory Liabilities
PublicUtilitiesDescriptionOfSpecificRegu.d: Description of a specific regulatory liability pertaining to public utilities.

PublicUtilitiesDisclosureOfRateMatters.l: Public Utilities, Disclosure of Rate Matters
PublicUtilitiesDisclosureOfRateMatters.d: Describes all of the specific events that have or may impact rates and amortization of regulatory assets and liabilities (for example, pending or recently concluded regulatory proceedings, environmental requirements). Specifics may include quantifications related to rates, costs, and earnings. Events may relate to rate moratoriums or price caps.

PublicUtilitiesDisclosureOfRegulatoryMat.l: Public Utilities, Disclosure of Regulatory Matters Pending
PublicUtilitiesDisclosureOfRegulatoryMat.d: Describes all of the specific regulatory matters that are pending, including the regulatory authorities involved and the potential impacts.

PublicUtilitiesDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for public utilities.

DescriptionOfRegulatoryAssetsAndLiabilit.l: Description of Regulatory Assets and Liabilities
DescriptionOfRegulatoryAssetsAndLiabilit.d: Describes a general nature of regulatory assets and liabilities. May include such items as what the assets and liabilities relate to and how recorded.

InterestCostForPlantConstructionUsingInt.l: Interest Cost for Plant Construction Using Intermediary, Policy [Policy Text Block]
InterestCostForPlantConstructionUsingInt.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for electric utilities using an intermediary for plant construction.

LongTermContractsForPurchaseOfElectricPo.l: Regulated Operation, Long-Term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power [Table]
LongTermContractsForPurchaseOfElectricPo.d: Disclosure of information about long-term contract for purchase of electric power between regulated entity and public utility district, cooperative, or other organization.

RevenueRecognitionForAlternativeRevenueP.l: Revenue Recognition for Alternative Revenue Programs, Policy [Policy Text Block]
RevenueRecognitionForAlternativeRevenueP.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for revenue recognition related to alternative revenue programs. The major alternative revenue programs can generally be segregated into two categories, programs that adjust billings for the effects of weather abnormalities or broad external factors or to compensate the utility for demand-side management initiatives (for example, no-growth plans and similar conservation efforts); and programs that provide for additional billings (incentive awards) if the utility a

PublicUtilitiesNatureOfAllowanceForEarni.l: Public Utilities, Nature of Allowance for Earnings on Equity Capitalized for Rate Making Purposes
PublicUtilitiesNatureOfAllowanceForEarni.d: Description of the nature of any allowance for earnings on shareholders' equity capitalized for rate making purposes but not for the financial statements.

PhaseInPlanAmountOfCostsDeferredForRateM.l: Phase-in Plan, Amount of Costs Deferred for Rate-making Purposes
PhaseInPlanAmountOfCostsDeferredForRateM.d: The total amount of allowable costs capitalized during the period by the entity pertaining to Phase-In plans which were deferred on the expectation of future recovery.

PublicUtilitiesPhaseInPlanTerms.d: Describes the terms of phase-in plans in effect during the current year or ordered for future years.

CapitalizationAndAmortizationOfFuelCosts.l: Capitalization and Amortization of Fuel Costs, Policy [Policy Text Block]
CapitalizationAndAmortizationOfFuelCosts.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for fuel costs amortized and recorded and recovered through rates, such as under a fuel adjustment clause or other tracking arrangement.

RegulatoryEnvironmentalCostsPolicy.l: Regulatory Environmental Costs, Policy [Policy Text Block]
RegulatoryEnvironmentalCostsPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for liabilities for remediation of environmental matters. The accounting policy may specify the conditions under which rate actions of a regulator provide reasonable assurance of the existence of an asset pertaining thereto.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment [Abstract]
Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Construction Work in Process Included in Rate Base
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Discloses the amount of construction work in process that is included in the rate making process at period end.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Disallowed Costs for Recently Completed Plant
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Amount of disallowed costs for rate making purposes for recently completed plants in regulated industries.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Disclosure of Composite Depreciation Rate for Plants in Service
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Composite depreciation rate for public utility plants in service.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Original Cost of Intangible Utility Plants
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Original cost of establishing intangible utility plants.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Plant Acquisition Adjustments for Intangible Utility Plants
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Any changes made to the acquisition costs of intangible utility plants.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Plant Adjustments for Intangible Utility Plants
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Any changes made to the basis costs of intangible utility plants.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Present Value of Regulated Asset for Plant Abandonment
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: The present value amount of future cost recoveries that are probable and estimable related to plant abandonment's for regulated industries.

RegulatoryAssetRecoveryAssessments.d: Describes the continual or periodic assessment of the probability of future recovery of regulatory assets.

RemainingAmountsOfRegulatoryAssetsForWhi.l: Remaining Amounts of Regulatory Assets for which No Return on Investment During Recovery Period is Provided
RemainingAmountsOfRegulatoryAssetsForWhi.d: Remaining balance of regulatory assets for which no return on investment during recovery is provided. In some cases, a regulator may permit an enterprise to include a cost that would be charged to expense by an unregulated enterprise as an allowable cost over a period of time by amortizing that cost for rate-making purposes, but the regulator does not include the unrecovered amount in the rate base.

ScheduleOfLongTermContractsForPurchaseOf.l: Schedule of Long-Term Contracts for Purchase of Electric Power [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfLongTermContractsForPurchaseOf.d: Tabular disclosure of information concerning the terms and significance of long term contracts to purchase power (generally referred to as purchase power agreements (PPAs) or power sale agreements (PSAs)) including date of contract expiration, share of plant output being purchased, estimated annual cost, annual minimum debt service payment required and amount of related long-term debt or lease obligations outstanding.

TypesOfNetRegulatoryAssetsEarningReturns.l: Types of Net Regulatory Assets Earning Returns
TypesOfNetRegulatoryAssetsEarningReturns.d: Identifies what net regulatory assets are earning a return through rate billings.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Plant in Service
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end amount of total gross PPE.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Equipment
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end book value of equipment owned (but not classified elsewhere) by the public utility.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Land
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end book value of land owned by the public utility.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Other Property, Plant and Equipment
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end book value of other property, plant and equipment (PPE) owned (but not classified elsewhere) by the public utility.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end book value of accumulated depreciation on property, plant and equipment (PPE) that is owned by the regulated operations of the public utility.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Common
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to regulated assets common to business units.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Construction Work in Progress
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end amount of construction work in progress in public utility.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Distribution
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to utility distribution.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Generation or Processing
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to generation or processing owned by public utility.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Transmission
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to utility transmission owned by public utility.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Transmission and Distribution
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to transmission and distribution owned by public utility.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Fuel
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to fuels owned by the public utility.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Vehicles
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end book value of vehicles owned by the public utility.

PumpTaxes.d: Pump tax, commonly known as a Replenishment assessment. A charge on each acre-foot of groundwater extracted from the basin. Income from the pump taxes finances the replenishment of the basin and projects for water recycling and water quality improvements.

PaymentsToAcquireCommercialRealEstate.l: Payments to Acquire Commercial Real Estate
PaymentsToAcquireCommercialRealEstate.d: The cash outflow from the acquisition of property as primarily intended to generate income for its owner.

PaymentsForConstructionInProcess.d: The cash outflow from construction costs to date on capital projects that have not been completed and assets being constructed that are not ready to be placed into service.

PaymentsToAcquireAndDevelopRealEstate.l: Payments to Acquire and Develop Real Estate
PaymentsToAcquireAndDevelopRealEstate.d: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land and anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth, and payments to develop real estate assets by adding improvements on or to a parcel of land. Such improvements may include drainage, utilities, subdividing, access, buildings, and any combination of these elements. Including real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excluding real estate acquired for use by the owner.

PaymentsToAcquireAndDevelopRealEstateAbs.l: Payments to Acquire and Develop Real Estate [Abstract]

PaymentsToAcquireEquityMethodInvestments.l: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments
PaymentsToAcquireEquityMethodInvestments.d: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

PaymentsToAcquireFederalReserveStock.l: Payments to Acquire Federal Reserve Bank Stock
PaymentsToAcquireFederalReserveStock.d: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

PaymentsToAcquireFinanceReceivables.d: The cash outflow for the purchase of amounts due from customers, clients, lessees, borrowers, or others under the terms of its agreements therewith.

PaymentsToAcquireHeldToMaturitySecuritie.d: Amount of cash outflow through purchase of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

PaymentsToAcquireHeldForSaleRealEstate.l: Payment for Acquisition, Real Estate, Held-for-Sale
PaymentsToAcquireHeldForSaleRealEstate.d: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

PaymentsToAcquireInProcessResearchAndDev.l: Payments to Acquire in Process Research and Development
PaymentsToAcquireInProcessResearchAndDev.d: The cash outflows from the purchase of net carrying value allocated to in-process research and development costs and materials acquired in a business combination.

PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets.d: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

PaymentsToAcquireInterestInJointVenture.l: Payments to Acquire Interest in Joint Venture
PaymentsToAcquireInterestInJointVenture.d: The cash outflow associated with the investment in or advances to an entity in which the reporting entity shares control of the entity with another party or group.

PaymentsToAcquireInterestInSubsidiariesA.l: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
PaymentsToAcquireInterestInSubsidiariesA.d: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of or advances to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, and joint venture or equity method investment) or the acquisition of an additional interest in a subsidiary (controlled entity).

PaymentsToAcquireInterestInSubsidiariesA.l: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates [Abstract]

PaymentsToAcquireInvestments.d: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of all investments (debt, security, other) during the period.

PaymentsToAcquireLand.d: The cash outflow from the acquisition of real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes land acquired for use by the owner.

PaymentsToAcquireLeaseReceivables.d: The cash outflow for the purchase of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

PaymentsToAcquireLeasesHeldForInvestment.d: The cash outflow associated with purchasing leases held for investment purposes during an accounting period.

PaymentsToAcquireLifeInsurancePolicies.l: Payment to Acquire Life Insurance Policy, Investing Activities
PaymentsToAcquireLifeInsurancePolicies.d: Amount of cash outflow for payment of premium on corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

PaymentsToAcquireLoansHeldForInvestment.d: The cash outflow associated with purchasing loans held for investment purposes during the period.

PaymentsToPurchaseLoansHeldForSale.d: The aggregate cash outflow used to purchase all loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesHeldForIn.l: Payment for Acquisition, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment
PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesHeldForIn.d: The cash outflow from (a) purchases of loans held-for-investment, (b) purchases of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesHeldForIn.l: Payment for Acquisition, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment [Abstract]

PaymentsToAcquireOtherLoansAndLeasesHeld.l: Payment for Acquisition, Loan and Lease, Other, Held-for-Investment
PaymentsToAcquireOtherLoansAndLeasesHeld.d: Amount of cash outflow from purchases of loans and leases held-for-investment classified as other.

PaymentsToAcquireLoansReceivable.d: The cash outflow for the purchase of loan receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

PaymentsToAcquireManagementContractRight.l: Payments to Acquire Management Contract Rights
PaymentsToAcquireManagementContractRight.d: The cash outflow from amounts paid for the rights to manage the property.

PaymentsToAcquireMarketableSecurities.d: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of marketable security.

PaymentsToAcquireMineralRights.d: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a mineral right which is the right to extract a mineral from the earth or to receive payment, in the form of royalty, for the extraction of minerals.

PaymentsToAcquireMiningAssets.d: The cash outflow from the purchase of mining and mining related assets during the period.

PaymentsToAcquireAdditionalInterestInSub.l: Payments to Acquire Additional Interest in Subsidiaries
PaymentsToAcquireAdditionalInterestInSub.d: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of noncontrolling interest during the period.

PaymentsToAcquireMortgageBackedSecuritie.l: Payments to Acquire Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-Sale
PaymentsToAcquireMortgageBackedSecuritie.d: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

PaymentsToPurchaseMortgageLoansHeldForSa.l: Payment for Purchase, Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale
PaymentsToPurchaseMortgageLoansHeldForSa.d: The cash outflow used to purchase loans that are secured with real estate mortgage and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

PaymentsToAcquireMortgageNotesReceivable.l: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Notes Receivable
PaymentsToAcquireMortgageNotesReceivable.d: The cash outflow from the purchase of receivables arising from the mortgage note on real estate.

PaymentsToAcquireNotesReceivable.d: The cash outflow to acquire an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the entity (holder) a definite sum of money at a future date. Such amount may include accrued interest receivable in accordance with the terms of the note. The note also may contain provisions including a discount or premium, payable on demand, secured, or unsecured, interest bearing or noninterest bearing, among myriad other features and characteristics.

PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasEquipment.l: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Equipment
PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasEquipment.d: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset use for the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.

PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasProperty.l: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property
PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasProperty.d: The cash outflow to purchase of mineral interests in oil and gas properties for use in the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.

PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasPropertyAndEqu.l: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasPropertyAndEqu.d: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset for use in the normal oil and gas operations and to purchase mineral interests in oil and gas properties not intended for resale.

PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasPropertyAndEqu.l: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property and Equipment [Abstract]

PaymentsToAcquireOtherProductiveAssets.l: Payments to Acquire Other Productive Assets
PaymentsToAcquireOtherProductiveAssets.d: Amount of cash outflow for the purchase of or improvements to tangible or intangible assets, used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

PaymentsToPurchaseOtherLoansHeldForSale.l: Payment for Purchase, Loan, Other, Held-for-Sale
PaymentsToPurchaseOtherLoansHeldForSale.d: The cash outflow used to purchase loans (other than mortgage loans) that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

PaymentsToAcquireOtherRealEstate.l: Payments to Acquire Other Real Estate
PaymentsToAcquireOtherRealEstate.d: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of other real estate investments held by the entity for investment purposes not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

PaymentsToAcquireOtherReceivables.d: Amount of cash outflow from the purchase of receivables classified as other.

PaymentsToAcquireOtherInvestments.d: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investments classified as other.

PaymentsToAcquireProjects.d: The cash outflow from the amount invested for projects in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipme.l: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipme.d: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipme.l: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment [Abstract]

PaymentsToAcquireRealEstate.d: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth; includes real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes real estate acquired for use by the owner.

PaymentsToAcquireReceivables.d: The cash outflow for the purchase of all receivables.

PaymentsToAcquireResidentialRealEstate.l: Payments to Acquire Residential Real Estate
PaymentsToAcquireResidentialRealEstate.d: The cash outflow from the acquisition of residential property intended to generate income for the owner.

PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedCertificatesO.l: Payments to Acquire Restricted Certificates of Deposit
PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedCertificatesO.d: The cash outflow from temporary investment with specific maturity and interest rate that are prohibited for current use.

PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedInvestments.d: The cash outflow to acquire investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

PaymentsToAcquireRetainedInterestInSecur.l: Payments to Acquire Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables
PaymentsToAcquireRetainedInterestInSecur.d: The cash outflow for the purchase of a retained interest in a receivable securitized via a structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesHeldForIn.l: Payment for Acquisition, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment, Credit Card Securitization
PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesHeldForIn.d: The cash outflow from the purchase of securitized credit card receivables which are held for investment purposes. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

PaymentsToAcquireShortTermInvestments.d: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

PaymentsToAcquireSoftware.d: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition from vendors of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

PaymentsToAcquireTrustPreferredInvestmen.l: Payments to Acquire Trust Preferred Investments
PaymentsToAcquireTrustPreferredInvestmen.d: The cash outflow for the purchase of trust preferred securities, which possess characteristics of both equity and debt securities.

PaymentsToAcquireWasteWaterSystems.l: Payments to Acquire Waste Water Systems
PaymentsToAcquireWasteWaterSystems.d: The cash outflow for the purchase of waste water systems which includes the waste treatment and disposal facility and equipment to households and industry.

PaymentsToAcquireWaterSystems.d: The cash outflow for the purchase of a facility and equipment that provides water supply which includes wells, reservoirs, pumping stations, and control facilities.

PaymentsToAcquireWaterAndWasteWaterSyste.l: Payments to Acquire Water and Waste Water Systems
PaymentsToAcquireWaterAndWasteWaterSyste.d: The cash outflow for the purchase of a facility and equipment that provides water supply which includes wells, reservoirs, pumping stations, and control facilities; and waste water systems which includes the waste treatment and disposal facility and equipment to households and industry.

PaymentsToAcquireWaterAndWasteWaterSyste.l: Payments to Acquire Water and Waste Water Systems [Abstract]

OtherInventoryPurchasedGoods.d: Gross amount of components used by the entity which are bought from another entity rather than produced by the entity.

InterestIncomePurchasedReceivables.d: Interest earned from receivables purchased; for instance, receivables purchased through a factoring arrangement.

PaymentsForProceedsFromInvestments.d: The net cash paid (received) associated with the acquisition or disposal of all investments, including securities and other assets.

PurposeOfForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstru.l: Purpose of Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
PurposeOfForeignCurrencyDerivativeInstru.d: Description of the purpose of activity relating to foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments. For example, some derivatives are used to hedge risks but are not designated as hedges for accounting purposes.

PurposeOfInterestRateDerivativeInstrumen.l: Purpose of Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
PurposeOfInterestRateDerivativeInstrumen.d: Description of the purpose of activity relating to interest rate derivatives not designated as hedging instruments. For example, some derivatives are used to hedge risks but are not designated as hedges for accounting purposes.

PurposeOfPriceRiskDerivativeInstrumentsN.l: Purpose of Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
PurposeOfPriceRiskDerivativeInstrumentsN.d: Description of the purpose of activity relating to price risk rate derivatives not designated as hedging instruments. For example, some derivatives are used to hedge risks but are not designated as hedges for accounting purposes.

SecuritizedAssetsAndAnyOtherFinancialAss.l: Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Securitized or Asset-Backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together [Line Items]
SecuritizedAssetsAndAnyOtherFinancialAss.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

SecuritizedAssetsAndAnyOtherFinancialAss.l: Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Transferred Financial Assets and Other Financial Assets Managed Together [Table]
SecuritizedAssetsAndAnyOtherFinancialAss.d: Disclosure of information about transferred financial assets that continue to be recognized and other financial assets that it manages together with them. Includes, but is not limited to, credit delinquencies and credit losses, after recoveries.

RailroadTransportationEquipmentMember.d: Equipment used for the primary purpose of rail transportation, including railroad cars, tracks and ties.

InventoryRawMaterialsAndSupplies.l: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Gross
InventoryRawMaterialsAndSupplies.d: Gross amount of unprocessed materials to be used in manufacturing or production process and supplies that will be consumed.

RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationCost.l: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Cost Capitalized Subsequent to Acquisition, Cost
RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationCost.d: Amount of cost capitalized subsequent to acquisition for real estate investment property, including, but not limited to, real estate tax and insurance, by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate. Excludes initial purchase price and improvement, and real estate not held as investment or interest.

RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationCarr.l: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Building and Improvements, Amount
RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationCarr.d: Amount before accumulated depreciation of buildings and improvements for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate. Excludes real estate not held as an investment or interest.

RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationCarr.l: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Land, Amount
RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationCarr.d: Amount of land for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate. Excludes real estate not held as an investment or interest.

RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationCost.l: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Cost Capitalized Subsequent to Acquisition, Improvements
RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationCost.d: Amount of land and buildings and improvements made to real estate investments and capitalized after acquisition for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationInit.l: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Initial Cost of Building and Improvements
RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationInit.d: Initial cost of buildings and improvements for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate. Excludes real estate not held as an investment or interest.

RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationInit.l: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Initial Cost of Land
RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationInit.d: Initial cost of land for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate. Excludes real estate not held as an investment or interest.

RealEstateAcquiredInSatisfactionOfDebtMe.l: Real Estate Acquired in Satisfaction of Debt [Member]
RealEstateAcquiredInSatisfactionOfDebtMe.d: Real estate taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

RealEstateAcquiredThroughForeclosure.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of land and buildings obtained through foreclosure proceedings or defeasance in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement.

RealEstateDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for certain real estate investment financial statements, real estate investment trust operating support agreements, real estate owned, retail land sales, time share transactions, as well as other real estate related disclosures.

RealEstateHeldForDevelopmentAndSale.l: Real Estate Held for Development and Sale
RealEstateHeldForDevelopmentAndSale.d: For banks, amount of real estate assets held for development or sale by the consolidated entity.

RealEstateInvestmentFinancialStatementsD.l: Real Estate Investment Financial Statements, Disclosure [Table Text Block]
RealEstateInvestmentFinancialStatementsD.d: Tabular disclosure of nonconsolidated investments in real estate including interests in corporations, partnerships and joint ventures. Disclosures may include summarized aggregate financial statements for the real estate investments.

RealEstateInvestmentPartnershipCostOfSal.l: Real Estate Investment Partnership Cost of Sales
RealEstateInvestmentPartnershipCostOfSal.d: Amount of cost of sales related to investments in real estate partnerships and variable interest entities.

RealEstateInvestmentPartnershipRevenue.d: Amount of revenue recognized from investments in real estate partnerships and variable interest entities.

RealEstateInvestments.d: Amount of real estate investments, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; (7) other real estate investments; (8) real estate joint ventures; and (9) unconsolidated real estate and other joint ventures not separately presented.

RealEstateInvestmentsJointVentures.d: The book value of investments in real estate joint ventures including direct and indirect investments.

RealEstateInvestmentMember.d: This element represents direct equity investments in real estate projects (Land, buildings and improvements owned for income production and capital accretion potential) and certain loans accounted for as real estate investments. For loans accounted for as real estate investments, the entity (lender) has virtually the same risks and rewards as those of owners or joint venture participants. Such arrangements are treated as if the entity actually has an ownership interest in the property. In such a

RealEstateOwnedTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for real estate owned (as defined). Generally, the largest component of real estate owned by lenders is assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure. Real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned.

RealEstateOwnedDisclosureOfDetailedCompo.l: Real Estate Owned, Disclosure of Detailed Components (Deprecated 2026)
RealEstateOwnedDisclosureOfDetailedCompo.d: Disclosures related to real estate owned (as defined). Generally, the largest component of real estate owned by lenders is assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure. Real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned.

RealEstateOwnedDisclosureOfDetailedCompo.l: Real Estate Owned, Disclosure of Detailed Components [Abstract]

RealEstateOwnedAccumulatedDepreciation.d: Amount of accumulated depreciation for real estate owned (REO).

RealEstateOwnedFinancialStatementCaption.l: Real Estate Owned, Financial Statement Caption (Deprecated 2026)
RealEstateOwnedFinancialStatementCaption.d: Describes the financial statement caption of amounts included in real estate owned in the accompanying balance sheet (such as Other Assets).

RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanceCompone.l: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Component (Deprecated 2026)
RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanceCompone.d: The valuation allowance loss on real estate owned or any impairment losses taken against real estate investments held for use or resale.

RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowance.d: For each period for which an income statement is required, disclosure of the changes in the allowance, including balances at end of period.

RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanceRollFor.l: Real Estate Owned Valuation Allowance [Roll Forward]
RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanceRollFor.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanceAmounts.l: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Amounts Applied
RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanceAmounts.d: Amount of the valuation allowance for real estate owned that was applied in the period against the carrying amount of real estate owned that was sold, written down or written off.

RealEstateInvestmentPropertyAtCost.l: Real Estate Investment Property, at Cost
RealEstateInvestmentPropertyAtCost.d: Amount of real estate investment property which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.

RealEstateInvestmentPropertyAtCostAbstra.l: Real Estate Investment Property, at Cost [Abstract]

RealEstateInvestmentPropertyNet.d: Amount of real estate investment property, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.

ReasonForChangingPlanToSellAssetsHeldFor.l: Long-Lived Asset, Change to Plan of Sale, Reclassification from Held-for-Sale to Held-and-Used [Abstract]

RecapitalizationCosts.d: Amount of recapitalization costs for professional fees associated with restructuring debt and equity mixture that do not qualify for capitalization.

ReceiptOfAssetsInSatisfactionOfDebtMembe.l: Receipt of Assets in Satisfaction of Debt [Member]
ReceiptOfAssetsInSatisfactionOfDebtMembe.d: The receipt of assets, such real estate or equity interest, in settlement of monies owed.

ReceivableForRecoveryOfImportDutiesNet.l: Receivable for Recovery of Import Duties, Net
ReceivableForRecoveryOfImportDutiesNet.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of tariffs due either from customers or suppliers arising from sales or purchases, or as previously overpaid to tax authorities or vendors.

LoansNotesTradeAndOtherReceivablesDisclo.l: Loans, Notes, Trade and Other Receivables Disclosure [Text Block]
LoansNotesTradeAndOtherReceivablesDisclo.d: The entire disclosure for claims held for amounts due to entity, excluding financing receivables.
