VariableInterestEntityNatureOfInvolvemen.l: Variable Interest Entity, Qualitative or Quantitative Information, Nature and Extent of Involvement
VariableInterestEntityNatureOfInvolvemen.d: Describes the relationship and business conducted between the reporting entity and the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

VariableInterestEntityPrimaryBeneficiary.d: Variable Interest Entities (VIE) in which the entity has a controlling financial interest (as defined) and of which it is therefore the primary beneficiary. A controlling financial interest is determined based on both: (a) the entity's power to direct activities of the VIE that most significantly impact the VIE's economic performance and (b) the entity's obligation to absorb losses of the VIE that could potentially be significant to the VIE or the right to receive benefits from the VIE that coul

VariableInterestEntityVIEActivitiesOfVIE.l: Variable Interest Entity, Qualitative or Quantitative Information, Activities of VIE
VariableInterestEntityVIEActivitiesOfVIE.d: Description of the transactions or business conducted by the Variable Interest Entity (VIE), including how the VIE is financed.

VariableInterestEntityDescriptionOfEntit.l: Variable Interest Entity, Qualitative or Quantitative Information, Nature of VIE
VariableInterestEntityDescriptionOfEntit.d: Description of the variable interest entity's nature.

VariableInterestEntityOwnershipPercentag.l: Variable Interest Entity, Qualitative or Quantitative Information, Ownership Percentage
VariableInterestEntityOwnershipPercentag.d: Percentage of the Variable Interest Entity's (VIE) voting interest owned by (or beneficial interest in) the reporting entity (directly or indirectly).

VariableInterestEntityVIEPurposeOfVIE.l: Variable Interest Entity, Qualitative or Quantitative Information, Purpose of VIE
VariableInterestEntityVIEPurposeOfVIE.d: The overall reason that the Variable Interest Entity (VIE) was formed. For example, the VIE was formed to hold financial assets, including loans or receivables, real estate or other property or to engage in research and development or other activities on behalf of another company.

VariableInterestEntityVIESizeOfVIE.l: Variable Interest Entity, Qualitative or Quantitative Information, Size of VIE
VariableInterestEntityVIESizeOfVIE.d: Size of the Variable Interest Entity (VIE), such as small, medium, or large in relation to certain benchmarks, or a stated measure such as number of employees, assets, net assets, revenues, or expenses.

VariableInterestEntityTypeOfEntity.l: Variable Interest Entity, Qualitative or Quantitative Information, Type of Entity
VariableInterestEntityTypeOfEntity.d: Structure or legal form of Variable Interest Entity (VIE). In general, a VIE is a corporation, partnership, trust, or any other legal structure used for business purposes that either (a) does not have equity investors with voting rights or (b) has equity investors that do not provide sufficient financial resources for the entity to support its activities.

VariableLifeMember.d: Contract providing life insurance under which benefit payable upon death or surrender varies to reflect investment experience of separate account supporting policy.

VehiclesMember.d: Equipment used primarily for road transportation.

WarehouseAgreementBorrowings.d: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the outstanding short-term borrowings under a revolving line of credit used by mortgage bankers to finance the origination or purchase of loans.

WarehouseAgreementBorrowingsMember.d: A revolving line of credit facility used by mortgage bankers to finance the origination or purchase of loans.

OtherInventoryWarehouse.d: Gross amount of merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies held by the entity in a building or part of a building for future sale.

WarrantMember.d: Security that gives the holder the right to purchase shares of stock in accordance with the terms of the instrument, usually upon payment of a specified amount.

WarrantsAndRightsOutstanding.d: Value of outstanding derivative securities that permit the holder the right to purchase securities (usually equity) from the issuer at a specified price.

WarrantyObligationsMember.d: A revision in the estimated costs to be incurred to make repairs or fix problems on sold goods or services pursuant to promises or guarantees made as to satisfactory performance.

ProductWarrantyAccrualNoncurrent.d: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer) for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers.

WarrantyReservesMember.d: Reserve for expected cost from warranty provided on specific product or service.

WaterDistributionMember.d: System used for the primary purpose of distributing water to the consumer.

WaterPlantMember.d: Plant used in connection with the operations of a water utility company.

WaterTransmissionMember.d: System used for the primary purpose of transmitting water to the consumer.

WeightedAverageCostInventoryAmount.d: The amount of weighted average cost inventory present at the reporting date when inventory is valued using different valuation methods.

WeightedAverageInterestRateOfTimeDeposit.l: Weighted Average Interest Rate of Time Deposits, $100,000 or More
WeightedAverageInterestRateOfTimeDeposit.d: Weighted average interest rate of time deposits, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of $100,000 or more.

WeightedAverageInterestRateOfTimeDeposit.l: Weighted Average Interest Rate of Time Deposits, $100,000 or More [Abstract]
Weighted Average Interest Rate of Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, after 12 Months
WeightedAverageInterestRateOfTimeDeposit.d: The weighted average interest rate of domestic and foreign time deposits (including certificates of deposits, individual retirement accounts and open accounts) in denominations of $100,000 or more, with maturities of greater than twelve months.

WeightedAverageInterestRateOfTimeDeposit.l: Weighted Average Interest Rate of Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, Description (Deprecated 2026)
WeightedAverageInterestRateOfTimeDeposit.d: Description of the weighted average interest rate of time deposits, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of $100,000 or more.

WeightedAverageInterestRateOfTimeDeposit.l: Weighted Average Interest Rate of Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, 6 Months through 12 Months
WeightedAverageInterestRateOfTimeDeposit.d: The weighted average interest rate of domestic and foreign time deposits (including certificates of deposits, individual retirement accounts and open accounts) in denominations of $100,000 or more, with maturities of six months through twelve months.

WeightedAverageInterestRateOfTimeDeposit.l: Weighted Average Interest Rate of Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, Three Months or Less
WeightedAverageInterestRateOfTimeDeposit.d: The weighted average interest rate of domestic and foreign time deposits (including certificates of deposits, individual retirement accounts and open accounts) in denominations of $100,000 or more, with maturities of three months or less.

WeightedAverageInterestRateOfTimeDeposit.l: Weighted Average Interest Rate of Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, Three Months Through Six Months
WeightedAverageInterestRateOfTimeDeposit.d: The weighted average interest rate of domestic and foreign time deposits (including certificates of deposits, individual retirement accounts and open accounts) in denominations of $100,000 or more, with maturities of three months through six months.

WeightedAverageNumberBasicSharesOutstand.l: Weighted Average Number Basic Shares Outstanding Adjustment, Pro Forma
WeightedAverageNumberBasicSharesOutstand.d: Adjustment to the weighted average number of basic shares outstanding to convert this to a pro forma presentation.

WeightedAverageBasicSharesOutstandingPro.l: Weighted Average Basic Shares Outstanding, Pro Forma
WeightedAverageBasicSharesOutstandingPro.d: The weighted average number of shares (units) outstanding in the calculation of pro forma basic earnings per share (earnings per unit), which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesContingentl.l: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Contingently Issuable
WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesContingentl.d: Shares issuable for little or no cash consideration upon the satisfaction of certain conditions (contingently issuable shares) are considered outstanding common shares and included in the computation of basic Earnings Per Share as of the date that all necessary conditions have been satisfied (in essence, when issuance of the shares is no longer contingent). Outstanding common shares that are contingently returnable (that is, subject to recall) are treated in the same manner as contingently issua

WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOuts.l: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOuts.d: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

WeightedAverageNumberDilutedSharesOutsta.l: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted, Adjustment
WeightedAverageNumberDilutedSharesOutsta.d: The sum of dilutive potential common shares or units used in the calculation of the diluted per-share or per-unit computation.

ProFormaWeightedAverageSharesOutstanding.l: Pro Forma Weighted Average Shares Outstanding, Diluted
ProFormaWeightedAverageSharesOutstanding.d: The weighted average number of shares or units and dilutive common stock or unit equivalents outstanding in the calculation of proforma diluted earnings per share (earnings per unit), which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesCommonStock.l: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Common Stock Subject to Repurchase or Cancellation
WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesCommonStock.d: Number of shares of common stock subject to repurchase or cancellation determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that these shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Common stock subject to repurchase are outstanding common shares that are contingently returnable (that is, subject to recall).

WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesEmployeeSto.l: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Employee Stock Ownership Plan Shares Not Committed to be Released
WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesEmployeeSto.d: Number of employee stock ownership plan (ESOP) shares that have not been committed to be released determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that these shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstanding.l: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstanding.d: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesRestrictedS.l: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Restricted Stock
WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesRestrictedS.d: Number of shares of restricted stock determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that restricted shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Restricted shares are subject to sales, contractual, regulatory or other restrictions that prevent or inhibit the holder from freely disposing of them before the restriction ends.

WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesTreasurySto.l: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Treasury Stock
WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesTreasurySto.d: Number of shares of treasury stock determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that treasury shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Treasury stock is stock that the Entity has issued but subsequently reacquired.

WeightedAverageRateDomesticDeposit.l: Weighted Average Rate, Interest-Bearing Domestic Deposits, Point in Time
WeightedAverageRateDomesticDeposit.d: Weighted average interest rate calculated at point in time for domestic deposit liability.

WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositBroker.l: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Brokered
WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositBroker.d: The weighted average interest rate for domestic brokered deposit liabilities.

WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositCertif.l: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Certificates of Deposit
WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositCertif.d: The weighted average interest rate for domestic certificates of deposit liabilities.

WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositChecki.l: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Checking
WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositChecki.d: The weighted average interest rate for domestic checking deposit liabilities.

WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositDemand.l: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Demand
WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositDemand.d: The weighted average interest rate for domestic demand deposit liabilities.

WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositLiabil.l: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit Liabilities [Abstract]

WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositMoneyM.l: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Money Market
WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositMoneyM.d: The weighted average interest rate for domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities.

WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositNotice.l: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Notice of Withdrawal
WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositNotice.d: The weighted average interest rate for domestic notice of withdrawal demand deposit liabilities.

WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositOtherT.l: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Other Time Deposit
WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositOtherT.d: The weighted average interest rate for domestic time deposit liabilities other than certificates of deposit.

WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositSaving.l: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Savings
WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositSaving.d: The weighted average interest rate for domestic savings deposit liabilities.

WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositTimeDe.l: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Time Deposits
WeightedAverageRateDomesticDepositTimeDe.d: The weighted average interest rate for domestic time deposit liabilities.

WeightedAverageRateForeignDeposit.l: Weighted Average Rate, Interest-Bearing Foreign Deposits, Point in Time
WeightedAverageRateForeignDeposit.d: Weighted average interest rate calculated at point in time for foreign deposit liability.

WeightedAverageRateForeignDepositBrokere.l: Weighted Average Rate Foreign Deposit, Brokered
WeightedAverageRateForeignDepositBrokere.d: Weighted average interest rate for brokered deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices.

WeightedAverageRateForeignDepositLiabili.l: Weighted Average Rate Foreign Deposit Liabilities [Abstract]

WeightedAverageRateForeignDepositTimeDep.l: Weighted Average Rate Foreign Deposit, Time Deposit
WeightedAverageRateForeignDepositTimeDep.d: Weighted average interest rate for time deposit in foreign banking offices.

WeightedAverageRateOfTimeDepositsAbstrac.l: Weighted Average Rate of Time Deposits [Abstract]

DepositsWholesale.d: The aggregate amount of all wholesale deposit accounts including certificates of deposits.

WithdrawalFromContractHoldersFunds.d: The cash outflow for a segregated fund account during the period.

InventoryWorkInProcessAndRawMaterials.l: Inventory, Work in Process and Raw Materials
InventoryWorkInProcessAndRawMaterials.d: The aggregate carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of items held by the entity which are partially completed at the time of measurement and unprocessed items that will go through the production process and become part of the final product. Includes supplies used directly or indirectly in the manufacturing or production process. This element may be used when the reporting entity combines work in process and raw materials into an aggregate amount.

WorkersCompensationDiscountPercent.d: Percent discount applied to worker's compensation reserve liability to reduce the reserve to present value.

WorkersCompensationDiscountPriorYearAmou.l: Workers' Compensation Discount, Prior Year Amount
WorkersCompensationDiscountPriorYearAmou.d: Prior year monetary amount of the change in worker's compensation reserve liability resulting from the discount applied to reduce the reserve to present value.

WriteOffOfDeferredDebtIssuanceCost.d: Write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance cost in an extinguishment of debt.

YearEndAdjustmentsEffectOfFourthQuarterE.l: Effect of Fourth Quarter Events, Description
YearEndAdjustmentsEffectOfFourthQuarterE.d: Description of a transaction recognized in the fourth quarter. Includes, but is not limited to, the disposal of a component of an entity, an unusual or infrequently occurring item, or both, effect from a change in accounting estimate, and effect of a year-end adjustment.

DueFromBanks.d: A bank's noninterest bearing demand deposits in other banks (such as correspondents).

EntityWideDisclosureOnGeographicAreasDes.l: Segment Reporting, Geographical Area, Revenue, Description
EntityWideDisclosureOnGeographicAreasDes.d: Description of revenue attributed to country of domicile and foreign country from which revenue is derived.

RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsNoncurre.l: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalent, Noncurrent
RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsNoncurre.d: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in int

MajorityOwnedSubsidiaryUnconsolidatedMem.d: Nonconsolidated entity in which financial interest is held through direct or indirect ownership of more than 50 percent of voting interest but entity is not controlled or broker-dealer has control of entity but control is likely to be temporary.

SubsidiaryOfCommonParentMember.d: Refers to an entity under the control of the same parent as another entity (that is, a sister company).

MajorityShareholderMember.d: Owner that controls more than 50 percent of the voting interest in the entity through direct or indirect ownership.

PrincipalOwnerMember.d: Owner of record or known beneficial owner of more than 10 percent of the voting interests of the entity.

ImmediateFamilyMemberOfManagementOrPrinc.l: Immediate Family Member of Management or Principal Owner [Member]
ImmediateFamilyMemberOfManagementOrPrinc.d: Family member whom a principal owner or a member of management might control or influence, or by whom they might be controlled or influenced, because of the family relationship.

TrustForBenefitOfEmployeesMember.d: Trust created by the entity that exists for the benefit of its employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management.

CorporateJointVentureMember.d: Corporation owned and operated by a small group of ventures to accomplish a mutually beneficial venture or project.

CoVenturerMember.d: Other venturer from the perspective of the entity in the corporate joint venture.

EquityMethodInvesteeMember.d: An entity that issued voting stock held by an investor and that is accounted for under the equity method of accounting by the investor.

BeneficialOwnerMember.d: Any person who, directly or indirectly, through any contract, arrangement, understanding, relationship, or otherwise has shares of the entity with 1) voting power which includes the power to vote, or to direct the voting of, such security, and/or 2) investment power which includes the power to dispose, or to direct the disposition of, such security.

GeneralPartnerMember.d: Party to a partnership business who has unlimited liability.

LimitedPartnerMember.d: Party to a partnership business who has limited liability.

UndividedInterestMember.d: Ownership arrangement in which two or more parties jointly own property, and title is held individually to the extent of each party's interest.

InvestorMember.d: Business entity or individual that puts money, by purchase or expenditure, in something offering potential profitable returns, such as interest income or appreciation in value.

InvesteeMember.d: A corporation that issued voting stock held by an investor.

LimitedLiabilityCompanyMember.d: Legal form of business company offering limited liability to its owners (denoted by L.L.C. or LLC in the U.S.).

CommonStockMember.d: Stock that is subordinate to all other stock of the issuer.

LongTermPurchaseCommitmentDescription.d: Describes the terms of a significant arrangement with a supplier (excluding an unconditional purchase obligation) to acquire goods or services over a period of time beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, which may include identification of the goods or services to be purchased, pricing, effects on pricing of failing to reach minimum quantities required to be purchased, cancellation rights, and termination provisions.

AssetsHeldUnderCapitalLeasesMember.d: Long lived property, plant or equipment assets held by a lessee through a capital lease arrangement.

ConstructionInProgressMember.d: Structure or a modification to a structure under construction. Includes recently completed structures or modifications to structures that have not been placed into service.

OtherCapitalizedPropertyPlantAndEquipmen.l: Other Capitalized Property Plant and Equipment [Member]
OtherCapitalizedPropertyPlantAndEquipmen.d: All other long term capitalized assets related to property plant and equipment not otherwise previously categorized.

OtherMachineryAndEquipmentMember.d: Other tangible personal property, nonconsumable in nature, with finite lives used to produce goods and services.

OtherTransportationEquipmentMember.d: Long lived, depreciable assets used for the primary purpose of transportation.

OtherEnergyEquipmentMember.d: Other long lived, depreciable assets used to process natural resources into a marketable finished product.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentDisclosureTextB.d: The entire disclosure for property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentTypeDomain.d: Class of long-lived asset. Includes, but is not limited to, property, plant, and equipment; right-of-use asset from finance lease; long-lived asset of lessor subject to operating lease; proved oil and gas property accounted for under successful efforts method; and long-term prepaid asset.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAdditions.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, before Accumulated Depreciation, Addition
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAdditions.d: Amount of increase in property, plant, and equipment from addition. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

GasDistributionEquipmentMember.d: Long lived, depreciable assets used for the primary purpose of distributing a gas product to the consumer.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOtherTypesMembe.l: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other Types [Member]
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOtherTypesMembe.d: Long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

LandBuildingsAndImprovementsMember.d: Real estate held and additions or improvements to real estate held and structures used in the conduct of business.

GasTransmissionAndDistributionEquipmentM.d: Equipment used for transmitting and distributing a gas product to the consumer.

ElectricGenerationTransmissionAndDistrib.l: Electric Generation, Transmission and Distribution Equipment [Member]
ElectricGenerationTransmissionAndDistrib.d: Equipment used primarily for generating, transmitting and distributing electricity to the consumer.

USGovernmentAgenciesSecuritiesAtCarrying.l: Cash Equivalent, US Government Agency Security, Carrying Value
USGovernmentAgenciesSecuritiesAtCarrying.d: Debt securities issued by a United States government agency such as Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae), Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (Freddie Mac), and Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae), which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with origi

InitialHookupDeferredRevenueMember.d: Category of deferred revenue by arrangement wherein cable television companies' initial hookup revenue is recognized as revenue to the extent of direct selling costs incurred. The remainder is deferred and amortized to income over the estimated average period that subscribers are expected to remain connected to the system.

LandAndLandImprovementsMember.d: Real estate held and assets that are an addition or improvement to real estate held.

LeaseholdsAndLeaseholdImprovementsMember.d: Asset held by lessee under finance lease and addition or improvement to asset held under lease arrangement.

ProductiveLandMember.d: Land containing resources that are subject to depletion. Examples include, but are not limited to, mines, timberland and landfills.

SoftwareDevelopmentMember.d: Internally developed software. Excludes in-development and purchased software.

RemediationPropertyForSaleAbandonmentOrD.l: Remediation Property for Sale, Abandonment or Disposal [Member]
RemediationPropertyForSaleAbandonmentOrD.d: Land and facilities subject to environmental issues for which a plan is in place to sell, abandon, or otherwise dispose of the property.

SoftwareAndSoftwareDevelopmentCostsMembe.l: Software, In-Development, Internally Developed, and Purchased [Member]
SoftwareAndSoftwareDevelopmentCostsMembe.d: In-development, internally developed, and purchased software.

BuildingAndBuildingImprovementsMember.d: Facility held for productive use including, but not limited to, office, production, storage and distribution facilities and any addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, for example, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentDisposals.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, before Accumulated Depreciation, Disposition
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentDisposals.d: Amount of decrease in property, plant, and equipment from disposition. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNetAbstract.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, after Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization [Abstract]

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGrossPeriodIncr.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, before Accumulated Depreciation, Period Increase (Decrease)
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGrossPeriodIncr.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense.d: Amount of expense for research and development. Includes, but is not limited to, cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed and writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or joint venture formation or both. Excludes write-down of intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, used in research and development activity.

CallOptionMember.d: Financial contract between two parties, the buyer and the seller of the option, where the buyer has the right but not the obligation to buy an agreed quantity of a particular commodity or financial instrument (the underlying instrument) from the seller of the option for a certain price (the strike price). Seller is obligated to sell the asset to the buyer, if the buyer exercises the option.

PutOptionMember.d: A financial contract between two parties, the buyer and the seller (writer) of the option, where the buyer has the right but not the obligation to sell a commodity or financial instrument (the underlying instrument) to the seller (writer) at a certain time for a certain price (the strike price). The seller (writer) has the obligation to purchase the underlying asset at that strike price, if the buyer exercises the option.

ExchangeTradedOptionsMember.d: Contracts conveying rights, but not obligations, to buy or sell a specific or standard commodity, or financial or equity instrument, at a specified price during a specified period (an American option) or at a specified date (a European option), which are traded on a stock exchange.

ConvertibleNotesPayableMember.d: Written promise to pay a note which can be exchanged for a specified quantity of securities (typically common stock), at the option of the issuer or the holder.

Cash.d: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

AvailableForSaleSecuritiesInUnrealizedLo.l: Available-for-Sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Nature (Deprecated 2025)
AvailableForSaleSecuritiesInUnrealizedLo.d: Description of nature of available-for-sale security where cost exceeds fair value and its impairment is not other-than-temporary.

AvailableForSaleSecuritiesInUnrealizedLo.l: Available-for-Sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Cause (Deprecated 2025)
AvailableForSaleSecuritiesInUnrealizedLo.d: Description of cause for impairment of available-for-sale security where cost exceeds fair value and its impairment is not other-than-temporary impairment.

AvailableForSaleSecuritiesInUnrealizedLo.l: Available-for-Sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Severity (Deprecated 2025)
AvailableForSaleSecuritiesInUnrealizedLo.d: Disclosure regarding factors used to determine that the impairment of securities not categorized as either held-to-maturity securities or trading securities (hence equal to available for sale securities) where cost exceeds fair value is not other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI). This item contains disclosure of the severity and duration of the temporary impairment of the available-for-sale investments.

AvailableForSaleSecuritiesInUnrealizedLo.l: Available-for-Sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Other (Deprecated 2025)
AvailableForSaleSecuritiesInUnrealizedLo.d: Disclosure regarding factors used to determine that the impairment of securities not categorized as either held-to-maturity securities or trading securities (hence equal to available for sale securities) where amortized cost basis exceeds fair value is not other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI). AccumulatedDepreciationDepletionAndAmort.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization, Period Increase (Decrease)
AccumulatedDepreciationDepletionAndAmort.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of property, plant and equipment.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Cash and Cash Equivalents
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as cash and cash equivalents attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts, Notes and Loans Receivable, Net

ClosedBlockOperationsBenefitsAndExpenseA.l: Closed Block Operations, Benefits and Expense [Abstract]

PremiumsEarnedNetOtherInsurance.d: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of other types of premiums earned.

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesTransferredToTra.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Transfer to Trading, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesTransferredToTra.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings from transfer of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading). Includes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) previously recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

MarketableSecuritiesUnrealizedGainLoss.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

MarketableSecuritiesRealizedGainLoss.d: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

IntangibleAssetsDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for intangible asset. Includes, but is not limited to, finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets, capitalized cost for internal-use software and software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

PreferredStockSharesSubscribedButUnissue.d: Amount of subscription received from investors who have been allocated nonredeemable preferred stock or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

PreferredStockSharesSubscribedButUnissue.l: Preferred Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued, Subscriptions Receivable
PreferredStockSharesSubscribedButUnissue.d: Amount of subscription receivable from investors who have been allocated nonredeemable preferred stock or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

AssetRecoveryDamagedPropertyCostsNoncurr.l: Asset Recovery Damaged Property Costs, Noncurrent
AssetRecoveryDamagedPropertyCostsNoncurr.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the reserved funds established by a utility from customer payments to cover the repair costs of damages from major storms, which repairs are expected to be incurred beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

PrepaidInterest.d: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for interest that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

InvestmentIncomeTextBlock.d: Tabular disclosure of investment income, including, but not limited to, interest and dividend income and amortization of discount (premium) derived from debt and equity securities. Excludes realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investments.

ScheduleOfInvestmentIncomeReportedAmount.d: Disclosure of information about investment income, including, but not limited to, interest and dividend income and amortization of discount (premium) derived from debt and equity securities. Excludes realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investments.

InvestmentIncomeInterest.d: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income on nonoperating securities.

InvestmentIncomeDividend.d: Amount of dividend income on nonoperating securities.

InvestmentIncomeInterestAndDividend.d: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

StatutoryAccountingPracticesRetainedEarn.l: Statutory Accounting Practices, Retained Earnings Not Available for Dividends
StatutoryAccountingPracticesRetainedEarn.d: The amount of retained earnings as of the balance sheet date that cannot be distributed to stockholders pursuant to statutory rules and regulations.

InvestmentIncomeAmortizationOfDiscount.d: Amount of accretion of purchase discount on nonoperating securities.

InvestmentIncomeAmortizationOfPremium.d: Amount of amortization of purchase premium on nonoperating securities.

SecuritiesHeldAsCollateralAtFairValue.l: Securities Held as Collateral, at Fair Value
SecuritiesHeldAsCollateralAtFairValue.d: The carrying amount (fair value) as of the balance sheet date of securities held that had been pledged by counterparties under financing and lending arrangements, pursuant to which the entity has the right by agreement or custom to sell or re-pledge such securities.

SharesHeldInEmployeeStockOptionPlanCommi.l: Shares Held in Employee Stock Option Plan, Committed-to-be-Released
SharesHeldInEmployeeStockOptionPlanCommi.d: Number of committed-to-be-released shares held by the Employee Stock Option Plan at balance sheet date. Committed-to-be-released shares are shares that will be released in the future and will be allocated to employees for services rendered in an accounting period. These shares are legally released from suspense and from serving as collateral for ESOP debt as a result of payment of debt service.

SharesHeldInEmployeeStockOptionPlanSuspe.l: Shares Held in Employee Stock Option Plan, Suspense Shares
SharesHeldInEmployeeStockOptionPlanSuspe.d: Number of suspense shares held by the Employee Stock Option Plan at balance sheet date. Suspense shares are shares that have not been released, committed to be released or allocated to individual participant accounts.

CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNotAccount.l: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Consumer, at Acquisition, at Fair Value
CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNotAccount.d: Fair value at acquisition of acquired consumer loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNotAccount.l: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Commercial, at Acquisition, at Fair Value
CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNotAccount.d: Fair value at acquisition of acquired commercial loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNotAccount.l: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Consumer, Cash Flows Expected to be Collected at Acquisition
CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNotAccount.d: Amount of cash flows expected to be collected at acquisition of acquired consumer loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNotAccount.l: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Commercial, Cash Flows Expected to be Collected at Acquisition
CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNotAccount.d: Amount of cash flows expected to be collected at acquisition of acquired commercial loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

AdditionsToOtherAssetsAmount.d: Amount of significant additions in the period in other assets (current, noncurrent, or unclassified).

ReductionsInOtherAssetsAmount.d: Amount of significant reductions in the period of other assets (current, noncurrent, or unclassified).

EquityMethodInvestmentSummarizedFinancia.l: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information [Abstract]

DeferredFinanceCostsNoncurrentGross.d: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

AccumulatedAmortizationOfNoncurrentDefer.l: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs, Noncurrent
AccumulatedAmortizationOfNoncurrentDefer.d: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs classified as noncurrent.

DeferredFinanceCostsNoncurrentNet.d: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

DeferredFinanceCostsCurrentGross.d: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

AccumulatedAmortizationOfCurrentDeferred.l: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs, Current
AccumulatedAmortizationOfCurrentDeferred.d: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs classified as current.

DeferredFinanceCostsCurrentNet.d: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentIncomeStatement.l: Property Plant and Equipment Income Statement Disclosures [Abstract]

EquityMethodInvestmentDifferenceBetweenC.l: Equity Method Investment, Difference Between Carrying Amount and Underlying Equity [Abstract]

AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockEquitySecur.l: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Equity Securities, Available-for-Sale, at Fair Value (Deprecated 2025)
AssetsDesignatedToClosedBlockEquitySecur.d: Fair value of equity securities designated as available for sale, which are allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block. Also a component of change in other comprehensive income in the period, which is reflected in the closed block disclosure.

StateInsuranceDepartmentStatutoryToNAICD.l: State Insurance Department, Statutory to NAIC, Description of Reconciling Item (Deprecated 2025)
StateInsuranceDepartmentStatutoryToNAICD.d: Description of item which resulted in a difference from applying state prescribed or permitted statutory accounting practices rather than statutory accounting practices prescribed by National Association of Insurance Commissioners.

ExcessOfReportedClosedBlockLiabilitiesOv.l: Excess of Reported Closed Block Liabilities over Assets Designated to Closed Block
ExcessOfReportedClosedBlockLiabilitiesOv.d: The difference between the liabilities of and the assets allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

EquityMethodInvestmentFinancialStatement.l: Equity Method Investment, Financial Statement, Reported Amounts [Abstract]

AccountsNotesAndLoansReceivableClassifie.l: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current and Noncurrent [Abstract]

AccountsAndNotesReceivableUnclassifiedAb.l: Accounts, Notes, Loans and Financing Receivable, Unclassified [Abstract]

NotesReceivableNetAbstract.l: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss [Abstract]

AccountsNotesAndLoansReceivableLineItems.l: Accounts, Notes, Loans and Financing Receivable [Line Items]
AccountsNotesAndLoansReceivableLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ReceivableWithImputedInterestNetAmountAb.l: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Net Amount [Abstract]

LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmo.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount [Abstract]

OtherLiabilitiesCurrent.d: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

OtherLiabilitiesNoncurrent.d: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DiscontinuedApplicationOfSpecializedAcco.l: Discontinued Application of Specialized Accounting for Regulated Operations
DiscontinuedApplicationOfSpecializedAcco.d: Net effect of discontinued application of the specialized accounting to all or part of its operations; the entity eliminates from its statement of financial position prepared for general-purpose external financial reporting the effects of any actions of regulators that had been recognized as assets and liabilities pursuant to that specialized accounting but would not have been recognized as assets and liabilities by entities in general except for carrying amounts of plant, equipment, and invento

DeferredCompensationArrangementsOverallD.d: General description of deferred compensation arrangements. Deferred compensation represents currently earned compensation that, under the terms of a profit-sharing, rabbi trust, pension, employee contract, or equity-based (including stock or unit option) plan, is not actually paid until a later date and is therefore not taxable until that date. May also include some split-dollar life insurance arrangements. This type of arrangement is usually made to help employees postpone paying taxes on the i

OtherGeneralExpense.d: Amount of general expenses not normally included in Other Operating Costs and Expenses.

ConcentrationRiskBenchmarkDescription.d: Identifies or describes the benchmark that serves as the denominator in the calculation of the percentage of concentration risk.

ConcentrationRiskByBenchmarkAxis.d: Information by benchmark of concentration risk.

ConcentrationRiskBenchmarkDomain.d: The denominator in a calculation of a disclosed concentration risk percentage.

SalesRevenueProductLineMember.d: Revenue from specified product or service, when it serves as benchmark in concentration of risk calculation. Includes, but is not limited to, revenue from contract with customer and other sources.

SalesRevenueSegmentMember.d: Revenue from specified business segment, when it serves as benchmark in concentration of risk calculation. Includes, but is not limited to, revenue from contract with customer and other sources.

NumberOfEmployeesTotalMember.d: The consolidated full-time equivalent number of the entity's employees as of the balance sheet date, when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

NumberOfEmployeesGeographicAreaMember.d: The full-time equivalent number of the entity's employees in a specified geographic area as of the balance sheet date, when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

NetAssetsGeographicAreaMember.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the total assets less the total liabilities of a designated geographic area ( such as a state, country, continent, or market) when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

NetAssetsSegmentMember.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the total assets less the total liabilities of a business segment when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

WorkforceSubjectToCollectiveBargainingAr.l: Workforce Subject to Collective-Bargaining Arrangements Expiring within One Year [Member]
WorkforceSubjectToCollectiveBargainingAr.d: The number of employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement that will expire within one year after the balance sheet date, when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

NonredeemableConvertiblePreferredStockMe.d: Capital stock of an entity that has priority over common stock in the distribution of dividends and in the event of liquidation of the entity and may be exchanged into common shares or other types of securities at the owner's option as long as it is in accordance with the issuer's terms. This security does not have redemption requirements.

PreferredStockRedemptionTerms.d: The redemption terms of preferred stock of an entity that has priority over common stock in the distribution of dividends and in the event of liquidation of the entity. The redemption features of this capital stock are solely within the control of the issuer.

PreferredStockRedemptionPricePerShare.l: Preferred Stock, Redemption Price Per Share
PreferredStockRedemptionPricePerShare.d: The price per share at which the preferred stock of an entity that has priority over common stock in the distribution of dividends and in the event of liquidation of the entity is redeemed or may be called at. The redemption features of this preferred stock are solely within the control of the issuer.

PreferredStockRedemptionDate.d: Date the preferred stock has been redeemed, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

AccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilitiesNonc.l: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Noncurrent [Abstract]

JointlyOwnedNaturalGasProcessingPlantMem.l: Jointly Owned Natural Gas Processing Plant [Member]
JointlyOwnedNaturalGasProcessingPlantMem.d: Jointly owned plant in connection with natural gas processing operations.

JointlyOwnedWaterPlantMember.d: Jointly owned plant in connection with operations of water plant.

LiabilitiesOfBusinessTransferredUnderCon.l: Liabilities of Business Transferred under Contractual Arrangement, Noncurrent
LiabilitiesOfBusinessTransferredUnderCon.d: The noncurrent portion, due in greater than one year or one operating cycle, if longer, of liabilities resulting from the transfer of a business segment under contractual arrangement where the transferor maintains certain risks, obligations, or liabilities.

LiabilitiesOfBusinessTransferredUnderCon.l: Liabilities of Business Transferred under Contractual Arrangement, Current
LiabilitiesOfBusinessTransferredUnderCon.d: The current carrying amount, due within one year or one operating cycle, if longer, of liabilities resulting from the transfer of a business segment under contractual arrangement where the transferor maintains certain risks, obligations or liabilities.

LifeSettlementContractsPolicy.l: Life Settlement Contracts, Policy [Policy Text Block]
LifeSettlementContractsPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for life settlement contracts including the classification of cash receipts and cash disbursements in the statement of cash flows.

LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodAb.l: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method [Abstract]

LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodGa.l: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Gain (Loss) [Abstract]

ScheduleOfLifeSettlementContractsInvestm.l: Schedule of Life Settlement Contracts, Investment Method [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfLifeSettlementContractsInvestm.d: Tabular disclosure of life settlement contracts based on the remaining life expectancy for each of the first five succeeding years from the date of the statement of financial position and thereafter, as well as in the aggregate including: (a) the number of life settlement contracts, (b) the carrying value of the life settlement contracts, and (c) the face value (death benefits) of the life insurance policies underlying the contracts, and (d) the life insurance premiums anticipated to be paid for

ConcentrationRisksTypesNoConcentrationPe.l: Concentration Risks, Types, No Concentration Percentage [Abstract]

ConcentrationRiskSourceOfSupplyOfLabor.l: Concentration Risk, Source of Supply of Labor
ConcentrationRiskSourceOfSupplyOfLabor.d: Description of risks that arise due to issues about actual or potential shortage of people needed to perform essential functions. The description may address risks inherent in the industry, geopolitical issues, and shortages with respect to specialized needs, and would be generally expected to be adequate to inform users as to the general nature of the risk.

ConcentrationRiskCreditRiskFinancialInst.l: Concentration Risk, Credit Risk, Financial Instrument, Maximum Exposure
ConcentrationRiskCreditRiskFinancialInst.d: Maximum amount of loss due to credit risk that, based on the gross fair value of the financial instrument, the entity would incur if parties to the financial instruments that make up the concentration failed completely to perform according to the terms of the contracts and the collateral or other security, if any, for the amount due proved to be of no value to the entity.

ConcentrationRiskMaterial.d: Description of risks that arise due to the entity's reliance on a particular material used in its operations and the availability of that material. The description would generally be expected to be adequate to inform financial statement users as to the general nature of the risk.

RevenueRightsGrantedMember.d: Revenue during the period derived from licenses, patents, trademarks and other rights granted to other parties, when it serves as a benchmark in a concentration of risk calculation.

RevenueFromRightsConcentrationRiskMember.d: Reflects the percentage that license fee or royalty revenues during the period from other parties from use of a specified patent, trademark, or other form of right granted to such parties are to a specified benchmark, such as total license fees, total revenues, segment revenues or product line revenues. May also reflect the percentage contribution the revenue made to operating results. Risk is materially adverse effects of a loss of such revenues, which could occur upon loss of rights to sell, d

ConcentrationRiskAdditionalCharacteristi.d: For an entity that discloses a concentration risk as a percentage of some financial balance or benchmark, this item identifies a second characteristic of the concentration. For example, "Europe" is the second characteristic in the phrase: "net assets in Europe are 70 percent of total net assets".

CostOfGoodsTotalMember.l: Cost of Goods and Service Benchmark [Member]
CostOfGoodsTotalMember.d: Cost of product sold and service rendered, when it serves as benchmark in concentration of risk calculation.

CostOfGoodsSegmentMember.l: Cost of Goods and Service, Segment Benchmark [Member]
CostOfGoodsSegmentMember.d: Cost of product sold and service rendered from specified business segment, when it serves as benchmark in concentration of risk calculation.

CostOfGoodsProductLineMember.l: Cost of Goods and Service, Product and Service Benchmark [Member]
CostOfGoodsProductLineMember.d: Cost of product sold and service rendered from specified product or service, when it serves as benchmark in concentration of risk calculation.

ConcentrationRiskNetAssetsAmountGeograph.l: Concentration Risk, Net Assets Amount, Geographic Area
ConcentrationRiskNetAssetsAmountGeograph.d: Carrying amount of total assets less total liabilities of a designated geographic area if disclosed as a concentration risk.

TreasuryStockRestrictions.d: This element represents a description of restrictions imposed by state laws on the entity's acquisition of its own [treasury] stock and the accounting treatment required to be applied in compliance with such restrictions. The information represented by this element does not include restrictions on the payment of dividends.

ScheduleOfBusinessAcquisitionsByAcquisit.l: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Equity Interest [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfBusinessAcquisitionsByAcquisit.d: Tabular disclosure of equity interest issued or issuable by acquirer as part of consideration transferred in business combination.

ScheduleOfBusinessAcquisitionsByAcquisit.l: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfBusinessAcquisitionsByAcquisit.d: Tabular disclosure of contingent payment arrangements including the terms that will result in payment and the accounting treatment that will be followed if such contingencies occur, including the potential impact on earnings per share if contingencies are to be settled in common stock of the entity. The description also may include the period over which amounts are expected to be paid, and changes in the amount since the previous reporting period. This also includes contingent options and commit

CommitmentsFromFranchiseAgreements.d: Describes all significant commitments and obligations resulting from franchise agreements, including a description of the services that the franchisor has agreed to provide for agreements that have not yet been substantially performed.

InitialFranchiseFees.d: The amount of initial franchise fees.

CostsOfFranchisorOwnedOutlets.d: Costs incurred that are directly related to generating franchise revenues from franchisor owned outlets.

CostsOfFranchisedOutlets.d: Costs incurred that are directly related to generating franchise revenues from franchised outlets.

LifeSettlementContractsInvestmentMethodF.l: Life Settlement Contracts, Investment Method, Premiums to be Paid
LifeSettlementContractsInvestmentMethodF.d: Amount of life insurance premiums anticipated to be paid to keep the life settlement contracts accounted for under the investment method in force.

LifeInsuranceCorporateOrBankOwnedRestric.l: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Restrictions
LifeInsuranceCorporateOrBankOwnedRestric.d: Description of contractual restrictions on the ability to surrender and thereby receive the cash-value of a corporate or bank owned life insurance policy.

LifeInsuranceCorporateOrBankOwnedAdditio.l: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Additional Information
LifeInsuranceCorporateOrBankOwnedAdditio.d: This element represents additional information the Company may choose to disclose concerning corporate or bank owned life insurance contracts.

LifeInsuranceCorporateOrBankOwnedTextBlo.l: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned [Text Block]
LifeInsuranceCorporateOrBankOwnedTextBlo.d: The entire disclosure for corporate (COLI) or bank (BOLI) owned life insurance including the amount of cash surrender value that could be received as of the date of the statement of financial position, any restrictions on the company's ability to obtain the value of the life insurance policy on surrender, or any other additional information desired to be disclosed.

ReceivablesHeldForSaleNetAmountAbstract.l: Accounts and Financing Receivables, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance [Abstract]

Dividends.d: Amount of paid and unpaid cash, stock, and paid-in-kind (PIK) dividends declared, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred stock.

CommonStockIssuedEmployeeTrustDeferred.l: Common Stock Issued, Employee Trust, Deferred
CommonStockIssuedEmployeeTrustDeferred.d: Aggregate value of common stock held in a trust that has been set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees but not yet earned.

CommonStockSharesHeldInEmployeeTrust.l: Common Stock, Shares Held in Employee Trust
CommonStockSharesHeldInEmployeeTrust.d: Value of common stock issued to a trust (for example, but not limited to, rabbi trust) set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees.

CommonStockSharesHeldInEmployeeTrustShar.l: Common Stock, Shares Held in Employee Trust, Shares
CommonStockSharesHeldInEmployeeTrustShar.d: Number of common stock held in a trust that has been set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees but not yet earned.

CostsIncurredAcquisitionOfOilAndGasPrope.l: Oil and Gas, Cost Incurred, Property Acquisition Cost [Abstract]

ResultsOfOperationsOilAndGasProducingAct.l: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, after Income Tax Expense (Benefit) [Abstract]

ResultsOfOperationsIncomeBeforeIncomeTax.l: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, before Income Tax Expense (Benefit) [Abstract]

CapitalizedCostsOilAndGasProducingActivi.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Cost, before Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization, and Valuation Allowance [Abstract]
Oil and Gas, Capitalized Cost, after Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization, and Valuation Allowance [Abstract]

LitigationReserveNoncurrent.d: Carrying amount of estimated litigation liability for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs, which is expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

IncomeTaxExaminationDescription.d: A brief description of status of the tax examination, significant findings to date, and the entity's position with respect to the findings.

IncomeTaxHolidayDescription.d: A description of the factual circumstances giving rise to an income tax exemption or special reduction received from a taxing jurisdiction.

IncomeTaxHolidayAggregateDollarAmount.l: Income Tax Holiday, Aggregate Dollar Amount
IncomeTaxHolidayAggregateDollarAmount.d: The amount of income taxes from which a reporting entity is exempt or for which it will receive a reduction in income taxes as a result of the income tax holiday granted by the taxing jurisdiction.

UnapprovedChangeOrdersAmount.l: Construction Contractor, Contract Cost, Subject to Uncertainty, Amount
UnapprovedChangeOrdersAmount.d: Amount of cost incurred on construction contract for unapproved change order, claim, or similar item subject to uncertainty.

PrecontractCostsPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for recording or deferring costs in anticipation of future contract sales in a variety of circumstances. The costs may consist of (a) costs incurred in anticipation of a specific contract that will result in no future benefit unless the contract is obtained (such as the costs of mobilization, engineering, architectural, or other services incurred on the basis of commitments or other indications of interest in negotiating a contract), (b) costs incurred for assets

CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared.l: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared.d: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

TransfersAndServicingOfFinancialInstrume.d: Instrument or contract that imposes a contractual obligation to deliver cash or another financial instrument or to exchange other financial instruments on potentially unfavorable terms and conveys a contractual right to receive cash or another financial instrument or to exchange other financial instruments on potentially favorable terms.

SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.l: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of Adverse Change in Other Assumption, Description (Deprecated 2026)
SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.d: Description of assumptions, classified as other, used in determining fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets.

SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.l: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of 10 Percent Adverse Change in Other Assumption
SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.d: The hypothetical financial impact of a 10 percent adverse change of the specified assumption on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.l: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of 20 Percent Adverse Change in Other Assumption
SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.d: The hypothetical financial impact of a 20 percent adverse change of the specified assumption on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.l: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of Other than 10 or 20 Percent Adverse Change in Prepayment Speed, Percent
SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.d: A specified percentage variance in the prepayment speed assumption in the determination of fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities).

SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.l: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of Other than 10 or 20 Percent Adverse Change in Prepayment Speed
SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.d: The hypothetical financial impact of a specified adverse percentage change in prepayment speed on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.l: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of Other than 10 or 20 Percent Adverse Change in Discount Rate, Percent
SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.d: A specified percentage variance in the discount rate assumption in the determination of fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.l: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of Other than 10 or 20 Percent Adverse Change in Discount Rate
SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.d: The hypothetical financial impact of a specified adverse percentage change in discount rate on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.l: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact Other than 10 or 20 Percent Adverse Change in Expected Credit Loss, Percent
SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.d: A specified percentage variance in the expected credit losses assumption, including static pool losses, in the determination of fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities).

SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.l: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact Other than 10 or 20 Percent Adverse Change in Expected Credit Loss
SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.d: The hypothetical financial impact of a specified adverse percentage change in expected credit losses, including static pool losses, on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.l: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of Other than 10 or 20 Percent Adverse Change in Other Assumption, Percent
SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.d: A specified percentage variance in a specified key assumption in the determination of fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities).

SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.l: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of Other than 10 or 20 Percent Adverse Change in Other Assumption
SensitivityAnalysisOfFairValueOfInterest.d: The hypothetical financial impact of a specified adverse percentage change in a specified other assumption on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities).

TargetedOrTrackingStockStockLineItems.l: Targeted or Tracking Stock, Stock [Line Items]
TargetedOrTrackingStockStockLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

TargetedOrTrackingStockStockTable.d: Disclosure of information about quantitative and qualitative information related to target or tracking stock issued, including, but not limited to, pricing of transactions and cost allocation method used.

ConvertibleCommonStockMember.d: Common stock securities that may be converted to another form of security.

CommonStockConversionFeatures.d: Description of common stock conversion feature. Includes, but is not limited to, conversion price; conversion right; timing of right; terms, event or change in circumstance causing contingency to be met or adjustment to conversion price or number of shares; manner of settlement upon conversion; and method of settlement.

ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementOperating.l: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Operating Activities

IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsExcluding.l: Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill), Fair Value Disclosure
IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsExcluding.d: Fair value portion of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, that lack physical substance, having a projected indefinite period of benefit.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsFairValueDisc.d: Fair value portion of assets, excluding financial assets, that lack physical substance, having a limited useful life.

FairValueOptionOtherEligibleItemsMember.d: This element embodies certain items identified as eligible for the fair value option that are not within the definition of financial assets and liabilities. FirmCommitmentNotRecognizedAtInceptionFa.l: Firm Commitment Not Recognized at Inception, Fair Value Option [Member]
FirmCommitmentNotRecognizedAtInceptionFa.d: This element represents a firm commitment that would otherwise not be recognized at inception and that involves only financial instruments. For example, a forward purchase contract for a loan that is not readily convertible to cash is a commitment involving only financial instruments-a loan and cash-and would not otherwise be recognized because it is not a derivative instrument.

WrittenLoanCommitmentFairValueOptionMemb.l: Written Loan Commitment, Fair Value Option [Member]
WrittenLoanCommitmentFairValueOptionMemb.d: This element represents a written loan commitment that would otherwise not be recognized in the issuers or borrowers financial statements as the loan has not yet been funded, but which meets the definition of a financial asset or liability for eligibility of applying the fair value option.

WarrantyRightsAndObligationsFairValueOpt.l: Warranty, Rights and Obligations, Fair Value Option [Member]
WarrantyRightsAndObligationsFairValueOpt.d: This element represents the rights and obligations under a warranty that is not a financial instrument (because it requires or permits the warrantor to provide goods or services rather than a cash settlement) but whose terms permit the warrantor to settle by paying a third party to provide those goods or services.

Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

FutureMinimumSubleaseRentalsSaleLeasebac.l: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Two Years (Deprecated 2026)
FutureMinimumSubleaseRentalsSaleLeasebac.d: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

FutureMinimumSubleaseRentalsSaleLeasebac.l: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Three Years (Deprecated 2026)
FutureMinimumSubleaseRentalsSaleLeasebac.d: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

FutureMinimumSubleaseRentalsSaleLeasebac.l: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Four Years (Deprecated 2026)
FutureMinimumSubleaseRentalsSaleLeasebac.d: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

FutureMinimumSubleaseRentalsSaleLeasebac.l: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Five Years (Deprecated 2026)
FutureMinimumSubleaseRentalsSaleLeasebac.d: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

FutureMinimumSubleaseRentalsSaleLeasebac.l: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Thereafter (Deprecated 2026)
FutureMinimumSubleaseRentalsSaleLeasebac.d: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

FutureMinimumSubleaseRentalsSaleLeasebac.l: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions (Deprecated 2026)
FutureMinimumSubleaseRentalsSaleLeasebac.d: Amount of minimum sublease rentals to be received by the seller-lessee for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

LeveragedLeasesNetInvestmentInLeveragedL.l: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Rental Receivables, Net
LeveragedLeasesNetInvestmentInLeveragedL.d: This element represents leveraged lease rentals receivable, net of that portion of the rental applicable to principal and interest on the nonrecourse debt.

LeveragedLeasesNetInvestmentInLeveragedL.l: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Rental Receivables, Net [Abstract]

IncreaseDecreaseInBrokerageReceivables.l: Increase (Decrease) in Receivable from Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
IncreaseDecreaseInBrokerageReceivables.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due to the entity related to activities and operations with other broker dealers, and clearing organizations, including deposits.

IncreaseDecreaseInPayablesToBrokerDealer.l: Increase (Decrease) in Payable to Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
IncreaseDecreaseInPayablesToBrokerDealer.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations incurred arising from transactions with broker-dealers, such as amounts due on margin and unsettled cash transactions; includes payables to brokers, dealers and clearing organizations.

TransfersAndServicingOfFinancialAssetsTe.l: Transfers and Servicing of Financial Assets [Text Block]
TransfersAndServicingOfFinancialAssetsTe.d: The entire disclosure for a transferor's continuing involvement in financial assets that it has transferred in a securitization or asset-backed financing arrangement, the nature of any restrictions on assets reported by an entity in its statement of financial position that relate to a transferred financial asset (including the carrying amounts of such assets), how servicing assets and servicing liabilities are reported, and (for securitization or asset-backed financing arrangements accounted for

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLeaseRece.l: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Lease Receivables
ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLeaseRece.d: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLeaseRece.l: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Lease Receivables [Abstract]

ProceedsFromCollectionOfLeaseReceivables.l: Proceeds from Collection of Lease Receivables
ProceedsFromCollectionOfLeaseReceivables.d: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

RefundReceivedRelatedToRevenueFromDiffer.l: Refund Received Related to Revenue from Different Year, Year Revenue Recognized
RefundReceivedRelatedToRevenueFromDiffer.d: Discloses year revenue was initially recognized related to refunds that are recognized in a period other than the period in which the related revenue was recognized and that have a material effect on net income.

RegulatedEntityOtherAssetsNoncurrent.d: Total of noncurrent other assets held by public utility entities.

GainLossOnSaleOfOtherLoansAndLeases.l: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Loans and Leases
GainLossOnSaleOfOtherLoansAndLeases.d: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of other loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period; excludes gains (losses) on sales of consumer and mortgage loans. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

PreferredStockCallOrExerciseFeatures.l: Preferred Stock, Call or Exercise Features
PreferredStockCallOrExerciseFeatures.d: Describe call and/or exercise rights, prices and dates of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer).

CommonStockCallOrExerciseFeatures.l: Common Stock, Call or Exercise Features
CommonStockCallOrExerciseFeatures.d: Describe the call and/or exercise rights, prices and dates of common stock.

ScheduleOfTreasuryStockByClassTextBlock.l: Class of Treasury Stock [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfTreasuryStockByClassTextBlock.d: Tabular disclosure of treasury stock, including, but not limited to, average cost per share, description of share repurchase program, shares repurchased, shares held for each class of treasury stock.

TreasuryStockCarryingBasis.d: Cost basis for treasury stock acquired for purposes other than retirement.

GeneralInsuranceExpense.d: The expense in the period incurred with respect to protection provided by insurance entities against risks other than risks associated with production (which are allocated to cost of sales).

EmbeddedDerivativeNoLongerBifurcatedReas.l: Embedded Derivative, No Longer Bifurcated, Reason
EmbeddedDerivativeNoLongerBifurcatedReas.d: A description of the principal changes causing the embedded option to no longer require separation from the host instrument.

EmbeddedDerivativeNoLongerBifurcatedAmou.l: Embedded Derivative, No Longer Bifurcated, Amount Reclassified to Stockholders' Equity
