EmbeddedDerivativeNoLongerBifurcatedAmou.d: The amount of the liability for the conversion option reclassified to stockholders' equity when the embedded option no longer required separation from the host instrument.

RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciationRealEst.l: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Accumulated Depreciation, Investment in Real Estate Sold
RealEstateAccumulatedDepreciationRealEst.d: Amount of decrease to accumulated depreciation for real estate investments sold for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestmentsNet.l: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments, Net of Dividends or Distributions [Abstract]

CommonStockSharesSubscribedButUnissued.l: Common Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued
CommonStockSharesSubscribedButUnissued.d: Number of unissued common shares allocated to investor for purchase on subscription basis.

MortgageLoansOnRealEstateOtherDeductions.l: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Other Deduction
MortgageLoansOnRealEstateOtherDeductions.d: Amount of reduction in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, classified as other.

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfNotesRece.l: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Notes Receivable
ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfNotesRece.d: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale of notes receivable, as well as principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation (note receivable).

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfNotesRece.l: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Notes Receivable [Abstract]

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfOtherRece.l: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Other Receivables
ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfOtherRece.d: Amount of cash inflow from the sale and collection of receivables classified as other.

ProceedsFromCollectionOfOtherReceivables.l: Proceeds from Collection of Other Receivables
ProceedsFromCollectionOfOtherReceivables.d: Amount of cash inflow from the collection of receivables classified as other.

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfOtherRece.l: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Other Receivables [Abstract]

ClassOfTreasuryStockTable.d: Disclosure of information about treasury stock, including, but not limited to, average cost per share, description of share repurchase program, shares repurchased, shares held for each class of treasury stock.

EquityClassOfTreasuryStockLineItems.l: Equity, Class of Treasury Stock [Line Items]
EquityClassOfTreasuryStockLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLoansRece.l: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Loans Receivable
ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLoansRece.d: The cash inflow associated with the sale and collection of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansReceivable.l: Proceeds from Collection of Loans Receivable
ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansReceivable.d: The cash inflow associated with the collection, including prepayments, of loans receivable issued for financing of goods and services.

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLoansRece.l: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Loans Receivable [Abstract]

ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.l: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Securities, Operating Activities
ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.d: Cash received from maturities, prepayments and calls of trading securities and other securities, classified as operating.

AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalStoc.l: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Split
AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalStoc.d: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a stock split in which per-share par value or stated value is not changed proportionately.

PremiumsAndOtherReceivablesNet.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date, net of allowance for doubtful accounts, of all premiums and other types of receivables due from other persons or entities.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndValueOf.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Net [Abstract]
Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Net
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndValueOf.d: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination.

ReceivablesFromBrokersDealersAndClearing.l: Receivable from Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
ReceivablesFromBrokersDealersAndClearing.d: Amount receivable from broker-dealers and clearing organizations, including, but not limited to, securities failed-to-deliver, certain deposits for securities borrowed, open transactions, good faith and margin deposits, commissions and floor brokerage receivables.

ImmaterialErrorCorrection.d: Describes nature and related effect on financial statements related to corrections of prior year errors in the current year financial statements when the effect of the prior year error was immaterial to the prior year financial statements and the current year correction is immaterial to the current year financial statements.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Range of Dividends Used
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: If different dividend rates are used during the contractual term, then disclose the range of expected dividends used.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Weighted Average Expected Dividend
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Disclosure of the weighted average expected dividend for an entity using a valuation technique with different dividend rates during the contractual term.

InvestmentRelatedLiabilities.d: The aggregate amount of liabilities as of the balance sheet date for obligations incurred in connection with the entity's investments.

DepreciationNonproduction.d: The expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of nonproduction tangible assets over their useful lives.

ConvertibleDebtNoncurrent.d: Carrying amount of long-term convertible debt as of the balance sheet date, net of the amount due in the next twelve months or greater than the normal operating cycle, if longer. The debt is convertible into another form of financial instrument, typically the entity's common stock.

ConvertibleDebt.d: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying amount of debt identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument (typically the entity's common stock) as of the balance sheet date, which originally required full repayment more than twelve months after issuance or greater than the normal operating cycle of the company.

IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredIncomeTaxes.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the account that represents the temporary difference that results from Income or Loss that is recognized for accounting purposes but not for tax purposes and vice versa.

IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredRevenue.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

DeferredRevenue.d: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

OtherCostAndExpenseOperating.d: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

OtherLongTermDebtNoncurrent.d: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

OtherLongTermDebt.d: Amount of long-term debt classified as other.

OtherAssetsNoncurrent.d: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfOtherInvest.l: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Other Investments [Abstract]

InvestmentIncomeNetAmortizationOfDiscoun.l: Investment Income, Net, Amortization of Discount and Premium [Abstract]

GoodwillRollForward.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

GoodwillPeriodIncreaseDecrease.d: Amount of increase (decrease) of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherDeposits.d: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from deposits classified as other.

OperatingExpenses.d: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

EarningsPerShareBasicLineItems.l: Earnings Per Share, Basic, by Common Class, Including Two Class Method [Line Items]
EarningsPerShareBasicLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

EarningsPerShareBasicOtherDisclosuresAbs.l: Earnings Per Share, Basic, Other Disclosure [Abstract]

AntidilutiveSecuritiesExcludedFromComput.l: Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Earnings Per Share, Amount
AntidilutiveSecuritiesExcludedFromComput.d: Securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic earnings per share (EPS) or earnings per unit (EPU) in the future that were not included in the computation of diluted EPS or EPU because to do so would increase EPS or EPU amounts or decrease loss per share or unit amounts for the period presented.
Information by type of antidilutive security.

AntidilutiveSecuritiesExcludedFromComput.l: Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Earnings Per Share [Line Items]
AntidilutiveSecuritiesExcludedFromComput.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

BasicEarningsPerShareAdjustmentProForma.l: Basic Earnings Per Share Adjustment, Pro Forma
BasicEarningsPerShareAdjustmentProForma.d: Pro Forma Basic Earnings Per Share Adjustment to reconcile between Net Income and Pro Forma.

BasicEarningsPerShareProForma.l: Basic Earnings Per Share, Pro Forma
BasicEarningsPerShareProForma.d: Pro forma basic earnings per share or earnings per unit, which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

BusinessAcquisitionProFormaEarningsPerSh.l: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Pro Forma Earnings Per Share, Basic
BusinessAcquisitionProFormaEarningsPerSh.d: Per basic share amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

BusinessAcquisitionProFormaEarningsPerSh.l: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Pro Forma Earnings Per Share, Diluted
BusinessAcquisitionProFormaEarningsPerSh.d: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

DilutedEarningsPerShareProForma.l: Diluted Earnings Per Share Pro Forma
DilutedEarningsPerShareProForma.d: Pro forma diluted earnings per share, which is commonly presented in initial public offerings.

UnusualOrInfrequentItemEarningsPerShareI.l: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Earnings Per Share Impact, Net
UnusualOrInfrequentItemEarningsPerShareI.d: Per share amount of earnings, after tax, of an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

UnusualOrInfrequentItemEarningsPerShareI.l: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Earnings Per Share Impact, Gross
UnusualOrInfrequentItemEarningsPerShareI.d: Per share amount of earnings, before tax, of an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

StockholdersEquityNoteImpactOfConversion.l: Stockholders' Equity Note, Impact of Conversion of Contingently Convertible Securities on Diluted Earnings Per Share
StockholdersEquityNoteImpactOfConversion.d: Description of reason for including or excluding share issuable in conversion of contingently convertible security in calculation of diluted earnings per share.

ScheduleOfEarningsPerShareDilutedByCommo.l: Schedule of Earnings Per Share, Diluted, by Common Class, Including Two Class Method [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfEarningsPerShareDilutedByCommo.d: Tabular disclosure of the effect of income (loss) on an entity's diluted earnings per share.

ScheduleOfEarningsPerShareDilutedByCommo.l: Earnings Per Share, Diluted, by Common Class, Including Two-Class Method [Table]
ScheduleOfEarningsPerShareDilutedByCommo.d: Disclosure of information about diluted earnings per share by class of stock. Includes, but is not limited to, two-class method.

ScheduleOfEarningsPerShareBasicByCommonC.l: Schedule of Earnings Per Share, Basic, by Common Class, Including Two Class Method [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfEarningsPerShareBasicByCommonC.d: Tabular disclosure of the effect of income (loss) on basic earnings per share.

ScheduleOfEarningsPerShareBasicByCommonC.l: Earnings Per Share, Basic, by Common Class, Including Two-Class Method [Table]
ScheduleOfEarningsPerShareBasicByCommonC.d: Disclosure of information about basic earnings per share by class of stock. Includes, but is not limited to, two-class method.

ScheduleOfAntidilutiveSecuritiesExcluded.l: Schedule of Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Earnings Per Share [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfAntidilutiveSecuritiesExcluded.d: Tabular disclosure of securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic earnings per share (EPS) in the future that were not included in the computation of diluted EPS because to do so would increase EPS amounts or decrease loss per share amounts for the period presented, by antidilutive securities.
Disclosure of information about security that could potentially dilute basic earnings per share (EPS) in future that was not included in calculation of diluted EPS.

EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPEffectOnEa.l: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Effect on Earnings Per Share (Deprecated 2025)
EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPEffectOnEa.d: Describes the treatment of ESOP shares in earnings per share computations.

EarningsPerShareSubsequentEvents.d: For the latest period for which an income statement is presented, this element represents a description of any transaction that occurs after the end of the most recent period but before issuance of the financial statements that would have changed materially the number of common shares or potential common shares outstanding at the end of the period, if the transaction had occurred before the end of the period. Examples of those transactions include the issuance or acquisition of common shares (in

EarningsPerSharePotentiallyDilutiveSecur.l: Earnings Per Share, Potentially Dilutive Securities (Deprecated 2026)
EarningsPerSharePotentiallyDilutiveSecur.d: Securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic earnings per share (EPS) in the future that were not included in the computation of diluted EPS because to do so would have been antidilutive for the period presented.

EarningsPerSharePolicyTextBlock.l: Earnings Per Share, Policy [Policy Text Block]
EarningsPerSharePolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for computing basic and diluted earnings or loss per share for each class of common stock and participating security. Addresses all significant policy factors, including any antidilutive items that have been excluded from the computation and takes into account stock dividends, splits and reverse splits that occur after the balance sheet date of the latest reporting period but before the issuance of the financial statements.

EarningsPerShareDilutedOtherDisclosuresA.l: Earnings Per Share, Diluted, Other Disclosure [Abstract]

EarningsPerShareDilutedLineItems.l: Earnings Per Share, Diluted, by Common Class, Including Two Class Method [Line Items]
EarningsPerShareDilutedLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

EarningsPerShareDilutedProFormaAdjustmen.l: Earnings Per Share, Diluted, Pro Forma Adjustment
EarningsPerShareDilutedProFormaAdjustmen.d: Pro forma diluted earnings per share adjustment to reconcile between net income and pro forma amounts.

IncreaseDecreaseInBrokerDealerRelatedRec.l: Increase (Decrease) in Broker-Dealer Related Receivables (Payables), Net
IncreaseDecreaseInBrokerDealerRelatedRec.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables or payables that result from buying and selling securities for the firm's own account or from acting as an agent or intermediary in the sale of securities.

QuarterlyFinancialInformationQuarterlyCh.l: Quarterly Financial Information, Quarterly Charges and Credits, Amount Affecting Comparability
QuarterlyFinancialInformationQuarterlyCh.d: Amount of the item included in the interim period that affected period-to-period comparability (excluding restatement adjustments).

GoodwillAcquiredDuringPeriod.d: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

GoodwillWrittenOffRelatedToSaleOfBusines.d: Amount of decrease in goodwill acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized, from divestiture.

UnrealizedGainLossOnHybridInstrumentNet.l: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Hybrid Instrument, Net
UnrealizedGainLossOnHybridInstrumentNet.d: Amount of the unrealized gain (loss) in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value on hybrid instruments measured at fair value.

DescriptionOfReorganizationOfLimitedLiab.l: Description of Reorganization of Limited Liability Company (LLC) or Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Through Business Combination [Abstract]

OtherInvestmentsAndSecuritiesAtCost.l: Other Investments and Securities, at Cost
OtherInvestmentsAndSecuritiesAtCost.d: Includes other investments and securities that are not at fair value as of the balance sheet date and those that are not accounted for under the equity method.

DerivativeFinancialInstrumentsIndexedToA.l: Derivative Financial Instruments Indexed to, and Potentially Settled in, Entity's Own Stock, Equity [Abstract]

ResultsOfOperationsSalesOrTransfersToEnt.l: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Revenue, Entity's Other Operation
ResultsOfOperationsSalesOrTransfersToEnt.d: Amount of revenue from sale and transfer to entity's other operation in oil- and gas-producing activities.

QuarterlyFinancialInformationExplanatory.l: Quarterly Financial Information, Explanatory Note, Period
QuarterlyFinancialInformationExplanatory.d: Identification of the interim period (excluding the fourth quarter) for which the item affected period-to-period comparability.

Description of a material transaction, fact or circumstance that affected period-to-period comparability, such as the effects of seasonal activity, a business combination, and significant changes in accounting estimates, that occurred during one of the first three quarters.

GoodwillTranslationAndPurchaseAccounting.l: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation and Measurement Period Adjustments
GoodwillTranslationAndPurchaseAccounting.d: Amount of increase (decrease) from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquityInd.l: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Indexed Shares
ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquityInd.d: The number of issuer's shares to which the forward contract is indexed.

OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityIndexedShare.l: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Indexed Shares
OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityIndexedShare.d: The number of issuer's shares to which the option contract is indexed.

CommitmentsDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for significant arrangements with third parties, which includes operating lease arrangements and arrangements in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services, or has agreed to commit resources to supply goods or services, and operating lease arrangements. Descriptions may include identification of the specific goods and services, period of time covered, minimum quantities and amounts, and cancellation rights.

SignificantPurchaseCommitmentDescription.d: Excluding long-term commitments, description of arrangements in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services from one or more suppliers, which may include identification of the goods or services to be purchased, identity of the seller, pricing, effects on pricing (such as penalties) of failing to reach minimum quantities required to be purchased, cancellation rights, and termination provisions.

SignificantSupplyCommitmentDescription.d: Excluding long-term commitments, description of arrangements in which the entity must commit resources to supply goods or services to one or more customers, which may include identification of the goods or services to be furnished, identity of the buyer, pricing, effects on pricing (such as penalties) of failing to deliver minimum quantities required to be furnished, cancellation rights, and termination provisions.

SignificantSupplyCommitmentRemainingMini.l: Supply Commitment, Remaining Minimum Amount Committed
SignificantSupplyCommitmentRemainingMini.d: The floor amount as of the balance sheet date that the entity must expend to satisfy the terms of disclosed arrangements (excluding long-term commitments) in which the entity must commit resources to supply goods or services to one or more customers.

EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPTaxBenefit.l: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Tax Benefit of Dividends Paid to Plan
EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPTaxBenefit.d: The tax benefit resulting from dividends paid on preferred stock held by an employee stock option plan, when that stock is not a common stock equivalent.

IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingLiabilit.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating liabilities classified as other.

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfFinanceRe.l: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Finance Receivables
ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfFinanceRe.d: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

InvestmentIncomeNetAmortizationOfDiscoun.l: Investment Income, Net, Amortization of Discount and Premium
InvestmentIncomeNetAmortizationOfDiscoun.d: Amount of accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) on nonoperating securities.

OperatingLeasesIncomeStatementInitialDir.d: Amount of incremental cost of lease that would not have been incurred if lease had not been obtained.

OperatingLeasesIncomeStatementCarryingAm.l: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Carrying Amount at Lease Inception Exceeds Fair Value (Deprecated 2026)
OperatingLeasesIncomeStatementCarryingAm.d: This element represents the loss resulting from the amount by which the cost or carrying amount, if different, of an asset subject to an agreement classified as an operating lease, at the inception of a lease involving real estate, exceeds the fair value of the leased property.

InsuranceSettlementMember.d: A potential recovery of a loss for which a claim was filed with an insurer.

GainContingencyDescription.d: Describes an existing condition, situation, or set of circumstances involving uncertainty as of the balance sheet date (or prior to issuance of the financial statements) as to a probable or reasonably possible gain to the entity that will ultimately be realized when one or more future events occur.

ReinsuranceLossOnUncollectibleAccountsIn.l: Reinsurance, Loss on Uncollectible Accounts in Period, Amount
ReinsuranceLossOnUncollectibleAccountsIn.d: Amount of the write-down or write-off of a receivable from a reinsurer.

RecognitionOfDeferredRevenue.d: The amount of previously reported deferred or unearned revenue that was recognized as revenue during the period. For cash flows, this element primarily pertains to amortization of deferred credits on long-term arrangements. As a noncash item, it is deducted from net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsPoli.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Policy [Policy Text Block]
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsPoli.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining PVFP and for amortizing it over future periods (methodologies and assumptions) in connection with the purchase of a life insurance company. It is also known as Value of Business Acquired, or VOBA. This element is appropriate for business combinations entered into before December 15, 2008.

ScheduleOfEffectsOnFutureEarningsAndCash.l: Schedule of Effects on Future Earnings and Cash Flows Resulting from Exit Plan [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfEffectsOnFutureEarningsAndCash.d: Tabular disclosure of the quantified effects on future earnings and cash flows resulting from the exit plan (for example, reduced depreciation, reduced employee expense, etc.) along with the initial period in which those effects are expected to be realized. May include whether the cost savings are expected to be offset by anticipated increases in other expenses or reduced revenues. Also identifies the income statement line items to be impacted (for example, cost of sales; marketing; selling, gen

ScheduleOfEffectsOnFutureEarningsAndCash.l: Exit Plan, Effect on Future Earnings and Cash Flows [Table]
ScheduleOfEffectsOnFutureEarningsAndCash.d: Disclosure of information about effect on future earnings and cash flows resulting from exit plan and initial period in which effect is expected to be realized.

EffectsOnFutureEarningsAndCashFlowsResul.l: Effects on Future Earnings and Cash Flows Resulting from Exit Plan [Axis]
EffectsOnFutureEarningsAndCashFlowsResul.d: Information by effect on future earnings and cash flows resulting from an exit plan.

EffectsOnFutureEarningsAndCashFlowsByTyp.l: Effects on Future Earnings and Cash Flows, by Type of Effect [Domain]
EffectsOnFutureEarningsAndCashFlowsByTyp.d: Identification of the types of effects on future earnings and cash flows.

ReducedDepreciationMember.d: A decrease in future depreciation expense as a result of disposal of depreciable assets that result from an exit plan.

ReducedEmployeeExpensesMember.d: A decrease in future employee expense as a result of disposal of a business that results from an exit plan.

EffectsOnFutureEarningsAndCashFlowsResul.l: Effects on Future Earnings and Cash Flows Resulting from Exit Plan [Line Items]
EffectsOnFutureEarningsAndCashFlowsResul.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

InitialPeriodInWhichEffectsAreExpectedTo.l: Initial Period in which Effects are Expected to be Realized (Deprecated 2025)
InitialPeriodInWhichEffectsAreExpectedTo.d: The initial period in which these effects are expected to be realized.

EffectOnFutureEarningsAndCashFlowsOffset.l: Effect on Future Earnings and Cash Flows, Offset Description (Deprecated 2025)
EffectOnFutureEarningsAndCashFlowsOffset.d: A description of an offsetting effect on future earnings or cash flow that results from a reduction in a future expense that results from an exit plan.

EffectOnFutureEarningsAndCashFlowsIncome.l: Effect on Future Earnings, Income Statement Line Item Impacted (Deprecated 2025)
EffectOnFutureEarningsAndCashFlowsIncome.d: A clearly identified income statement line item to be impacted in the future by an exit plan item.

ActualSavingsAnticipatedByPreviousExitPl.l: Actual Savings Anticipated by Previous Exit Plan Not Achieved as Expected, Outcome and Reasons (Deprecated 2025)
ActualSavingsAnticipatedByPreviousExitPl.d: If actual savings anticipated by the exit plan are not achieved as expected or are achieved in periods other than as expected, this element describes that outcome and its reasons.

IncreaseDecreaseInFundsHeldUnderReinsura.l: Increase (Decrease) in Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements
IncreaseDecreaseInFundsHeldUnderReinsura.d: The change in funds held under reinsurance agreements or treaty (contract between the reinsurer and the ceding entity stipulating the manner in which insurance written on various risks is to be shared).

EarningsPerShareReconciliationDisclosure.d: Disclosure of the methodology and assumptions used in the reconciliation of earnings per share, which may include the individual income and share amount effects of all securities that affect earnings per share, the effect that has been given to preferred dividends in arriving at income available to common stockholders in computing basic earnings per share, securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic EPS in the future that were

InsuranceClaimsMember.d: A demand for payment of a policy benefit because of the occurrence of an insured event, such as the death or disability of the insured; the maturity of an endowment; the incurrence of hospital or medical bills; the destruction or damage of property and related deaths or injuries; defects in, liens on, or challenges to the title to real estate; or the occurrence of a surety loss; and the costs to process claims.

PolicyLoansReceivablePolicy.l: Policy Loans Receivable, Policy [Policy Text Block]
PolicyLoansReceivablePolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for policy loans receivable, including the basis for determining the amount reported for loans made to policyholders against and secured by future policy benefits. May also disclose the range of interest rates charged to policyholders on such loans.

PreferredStockRedemptionPremium.d: The excess of (1) fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock over (2) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet, during the accounting period.

PreferredStockConversionsInducements.d: The excess of (1) the fair value of all securities and other consideration transferred in transactions by the registrant to the holders of the convertible preferred stock over (2) the fair value of securities issuable pursuant to the original conversion terms, during the accounting period.

InsuranceRelatedAssessmentsMember.d: Any funding mandated by statute or regulatory authority that is related directly or indirectly to underwriting activities, including pools for self-insurance and excluding premium taxes and income taxes. The funds derived from the assessments generally enable a government guarantor to pay insurance claims in the event that the underwriting insurer is insolvent or otherwise unable to meet its payment obligations.

UnassertedClaimMember.d: A claim for damages that is likely to be made and for which it is reasonably possible that there will be an unfavorable outcome, such as a likelihood that lawsuits from parties as yet unidentified will be filed alleging injury from using a product when other parties have successfully sued the entity for such use.

EquityMethodInvestmentAggregateCost.d: This element represents the aggregate cost of investments accounted for under the equity method of accounting.

EquityMethodInvestmentDeferredGainOnSale.l: Equity Method Investment, Deferred Gain on Sale
EquityMethodInvestmentDeferredGainOnSale.d: This element represents disclosure of the amount of gain which has been deferred as the result of the sale of a business or operating assets to a highly leveraged entity which deferred gain has been reflected in the accompanying statement of financial position as reduction from the related asset.

LossContingencyRangeOfPossibleLossPortio.l: Loss Contingency, Range of Possible Loss, Portion Not Accrued
LossContingencyRangeOfPossibleLossPortio.d: The difference between the maximum amount of estimated loss and the amount recorded as of the balance sheet date.

RecordedThirdPartyEnvironmentalRecoverie.d: Recorded amount of the individual components comprising the asset for third-party recoveries related to environmental remediation obligations.

SiteContingencyLossExposureNotAccruedThi.l: Site Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Third-Party Recovery Commentary
SiteContingencyLossExposureNotAccruedThi.d: Describes the extent to which disclosed but not recognized contingent remediation losses are expected to be recoverable through insurance, indemnification arrangements, or other sources, and any material limitations of that recovery.

SiteContingencyAccrualAssumptions.d: Describes the important assumptions underlying the estimate of the remediation loss, and may describe any changes in the assumptions made since the last reporting period.

LossContingencyOpinionOfCounsel.d: Sets forth the entity's counsel's opinion as to the likely outcome of the matter, or that no such opinion can as yet be expressed.

LossContingencyAccrualInsuranceRelatedAs.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Insurance-related Assessment, Discount Rate
LossContingencyAccrualInsuranceRelatedAs.d: The rate applied as of the balance sheet date to reduce the undiscounted amount of a guarantee fund and other insurance-related assessments to present value.

LossContingencyUndiscountedAmountOfInsur.l: Loss Contingency, Undiscounted Amount of Insurance-related Assessment Liability
LossContingencyUndiscountedAmountOfInsur.d: The liability as of the balance sheet date representing required funding mandated by statute or regulatory authority that is related directly or indirectly to underwriting activities, including pools for self-insurance and excluding premium taxes and income taxes. The funds derived from the assessments generally enable a government guarantor to pay insurance claims in the event that the underwriting insurer is insolvent or otherwise unable to meet its payment obligations.

InsuredEventGainLoss.d: Amount of excess (deficiency) of insurance recovery over the loss incurred from an insured event.

RelatedPartyTaxExpenseMethodology.d: Principal provisions of the method by which consolidated amount of current and deferred tax expense is allocated to members of a group for which a consolidated tax return is filed.

RelatedPartyTaxExpenseDueToAffiliatesCur.l: Related Party Tax Expense, Due to Affiliates, Current
RelatedPartyTaxExpenseDueToAffiliatesCur.d: The amount of any current tax-related balances due to affiliates as of the date of each statement of financial position presented.

RelatedPartyTaxExpenseDueFromAffiliatesC.l: Related Party Tax Expense, Due from Affiliates, Current
RelatedPartyTaxExpenseDueFromAffiliatesC.d: The amount of any current tax-related balances due from affiliates as of the date of each statement of financial position presented.

RelatedPartyTaxExpenseDueToAffiliatesDef.l: Related Party Tax Expense, Due to Affiliates, Deferred
RelatedPartyTaxExpenseDueToAffiliatesDef.d: The amount of any deferred tax-related balances due to affiliates as of the date of each statement of financial position presented.

RelatedPartyTaxExpenseDueFromAffiliatesD.l: Related Party Tax Expense, Due from Affiliates, Deferred
RelatedPartyTaxExpenseDueFromAffiliatesD.d: The amount of any deferred tax-related balances due from affiliates as of the date of each statement of financial position presented.

SpentNuclearFuelObligationNoncurrent.d: Provision for the disposal costs of spent nuclear fuel from generating stations.

LossContingencyLossInPeriod.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Loss (Reversal of Loss)
LossContingencyLossInPeriod.d: Amount of loss (reversal of loss) recognized for loss contingency liability. Includes, but is not limited to, effect of revision in previously reported estimate.

LossContingencyAccrualInsuranceRelatedAs.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Insurance-related Assessment, Premium Tax Offset
LossContingencyAccrualInsuranceRelatedAs.d: The amount of insurance-related assessment liability that is expected to be recovered through a premium tax offset based on current laws applied to in-force policies.

LossContingencyAccrualInsuranceRelatedAs.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Insurance-related Assessment, Policy Surcharge Asset
LossContingencyAccrualInsuranceRelatedAs.d: The amount of insurance-related assessment liability that is expected to be recovered through policy surcharges applied to in-force policies.

LossContingencyDiscountedAmountOfInsuran.l: Loss Contingency, Discounted Amount of Insurance-related Assessment Liability
LossContingencyDiscountedAmountOfInsuran.d: The present value of the liability as of the balance sheet date representing required funding mandated by statute or regulatory authority that is related directly or indirectly to underwriting activities, including pools for self-insurance and excluding premium taxes and income taxes. The funds derived from the assessments generally enable a government guarantor to pay insurance claims in the event that the underwriting insurer is insolvent or otherwise unable to meet its payment obligations.

LossContingencyDiscountedAmountOfInsuran.l: Loss Contingency, Discounted Amount of Insurance-related Assessment Liability, Payment Period
LossContingencyDiscountedAmountOfInsuran.d: The period of time over which the discounted amount of the assessment is expected to be paid.

LossContingencyDiscountedAmountOfInsuran.l: Loss Contingency, Discounted Amount of Insurance-related Assessment Liability, Realization Period for Associated Asset Offsets
LossContingencyDiscountedAmountOfInsuran.d: The period of time over which the assets related to premium tax offsets and policy surcharges are expected to be realized.

GainOnBusinessInterruptionInsuranceRecov.l: Gain on Business Interruption Insurance Recovery
GainOnBusinessInterruptionInsuranceRecov.d: The net amount (to the extent disclosed within this portion of the income statement) by which an insurance settlement exceeds incremental costs incurred from the event causing an interruption of business, plus the insurance award for earnings lost from the event, such as a natural catastrophe, explosion or fire.

DiscontinuedOperationContinuationOfActiv.l: Discontinued Operation, Nature of Activities Having Continuing Involvement after Disposal
DiscontinuedOperationContinuationOfActiv.d: Description of the nature of activities that give rise to the continuing involvement with a discontinued operation after disposal.

ScheduleOfRestructuringReserveByTypeOfCo.l: Schedule of Restructuring Reserve by Type of Cost [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfRestructuringReserveByTypeOfCo.d: Tabular disclosure of an entity's restructuring reserve that occurred during the period associated with the exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings for each major type of cost. This element may also include a description of any reversal and other adjustment made during the period to the amount of an accrued liability for restructuring activities. This element may be used to encapsulate the roll forward presentations of an entity's restructuring reserve by type of cost and

DeferredCompensationCashBasedArrangement.l: Deferred Compensation Cash-Based Arrangements, Liability, Current
DeferredCompensationCashBasedArrangement.d: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for deferred compensation arrangements payable within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Represents currently earned compensation under cash arrangements (such as a profit-sharing plan, rabbi trust, and employee contract--excluding equity-based arrangements) that is not actually paid until a later date.

DeferredCompensationShareBasedArrangemen.l: Deferred Compensation Share-Based Arrangements, Liability, Current
DeferredCompensationShareBasedArrangemen.d: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for stock option plans and other equity-based compensation arrangements payable within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).

ScheduleOfTradingSecuritiesAndOtherTradi.l: Debt and Equity Securities, FV-NI [Line Items]
ScheduleOfTradingSecuritiesAndOtherTradi.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

GeneralAndAdministrativeCostsInInventory.l: General and Administrative Costs in Inventory [Abstract]
General and Administrative Costs in Inventory, Amount Incurred
GeneralAndAdministrativeCostsInInventory.d: Aggregate amount of general and administrative costs incurred in each period and charged to inventory.

GeneralAndAdministrativeCostsInInventory.l: General and Administrative Costs in Inventory, Amount Remaining
GeneralAndAdministrativeCostsInInventory.d: Actual or estimated amount of general and administrative costs remaining in inventory.

ScheduleOfInvestmentIncomeReportedAmount.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentsTable.d: Disclosure of information about equity method investment. Includes, but is not limited to, name of investee or group of investees, percentage ownership, difference between investment and value of underlying equity in net assets.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.d: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.

ScheduleOfAvailableForSaleSecuritiesLine.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ScheduleOfHeldToMaturitySecuritiesLineIt.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentsLineIte.l: Schedule of Equity Method Investments [Line Items]
ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentsLineIte.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

AnnualMembershipFeesMember.d: Annual membership fees collected in advance and recognized in revenue, net of estimated refunds.

RestructuringAndRelatedCostDescription.d: Information pertinent to an understanding of the specified type of restructuring cost, including the facts and circumstances leading to the expected activity, discussion of the level and quantity of personnel to be terminated, and the expected completion date.

StatementClassOfStockAxis.d: Information by the different classes of stock of the entity.

OtherDeferredCreditsCurrent.d: Amount of unearned revenue or income classified as other, expected to be taken into income within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

OtherDeferredCompensationArrangementsLia.l: Other Deferred Compensation Arrangements, Liability, Current
OtherDeferredCompensationArrangementsLia.d: Amount of the liabilities, classified as other, for deferred compensation arrangements payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

AdvancesReceivedOnGovernmentContractsNot.l: Advances Received on Government Contracts, Not Netted Against Accounts Receivable
AdvancesReceivedOnGovernmentContractsNot.d: Advances received on government contracts that are not offset against receivables because they cannot be definitely regarded as payments on account for contract work in progress.

DeferredRevenueAndCreditsCurrent.d: Total carrying amount of consideration received or receivable as of the balance sheet date on potential earnings that were not recognized as revenue or other forms of income in conformity with GAAP, and which are expected to be recognized as such within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DeferredAirTrafficRevenue.d: Value of revenue deferred or cost to provide future services associated with points or miles outstanding and awards that expect to be redeemed through customer loyalty programs and the value of transportation services sold but as yet used by the passenger. Used to reflect the current portion of the liability (within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

DeferredRentCreditCurrent.d: Amount of excess of rental payment required by lease over rental income recognized, classified as current.

DeferredRentCreditNoncurrent.d: Amount of excess of rental payment required by lease over rental income recognized, classified as noncurrent.

OtherDeferredCreditsNoncurrent.d: Amount of unearned revenue or income classified as other, expected to be taken into income after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DeferredRevenueAndCreditsNoncurrent.d: Total carrying amount of consideration received or receivable as of the balance sheet date representing potential earnings that were not as yet recognized as revenue or other forms of income in conformity with GAAP, and which are expected to be recognized as such after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

ProductFinancingArrangementMember.d: Arrangement that in form is a sale with full right of return but in substance is a financing in that the financier is not the end customer, is not at risk other than credit risk similar to any other form of lending arrangement, and typically is repaid from collections of sales made to actual customers including an amount that constitutes interest.

LandfillMember.d: Authorized waste management facility on or in which collected municipal, construction or hazardous waste is deposited.

DeferredRentCredit.d: Amount of excess of rental payment required by lease over rental income recognized.

CapitalUnitsTotalCostToInvestors.d: Cost to investors of each class of capital shares or other capital units.

CapitalUnitsAdjustmentForMarketChanges.l: Capital Units, Adjustment for Market Changes
CapitalUnitsAdjustmentForMarketChanges.d: The adjustment for market appreciation or depreciation of capital units or shares.

CapitalUnitsDeductionsFromTotalCostToInv.l: Capital Units, Deduction from Cost to Investors
CapitalUnitsDeductionsFromTotalCostToInv.d: Amount of deductions from cost to investors of capital shares or other capital units for fees, loads and other charges.

CapitalUnitsDeductionsFromTotalCostToInv.l: Capital Units, Deductions from Cost to Investors, Explanation
CapitalUnitsDeductionsFromTotalCostToInv.d: Description of deductions from cost to investors of capital shares or other capital units for fees, loads and other charges.

CapitalUnitsNetAmount.d: Net amount applicable to investors of capital units or shares.

AccruedCappingClosurePostClosureAndEnvir.l: Accrued Capping, Closure, Post-closure and Environmental Costs, Noncurrent
AccruedCappingClosurePostClosureAndEnvir.d: The estimated amount of costs required as of the balance sheet date to comply with regulatory requirements pertaining to the retirement of a waste management facility, which will be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

PostemploymentLiabilityNotAccrued.d: Description of the nature of postemployment benefits that otherwise would have been accrued had the amount of the obligation been reasonably estimable.

DeferredIncomeTaxesAndTaxCreditsAbstract.l: Deferred Income Taxes and Tax Credits [Abstract]

DeferredIncomeTaxesAndTaxCredits.l: Deferred Income Taxes and Tax Credits
DeferredIncomeTaxesAndTaxCredits.d: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) and income tax credits.

DeferredRevenueAndCredits.d: Total carrying amount of consideration received or receivable as of the balance sheet date representing potential earnings that were not as yet recognized as revenue or other forms of income in conformity with GAAP.

AdvancesFromFederalHomeLoanBanksAbstract.l: Advance from Federal Home Loan Bank [Abstract]

SecuritiesLoaned.d: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseReser.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Unearned Premiums Reserve
DeferredTaxAssetsTaxDeferredExpenseReser.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the unearned premiums reserve.

UnearnedPremiums.d: Carrying amount of premiums written on insurance contracts that have not been earned as of the balance sheet date.

SupplementaryInsuranceInformationUnearne.l: SEC Schedule, 12-16, Insurance Companies, Supplementary Insurance Information, Unearned Premium
SupplementaryInsuranceInformationUnearne.d: Amount of premium not yet earned, disclosed in supplementary insurance information.

SupplementalInformationForPropertyCasual.l: SEC Schedule, 12-18, Supplemental Information, Property-Casualty Insurance Underwriters, Unearned Premium
SupplementalInformationForPropertyCasual.d: Amount of premium written but not yet earned by property-casualty insurance underwriter.

DeferredRentAssetNetCurrent.d: Amount of excess of rental income recognized over rental payment required by lease, classified as current.

AccruedCappingClosurePostClosureAndEnvir.l: Accrued Capping, Closure, Post-closure and Environmental Costs
AccruedCappingClosurePostClosureAndEnvir.d: The amount of estimated costs accrued as of the balance sheet date to comply with regulatory requirements pertaining to the retirement of a waste management facility (such as a landfill or waste treatment facility). Represents the portion that will be paid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

IntangibleAssetsExplanationOfSignificant.l: Intangible Assets, Explanation of Significant Additions
IntangibleAssetsExplanationOfSignificant.d: An explanation of any significant addition to intangible assets during the reporting period.

IntangibleAssetsExplanationOfSignificant.l: Intangible Assets, Explanation of Significant Deletions
IntangibleAssetsExplanationOfSignificant.d: An explanation of any significant deletions to intangible assets during the reporting period.

ReasonForChangeInDateOfAnnualGoodwillImp.l: Reason for Change in Date of Annual Goodwill Impairment Test (Deprecated 2024)
ReasonForChangeInDateOfAnnualGoodwillImp.d: The reason for any change to the date of the annual goodwill impairment test.

NewDateOfAnnualGoodwillImpairmentTest.l: New Date of Annual Goodwill Impairment Test (Deprecated 2026)
NewDateOfAnnualGoodwillImpairmentTest.d: The new date of the annual goodwill impairment test.

ScheduleOfEmployeeServiceShareBasedCompe.l: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expensed and Capitalized, Amount [Table]
ScheduleOfEmployeeServiceShareBasedCompe.d: Disclosure of information about amount recognized for award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, amount expensed in statement of income or comprehensive income, amount capitalized in statement of financial position, and corresponding reporting line item in financial statements.

ScheduleOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentTable.d: Disclosure of information about property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentTransfersAndCha.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, before Accumulated Depreciation, Other Increase (Decrease)
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentTransfersAndCha.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in property, plant, and equipment from reclassification, impairment, donation, and change classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

ScheduleOfImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAnd.l: Long-Lived Asset, Held and Used, Impairment [Table]
ScheduleOfImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAnd.d: Disclosure of information about impairment of long-lived asset held and used.

ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.l: Long-Lived Asset, to be Disposed of Other than by Sale, Impairment [Table]
ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.d: Disclosure of information about impairment of long-lived asset to be disposed of other than sale by sale.

DisclosureOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForSaleTe.d: Tabular disclosure of long-lived asset held for sale.

ScheduleOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForSaleTabl.d: Disclosure of information about long-lived asset held for sale. Includes, but is not limited to, description of fact and circumstance leading to expected disposal, manner and timing of disposal, amount of asset held for sale, gain (loss) recognized in statement of income, and statement of income caption that includes gain (loss).

LongLivedAssetsHeldForSaleNameDomain.d: A name of the assets to be disposed.

ScheduleOfDeferredCompensationArrangemen.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Share-Based Payment [Table]
ScheduleOfDeferredCompensationArrangemen.d: Disclosure of information about equity-based arrangements (such as stock or unit options and stock or unit awards) with individual employees, which are generally based on employment contracts between the entity and one or more selected officers or key employees, and which contain a promise by the employer to pay certain equity-based awards at future dates, sometimes including a period after retirement, upon compliance with stipulated requirements. This type of arrangement is distinguished from b

FinancialServicesLiabilities.d: For entities that provide full or partial financing and servicing for customers supplementary to its major operations (such as a manufacturer or a homebuilder providing and servicing loans to buyers), represents the liabilities associated with such activities, including accounts payable and accrued liabilities.

ReinsurancePayable.d: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the known and estimated amounts owed to insurers under reinsurance treaties or other arrangements.

CollateralizedFinancings.d: The value of the collateral (typically cash) that the entity receives in a financing transaction in exchange for securities lent. This item represents a liability in the financial statements of the lender of the securities.

CapitalLeaseObligations.d: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal through the balance sheet date.

CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare.l: Common Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare.d: Face amount or stated value per share of common stock.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeReclassification.l: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer from Held-to-Maturity, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment and Tax
OtherComprehensiveIncomeReclassification.d: Amount, before tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

OtherComprehensiveIncomeReclassification.l: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer from Held-to-Maturity, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
OtherComprehensiveIncomeReclassification.d: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.l: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Net of Tax
OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.d: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

AuctionMarketPreferredSecuritiesStockSer.l: Auction Market Preferred Securities, Stock Series, Per-Share Redemption Amount
AuctionMarketPreferredSecuritiesStockSer.d: The per-share amount at which preferred stock may be called or is subject to redemption through sinking-fund operations or otherwise.

SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionChange.l: Shares Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Changes in Redemption Value, Policy [Policy Text Block]
SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionChange.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for recognition of changes in redemption value of mandatorily redeemable shares. Provides the period over which changes in redemption value are accreted, usually from the issuance date (or from the date that it becomes probable that the security will become redeemable, if later) to the earliest redemption date of the security.

SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.l: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Reason for Uncertain Redemption (Deprecated 2025)
SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.d: If the financial instrument is not redeemable currently (for example, because a contingency has not been met), and it is not probable that the security will become redeemable, the reason for this uncertainty in redemption.

ScheduleOfOtherAssetsNoncurrentTextBlock.l: Schedule of Other Assets, Noncurrent [Table Text Block]

OtherAssetsSignificantAdditionsOrDeletio.l: Other Assets, Significant Additions or Deletions [Abstract]

DeferredChargesPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for deferral and amortization of significant deferred charges.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.l: OCI, Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), Arising During Period, Tax
OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.d: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDerivativesQuali.l: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax [Abstract]

TreasuryStockDeferredEmployeeStockOwners.l: Deferred Employee Stock Ownership Plan, Issuance of Shares or Sale of Treasury Shares
TreasuryStockDeferredEmployeeStockOwners.d: The issuance of shares or sale of treasury shares to an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

InvestmentsAndCash.d: Sum of investments and unrestricted cash as of the balance sheet date.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentByTypeAxis.d: Information by class of long-lived asset. Includes, but is not limited to, property, plant, and equipment; right-of-use asset from finance lease; long-lived asset of lessor subject to operating lease; proved oil and gas property accounted for under successful efforts method; and long-term prepaid asset.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAndUsedByType.l: Impaired Long-Lived Assets Held and Used by Type [Axis]
ImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAndUsedByType.d: Information by type of impaired long-lived asset held and used.

ImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAndUsedLineIt.l: Long-Lived Asset, Held and Used, Impairment [Line Items]
ImpairedLongLivedAssetsHeldAndUsedLineIt.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.l: Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale by Type [Axis]
ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.d: Information by type of impaired long-lived asset to be disposed of by method other than sale.

ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.l: Long-Lived Asset, to be Disposed of Other than by Sale, Impairment [Line Items]
ImpairedAssetsToBeDisposedOfByMethodOthe.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

LongLivedAssetsHeldForSaleByAssetTypeAxi.d: Information by long-lived asset held for sale.

LongLivedAssetsHeldForSaleLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ObligationToReturnSecuritiesReceivedAsCo.l: Obligation to Return Securities Received as Collateral
ObligationToReturnSecuritiesReceivedAsCo.d: The fair value of collateral received by the entity associated with securities borrowed that must be returned if the counterparty fulfills its obligations. It appears on the balance sheet as a liability and has a corresponding asset that appears on the balance sheet called Securities Received as Collateral.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Share-Based Payments [Line Items]
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeMinority.l: Subsidiary, Redeemable Preferred Stock Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Dividend
SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeMinority.d: The dividends from redeemable preferred stock of a subsidiary that are accounted for as a noncontrolling interest in income of a subsidiary in a parent's consolidated financial statements.

ConvertiblePreferredStockSettlementTerms.d: Describe the manner of settlement upon conversion and any alternative settlement methods (e.g., cash, shares, a combination of both).

ConvertiblePreferredStockAssociatedDeriv.l: Convertible Preferred Stock, Associated Derivative Transactions
ConvertiblePreferredStockAssociatedDeriv.d: Describe and provide information on derivative transactions entered into in connection with the issuance of the contingently convertible securities that may be useful in explaining the potential impact of the contingently convertible securities. May include the terms of those derivative transactions (including the terms of the settlement), how those transactions relate to the contingently convertible securities, and the number of shares underlying the derivatives.

PreferredStockParticipationRights.d: Describe the contractual rights of preferred stockholders to receive dividends or returns from the entity's profits, cash flows, or returns on investments.

CommonStockVotingRights.d: Description of voting rights of common stock. Includes eligibility to vote and votes per share owned. Include also, if any, unusual voting rights.

CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutur.l: Common Stock, Capital Shares Reserved for Future Issuance
CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutur.d: Aggregate number of common shares reserved for future issuance.

PreferredStockValueOutstanding.d: Value of nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer, held by shareholders. Excludes preferred shares repurchased and held as treasury shares.

CommonStockValueOutstanding.d: Value of common shares held by shareholders. Excludes common shares repurchased and held as treasury shares.

PreferredStockDiscountOnShares.d: Discount on preferred shares, or any unamortized balance thereof, shown separately as a deduction from the applicable account(s) as circumstances require.

PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInC.l: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount [Abstract]
Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount
PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInC.d: Aggregate par value plus amounts in excess of par or issuance value (in cases of no-par value stock) for nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued and outstanding, net of discount on shares. Aggregate for preferred stock issued and outstanding.

CommonStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInCapi.l: Common Stocks, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount [Abstract]

RestrictionsForConsolidatedAndUnconsolid.l: Restrictions for Consolidated and Unconsolidated Subsidiaries [Abstract]

RestrictionToTransferFunds.d: The description of the nature of any restrictions on the ability of consolidated and unconsolidated subsidiaries to transfer funds to the parent in the form of cash dividends, loans and advances.

AmountOfRestrictedNetAssetsForConsolidat.l: Amount of Restricted Net Assets for Consolidated and Unconsolidated Subsidiaries
AmountOfRestrictedNetAssetsForConsolidat.d: Amount of restricted net assets of consolidated and unconsolidated subsidiaries as of the end of the most recently completed fiscal year.

SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.l: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Description
SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.d: Describe the nature and terms of the financial instrument, and the rights and obligations embodied in the instrument. Include settlement alternatives, if any, in the contract and identify the entity that controls the settlement alternatives.

SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.l: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Excess of Liabilities over Assets
SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.d: The value of the excess of liabilities over assets. If all outstanding shares are subject to mandatory redemption and the redemption price is more than the book value (the redemption price exceeds the company's equity balance), the resulting cumulative transition adjustment and subsequent adjustments to reflect changes in the redemption price of the shares are recorded as an excess of liabilities over assets.

SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.l: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Excess of Assets over Liabilities
SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.d: The value of the excess of assets over liabilities. If all outstanding shares are subject to mandatory redemption and the redemption price is less than the book value (the redemption price is less than the company's equity balance), the resulting cumulative transition adjustment and subsequent adjustments to reflect changes in the redemption price of the shares are recorded as an excess of assets over liabilities (equity).

InterestExpensePolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for recognizing interest expense, including the method of amortizing debt issuance costs.

LoanCommitmentsPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for loan commitments accounted for as derivatives, including the methods and assumptions used to estimate fair value and any associated hedging strategies.

MiningPropertiesAndMineralRightsMember.d: Legal right to explore, extract, and retain some or all portions of the benefits from mining or mineral deposits and properties used for mining.

PreferredStockSharesSubscribedButUnissue.l: Preferred Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued, Value [Abstract]

DebtPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy related to debt. Includes, but is not limited to, debt issuance costs, the effects of refinancings, method of amortizing debt issuance costs and original issue discount, and classifications of debt.

DerivativesOffsettingFairValueAmountsPol.l: Derivatives, Offsetting Fair Value Amounts, Policy [Policy Text Block]
DerivativesOffsettingFairValueAmountsPol.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for offsetting or not offsetting fair value amounts recognized for derivative instruments against such amounts recognized for the right to reclaim cash collateral (a receivable) or the obligation to return cash collateral (a payable) arising from derivative instruments recognized at fair value.

FundsHeldForClients.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the funds held on behalf of others and that are expected to be liquidated within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. This does not include funds held under reinsurance agreements.

SupplementalInformationForPropertyCasual.l: SEC Schedule, 12-18, Supplemental Information, Property-Casualty Insurance Underwriters, Interest Rate at which Discount Computed
SupplementalInformationForPropertyCasual.d: Rate at which discount was computed for deduction from reserve for unpaid claim and claim adjustment expense by property-casualty insurance underwriter.

FundsHeldUnderReinsuranceAgreementsAsset.l: Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements, Asset
FundsHeldUnderReinsuranceAgreementsAsset.d: Amount of the reinsurer's funds held on its behalf by the ceding insurer, including funds held in trust, under reinsurance treaties or contracts with the assuming insurer as security for the payment of the obligations thereunder.

DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeAssetAmou.l: Derivative Asset, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, before Offset of Collateral
DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeAssetAmou.d: Fair value, after offset of derivative liability, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, before offset against an obligation to return collateral under a master netting arrangement. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeAssetAmou.l: Derivative Asset, Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeAssetAmou.d: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability.l: Derivative Liability, Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability.d: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability.l: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, before Offset of Collateral
DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability.d: Fair value, after offset of derivative asset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, elected not to be and before offset against a right to receive collateral under a master netting arrangement. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

ShortDurationContractsDiscountedLiabilit.d: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of loss reserves carried at present value.

ShortDurationContractsDiscountedLiabilit.l: Short-Duration Contract, Discounted Liability, Discount Rate
ShortDurationContractsDiscountedLiabilit.d: Discount rate used to obtain present value of liability for unpaid claim and claim adjustment expense for short-duration contract issued by insurance entity.

ShortDurationContractsDiscountedLiabilit.l: Short-Duration Contracts, Discounted Liabilities, Basis for Discount Rate (Deprecated 2025)
ShortDurationContractsDiscountedLiabilit.d: Describes the facts and circumstances pertaining to the selection of the discount rate used to reduce the estimated amount of loss reserves on short-duration contracts to present value.

StatutoryAccountingPracticesPortionOfExc.l: Statutory Accounting Practices, Portion of Excess Retained Earnings Not Taxed
StatutoryAccountingPracticesPortionOfExc.d: The amount of retained earnings as of the balance sheet date in excess of statutory unassigned surplus on which no income tax provisions have been made.

ParticipatingPoliciesAmountInForce.d: Amount of participating insurance in force.

ParticipatingPoliciesAsPercentageOfGross.l: Participating Insurance, Percentage of Gross Insurance in Force
ParticipatingPoliciesAsPercentageOfGross.d: Percentage of participating insurance contract to insurance contracts in force.

ParticipatingPoliciesAdditionalIncomeAll.d: Amount of additional income allocated to policy holders whose contracts entitle them to a portion of the entity's earnings or surplus, paid through dividends.

PolicyholderDividendsRateOnPolicyEarning.l: Policyholder Dividends, Rate on Policy Earnings
PolicyholderDividendsRateOnPolicyEarning.d: The percentage of earnings allocable to participating policyholders based on earnings of such policies for payment of dividends.

UnusualOrInfrequentTaxEffect.l: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Tax Effect
UnusualOrInfrequentTaxEffect.d: Amount of tax related to an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

ScheduleOfBusinessInsuranceRecoveriesTex.d: Tabular disclosure of business interruption insurance recoveries. Includes, but is not limited to, the nature of the event resulting in business interruption loss, amount of business interruption insurance recoveries recognized, and line item in the statement of income in which those recoveries are classified.

BusinessInterruptionLossesNatureOfEvent.l: Business Interruption Losses, Nature of Event
BusinessInterruptionLossesNatureOfEvent.d: A description of the event that resulted in a business interruption loss.

GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsHeldForTr.l: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments Held for Trading Purposes, Net
GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsHeldForTr.d: Aggregate net gain and losses (whether realized or unrealized) on all derivative instruments held for trading purposes whether or not settled physically.

EstimateOfCancellations.d: Estimates of cancellations for refundable service fees, if accounted for by analogy to FASB Statement No. 48.

InsuranceRecoveries.d: The amount recovered from insurance. These recoveries reduce costs and losses that are reported as a separate line item under operating expenses.

GainLossOnSaleOfStockInSubsidiaryOrEquit.l: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee
GainLossOnSaleOfStockInSubsidiaryOrEquit.d: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

ServicingAssetAtFairValueDescriptionOfOt.l: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Description of Other Changes in Fair Value
ServicingAssetAtFairValueDescriptionOfOt.d: Description of other change in fair value of servicing asset. Excludes change from addition and disposal and in valuation input and assumption.

ServicingAssetAtFairValueOtherChangesInF.l: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Other Changes in Fair Value
ServicingAssetAtFairValueOtherChangesInF.d: Amount of increase (decrease) from changes in fair value classified as other for a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

ServicingAssetAtFairValueDescriptionOfOt.l: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Description of Other Changes that Affect Balance
ServicingAssetAtFairValueDescriptionOfOt.d: A description of the other changes in the balance of servicing assets subsequently measured at fair value. This element is for descriptions of changes other than additions, disposals, changes in fair value resulting from changes in valuation inputs or changes in assumptions, or other changes in fair value.

ServicingAssetAtFairValueOtherChangesTha.l: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Other Changes that Affect Balance
ServicingAssetAtFairValueOtherChangesTha.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes classified as other for a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueDescription.l: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Description of Other Changes in Fair Value
ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueDescription.d: Description of other change in fair value of servicing liability. Excludes change from addition and disposal and in valuation input and assumption.
