ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueDescription.l: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Description of Other Changes that Affect Balance
ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueDescription.d: Description of the other changes in the balance of servicing liabilities subsequently measured at fair value, including changes other than additions, disposals, changes in fair value resulting from changes in valuation inputs or changes in assumptions, or other changes in fair value.

ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueOtherChange.l: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Other Changes in Fair Value
ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueOtherChange.d: Amount of increase (decrease) from changes in fair value classified as other for a contract to service financial assets under which the estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer.

ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueOtherChange.l: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Other Changes that Affect Balance
ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueOtherChange.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes classified as other for a contract to service financial assets under which the estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer.

ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentOfRecogni.l: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Deductions for Aggregate Write-Downs
ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentOfRecogni.d: Amount of decrease in the valuation allowance for impairment of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer from write-downs charged against the allowance.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

ScheduleOfSharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemp.l: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption [Table]
ScheduleOfSharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemp.d: Disclosure of information about financial instrument subject to mandatory redemption and its settlement alternative.

ScheduleOfSharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemp.l: Schedule of Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption by Settlement Terms [Axis]
ScheduleOfSharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemp.d: Information by financial instrument subject to mandatory redemption.

SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionFinanc.l: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Financial Instrument [Domain]
SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionFinanc.d: Identifying description of each financial instrument that embodies an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) or upon an event that is certain to occur. Examples are preferred stock or trust preferred securities, each of which has redemption rights beyond the control of the issuer on a specified date or upon an event that is certain to occur.

SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchas.l: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchas.d: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

CollateralizedAgreements.d: The total of collateralized agreements including securities purchased under agreements to resell (repos), borrowed securities, and secured demand notes.

OperatingCostsAndExpenses.d: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Excludes Selling, General and Administrative Expense.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableLoansInProcess.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Loans in Process
LoansAndLeasesReceivableLoansInProcess.d: Amount of undisbursed portion of the loan receivable balance (loans in process). Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

UnearnedESOPShares.d: Fair value of unearned shares for all classes of common stock and nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP). Includes the sale of shares or the issuance treasury shares to an ESOP.

StockholdersEquity.d: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

UtilitiesOperatingExpenseFuelUsed.d: Amount of operating expense for fuel used by regulated operation.

PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.l: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Rate
PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.d: Effective rate, including composite rate, of cost of financing additions to qualifying regulated assets, commonly called allowance for funds used during construction.

PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.l: Public Utilities, Description of Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Equity Costs Capitalized Only for Rate-making Purposes
PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.d: Description of the nature of costs of debt and equity financing capitalized for setting rates but not capitalized for financial statement purposes.

PlantRetirementAndAbandonmentPolicy.l: Plant Retirement and Abandonment, Policy [Policy Text Block]
PlantRetirementAndAbandonmentPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for plant retirement and for abandonment (under construction or in use) in regulated industries when abandonment becomes probable. Any difference between the new asset and the asset cost is recognized as a loss in the income statement. May also indicate the discount rate used in the calculation of present value of recoverable abandoned assets.

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedUSGovernmentAnd.l: Financial Instruments, Owned, US Government and Agency Obligations, at Fair Value
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedUSGovernmentAnd.d: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in debt obligations issued by the US government including short-term Treasury bills, medium-term Treasury notes, and long-term Treasury bonds, as well as debt issued by agencies. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedStateAndMunicip.l: Financial Instruments, Owned, State and Municipal Government Obligations, at Fair Value
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedStateAndMunicip.d: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in fixed income obligations issued by state and local governments and authorities. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedCorporateDebtAt.l: Financial Instruments, Owned, Corporate Debt, at Fair Value
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedCorporateDebtAt.d: Fair value of firm holdings in corporate fixed income securities. Includes pledged and unpledged holdings.

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedCorporateEquiti.l: Financial Instruments, Owned, Corporate Equities, at Fair Value
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedCorporateEquiti.d: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in corporate stocks (common and preferred), stock options, warrants and any other financial instrument which represents, or provides the ability to obtain, ownership rights in a corporation. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedPhysicalCommodi.l: Financial Instruments, Owned, Physical Commodities, at Fair Value
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedPhysicalCommodi.d: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in physical commodity contracts (for example, agricultural products, metals and energy). Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedDerivativesAndO.l: Financial Instruments, Owned, Derivatives and Other Contractual Agreements, at Fair Value
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedDerivativesAndO.d: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in all assets resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments. Their value is derived from the values of one or more underlying assets, reference rates, or indices of asset values. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedPrincipalInvest.l: Financial Instruments, Owned, Principal Investments, at Fair Value
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedPrincipalInvest.d: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in private equity, mezzanine, venture capital, merchant banking, real estate and special situations investments. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedOtherAtFairValu.l: Financial Instruments, Owned, Other, at Fair Value
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedOtherAtFairValu.d: Fair value of firm holdings in securities classified as other. Includes pledged and unpledged holdings.

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedAtFairValue.l: Financial Instruments, Owned, at Fair Value
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedAtFairValue.d: The aggregate fair value as of the balance sheet date of financial instruments and other positions owned by the entity including: (1) mortgages, mortgage-backed and asset backed securities; (2) US government and agency obligations; (3) state and municipal government obligations; (4) other sovereign government debt; (5) corporate obligations; (6) corporate equities; (7) principal investments; (8) derivative contracts; and (9) physical commodities. Includes both pledged and unpledged holdings.

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedAtFairValueByTy.l: Financial Instruments, Owned, at Fair Value, by Type, Alternative [Abstract]

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedMortgagesMortga.l: Financial Instruments, Owned, Mortgages, Mortgage-Backed and Asset-Backed Securities, at Fair Value
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedMortgagesMortga.d: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in mortgages, mortgage backed securities (investment instruments that represent ownership of an undivided interest in a group of mortgages, where principal and interest from the individual mortgages are used to pay investors' principal and interest on the mortgage backed security) and asset-backed securities that are primarily paid from the cash flows of a discrete pool of receivables or other financial assets (such as credit-card rece

DeferredTaxAssetsUnrealizedLossesOnTradi.l: Deferred Tax Asset, Debt Securities, Trading, Unrealized Loss
DeferredTaxAssetsUnrealizedLossesOnTradi.d: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesUnrealizedGainsOnT.l: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Unrealized Gains on Trading Securities
DeferredTaxLiabilitiesUnrealizedGainsOnT.d: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from unrealized gains on trading securities.

DiscontinuanceOfCertainRegulatoryReporti.l: Discontinuance of Certain Regulatory Reporting Practices
DiscontinuanceOfCertainRegulatoryReporti.d: Describes the entity's reasons for its discontinuation of accounting for the effects of certain types of regulation (primarily costs pertaining to ate-setting) and identifies the portion of its operations to which such application was discontinued.

UtilityRevenueAndExpenseRecognitionPolic.l: Utility, Revenue and Expense Recognition, Policy [Policy Text Block]
UtilityRevenueAndExpenseRecognitionPolic.d: Disclosure of accounting policies and anticipated effects of regulatory rulings and on rate-setting regarding revenues and expenses incurred and recovered, including billed and unbilled revenues, revenues collected subject to refund, taxes collected from customers and remitted to governmental authorities, and postretirement benefits.

IncomeTaxReconciliationChangeInDeferredT.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
IncomeTaxReconciliationChangeInDeferredT.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

IncomeTaxRateReconciliationDeductionsEmp.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Employee Stock Ownership Plan Dividend, Amount
IncomeTaxRateReconciliationDeductionsEmp.d: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan.

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesPropertyPlantAndEq.l: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
DeferredTaxLiabilitiesPropertyPlantAndEq.d: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

RevenueRecognitionRealEstateTransactions.l: Revenue Recognition, Real Estate Transactions, Policy [Policy Text Block]
RevenueRecognitionRealEstateTransactions.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for the timing and amount of revenue recognized on transfers of real estate, excluding retail land sales. The entity also may disclose its treatment of any unearned or deferred revenue that arises from the transaction.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Loss (Recovery) on Plant Abandonment
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Amount of loss (recovery of loss) related to a plant abandonment.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.l: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.d: Amount before tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Description of Electric Utility Use of Intermediary for Plant Construction
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Describes the organization and purpose of the intermediary and the nature of its authorization to incur debt to finance construction. The note discloses the rate at which interest on this debt has been capitalized and the dollar amount for each period for which an income statement is presented.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Interest Rate on Intermediary Debt for Electric Utility Plant Construction
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Discloses the interest rate related to debt for plant construction for an electric utility using an intermediary for each period for which an income statement is presented.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Interest Incurred on Intermediary Debt for Electric Utility Plant Construction
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Amount of interest cost incurred for plant construction by an electric utility using a construction intermediary.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Period end amount of total net PPE.

IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitIntraperiodTaxAll.l: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Intraperiod Tax Allocation
IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitIntraperiodTaxAll.d: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) for continuing operations, discontinued operations, other comprehensive income, and items charged (credited) directly to shareholders' equity.

IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.d: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Net [Abstract]

UnfavorableRegulatoryActionMember.d: Enacted or proposed action, ruling, or regulation that is likely to, or possibly, will have adverse effect on financial position or result of operation. Excludes income tax matter.

DisputesMember.d: Revision in estimates for financial differences between a party and counterparty pertaining to interpretations of terms or understandings of contractual and noncontractual arrangements, whether written or oral.

RegulatoryReviewsOfFilingsMember.d: Revisions in estimates based on preliminary indications by regulators of findings that are favorable or unfavorable to the entity based upon the regulator's review of required filings, excluding tax returns. Examples of such filings are cost reports upon which retrospective reimbursements or prospective rates from third-party payers (Medicare and Medicaid) are based, and state environmental department permitting filings in which height, angle, width and length, and closure and post-closure activ

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedOtherSovereignG.l: Financial Instruments, Owned, Other Sovereign Government Obligations, at Fair Value
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedOtherSovereignG.d: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in fixed income obligations issued by foreign governments. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossBefore.l: Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossBefore.d: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossBefore.l: Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax [Abstract]

PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.l: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Additions
PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.d: Total increase in earnings in the period representing the cost of equity (based on assumed rate of return) and/or borrowed funds (based on interest rate) used to finance construction of regulated assets, which is expected to be recovered through rate adjustments.

PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.l: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Net Increase [Abstract]

PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitCont.l: Payment for Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits [Abstract]
Payment for Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitCont.d: Amount of cash outflow for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree.

PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.l: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Cost of Equity
PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.d: The component of the allowance for funds used during construction during the period based on an assumed rate of return on equity funds used in financing the construction of regulated assets.

PhaseInPlanNetChangeInAmountOfCostsDefer.l: Phase-in Plan, Net Change in Amount of Costs Deferred for Rate-making Purposes
PhaseInPlanNetChangeInAmountOfCostsDefer.d: The increase (decrease) during the period in the costs deferred for rate-making purposes.

JointlyOwnedUtilityPlantInterestsLineIte.l: Jointly Owned Utility Plant Interests [Line Items]
JointlyOwnedUtilityPlantInterestsLineIte.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Remainder of Costs of Disallowed Assets for Recently Completed Plant
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: The remaining amount of assets disallowed from inclusion in the rate making process pertaining to recently completed plants in regulated industries.

InterestCostsIncurred.d: Total interest costs incurred during the period and either capitalized or charged against earnings.

InterestCostsCapitalized.d: Amount of interest capitalized during the period.

DeferredTaxAssetsRegulatoryAssetsAndLiab.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Regulatory Assets and Liabilities
DeferredTaxAssetsRegulatoryAssetsAndLiab.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences derived regulatory assets and liabilities.

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesRegulatoryAssetsAn.l: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Regulatory Assets and Liabilities
DeferredTaxLiabilitiesRegulatoryAssetsAn.d: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from regulatory assets and liabilities.

PublicUtilityPropertyPlantAndEquipmentTa.l: Public Utility, Property, Plant and Equipment [Table]
PublicUtilityPropertyPlantAndEquipmentTa.d: Disclosure of information about public utility physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Includes, but is not limited to, balances by class of assets, deprecation expense and method used, including composite depreciation, and accumulated deprecation.

PublicUtilityAxis.d: Information by type of utility plant.

PublicUtilityPropertyPlantAndEquipmentLi.l: Public Utility, Property, Plant and Equipment [Line Items]
PublicUtilityPropertyPlantAndEquipmentLi.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ForeignCurrencyTransactionLossBeforeTax.l: Foreign Currency Transaction Loss, before Tax
ForeignCurrencyTransactionLossBeforeTax.d: Amount before tax of foreign currency transaction realized and unrealized loss recognized in the income statement.

ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainBeforeTax.l: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain, before Tax
ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainBeforeTax.d: Amount before tax of foreign currency transaction realized and unrealized gain recognized in the income statement.

ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossUnreal.l: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossUnreal.d: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

UnprovedPropertiesDisclosureTextBlock.d: Tabular disclosure of unproved oil and gas property.

SuspendedWellCostsDisclosureTextBlock.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost [Text Block]
SuspendedWellCostsDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for parts or all of the information related to suspended well costs.

IncreaseDecreaseInCapitalizedExploratory.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost [Roll Forward]
IncreaseDecreaseInCapitalizedExploratory.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

CapitalizedExploratoryWellCosts.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost
CapitalizedExploratoryWellCosts.d: The amount of capitalized exploratory well costs that is pending the determination of proved reserves. This does not include amounts that were capitalized and subsequently expensed in the same annual period.

ScheduleOfAgingOfCapitalizedExploratoryW.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Capitalized for Period Greater than One Year, Aging [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfAgingOfCapitalizedExploratoryW.d: Tabular disclosure of aging for exploratory well cost capitalized for period of greater than one year after completion of drilling and number of related projects in oil- and gas-producing activities.

CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostsThatHaveB.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Capitalized for Period of One Year or Less
CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostsThatHaveB.d: Amount of exploratory well cost capitalized for period of one year or less after completion of drilling in oil- and gas-producing activities.

CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostsThatHaveB.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Capitalized for Period Greater than One Year
CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostsThatHaveB.d: Amount of exploratory well cost capitalized for period of greater than one year after completion of drilling in oil- and gas-producing activities.

ProjectsThatHaveExploratoryWellCostsThat.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Capitalized for Period Greater than One Year, Number of Projects
ProjectsThatHaveExploratoryWellCostsThat.d: Number of projects for exploratory well cost capitalized for period of greater than one year after completion of drilling in oil- and gas-producing activities.

ScheduleOfProjectsWithExploratoryWellCos.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Capitalized for Period Greater than One Year [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfProjectsWithExploratoryWellCos.d: Tabular disclosure of exploratory well cost capitalized for period of greater than one year after completion of drilling in oil- and gas-producing activities.

ProjectsWithExploratoryWellCostsCapitali.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Capitalized for Period Greater than One Year, Aging [Table]
ProjectsWithExploratoryWellCostsCapitali.d: Disclosure of information about aging for exploratory well cost capitalized for period of greater than one year after completion of drilling and number of related projects in oil- and gas-producing activities.

ProjectsWithExploratoryWellCostsCapitali.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Capitalized for Period Greater than One Year, Aging [Line Items]
ProjectsWithExploratoryWellCostsCapitali.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ProjectWithExploratoryWellCostsCapitaliz.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Capitalized for Period Greater than One Year, Activity to Evaluate Reserve, Description
ProjectWithExploratoryWellCostsCapitaliz.d: For exploratory well costs that continue to be capitalized for more than one year after the completion of drilling at the most recent balance sheet date, a description of the activities that the enterprise has undertaken to date in order to evaluate the reserves and the projects.

ProjectWithExploratoryWellCostsCapitaliz.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Capitalized for Period Greater than One Year, Remaining Activity to Prove Reserve, Description
ProjectWithExploratoryWellCostsCapitaliz.d: For exploratory well costs that continue to be capitalized for more than one year after the completion of drilling at the most recent balance sheet date, a description of the remaining activities required to classify the associated reserves as proved.

ReservesReportedToOtherAgenciesTextBlock.l: Reserves Reported to Other Agencies [Table Text Block] (Deprecated 2024)
ReservesReportedToOtherAgenciesTextBlock.d: Tabular disclosure of reserves reported to other federal agencies or authorities.

StatementThatNoReserveEstimatesWereFiled.l: Statement that No Reserve Estimates Were Filed with Another Federal Authority or Agency (Deprecated 2024)
StatementThatNoReserveEstimatesWereFiled.d: A statement of the fact that no reserve estimates were filed with another Federal authority or agency since the beginning of the last reporting period.

ReserveEstimatesThatExceedFivePercentDif.l: Reserve Estimates that Exceed 5 Percent Difference [Abstract] (Deprecated 2024)

ReserveEstimatesFiledWithAnotherFederalA.l: Reserve Estimates Filed with Another Federal Authority or Agency (Deprecated 2024)
ReserveEstimatesFiledWithAnotherFederalA.d: Any estimates of total, proved net oil or gas reserves (that exceed a 5 percent difference from those disclosed in the SEC filing) filed with or included in reports to the Federal authority or agency since the beginning of the last reporting period.

NameOfFederalAuthorityOrAgency.l: Name of Federal Authority or Agency (Deprecated 2024)
NameOfFederalAuthorityOrAgency.d: The name of the authority or agency.

ExplanationOfReasonsForDifferencesInRese.l: Explanation of Reasons for Differences in Reserve Estimates (Deprecated 2024)
ExplanationOfReasonsForDifferencesInRese.d: Description of the nature of differences between reserve estimates filed with other federal agency or authority and estimates included in Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filing.

StatementThatReserveEstimatesFiledWithAn.l: Statement that Reserve Estimates Filed with Another Federal Authority or Agency Do Not Exceed 5 Percent Difference (Deprecated 2024)
StatementThatReserveEstimatesFiledWithAn.d: A statement of the fact that reserve estimates filed with another Federal authority or agency since the beginning of the last reporting period do not exceed a 5 percent difference with those estimates included in the SEC filing.

PaymentsToAcquireMortgageBackedSecuritie.l: Payments to Acquire Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS) categorized as Held-to-Maturity
PaymentsToAcquireMortgageBackedSecuritie.d: The cash outflow for the purchase of securities issued by a governmental agency or corporation (for example, GNMA or FHLMC) or by private issuers (for example, banks and mortgage banking enterprises) secured by and repaid from underlying mortgages, which were designated as held to maturity when acquired.

ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetainedInterest.l: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables categorized as Held-to-Maturity
ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetainedInterest.d: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of loan receivable measured at amortized cost.

ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetainedInterest.l: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables categorized as Available-for-Sale
ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetainedInterest.d: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of loan receivable measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

IncreaseDecreaseInInterestsContinuedToBe.l: Increase (Decrease) in Interests Continued to be Held by Transferor, Current
IncreaseDecreaseInInterestsContinuedToBe.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of the assets created and retained during the securitization of trade receivables, which are not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

IncreaseDecreaseInInsuranceAssets.d: The increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period in insurance industry assets which are classified as cash flows from operating activities.

IncreaseDecreaseInUnearnedPremiums.d: Amount of increase (decrease) unearned premiums written. Excludes portion of unearned premiums amortized into income.

AssetsSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseMat.l: Repurchase Agreements and Similar Transactions, Maturity Periods [Axis]
AssetsSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseMat.d: Information by maturity period remaining for repurchase agreements and similar transactions, for example, but not limited to, securities lending arrangements. Element name and standard label in Maturity [numeric lower end] to [numeric higher end] [date measure] [Member] or Maturity Greater Than [low end numeric value] [date measure] [Member] or Maturity Less Than [high end numeric value] [date measure] [Member] formats.

AssetsSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseMat.l: Repurchase Agreements and Similar Transactions, Maturity Periods [Domain]
AssetsSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseMat.d: Maturity period remaining for repurchase agreements and similar transactions, for example, but not limited to, securities lending arrangements. Element name and standard label in Maturity [numeric lower end] to [numeric higher end] [date measure] [Member] or Maturity Greater Than [low end numeric value] [date measure] [Member] or Maturity Less Than [high end numeric value] [date measure] [Member] formats.

MaturityOvernightMember.d: Maturity period of the day after the reporting date for repurchase agreements and similar transactions, for example, but not limited to, securities lending arrangements.

Maturity30To90DaysMember.d: Maturity period that is more than 29 days but fewer than 91 days from the reporting date for repurchase agreements and similar transactions, for example, but not limited to, securities lending arrangements.

MaturityOver90DaysMember.d: Maturity period of over 90 days from the reporting date for repurchase agreements and similar transactions, for example, but not limited to, securities lending arrangements.

MaturityUpTo30DaysMember.d: Maturity period of up to 30 days from the reporting date for repurchase agreements and similar transactions, for example, but not limited to, securities lending arrangements.

MaturityOnDemandMember.d: Maturity period of on demand for repurchase agreements and similar transactions, for example, but not limited to, securities lending arrangements.

PensionAndOtherPostretirementAndPostempl.l: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Noncurrent [Abstract]

DebtOfSubsidiaryNotAssumed.d: Debt of a subsidiary that has not been assumed or guaranteed by the entity and any liens on premises of a subsidiary, or its consolidated subsidiaries, which have not been assumed by the entity, or its consolidated subsidiaries.

InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLiabilitie.l: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Withdrawal Penalties
InterestExpenseDomesticDepositLiabilitie.d: Early withdrawal penalties on domestic deposits which discourage customer withdrawal prior to maturity.

InventoryCashFlowPolicy.l: Inventory, Cash Flow Policy [Policy Text Block]
InventoryCashFlowPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for determining where the cash flows related to the sale of inventory are classified in the statements of cash flows and explain the nature of the receivables, notes, and loans.

GrandfatheredESOPExpenseRecognitionPolic.l: Grandfathered ESOP Expense Recognition, Policy [Policy Text Block]
GrandfatheredESOPExpenseRecognitionPolic.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for grandfathered ESOP shares acquired prior to January 1, 1993, including the method of measuring compensation, method of recognizing expense, the classification of dividends on ESOP shares, impact of the ESOP on the financial statements and the treatment of ESOP shares for earnings per share computations.

PublicUtilityRegulatedOrUnregulatedStatu.d: Information by status (regulated or unregulated) of the public utility.

GainLossOnSalesOfMortgageBackedSecuritie.l: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS)
GainLossOnSalesOfMortgageBackedSecuritie.d: Net gain (loss) resulting from the sales of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans (mortgages).

BusinessCombinationsBankPresentationAbst.l: Banking and Thrift, Premium, Discount, and Intangible Asset, Business Combination [Abstract]

BusinessAcquisitionsPurchasePriceAllocat.l: Banking and Thrift, Premium, Discount, and Intangible Asset, Year of Business Combination, Description
BusinessAcquisitionsPurchasePriceAllocat.d: Description of fair market value adjustment for premium, discount, and intangible asset; method of amortization of premium and intangible asset and accretion of discount; and estimated remaining life in year of business combination when asset of acquired entity exceed 10 percent of consolidated assets.

BusinessAcquisitionsPurchasePriceAllocat.l: Banking and Thrift, Premium, Discount, and Intangible Asset, Year of Business Combination, Income before Tax, Increase (Decrease)
BusinessAcquisitionsPurchasePriceAllocat.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in income before tax from accretion of discount (amortization of premium and intangible asset) in year of business combination when asset of acquired entity exceed 10 percent of consolidated assets.

BusinessAcquisitionsPurchasePriceAllocat.l: Banking and Thrift, Premium, Discount, and Intangible Asset, Year after Business Combination, Remaining Adjustment
BusinessAcquisitionsPurchasePriceAllocat.d: Amount of unamortized premium and intangible asset (unaccreted discount) remaining in year after business combination when total amount of remaining premium, intangible asset, and discount exceeds 30 percent of stockholders' equity.

PhaseInPlanAmountOfCapitalizedCostsRecov.l: Phase-in Plan, Amount of Capitalized Costs Recovered
PhaseInPlanAmountOfCapitalizedCostsRecov.d: The sum total amount of allowable costs capitalized in the period pertaining to a phase-in plan and previously capitalized costs that were recovered (recognized in earnings) during the period through rates.

ShortTermBankLoansAndNotesPayable.l: Short-Term Bank Loans and Notes Payable
ShortTermBankLoansAndNotesPayable.d: Amount of borrowings from a bank classified as other, maturing within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

ShortTermNonBankLoansAndNotesPayable.l: Short-Term Nonbank Loan and Note Payables
ShortTermNonBankLoansAndNotesPayable.d: Amount of borrowings from a creditor other than a bank with a maturity within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

ProceedsFromRefundsFromSuppliersOfMateri.l: Proceeds from Refunds from Suppliers of Material
ProceedsFromRefundsFromSuppliersOfMateri.d: Cash received for refunds from suppliers during the current period. This element includes refunds from suppliers of materials; it excludes refunds from providers of fixed assets.

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesDebtMaturitiesNe.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Maturity [Abstract]

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesDebtMaturitiesWi.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesDebtMaturitiesWi.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesDebtMaturitiesAf.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year One through Five
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesDebtMaturitiesAf.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesDebtMaturitiesAf.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 through 10
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesDebtMaturitiesAf.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesDebtMaturitiesAf.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 10
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesDebtMaturitiesAf.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesDebtMaturitiesWi.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Maturity, without Single Maturity Date
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesDebtMaturitiesWi.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) without single maturity date and not allocated over maturity grouping.

ScheduleOfComplianceWithRegulatoryCapita.l: Schedule of Compliance with Regulatory Capital Requirements under Banking Regulations [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfComplianceWithRegulatoryCapita.d: Tabular disclosure of the capital amounts and ratios as of the balance sheet date, indicating whether the entity or entities are in compliance with regulatory capital requirements, by entity.

ScheduleOfComplianceWithRegulatoryCapita.l: Banking Regulation, Regulatory Capital Requirement, Compliance [Table]
ScheduleOfComplianceWithRegulatoryCapita.d: Disclosure of information about compliance with regulatory capital requirement. Includes, but is not limited to, required and actual ratios and amount of regulatory capital.

ComplianceWithRegulatoryCapitalRequireme.l: Compliance with Regulatory Capital Requirements under Banking Regulations [Line Items]
ComplianceWithRegulatoryCapitalRequireme.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

DescriptionOfRegulatoryAssistance.d: Description of the nature and terms of regulatory assistance from a federal regulatory agency in conjunction with either an acquisition of a troubled financial institution, transfer of nonperforming assets to a newly-formed entity, or other reorganization.

PreferredStockValue.d: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

ConvertiblePreferredStockNonredeemableOr.l: Convertible Preferred Stock, Nonredeemable or Redeemable, Issuer Option, Value
ConvertiblePreferredStockNonredeemableOr.d: Value of outstanding nonredeemable convertible preferred stock or outstanding convertible preferred stock that is redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

CommonStockNumberOfSharesParValueAndOthe.l: Common Stock, Number of Shares, Par Value and Other Disclosure [Abstract]

PreferredStockNumberOfSharesParValueAndO.l: Preferred Stock, Number of Shares, Par Value and Other Disclosure [Abstract]

StockholdersEquityNumberOfSharesParValue.l: Stockholders' Equity, Number of Shares, Par Value and Other Disclosure [Abstract]

AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalConv.l: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Convertible Debt with Conversion Feature
AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalConv.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from recognition of deferred taxes for convertible debt with a beneficial conversion feature.

FullCostMethodOfAccountingForInvestments.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Property and Equipment [Text Block]
FullCostMethodOfAccountingForInvestments.d: The entire disclosure for oil and gas enterprises that follow the full cost method of accounting for investments in oil and gas properties.

AmortizationExpensePerUnitOfProductionTa.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Amortization Expense [Table]
AmortizationExpensePerUnitOfProductionTa.d: Disclosure of information about amortization expense per equivalent physical unit of production and per dollar of gross revenue from production for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

AmortizationExpensePerEquivalentUnitOfPr.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Amortization Expense [Line Items]
AmortizationExpensePerEquivalentUnitOfPr.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

AmortizationExpensePerPhysicalUnitOfProd.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Amortization Expense Per Unit of Production
AmortizationExpensePerPhysicalUnitOfProd.d: Amount of amortization expense per equivalent physical unit of production in oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

AmortizationExpensePerDollarOfGrossReven.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Amortization Expense Per Dollar of Gross Revenue
AmortizationExpensePerDollarOfGrossReven.d: Amount of amortization expense per dollar of gross revenue from production in oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

ScheduleOfAmortizationExpensePerUnitOfPr.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Amortization Expense [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfAmortizationExpensePerUnitOfPr.d: Tabular disclosure of amortization expense per unit of production for oil and gas enterprises that follow the full cost method of accounting for investments in oil and gas properties.

ScheduleOfCapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedProp.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfCapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedProp.d: Tabular disclosure of the capitalized costs of unproved properties and major development projects that are excluded from capitalized costs being amortized. This includes the total costs excluded and, at a minimum, these categories of costs: acquisition costs, exploration costs, development costs in the case of significant development projects, and capitalized interest.

CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedPropertiesExcl.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization [Table]
CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedPropertiesExcl.d: Disclosure of information about capitalized acquisition, exploration, and development costs and capitalized interest incurred and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

AcquisitionCosts.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Acquisition Cost, Period Cost
AcquisitionCosts.d: Amount of capitalized acquisition cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes exploration and development costs and capitalized interest.

ExplorationCosts.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Exploration Cost, Period Cost
ExplorationCosts.d: Amount of capitalized exploration cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and development costs and capitalized interest.

DevelopmentCosts.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Development Cost, Period Cost
DevelopmentCosts.d: Amount of capitalized development cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and exploration costs and capitalized interest.

ProductionCosts.l: Oil and Gas, Production Cost, Period Cost
ProductionCosts.d: Amount of capitalized production cost incurred during period for oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes cost incurred to operate and maintain well and related equipment and facility.

CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedPropertiesExcl.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization [Line Items]
CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedPropertiesExcl.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedPropertiesExcl.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Period Cost
CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedPropertiesExcl.d: Amount of capitalized acquisition, exploration, and development costs and capitalized interest incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedPropertiesExcl.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Period Cost [Abstract]

DescriptionOfCurrentStatusOfProject.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Property and Project, Description
DescriptionOfCurrentStatusOfProject.d: A description of the current status of the significant properties or projects involved that have been excluded from amortization because the existence of oil and gas reserves has not been proved.

AnticipatedTimingOfInclusionOfCostsInAmo.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Anticipated Timing of Cost Inclusion, Description
AnticipatedTimingOfInclusionOfCostsInAmo.d: The anticipated timing of the inclusion of the costs in the amortization computation.

OtherOperatingIncome.d: The total amount of other operating income, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

StockholdersEquityNoteSpinoffTransaction.d: The change in equity as a result of a spin-off transaction (a regular or reverse spin-off) which is based on the recorded amounts.

EffectsOfUsingCashFlowHedgesInCalculatin.l: Effects of Using Cash Flow Hedges in Calculating Ceiling Limitations [Table Text Block] (Deprecated 2024)
EffectsOfUsingCashFlowHedgesInCalculatin.d: Tabular disclosure of the effects of using cash flow hedges in calculating ceiling limitations for oil and gas producing companies subject to full cost rules.

UnamortizedCostsCapitalizedExceedCeiling.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost, Cost Center Ceiling Limitation [Abstract]

UnamortizedCostsCapitalizedLessRelatedDe.l: Unamortized Costs Capitalized Less Related Deferred Income Taxes Exceed Ceiling Limitations, Cost Center (Deprecated 2024)
UnamortizedCostsCapitalizedLessRelatedDe.d: The cost center for which unamortized costs capitalized less related deferred income taxes exceed the cost center ceiling limitation for oil and gas producing companies that use full cost method of accounting for investments in oil and gas producing properties.

UnamortizedCostsCapitalizedLessRelatedDe.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost in Excess of Cost Center Ceiling Limitation, Expense Not Charged, Description
UnamortizedCostsCapitalizedLessRelatedDe.d: If as of an entity's fiscal year-end, its capitalized costs exceed the limitation prescribed, but events occur subsequent to year end that if the full cost ceiling limitation were recomputed giving effect to those factors as of year end, the ceiling would more than cover the costs, and the excess was not charge against earnings, this disclosure would provide the explanation.

FullCostMethodUsingGrossRevenueMethodPol.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Amortization Expense Calculation Method, Gross Revenue [Policy Text Block]
FullCostMethodUsingGrossRevenueMethodPol.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for use of the gross revenue method in place of the full cost method of accounting. The policy may describe when the entity believes it is more appropriate due to economic circumstances to compute amortization of capitalized costs based on the gross revenue method (rather than the units of production method that would result in improper matching of costs to the related revenue).

EffectsOfCashFlowHedgesNotConsideredInCa.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Effect of Cash Flow Hedge, Not Charged to Income, Amount
EffectsOfCashFlowHedgesNotConsideredInCa.d: Amount that would have been charged to income had the effects of the cash flow hedges not been considered in calculating the ceiling limitation at an oil and gas producing company subject to the full cost rules.

CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostsAbstract.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost [Abstract]

DepositsForeign.d: The aggregate of all foreign interest-bearing and noninterest-bearing deposit liabilities.

DepositsForeignNoninterestBearingAndInte.l: Deposits, Foreign Noninterest-Bearing and Interest-Bearing Combined, Alternative [Abstract]

FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedA.l: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value [Abstract]

RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense.d: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income after deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

EnergyMarketingAccountsPayable.d: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for energy purchases, typically by a utility or an entity engaged in selling energy contracts.

CommonStockDividendsPerShareCashPaid.l: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
CommonStockDividendsPerShareCashPaid.d: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

OtherExpenses.d: Amount of expense classified as other.

EquipmentExpense.d: This element represents equipment expense including depreciation, repairs, rentals, and service contract costs. This item also includes equipment purchases which do not qualify for capitalization in accordance with the entity's accounting policy. This item may also include furniture expenses.

GuarantyAssets.d: The carrying amount of the contractual right to receive fees, as compensation in exchange for providing a guarantee to a third party, over life of the guarantee.

GuarantyLiabilities.d: This item represents a non-contingent liability for the fair value of an obligation to stand ready to perform over the term of a guaranty issued in the event that specified triggering events or conditions occur.

MortgageBackedSecuritiesHeldToMaturityFa.l: Debt Security, Mortgage-Backed, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value Disclosure
MortgageBackedSecuritiesHeldToMaturityFa.d: Fair value of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans classified as held-to-maturity.

MortgageBackedSecuritiesAvailableForSale.l: Debt Security, Mortgage-Backed, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value Disclosure
MortgageBackedSecuritiesAvailableForSale.d: Fair value of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans classified as available-for-sale.

USGovernmentAgenciesDebtSecuritiesMember.d: Debentures, notes, and other debt securities issued by US government agencies, for example, but not limited to, Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA or Ginnie Mae). Excludes US treasury securities and debt issued by government-sponsored Enterprises (GSEs), for example, but is not limited to, Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC or Freddie Mac), Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA or Fannie Mae), and the Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).

USGovernmentSponsoredEnterprisesDebtSecu.d: Debentures, bonds and other debt securities issued by US government sponsored entities (GSEs), for example, but not limited to, Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC or Freddie Mac), Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA or Fannie Mae), and the Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB). Excludes debt issued by the Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA or Ginnie Mae).

ScheduleOfFairValueOffBalanceSheetRisksT.l: Schedule of Fair Value, off-Balance-Sheet Risks [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfFairValueOffBalanceSheetRisksT.d: Tabular disclosure of the fair value of financial instruments (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined) which are not recognized in the financial statements (off-balance sheet) because they fail to meet some other criterion for recognition.

FairValueOffBalanceSheetRisksDisclosureI.l: Fair Value, off-Balance-Sheet Risks, Disclosure Information [Line Items]
FairValueOffBalanceSheetRisksDisclosureI.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

FederalFundsPurchasedMember.d: Short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank.

EmbeddedDerivativeFairValueOfEmbeddedDer.l: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative, Net [Abstract]

EmbeddedDerivativeGainLossOnEmbeddedDeri.l: Embedded Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Embedded Derivative, Net [Abstract]

DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedg.l: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain (Loss), Net [Abstract]

StartUpActivitiesCostPolicy.l: Start-up Activities, Cost Policy [Policy Text Block]
StartUpActivitiesCostPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for start-up costs. Start-up activities include those one-time activities related to opening a new facility, introducing a new product or service, conducting business in a new territory, conducting business with a new class of customer or beneficiary, initiating a new process in an existing facility, or commencing some new operation. Start-up activities include activities related to organizing a new entity (commonly referred to as organization costs).

CarryingValueOfFederalFundsSoldSecuritie.l: Federal Funds Sold, Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, and Deposit Paid for Security Borrowed [Abstract]

CarryingValueOfFederalFundsPurchasedSecu.l: Federal Funds Purchased, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Deposit Received for Security Loaned [Abstract]

LongTermDebtByComponentsCurrentAndNoncur.l: Long-Term Debt, by Type, Current and Noncurrent [Abstract]

ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTaxAbstract.l: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent [Abstract]

ScheduleOfFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAcq.l: Business Combination, Intangible Asset, Acquired, Finite-Lived [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAcq.d: Tabular disclosure of finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAcquiredAsPar.l: Business Combination, Intangible Asset, Acquired, Finite-Lived [Table]
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAcquiredAsPar.d: Disclosure of information about finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination.

ScheduleOfIndefiniteLivedIntangibleAsset.l: Business Combination, Intangible Asset, Acquired, Indefinite-Lived [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfIndefiniteLivedIntangibleAsset.d: Tabular disclosure of indefinite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination.

IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAcquiredA.l: Business Combination, Intangible Asset, Acquired, Indefinite-Lived [Table]
IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAcquiredA.d: Disclosure of information about indefinite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination.

ScheduleOfFairValueOffBalanceSheetRisksT.d: Disclosure of information about fair value of financial asset and liability not recognized in financial statement because of failure to meet criterion for recognition.

TimeDeposits.d: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit.

DefinedBenefitPlanSpecialOrContractualTe.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Special and Contractual Termination Benefits [Abstract]

PercentageRent.d: This element represents the rental revenue earned during the period from lessee-operators based on revenues generated in their operations, generally in excess of a base amount. Such rental revenue is generally stipulated in the lease agreement, usually will provide for a fixed percentage of revenue to be paid as additional (or possibly only) rent due the lessor, and may be based on gross revenues, net revenues, or multiple variations thereof. DeferredCostsLeasingNet.l: Deferred Initial Direct Cost, Lease, after Accumulated Amortization
DeferredCostsLeasingNet.d: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of deferred initial direct cost for lease.

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesInvestmentInNoncon.l: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Investment in Noncontrolled Affiliates
DeferredTaxLiabilitiesInvestmentInNoncon.d: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from investments in unconsolidated subsidiaries and investments in other affiliates which are not controlled nor consolidated.

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesZeroCouponNotes.l: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Zero Coupon Notes
DeferredTaxLiabilitiesZeroCouponNotes.d: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from investments in zero coupon (no stated interest) debt securities.

IncreaseDecreaseInReceivablesUnderRepurc.l: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables under Repurchase Agreements
IncreaseDecreaseInReceivablesUnderRepurc.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due the entity under agreements to sell and repurchase securities.

IncreaseDecreaseInSecuritiesBorrowed.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due the entity arising from securities borrowed transactions.

CapitalLeasesIndemnificationAgreementsPa.d: Amount of payments made under the terms of an indemnification agreement contained in a lease.

PropertyLeaseGuaranteeMember.d: A guarantee of performance by a third party lessee under terms of a lease agreement.

SuretySegmentMember.d: Contract providing insurance coverage for guarantee of performance.

DerivativeLiabilities.d: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesGrossGainsLosses.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Derivative, Cumulative Gain (Loss) [Abstract]

IncreaseDecreaseInPayablesUnderRepurchas.l: Increase (Decrease) in Payables under Repurchase Agreements
IncreaseDecreaseInPayablesUnderRepurchas.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability under agreements to repurchase securities that were sold.

IncreaseDecreaseInSecuritiesLoanedTransa.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability arising from securities loaned transactions.

DefinedBenefitPlanPensionMethodToDetermi.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Method to Determine Vested Benefit Obligation, Description
DefinedBenefitPlanPensionMethodToDetermi.d: Description of method used in determination of actuarial present value of vested benefits for defined benefit plan.

MinorityInterestDecreaseFromRedemptions.l: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Redemptions or Purchase of Interests
MinorityInterestDecreaseFromRedemptions.d: Decrease in noncontrolling interest (for example, but not limited to, redeeming or purchasing the interests of noncontrolling shareholders, issuance of shares (interests) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to the parent entity for other than cash, and a buyback of shares (interest) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary from the noncontrolling interests).

MinorityInterestChangeInRedemptionValue.l: Noncontrolling Interest, Change in Redemption Value
MinorityInterestChangeInRedemptionValue.d: Change in noncontrolling interest during the period as a result of a change in the redemption value of redeemable noncontrolling interest.

OtherIncome.d: Amount of revenue and income classified as other.

PrincipalOnlyStripMember.d: Tranche of a financial asset securitization that entitles the holder to receive some or all of the principal repayments collected on the underlying assets.

CommercialPaperNotIncludedWithCashAndCas.l: Commercial Paper, Not Included with Cash and Cash Equivalents [Member]
CommercialPaperNotIncludedWithCashAndCas.d: Unsecured promissory note (generally negotiable) that provides institutions with short-term funds that is excluded from cash and cash equivalents.

TimeSharingTransactionsDeferredProfit.d: Amount of deferred profit on time share sales.

TimeSharingTransactionsAggregateMaturiti.l: Time-Sharing Transactions, Aggregate Maturities of Notes Receivable, Gross [Abstract]

TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.l: Time-Sharing Transactions, Maturities of Notes Receivable, Net
TimeSharingTransactionsMaturitiesOfNotes.d: Amount of notes receivable related to time share sales, net of allowance for uncollectible accounts and deferred profit.

SecondaryMarketInvestorDomain.d: Secondary market investor imposing net worth requirement for mortgage banking entity.

ScheduleOfComplianceWithRegulatoryCapita.l: Banking Regulation, Mortgage Banking, Capital Requirement [Table]
ScheduleOfComplianceWithRegulatoryCapita.d: Disclosure of information about actual and required net worth for mortgage banking by secondary market investor and state-imposed regulatory mandate.

ScheduleOfComplianceWithRegulatoryCapita.l: Banking Regulation, Mortgage Banking, Capital Requirement [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfComplianceWithRegulatoryCapita.d: Tabular disclosure of required and actual net worth amounts for mortgage banking as defined by regulatory framework.

WithdrawalFromMultiemployerDefinedBenefi.l: Withdrawal from Multiemployer Defined Benefit Plan [Member]
WithdrawalFromMultiemployerDefinedBenefi.d: Obligation(s) resulting from employer withdrawal from a multiemployer 1) pension plan under circumstances that would give rise to an obligation or (b) other postretirement benefit plan under circumstances that would give rise to an obligation or an increase in the contribution to the fund during the remainder of the contract period to make up a shortfall necessary to fund the vested and negotiated benefits.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOther.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Other, before Accumulated Depreciation
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOther.d: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment; classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

DeferredCostsLeasingNetNoncurrent.d: This element represents costs incurred by the lessor that are (a) costs to originate a lease incurred in transactions with independent third parties that (i) result directly from and are essential to acquire that lease and (ii) would not have been incurred had that leasing transaction not occurred and (b) certain costs directly related to specified activities performed by the lessor for that lease. Those activities are: evaluating the prospective lessee's financial condition; evaluating and reco

DeferredCostsLeasingNetCurrent.d: This element represents costs incurred by the lessor that are (a) costs to originate a lease incurred in transactions with independent third parties that (i) result directly from and are essential to acquire that lease and (ii) would not have been incurred had that leasing transaction not occurred and (b) certain costs directly related to specified activities performed by the lessor for that lease. ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageLoansHeldForSa.d: The cash inflow from sales of loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherLoansHeldForSale.l: Proceeds from Sale, Loan, Other, Held-for-Sale
ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherLoansHeldForSale.d: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans (other than mortgage loans) that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

CreditCardIntermediaryReceivablesMember.d: Third-party credit card intermediaries, such as Visa and Mastercard.

IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsAndOtherReceiv.l: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts and Other Receivables
IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsAndOtherReceiv.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from customers for the credit sale of goods and services; includes accounts receivable and other types of receivables.

ProceedsFromCollectionOfMortgageLoansHel.l: Proceeds from Collection, Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale
ProceedsFromCollectionOfMortgageLoansHel.d: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansHeldForSale.d: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future; includes mortgages and other types of loans.

ProceedsFromCollectionOfOtherLoansHeldFo.l: Proceeds from Collection, Loan, Other, Held-for-Sale
ProceedsFromCollectionOfOtherLoansHeldFo.d: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future; includes loans that are not mortgages.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetOffMarketLease.l: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, off-Market Lease, Favorable, Gross
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetOffMarketLease.d: This element represents the identifiable intangible asset established upon acquisition based on a favorable difference between the terms of an acquired lease and the current market terms for that lease at the acquisition date.

OffMarketLeaseUnfavorable.d: This element represents a liability associated with the acquisition of an off-market lease when the terms of the lease are unfavorable to the market terms for the lease at the date of acquisition.

IncentiveToLessee.d: Amount of incentive granted by lessor to lessee.

IncentiveFromLessor.d: Amount of incentive received by lessee from lessor.

ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfLoansHeldFo.d: The cash inflow from securitizing loans held with the intention to resell in the near future.

AsbestosIssueMember.d: Individual or consolidated class action claims alleging that asbestos caused cancer or other illnesses to persons exposed to it.

DeferredSetUpCostsCurrent.d: Deferred incremental direct costs incurred typically at a contract's inception so that the company may be in a position to fulfill all contractual obligations of an arrangement. The costs are directly related to specified activities under the arrangement and are deferred in order to match revenue that will be recognized within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle if longer).

AmortizationOfDeferredLeasingFees.d: This element represents the amortization of deferred leasing fees incurred by the lessor and amortized over the term of the lease. Such fees represent (a) costs to originate a lease incurred in transactions with independent third parties that (i) result directly from and are essential to acquire that lease and (ii) would not have been incurred had that leasing transaction not occurred and (b) certain costs directly related to specified activities performed by the lessor for that lease. Those act

SecuritiesForReverseRepurchaseAgreements.d: The carrying value of securities purchased to be resold in reverse repurchase transactions as of the balance sheet date.

DeferredSubscriberAcquisitionCostsCurren.d: Costs deferred when a service provider provides incentives to third-party manufacturers or resellers to reduce the selling prices of specialized equipment in order to stimulate end-customer demand for the service provider's offerings.

DeferredSetUpCostsNoncurrent.d: Deferred incremental direct costs incurred typically at a contract's inception so that the company may be in a position to fulfill all contractual obligations of an arrangement. The costs are directly related to specified activities under the arrangement and are deferred in order to match revenue that will be recognized after one year from the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle if longer). Excludes start-up costs (such as one-time activities related to opening a new facility, introducing

DeferredSubscriberAcquisitionCostsNoncur.d: Costs deferred when a service provider gives incentives to third-party manufacturers or resellers to reduce the selling prices of specialized equipment in order to stimulate end-customer demand for the service provider's offerings.

GainLossOnInvestmentsTextBlock.d: Tabular disclosure of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in security.

ScheduleOfGainLossOnInvestmentsIncluding.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

MarketableSecuritiesGainLoss.d: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

ReserveForEnvironmentalCostsMember.d: Reserve for expected cost from environmental loss contingency.

LegalReserveMember.d: Reserve for expected cost from potential and pending litigation. Excludes statutory reserve for bank or insurance company.

ReserveForOffBalanceSheetActivitiesMembe.d: Reserve for obligation, contingent liability, and other exposure related to off-balance sheet arrangement, including, but not limited to, unfunded loan commitment, contractual obligation, recourse from loan securitized, and variable interest entity.

LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityNe.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Net, Fiscal Year Maturity [Abstract]

LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityGr.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Gross, Fiscal Year Maturity [Abstract]

LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityUn.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Undiscounted, to be Paid, Year One
LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityUn.d: Undiscounted amount of accrual for damage arising from third-party use of product or process to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityUn.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Undiscounted, to be Paid, Year Two
LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityUn.d: Undiscounted amount of accrual for damage arising from third-party use of product or process to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityUn.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Undiscounted, to be Paid, Year Three
LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityUn.d: Undiscounted amount of accrual for damage arising from third-party use of product or process to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityUn.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Undiscounted, to be Paid, Year Four
LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityUn.d: Undiscounted amount of accrual for damage arising from third-party use of product or process to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityUn.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Undiscounted, to be Paid, Year Five
LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityUn.d: Undiscounted amount of accrual for damage arising from third-party use of product or process to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityUn.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Undiscounted, to be Paid, after Year Five
LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityUn.d: Undiscounted amount of accrual for damage arising from third-party use of product or process to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityGr.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Gross
LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityGr.d: Undiscounted amount of the accrual for damages arising from third-party use of the entity's product or process.

LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityDi.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Discount
LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityDi.d: The amount of imputed interest necessary to reduce (reconcile) the estimated aggregate undiscounted amount of the accrual for damages arising from third-party use of the entity's product(s) or process(es) to the present value recognized on the balance sheet (if the accrual qualifies for discounting).

LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityNe.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Net
LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityNe.d: Present value of the estimated aggregate accrual for damages arising from third-party use of the entity's product(s) or process(es) as of the balance sheet date (if the accrual qualifies for discounting).

LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityNe.l: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Net, Explanation of Material Change in Accrual
LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityNe.d: Describes the nature or cause of a material change in the expected aggregate amount since the prior balance sheet date, other than a change resulting from pay-down of the obligation.

SiteContingencyManagementAssessmentProce.d: Describes management's process to evaluate the site contingency matter and to estimate the impact on the financial statements and ongoing operations.

ProceedsFromCollectionOfPolicyLoans.l: Proceeds from Collection of Policy Loans
ProceedsFromCollectionOfPolicyLoans.d: The cash inflow associated with the collection of policy loans receivable.

PaymentsToFundPolicyLoans.d: The initial funding or additional funding of loans receivable to policy holders principally secured by the benefits under the policy.
