DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets, Noncurrent
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

ProductLiabilityAccrualComponentAmount.d: Recorded amount of the accrual for a material component of a product liability contingency.

RegistrationPaymentArrangementGainsAndLo.l: Registration Payment Arrangement, Gains and Losses

UncertaintyContinuedMarketabilityOfGoods.l: Uncertainty, Continued Marketability of Goods and Services (Deprecated 2025)

GoodFaithAndMarginDepositsWithBrokerDeal.l: Good Faith and Margin Deposit with Broker-Dealer
GoodFaithAndMarginDepositsWithBrokerDeal.d: Amount of right to receive cash and securities on deposit with broker-dealers to demonstrate an intention to complete a purchase (good faith deposit) and collateral deposited by counterparty to cover the credit risk assumed (margin deposit).

CommissionsAndFloorBrokerageReceivables.d: Amount receivable from broker-dealers from commissions for executing orders on the floor of an exchange.

OtherReceivablesFromBrokerDealersAndClea.l: Other Receivable from Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
OtherReceivablesFromBrokerDealersAndClea.d: Amount of other receivables due from broker-dealers or clearing organizations.

SecuritiesFailedToDeliver.d: Amount receivable as the result of a fail-to-deliver. A fail-to-deliver is a securities sale to another broker-dealer that has not been delivered to buying broker-dealer by the close of business on the settlement date.

SecuritiesFailedToReceive.d: Amount payable as the result of fail-to-receive. A fail-to-receive is a securities purchase from another broker-dealer not received from the selling broker-dealer by the close of business on the settlement date.

CommissionsPayableToBrokerDealersAndClea.l: Commission Payable to Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
CommissionsPayableToBrokerDealersAndClea.d: Amount payable to broker-dealers or clearing organizations for executing or clearing trades or orders.

OtherPayablesToBrokerDealersAndClearingO.l: Other Payable to Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization
OtherPayablesToBrokerDealersAndClearingO.d: Amount of other payables due to broker-dealers or clearing organizations.

PayablesToBrokerDealersAndClearingOrgani.l: Broker-Dealer, Payable to Other Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization [Abstract]

ReceivablesFromBrokersDealersAndClearing.l: Receivable from Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization [Abstract]

OtherSecuredFinancings.d: Secured financing other than securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

RetailLandSalesInstallmentMethodSalesVal.l: Retail Land Sales, Installment Method, Sales Value (Deprecated 2026)
RetailLandSalesInstallmentMethodSalesVal.d: Amount of sales related to retail land transactions accounted for under the installment method.

DefinedBenefitPlanEstimatedFutureEmploye.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Next Fiscal Year, Description
DefinedBenefitPlanEstimatedFutureEmploye.d: Description of contribution expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, range of expected contributions, required minimum contribution and whether expected contribution is discretionary or noncash.

InterestExpenseAllocatedToDiscontinuedOp.l: Interest Expense Allocated to Discontinued Operation [Policy Text Block]
InterestExpenseAllocatedToDiscontinuedOp.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for allocating interest on borrowing to discontinued operation.

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesParentsBasisInDisc.l: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Parent's Basis in Discontinued Operation
DeferredTaxLiabilitiesParentsBasisInDisc.d: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from the entity's basis in a discontinued operation.

LossContingencyPartiesJointlyAndSeverall.l: Loss Contingency, Parties Jointly and Severally Liable in Litigation
LossContingencyPartiesJointlyAndSeverall.d: Identifies individuals or entities that are co-defendants in a lawsuit, and who may have to pay all or a portion of any damages awarded.

DisposalGroupDeferredGainOnDisposal.l: Disposal Group, Deferred Gain on Disposal (Deprecated 2026)
DisposalGroupDeferredGainOnDisposal.d: The excess amount received or due over net assets in a transaction accounted for as a divestiture where a subsidiary, business or operating assets are "sold" by the entity to a newly formed, thinly capitalized, highly leveraged buyer. This gain is not yet recognized and is disclosed on the balance sheet as an offset against the carrying amount of the securities received.

OperatingAndBroadcastRightsMember.d: Legal claim or title to operate as a broadcaster and broadcast radio or television signals on a particular spectrum of airwave. Broadcast rights may also refer to the license granted to televise a particular event, such as a sporting event.

UseRightsMember.d: Legal right to use or benefit from the use of natural resources or access. Examples include, but are not limited to, drilling rights, water rights, air rights, timber cutting rights and route authorities.

PatentedTechnologyMember.d: Exclusive legal right granted by the government to the owner of the patented technology to exploit the technology for a period of time specified by law.

CustomerContractsMember.d: Entity's established relationships with its customers through contracts.

ArtisticRelatedIntangibleAssetsMember.d: Artistic-related assets that arise from contractual or legal rights such as those provided by copyright. Include, but are not limited to, plays, operas, ballets, books, magazines, newspapers, other literary works, musical works such as compositions, song lyrics, advertising jingles, pictures, photographs, video and audiovisual material including motion pictures or films, music videos, and television programs.

PrincipalInvestmentGainsLosses.d: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss), from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, and includes, but is not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

RetailLandSalesInstallmentMethodTotalCos.l: Retail Land Sales, Installment Method, Cost of Sales (Deprecated 2026)
RetailLandSalesInstallmentMethodTotalCos.d: Cost of sales related to retail land sales transactions accounted for under the installment method.

RetailLandSalesInstallmentMethodGrossPro.l: Retail Land Sales, Installment Method, Gross Profit, Deferred (Deprecated 2026)
RetailLandSalesInstallmentMethodGrossPro.d: Amount of deferred gross profit, realized on retail land sale transaction accounted for under the installment method.

RetailLandSalesInstallmentMethodGrossPro.l: Retail Land Sales, Installment Method, Gross Profit, Deferred [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

RetailLandSalesDepositMethodSalesContrac.l: Retail Land Sales, Deposit Method, Sales Contract Disclosure [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

RetailLandSalesDepositMethodPropertyCarr.l: Retail Land Sales, Deposit Method, Property Carrying Value (Deprecated 2026)
RetailLandSalesDepositMethodPropertyCarr.d: This element represents the carrying value, net of accumulated deprecation, as of the date of the statement of financial position of a property sold during the reporting period, but which sale is accounted for under the deposit method and, therefore, which property continues to be included in the statement of financial position.

RetailLandSalesDepositMethodDepositRecei.l: Retail Land Sales, Deposit Method, Deposit Received (Deprecated 2026)
RetailLandSalesDepositMethodDepositRecei.d: This element represents the amount of deposit received in a retail land sale transaction accounted for under the deposit method.

IncreaseDecreaseInRetailRelatedInventori.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of merchandise inventory held by a retailer, wholesaler, or distributor for future sale; includes packaging and other supplies used to store, transport, or present merchandise inventory.

IncreaseDecreaseInFinishedGoodsAndWorkIn.l: Increase (Decrease) in Finished Goods and Work in Process Inventories
IncreaseDecreaseInFinishedGoodsAndWorkIn.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of finished goods inventory and work in process inventory.

IncreaseDecreaseInOtherFinancialInstrume.l: Increase (Decrease) in Other Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities
IncreaseDecreaseInOtherFinancialInstrume.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value of other financial instruments used in operating activities.

PaymentGuaranteeMember.d: A contract that contingently requires the guarantor to make payments (either in cash, financial instrument, other assets, shares of its stock, or provision of services) to the guaranteed party based on changes in an underlying that is related to an asset, a liability, or an equity security of the guaranteed party.

AccountsReceivableMember.d: Due from customers or clients for goods or services that have been delivered or sold.

NotesReceivableMember.d: An amount representing an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the Entity (holder) a definite sum of money at a future date(s) within one year of the balance sheet date. Such amount may include accrued interest receivable in accordance with the terms of the note. The note also may contain provisions including a discount or premium, payable on demand, secured, or unsecured, interest bearing or noninterest bearing, among myriad other features and characteristics.

PremiumsReceivableMember.d: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due the entity from (a) agents and insureds, (b) uncollected premiums and (c) others.

EquityMethodInvestmentsMember.d: Investment in the stock of an investee which is adjusted for the investor's share of the earnings or losses of the investee after the date of acquisition.

DerivativeFinancialInstrumentsAssetsMemb.d: Financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, with notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset.

LoansReceivableMember.d: Amount of money and property lent to borrower in exchange for promise to repay amount borrowed plus interest at date certain in future.

CashSurrenderValueMember.d: Cash that could be realized under a life insurance contract or contracts owned by the Company (for example, but not limited to corporate-owned life insurance (COLI) or bank-owned life insurance (BOLI)).

RetainedInterestMember.d: This item represents the interest continued to be held by a transferor (retained or residual interest) after transferring financial assets to a third party.

InvestmentInFederalHomeLoanBankStockMemb.l: Investment in Federal Home Loan Bank Stock [Member]
InvestmentInFederalHomeLoanBankStockMemb.d: This item represents the amount shown on an entity's books for investments in Federal Home Loan Bank stock.

FederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesBorrowedOrP.l: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Borrowed or Purchased under Agreements to Resell [Member]
FederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesBorrowedOrP.d: Federal funds sold and securities borrowed or purchased under agreements to resell.

AccountsPayableMember.d: Obligations incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received.

BorrowingsMember.d: Obligations to pay to another in accordance with an expressed or implied agreement.

ObligationsMember.d: Obligation, including, but not limited to, short-term and long-term debt and finance lease obligation.

SubordinatedDebtObligationsMember.d: Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment and ahead of general creditors in a liquidation of the entity's assets.

TradingLiabilitiesMember.d: Liability for principal and customer trading transactions incurred from short-term fluctuation in price in market-making, hedging, and proprietary trading. Includes, but is not limited to, short position in security, derivative, and commodity, obligation under repurchase agreement, and security borrowed arrangement.

FederalFundsPurchasedAndSecuritiesSoldUn.l: Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase [Member]
FederalFundsPurchasedAndSecuritiesSoldUn.d: Short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank and securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

SecuritiesLoanedOrSoldUnderAgreementsToR.l: Securities Loaned or Sold under Agreements to Repurchase [Member]
SecuritiesLoanedOrSoldUnderAgreementsToR.d: The amount of securities that an institution sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price, net of any reductions or offsets.

FederalHomeLoanBankBorrowingsMember.d: This item represents the amount that a bank with insufficient reserves borrows, from the Federal Home Loan Bank [system], to meet its reserve requirements.

InvestmentContractsMember.d: Guarantee by insurance entity to contract holder for specified rate of return on investment for specified period.

DerivativeFinancialInstrumentsLiabilitie.d: This item represents derivative instrument obligations meeting the definition of a liability which are reported as of the balance sheet date. Derivative instrument obligations are generally measured at fair value, and adjustments to the carrying amount of hedged items reflect changes in their fair value (that is, losses) that are attributable to the risk being hedged and that arise while the hedge is in effect.

CommitmentsMember.d: This element represents significant arrangements with third parties, which includes operating lease arrangements and arrangements in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services, or has agreed to commit resources to supply goods or services, and operating lease arrangements.

GuaranteesMember.d: A guaranty by which one person assumes responsibility for paying another's debts or fulfilling another's responsibilities; or a promise, pledge, assurance, especially one given in writing, that attests: (a) to the quality or durability of a product or service; (b) that something will be performed in a specified manner; or (c) that execution, completion, or existence of something is as represented or stipulated by agreement.

MandatorilyRedeemablePreferredStockMembe.d: Preferred shares that an entity is required to redeem for cash or other assets at a fixed or determinable date or upon the occurrence of an event.

SecuritiesSoldNotYetPurchasedMember.d: Proprietary securities transactions entered into by the entity (broker-dealer) for trading or investment purposes.

ProductLiabilityContingenciesTextBlock.d: Tabular disclosure of exposure to material amount of loss arising from allegations of damages pertaining to and arising from one or more of the entity's products.

ProductLiabilityContingencyLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ProductLiabilityContingencyDescription.d: Describes the damages allegedly caused by appropriate use of the product, such as death from a drug and injury from a toy, which the damaged party reasonably believed was attributable to dangers for which no warning or inadequate warning was provided, such as defects in labeling, construction, and inappropriate (impurities in) processing.

ProductLiabilityContingencyAccrualAssump.d: Describes the important assumptions underlying the estimate of the product liability loss, and may describe any changes in the assumptions made since the last reporting period.

ProductLiabilityContingencyIndicationAcc.l: Product Liability Contingency, Indication Accrual May Change (Deprecated 2025)
ProductLiabilityContingencyIndicationAcc.d: Disclosure that it is reasonably possible that a change in an estimate of the obligation will occur in the near term when information available prior to issuance of the financial statements indicates that it is at least reasonably possible that the product liability accrual estimate will change due to one or more future confirming events.

ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureN.l: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Description
ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureN.d: Nature of the reasonably possible allegations of damages and estimate of the loss exposure for product liability for which no accrual has been recorded.

ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureN.l: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Best Estimate
ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureN.d: Best estimate of the loss exposure for a reasonably possible liability for product liability damages for which no accrual has been recorded.

ProductLiabilityContingencyManagementAss.l: Product Liability Contingency, Management Assessment Process (Deprecated 2024)
ProductLiabilityContingencyManagementAss.d: Describes management's process to evaluate allegations of damages pertaining to a product and to estimate the impact on the financial statements and ongoing operations.

ProductLiabilityContingencyCircumstances.l: Product Liability Contingency, Circumstances Impacting Precision of Estimate
ProductLiabilityContingencyCircumstances.d: Circumstances affecting the reliability and precision of damages estimates for a specified product.

ProductLiabilityContingencyFactorsChangi.l: Product Liability Contingency, Factors Changing Estimate (Deprecated 2025)
ProductLiabilityContingencyFactorsChangi.d: Factors that may cause a change in an estimate of a loss that exceeds: the amount accrued for the contingency, a recognized asset for third-party recoveries, an estimated loss contingency that has not been accrued, or a disclosed gain contingency.

ProductLiabilityContingencyAccrualDiscou.l: Product Liability Contingency, Accrual, Discount Rate
ProductLiabilityContingencyAccrualDiscou.d: Rate applied to the undiscounted amount of estimated damages for product liability to arrive at the present value recorded as of the balance sheet date.

ProductLiabilityContingencyAccrualPresen.l: Product Liability Contingency, Accrual, Present Value (Deprecated 2024)
ProductLiabilityContingencyAccrualPresen.d: Present value of the accrual for product liability loss contingencies as of the balance sheet date (if the accrual qualifies for discounting).

ProductLiabilityContingencyUnassertedCla.d: Extent to which unasserted claims are reflected in an accrual or may affect the magnitude of the product liability contingency.

ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureN.l: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Third-Party Recovery Commentary
ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureN.d: Describes the extent to which disclosed but not recognized contingent losses from product liability damages are expected to be recoverable through insurance, indemnification arrangements, or other sources, and any material limitations of that recovery.

ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureI.l: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure in Excess of Accrual, Best Estimate
ProductLiabilityContingencyLossExposureI.d: Best estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for damages pertaining to a specified product.

ProductLiabilityContingencyUncertainties.l: Product Liability Contingency, Uncertainties from Joint and Several Liability
ProductLiabilityContingencyUncertainties.d: Uncertainties with respect to joint and several liability that may affect the magnitude of the contingency.

ProductLiabilityContingencyTimeFrameOfDi.l: Product Liability Contingency, Time Frame of Disbursements (Deprecated 2024)
ProductLiabilityContingencyTimeFrameOfDi.d: Estimated time frame of disbursements over which the accrued or presently unrecognized amounts may be paid out for damages pertaining to a specified product.

ProductLiabilityContingencyUncertainties.l: Product Liability Contingency, Uncertainties from Insurance
ProductLiabilityContingencyUncertainties.d: Uncertainties with respect to the legal sufficiency of insurance claims or the solvency of carriers for product liability damages.

IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredLeasingFees.l: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Initial Direct Cost, Lease
IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredLeasingFees.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred initial direct cost for lease.

DefinedBenefitPlanWeightedAverageAssetAl.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Actual Allocation, Percentage
DefinedBenefitPlanWeightedAverageAssetAl.d: Percentage of actual investment allocation to total plan assets. Includes, but is not limited to, percentage on weighted-average basis if more than one plan.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DescriptionOfLesseeLeasingArrangementsOp.l: Description of Lessee Leasing Arrangements, Operating Leases (Deprecated 2026)
DescriptionOfLesseeLeasingArrangementsOp.d: A general description of the nature of the existing leasing arrangements of a lessee for all operating leases including, but not limited to: (1) rental escalation clauses; (2) renewal or purchase options; (3) guarantees or indemnities, if any, (4) restrictions imposed by lease arrangements; (5) unusual provisions or conditions; (6) contingent rentals, if any; and (7) lease expiration dates.

IncreaseDecreaseInMortgageLoansHeldForSa.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of mortgage loan held with intention to sell or be securitized in near future.

NontraditionalLongDurationContractsMembe.d: Primarily annuity and life products having nontraditional terms. Some of these products combine fixed and variable features and are sold as general account or separate account products.

AdditionalPaidInCapitalMember.d: Excess of issue price over par or stated value of the entity's capital stock and amounts received from other transactions involving the entity's stock or stockholders.

AccumulatedNetUnrealizedInvestmentGainLo.l: AOCI, Accumulated Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Parent [Member]
AccumulatedNetUnrealizedInvestmentGainLo.d: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeMembe.d: Accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, attributable to the parent. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

AccumulatedTranslationAdjustmentMember.l: Accumulated Foreign Currency Adjustment Attributable to Parent [Member]
AccumulatedTranslationAdjustmentMember.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) resulting from foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to the parent.

AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.l: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment Attributable to Parent [Member]
AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.d: Accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss related to defined benefit plans attributable to the parent.

EquityComponentDomain.d: Components of equity are the parts of the total Equity balance including that which is allocated to common, preferred, treasury stock, retained earnings, etc.

ForeignCurrencyContractAssetFairValueDis.l: Foreign Currency Contract, Asset, Fair Value Disclosure
ForeignCurrencyContractAssetFairValueDis.d: Fair value portion of asset contracts related to the exchange of different currencies, including, but not limited to, foreign currency options, forward contracts, and swaps.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Tax Liabilities
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as deferred tax liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

ShareBasedCompensationSharesAuthorizedUn.l: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Lower Range Limit
ShareBasedCompensationSharesAuthorizedUn.d: The floor of a customized range of exercise prices for purposes of disclosing shares potentially issuable under outstanding stock option awards on all stock option plans and other required information pertaining to awards in the customized range.

PaymentsForMergerRelatedCosts.d: The amount of cash paid during the reporting period for charges associated with the mergers.

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMat.l: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMat.d: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

ProceedsFromShortTermDebtMaturingInThree.l: Proceeds from Short-Term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
ProceedsFromShortTermDebtMaturingInThree.d: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

RepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturingInThree.l: Repayments of Short-Term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
RepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturingInThree.d: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMat.l: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less, Alternative [Abstract]
Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months, Alternative [Abstract]

ProceedsFromShortTermDebtMaturingInMoreT.l: Proceeds from Short-Term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
ProceedsFromShortTermDebtMaturingInMoreT.d: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

RepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturingInMoreT.l: Repayments of Short-Term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
RepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturingInMoreT.d: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMat.l: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMat.d: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

RestructuringCostsAndAssetImpairmentChar.l: Restructuring Costs and Asset Impairment Charges [Abstract]
Restructuring Costs and Asset Impairment Charges
RestructuringCostsAndAssetImpairmentChar.d: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan and expenses resulting from the write-down of assets. Excludes expenses related to a business combination, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

CapitalExpendituresIncurredButNotYetPaid.l: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
CapitalExpendituresIncurredButNotYetPaid.d: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

ConstructionInProgressExpendituresIncurr.l: Construction in Progress Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
ConstructionInProgressExpendituresIncurr.d: Future cash outflow to pay for construction in progress expenditures that have occurred.

MalpracticeLossContingencyClaimsIncurred.l: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Claims Incurred in Period
MalpracticeLossContingencyClaimsIncurred.d: Amount of loss recognized for asserted and unasserted malpractice claims.

EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.l: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure [Abstract]
Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Employer Loan, Description
EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.d: Sets forth the terms of the arrangement, including interest rate and repayment requirements, in which the employer lends funds to the ESOP. The loan amount is not required to be externally reported.

EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.l: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Direct Loan, Description
EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.d: Description of the terms of a loan made to the ESOP by a lender other than the employer, including interest rate and repayment requirements, and description of any guarantee of debt repayment made by the employer to the lender.

EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.l: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Direct Loan, Amount
EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.d: The amount reported as a liability as of the balance sheet date by the entity (the employer) of the loan made by a third-party lender directly to the ESOP.

EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.l: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Indirect Loan, Description
EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.d: Description of the terms of a loan, including interest rate and repayment requirements, made by a third-party lender to the employer relating to loans made by the employer to the ESOP, and description of any guarantee of debt repayment made by the employer to the lender.

EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.l: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Indirect Loan, Amount
EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.d: The amount reported as a liability as of the balance sheet date by the entity (the employer) of the loan made by a third-party lender to the employer relating to loans made by the employer to the ESOP.

EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.l: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Employer Loan Guarantee
EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.d: Reflects the amount as of the balance sheet date of the employer's guarantee of debt repayment by the ESOP.

EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.l: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Direct Loan, Employer Cash Payments Used for Debt Service
EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPDebtStruct.d: The amount of cash provided by the employer through contributions or dividends that the ESOP used in the period to repay debt and interest on a third-party loan made directly to the ESOP.

AccumulatedNetGainLossFromDesignatedOrQu.l: Accumulated Net Gain (Loss) from Cash Flow Hedges Attributable to Parent [Member] (Deprecated 2025)
AccumulatedNetGainLossFromDesignatedOrQu.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) resulting from gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges, attributable to the parent.

NetIncomeLossAllocatedToGeneralPartners.l: Net Income (Loss) Allocated to General Partners
NetIncomeLossAllocatedToGeneralPartners.d: Aggregate amount of net income allocated to general partners.

NetIncomeLossAllocatedToLimitedPartners.l: Net Income (Loss) Allocated to Limited Partners
NetIncomeLossAllocatedToLimitedPartners.d: Aggregate amount of net income allocated to limited partners.

EarningsPerGeneralPartnershipUnitAbstrac.l: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding General Partnership Unit, Net of Tax [Abstract]

WeightedAverageGeneralPartnershipUnitsOu.l: Weighted Average General Partnership Units Outstanding
WeightedAverageGeneralPartnershipUnitsOu.d: Weighted average number of general partnership units outstanding determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that general partnership units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

EarningsPerLimitedPartnershipUnitAbstrac.l: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax [Abstract]

IncreaseDecreaseInPostemploymentObligati.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the current portion of the liability that represents various benefits due to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement.

GeneralPartnersSpecialEarningsAllocation.d: The aggregate cumulative amount of earnings allocated to general partners as a result of a non-recurring event (for example, a one-time settlement).

EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPPolicy.l: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Policy [Policy Text Block]
EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for ESOP transactions, including the method of measuring compensation, the classification of dividends on ESOP shares, and the treatment of ESOP shares for EPS computations. If the employer has both old ESOP shares for which it does not adopt new guidance and new ESOP shares for which new guidance is required, these disclosures are required for both blocks of shares.

EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPMethodOfMe.l: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Method of Measuring Compensation (Deprecated 2025)
EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPMethodOfMe.d: Describes the methods used in determining compensation expense to be recognized by the entity pertaining to its ESOP.

EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPClassifica.l: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Classification of Dividends (Deprecated 2025)
EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPClassifica.d: Describes the entity's reporting of dividends on ESOP shares. For unallocated shares, describe the reduction of debt, reduction of accrued interest payable, or the increase of compensation cost. For allocated shares, describe the charge to retained earnings.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Exercise Price
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: The per share price that the individual must pay to acquire shares under the deferred compensation arrangement.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Fair Value of Shares Issued
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: The total fair value of shares issued during the period under a deferred compensation arrangement.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Term, Simplified Method
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Discloses use of the simplified method to calculate the expected term that stock option awards under the specified plan will exist before being exercised or terminated, the reason and justification for its use, and the periods for which the method was used if it was not used in all periods presented.

FairValueConcentrationOfRiskForeignCurre.l: Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Foreign Currency Contract, Asset
FairValueConcentrationOfRiskForeignCurre.d: Fair value of derivative asset for foreign currency contract subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

LeveragedLeasesNetInvestmentInLeveragedL.l: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Investment Tax Credit Receivable
LeveragedLeasesNetInvestmentInLeveragedL.d: This element represents the receivable for the amount of the investment tax credit to be realized on the leveraged lease transaction.

ScheduleOfDeferredCompensationArrangemen.l: Schedule of Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Excluding Share-Based Payments and Postretirement Benefits by Title of Individual and Type of Deferred Compensation [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfDeferredCompensationArrangemen.d: Tabular disclosure of arrangements with individual employees that are not equity-based payments or pensions and other postretirement benefits, which are generally employment contracts between the entity and selected officers or key employees containing a promise by the employer to pay certain amounts at designated future dates, usually including a period after retirement, upon compliance with stipulated requirements. This type of arrangement is distinguished from broader based employee benefit p

ScheduleOfDeferredCompensationArrangemen.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Excluding Share-Based Payment and Postretirement Benefit [Table]
ScheduleOfDeferredCompensationArrangemen.d: Disclosure of information about arrangements that are not equity-based payments, or pension and other postretirement benefits, with individual employees. The arrangements (for example, profit sharing, deferred bonuses or certain split-dollar life insurance arrangements) are generally based on employment contracts between the entity and one or more selected officers or key employees, and which contain a promise by the employer to pay certain amounts at designated future dates, sometimes including

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Description
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Description of terms of share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, type of award or grantee and reason for issuance.

ShareBasedCompensationSharesAuthorizedUn.l: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Beginning of Period [Abstract]
Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, End of Period [Abstract]

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Excluding Share-Based Payments and Postretirement Benefits [Line Items]
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Postretirement Benefits [Line Items]
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ScheduleOfDeferredCompensationArrangemen.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Postretirement Benefit [Table]
ScheduleOfDeferredCompensationArrangemen.d: Disclosure of information about pension and other postretirement benefit arrangement between employer and individual employee with promise by employer to pay certain amount at future date. Includes, but is not limited to, amount of compensation expense recognized and amount of liability.

GeneralPartnersShareOfUndistributedEarni.l: General Partner's Share of Undistributed Earnings, Incentive Distribution Right Embedded in General Partner Interest (Deprecated 2026)
GeneralPartnersShareOfUndistributedEarni.d: Amount of undistributed earnings allocated to the general partner (as if the undistributed earnings were available cash) when the incentive distribution right is embedded in the general partner's interest. Depending on the structure of the master limited partnership, the incentive distribution right may be a separate class of non-voting limited partner interest that the general partner holds but generally may sell of transfer apart from its overall interest.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Bonus and Profit Sharing Arrangements, Individual Contracts, Type of Deferred Compensation [Axis]
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Information by type of deferred compensation that is not equivalent to a defined benefit pension plan or a defined benefit other postretirement benefit plan. Includes, but is not limited to, employment contracts with one or more selected officers or key employees. Excludes equity-based compensation plans, defined benefit pension plans and defined benefit other postretirement benefit plans.

DeferredCompensationExcludingShareBasedP.l: Deferred Compensation, Excluding Share-Based Payments and Retirement Benefits [Member]
DeferredCompensationExcludingShareBasedP.d: Deferred compensation arrangements that are neither equity-based payments, nor pension and other postretirement benefits, with individual employees. The arrangements (for example, profit sharing, deferred bonus, certain rabbi trusts, perquisites, postemployment benefits, and certain split-dollar life insurance arrangements) are generally based on employment contracts between the entity and one or more selected officers or key employees, which contain a promise by the employer to pay certain amou

DeferredProfitSharingMember.d: An arrangement whereby an employee is entitled to receive in the future, subject to vesting and other restrictions, a share in the profits, as defined in the agreement, of the entity or portion thereof. Employer contributions may be discretionary or may be based on a fixed formula related to profits, compensation, or other factors. It is a form of incentive compensation to employees in addition to their regular salary and bonuses.

DeferredBonusMember.d: Contractual arrangement whereby employee is entitled to receive future bonus, subject to vesting and other restrictions as defined in agreement, in addition to employee's regular salary and profit sharing. Includes, but is not limited to, discretionary or fixed formula employer contribution based on individual, group, and entity-wide performance goals or other factors.

DeferredCompensationShareBasedPaymentsMe.d: Deferred compensation arrangements (such as stock or unit options and share or unit awards) that are equity-based payments with individual employees. The arrangements are generally based on employment contracts between the entity and one or more selected officers or key employees, and contain a promise by the employer to pay certain amounts or benefits at designated future dates, upon compliance with stipulated requirements. This type of arrangement is distinguished from broader based employee b

EmployeeStockOptionMember.d: Share-based payment arrangement granting right, subject to vesting and other restrictions, to purchase or sell certain number of shares at predetermined price for specified period of time.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, by Type of Compensation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits [Member]
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Deferred compensation arrangement providing pension or other postretirement benefits, to employee or their beneficiary, that are not equivalent to defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPostretirementLifeInsuranc.d: Plan designed to provide postretirement life insurance benefits to retiree or beneficiary. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

DefinedBenefitPostretirementHealthCovera.d: Plan designed to provide postretirement health benefits to retiree or beneficiary. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

GroupPoliciesMember.d: Contract consisting of insurance coverage issued to organization to provide benefit to more than one individual.

IndividualPoliciesMember.d: Contract consisting of insurance coverage issued to individual.

ShareBasedGoodsAndNonemployeeServicesTra.l: Share-Based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Valuation Method, Expected Volatility Rate (Deprecated 2024)
ShareBasedGoodsAndNonemployeeServicesTra.d: The estimated measure of the percentage amount by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during the expected term of a nonvested share or option award issued to other than an employee.

ShareBasedGoodsAndNonemployeeServicesTra.l: Share-Based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Valuation Method, Expected Dividend Rate (Deprecated 2024)
ShareBasedGoodsAndNonemployeeServicesTra.d: The estimated dividend rate (a percentage of the share price) to be paid (expected dividends) to holders of the underlying shares over the expected term of a nonvested share or option award issued to other than an employee.

ShareBasedGoodsAndNonemployeeServicesTra.l: Share-Based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Valuation Method, Risk Free Interest Rate (Deprecated 2024)
ShareBasedGoodsAndNonemployeeServicesTra.d: The risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing a nonvested share or option award issued to other than an employee.

RealizedInvestmentGainsLosses.d: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment.

PolicyholderFunds.d: Amount due to policyholder. Includes, but is not limited to, unpaid policy dividend, retrospective refund, and undistributed earnings on participating business. Excludes future policy benefit and claim expense.

PaidInKindInterest.d: Interest paid other than in cash for example by issuing additional debt securities. As a noncash item, it is added to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

DeferredOfferingCosts.d: Specific incremental costs directly attributable to a proposed or actual offering of securities which are deferred at the end of the reporting period.

ShareBasedGoodsAndNonemployeeServicesTra.l: Share-Based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Shares Approved for Issuance (Deprecated 2024)
ShareBasedGoodsAndNonemployeeServicesTra.d: The maximum number of shares (or other type of equity) that have been approved for issuance in the equity-based payment transaction.

OneTimeTerminationBenefitsMember.d: A lump sum payment to an involuntarily terminated employee in conjunction with exit or disposal activities.

ForeignExchangeAndOtherDerivativeFinanci.l: Foreign Exchange and Other Derivative Financial Instruments [Member] (Deprecated 2024)
ForeignExchangeAndOtherDerivativeFinanci.d: This element represents revenue from foreign exchange and from investments in other derivative financial instruments.

IncreaseDecreaseToSubordinatedLiabilitie.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

SubordinatedLiabilitiesAdditions.d: New liabilities assumed during the reporting period that are subordinated to claims of general creditors.

SubordinatedLiabilitiesExtinguished.d: Liabilities that are subordinated to claims of general creditors and were paid or extinguished during the reporting period.

LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.l: Long-Term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power, Interest Included in Contract Charges
LongTermContractForPurchaseOfElectricPow.d: The allocable portion of interest included in charges under a long-term contract to purchase electric power.

ExciseTaxesCollected.d: The excise taxes collected by a public utility and reported in revenues if the amount of excise taxes is equal to 1 percent or more of such total.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Operating Income (Loss)
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount of operating income (loss) attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

LoansHeldForSaleFairValueDisclosure.d: Fair value portion of loans held-for-sale including, but not limited to, mortgage loans and finance receivables.

SpecialTerminationBenefitsMember.d: Special benefits offered to employees to terminate employment.

HealthCareOrganizationStopLossInsuranceP.l: Health Care Organization, Stop Loss Insurance Premium Expense
HealthCareOrganizationStopLossInsuranceP.d: Stop-loss insurance premiums recognized as expense. In stop-loss insurance, prepaid health care providers or associated entities transfer portions of their financial risks to other companies. A provider typically contracts to recover health care costs in excess of stated amounts during the contract periods.

HealthCareOrganizationContractAcquisitio.l: Health Care Organization, Contract Acquisition Expense
HealthCareOrganizationContractAcquisitio.d: Costs associated with marketing of subscriber contracts and member enrollments. For example, commissions paid to agents or brokers and incentive compensation based on new enrollments. Includes also salaries of the marketing director and staff, general marketing brochures, and general advertising and promotion expenses.

HealthCareOrganizationHealthCareCostsGro.d: Total expenses of a HCO before stop-loss insurance recoveries. Costs of services rendered (including costs of services rendered but not yet reported).

HealthCareOrganizationStopLossInsuranceR.l: Health Care Organization, Stop Loss Insurance Recoveries
HealthCareOrganizationStopLossInsuranceR.d: Amount of stop-loss insurance recoveries. In stop-loss insurance, prepaid health care providers or associated entities transfer portions of their financial risks to other companies. A provider typically contracts to recover health care costs in excess of stated amounts during the contract periods.

HealthCareOrganizationExpensesNet.d: Total costs of health care costs, net of recoveries of stop-loss insurance. Costs of services rendered (including costs of services rendered but not yet reported).

ProductLiabilityContingencyTable.d: Disclosure of information about product liability contingency arising from reasonably possible loss from liability related to individual product.

LoansAcquiredAccountedForAsDebtSecuritie.l: Loans Acquired, Accounted for as Debt Securities, Disclosure [Abstract]
Loans Acquired, Accounted for as Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity Category [Abstract]
Loans Acquired, Accounted for as Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale Category [Abstract]
Loans Acquired, Accounted for as Debt Securities, General Items [Abstract]

LitigationSettlementExpense.d: Amount of litigation expense, including but not limited to legal, forensic, accounting, and investigative fees.

LegalCostsPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for legal costs incurred to protect or defend the entity's assets and rights, or to obtain assets, including monetary damages, or to obtain rights.

MortgagesHeldForSaleFairValueDisclosure.l: Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale, Fair Value Disclosure
MortgagesHeldForSaleFairValueDisclosure.d: Fair value portion of mortgage loans held-for-sale.

JuniorSubordinatedDebentureOwedToUnconso.l: Junior Subordinated Debenture Owed to Unconsolidated Subsidiary Trust
JuniorSubordinatedDebentureOwedToUnconso.d: Including the current and noncurrent portions, the carrying value of junior subordinated long-term debt owed to unconsolidated subsidiary trusts as of the balance sheet date. Such debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets and was initially scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

OtherRealEstateAndForeclosedAssetsAbstra.l: Other Real Estate, Foreclosed Assets, and Repossessed Assets [Abstract]

OtherRealEstateAndForeclosedAssets.l: Other Real Estate, Foreclosed Assets, and Repossessed Assets
OtherRealEstateAndForeclosedAssets.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of other real estate and foreclosed assets. Other real estate may include real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. Foreclosed assets include all assets obtained in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement through foreclosure proceedings.

DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOperationLos.l: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Loss (Gain) on Write-down
DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOperationLos.d: Amount, before tax, of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Additional Disclosures [Abstract]

RealEstateAndAccumulatedDepreciationInit.l: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Initial Cost [Abstract]

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: For presentations that combine terminations, the number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan or that expired.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Weighted average price of options that were either forfeited or expired.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Intrinsic Value
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: The combined weighted average of the accumulated differences between the fair values on underlying shares and exercises prices to acquire such shares as of the grant date on options that were either forfeited or lapsed.

CommonStockNoParValue.d: Face amount per share of no-par value common stock.

DefinedBenefitPlanRecognizedNetGainLossD.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Settlement and Curtailment [Abstract]

ShortTermDebtTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for short-term debt.

FederalReserveBankAdvancesMember.d: Borrowings from the Federal Reserve Bank, which are primarily used to cover shortages in the required reserve balance and also in times of liquidity shortages.

LongTermDebtTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for long-term debt.

LandImprovements.d: Amount before accumulated depreciation and depletion of additions or improvements to real estate held for productive use. Examples include, but are not limited to, walkways, driveways, fences, and parking lots.

AccountsAndNotesReceivableNetAbstract.l: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss [Abstract]

AccountsAndNotesReceivableNet.l: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
AccountsAndNotesReceivableNet.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivable. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

ReceivableFromOfficersAndDirectorsForIss.l: Receivable from Officers and Directors for Issuance of Capital Stock
ReceivableFromOfficersAndDirectorsForIss.d: Amounts receivable from officers and directors resulting from the sale of stock to officers or directors before the cash payment is received.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Profits [Abstract]

MovementAnalysisOfDeferredPolicyAcquisit.l: Movement Analysis of Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Profits [Roll Forward]
MovementAnalysisOfDeferredPolicyAcquisit.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Addition
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.d: Amount of addition in deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Period Increase (Decrease)
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncenti.l: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Excluding Option Exercised
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncenti.d: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes option exercised.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeFinalizationOfPe.l: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Adjustment for Settlement or Curtailment Gain (Loss), Tax
OtherComprehensiveIncomeFinalizationOfPe.d: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

Communication.d: The amount of expense incurred in the period for communication, which is the exchange of information by several methods.

InformationTechnologyAndDataProcessing.d: The amount of expenses incurred in the period for information technology and data processing products and services.

SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpensesP.l: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses, Policy [Policy Text Block]
SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpensesP.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for inclusion of significant items in the selling, general and administrative (or similar) expense report caption.

IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsRollForwa.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsWrittenOf.d: Amount of decrease in indefinite-lived intangible asset from divestiture. Excludes goodwill.

IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTranslati.l: Intangible Asset, Indefinite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation and Measurement Period Adjustments
IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTranslati.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in indefinite-lived intangible asset from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments. Excludes goodwill.

IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsPeriodInc.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

CashFDICInsuredAmount.d: The amount of cash deposited in financial institutions as of the balance sheet date that is insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.

CashUninsuredAmount.d: The amount of cash as of the balance sheet date that is not insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.

FederalReserveBankStock.d: Federal Reserve Bank stock represents an equity interest in the Federal Reserve Bank. It does not have a readily determinable fair value because its ownership is restricted and it lacks a market (liquidity).

FederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesPurchasedUn.l: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Parenthetical Disclosure [Abstract]
Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell Pledged as Collateral
FederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesPurchasedUn.d: The fair value of federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell that serve as collateral for borrowings.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueNewIssues.l: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueNewIssues.d: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCo.l: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCo.d: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmployeeStoc.l: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmployeeStoc.d: Aggregate change in value for stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock purchase plan.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmployeeStoc.l: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmployeeStoc.d: Aggregate value of stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedSt.l: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures [Abstract]
Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedSt.d: Aggregate value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedSt.l: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedSt.d: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards forfeited during the period.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedSt.l: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedSt.d: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period, net of the stock value of such awards forfeited.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueAcquisitions.l: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Acquisitions
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueAcquisitions.d: Value of stock issued pursuant to acquisitions during the period.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStockOptions.l: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Options Exercised
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStockOptions.d: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConversionOf.l: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConversionOf.d: The gross value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStockDividen.l: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Dividend
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStockDividen.d: Value of stock issued to shareholders as a dividend during the period.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueDividendRein.l: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueDividendRein.d: Value of stock issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the holder of the stock to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodVa.l: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Value
StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodVa.d: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased and retired during the period. The excess of the purchase price over par value can be charged against retained earnings (once the excess is fully allocated to additional paid in capital).

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues.l: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, New Issues
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues.d: Number of new stock issued during the period.

ReplacementReserveEscrow.d: This element represents those amounts set aside for the repair and replacement of real or personal property in the foreseen future. Such amount may be funded from sales revenue (for example; timeshare sales) or operating revenues; in a lump sum or installments (such as monthly); as per internal policy (for example: hotel operators), as required by contractual agreement (for example: sales contract); or by the terms of debt agreements.

LeasesAcquiredInPlaceMember.d: This element represents the amount of value allocated by a lessor (acquirer) to lease agreements which exist at acquisition of a leased property. Such amount may include the value assigned to tenant relationships and excludes the market adjustment component of the value assigned for above or below-market leases acquired.

LeasesAcquiredInPlaceMarketAdjustmentMem.d: This element represents the identifiable intangible asset or liability established for an assumed above or below-market lease acquired in an acquisition. Such asset or liability is established regardless of whether the acquiree is the lessee or the lessor.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetAcquiredInPlac.d: This element represents the amount of value allocated by a lessor (acquirer) to lease agreements which exist at acquisition of a leased property. Such amount may include the value assigned to existing tenant relationships and excludes the market adjustment component of the value assigned for above or below-market leases acquired.

SecurityDepositLiability.d: This element represents money paid in advance to protect the provider of a product or service, such as a lessor, against damage or nonpayment by the buyer or tenant (lessee) during the term of the agreement. Such damages may include physical damage to the property, theft of property, and other contractual breaches. Security deposits held may be interest or noninterest bearing.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedC.l: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedC.d: Number, after forfeiture, of shares or units issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes shares or units issued under employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeSto.l: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Purchase Plans
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeSto.d: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of an employee stock purchase plan.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedS.l: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures [Abstract]
Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedS.d: Total number of shares issued during the period, including shares forfeited, as a result of Restricted Stock Awards.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedS.l: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeited
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedS.d: Number of shares related to Restricted Stock Award forfeited during the period.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedS.l: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedS.d: Number of shares issued during the period related to Restricted Stock Awards, net of any shares forfeited.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesAcquisition.l: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Acquisitions
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesAcquisition.d: Number of shares of stock issued during the period pursuant to acquisitions.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockOption.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockOption.d: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesConversionO.l: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Convertible Securities
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesConversionO.d: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of the conversion of convertible securities.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesDividendRei.l: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesDividendRei.d: Number of shares issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the shareholders to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockSplits.l: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Stock Splits
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockSplits.d: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of a stock split.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesReverseStoc.l: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Reverse Stock Splits
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesReverseStoc.d: Reduction in the number of shares during the period as a result of a reverse stock split.

StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodSh.l: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Shares
StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodSh.d: Number of shares that have been repurchased and retired during the period.

TreasuryStockSharesAcquired.d: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and are being held in treasury.

AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalAbst.l: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital [Abstract]

RecoverableVacationPayMember.d: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of costs incurred for employee vacation.

AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalDivi.l: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Dividends in Excess of Retained Earnings
AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalDivi.d: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from dividends legally declared (or paid) in excess of retained earnings balance.

ProceedsFromDistributionOfRestrictedCash.l: Proceeds from Distribution of Restricted Cash from Pollution Control Bond
ProceedsFromDistributionOfRestrictedCash.d: The cash inflow from amounts received from distributions of restricted cash from pollution control bond, which is a debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

PaymentsForInvestmentInRestrictedCashFro.l: Payments for Investment in Restricted Cash from Pollution Control Bond
PaymentsForInvestmentInRestrictedCashFro.d: The cash outflow for investments in restricted cash from pollution control bond, which is a debt security issued by a state, certain agencies or authorities, a local government, or development corporation to finance the construction of air- or water-pollution control facilities or sewage or solid waste disposal facilities pursuant to federal law. The bonds are backed by the credit of the beneficiary of the financing rather than the credit of the issuer.

CapitalUnitsMember.d: Type of ownership interest in a corporation. Class of capital units or capital shares.

CommonStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInCapi.l: Common Stock Including Additional Paid in Capital [Member]
CommonStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInCapi.d: Common stock held by shareholders with par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value (in cases of no-par value stock).

PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInC.l: Preferred Stock Including Additional Paid in Capital [Member]
PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInC.d: Preferred stock held by shareholders with par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value (in cases of no-par value stock).

ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossRealiz.l: Realized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax
ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossRealiz.d: Amount, before tax, of realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToCon.l: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Conversion of Preferred Stock
IncrementalCommonSharesAttributableToCon.d: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of convertible preferred stock using the if-converted method.

OtherInventoriesSpareParts.d: Gross amount of components of assembled products that can be sold directly or indirectly through sales of assembled products.

InventoryNetItemsNetOfReserveAlternative.l: Inventory, Net, Items Net of Reserve Alternative [Abstract]

InventoryFinishedGoodsAndWorkInProcessNe.l: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Net of Reserves [Abstract]

InventoryFinishedGoodsNetOfReserves.l: Inventory, Finished Goods, Net of Reserves
InventoryFinishedGoodsNetOfReserves.d: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods held by the company that are readily available for sale.

InventoryWorkInProcessNetOfReserves.l: Inventory, Work in Process, Net of Reserves
InventoryWorkInProcessNetOfReserves.d: Carrying amount, net of reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or goods which are partially completed. This inventory is generally comprised of raw materials, labor and factory overhead costs, which require further materials, labor and overhead to be converted into finished goods, and which generally require the use of estimates to determine percentage complete and pricing.

InventoryFinishedGoodsAndWorkInProcessNe.l: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Net of Reserves
InventoryFinishedGoodsAndWorkInProcessNe.d: The aggregated amount of merchandise or goods held by the entity and readily available for future sale plus items held by the entity which are partially complete or in the process of being readied for future sale. This amount is net of valuation reserves and adjustments.

InventoryRawMaterialsAndSuppliesNetOfRes.l: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Net of Reserves [Abstract]

InventoryRawMaterialsNetOfReserves.l: Inventory, Raw Materials, Net of Reserves
InventoryRawMaterialsNetOfReserves.d: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of unprocessed items to be consumed in the manufacturing or production process.

InventorySuppliesNetOfReserves.d: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of products used directly or indirectly in the manufacturing or production process, which may or may not become part of the final product. May also include items used in the storage, presentation or transportation of physical goods.

InventoryRawMaterialsAndSuppliesNetOfRes.l: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Net of Reserves
InventoryRawMaterialsAndSuppliesNetOfRes.d: Aggregated amount of unprocessed materials to be used in manufacturing or production process and supplies that will be consumed. This amount is net of valuation reserves and adjustments.

InventoryWorkInProcessAndRawMaterialsNet.l: Inventory, Work in Process and Raw Materials, Net of Reserves
InventoryWorkInProcessAndRawMaterialsNet.d: The aggregate carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of items which are partially completed at the time of measurement and unprocessed items that will go through the production process and become part of the final product. This element may be used when the reporting entity combines work in process and raw materials into an aggregate amount.

InventoryRawMaterialsAndPurchasedPartsNe.l: Inventory, Raw Materials and Purchased Parts, Net of Reserves
InventoryRawMaterialsAndPurchasedPartsNe.d: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of items purchased for use as components of a finished product or pieces of machinery and equipment plus any items in their natural and unrefined state. This element may be used when the reporting entity combines raw materials and purchased parts into an aggregate amount.

InventoryPartsAndComponentsNetOfReserves.l: Inventory, Parts and Components, Net of Reserves
InventoryPartsAndComponentsNetOfReserves.d: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date for elements of machinery or equipment held for the purpose of replacing similar parts in the course of repair or maintenance.

OtherInventoryNetOfReserves.d: Amount, after of valuation reserves and allowances, of inventory, classified as other, expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

AccumulatedDeferredInvestmentTaxCredit.d: The noncurrent portion of the reserve for accumulated deferred investment tax credits as of the balance sheet date. This is the remaining investment credit, which will reduce the cost of services collected from ratepayers by a ratable portion over the investment's regulatory life.

LiabilityForUncertainTaxPositionsCurrent.l: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Current
LiabilityForUncertainTaxPositionsCurrent.d: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as current.

LiabilityForUncertainTaxPositionsNoncurr.l: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Noncurrent
LiabilityForUncertainTaxPositionsNoncurr.d: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as noncurrent.

StockholdersEquityPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for its capital stock transactions, including dividends and accumulated other comprehensive income.

DeferredRevenueLeasesCurrent.d: Amount of deferred lease income, classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, amount paid in advance by lessee.

DeferredRevenueLeasesNetNoncurrent.l: Deferred Lease Income, after Accumulated Amortization, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2026)
DeferredRevenueLeasesNetNoncurrent.d: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of deferred lease income, classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, amount paid in advance by lessee.

DeferredRevenueLeasesAccumulatedAmortiza.d: Amount of accumulated amortization of deferred lease income.

RetainedEarningsAppropriatedMember.d: Accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) not available for dividend distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, retained earnings appropriated for specific business purpose.

RetainedEarningsUnappropriatedMember.d: Accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) available for dividend distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, retained earnings not appropriated for specific business purpose.

CommitmentsAndContingenciesPolicyTextBlo.l: Commitments and Contingencies, Policy [Policy Text Block]
CommitmentsAndContingenciesPolicyTextBlo.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for commitments and contingencies, which may include policies for recognizing and measuring loss and gain contingencies.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesPeriodIncre.l: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Period Increase (Decrease)
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesPeriodIncre.d: The increase (decrease) during the period in the number of shares issued.

DeferredFinanceCostsGross.d: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

AccumulatedAmortizationDeferredFinanceCo.d: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs.

DeferredCostsLeasingNetAbstract.l: Deferred Initial Direct Cost, Lease, after Accumulated Amortization [Abstract]

DeferredCostsLeasingGross.l: Deferred Initial Direct Cost, Lease, before Accumulated Amortization
DeferredCostsLeasingGross.d: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of deferred initial direct cost for lease.

DeferredCostsLeasingAccumulatedAmortizat.l: Deferred Initial Direct Cost, Lease, Accumulated Amortization
