DeferredCostsLeasingAccumulatedAmortizat.d: Amount of accumulated amortization of deferred initial direct cost for lease.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeSto.l: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeSto.d: Number of shares of capital stock issued (purchased by employees) in connection with an employee stock ownership plan.

LeveragedLeaseInvestment.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of leveraged lease investments which represent the aggregate amount of the estimated residual value of the lease assets and lease payments receivables, net of unearned and deferred income to be allocated over the lease term and non-recourse debt.

DevelopedTechnologyRightsMember.d: Rights to developed technology, which can include the right to develop, use, market, sell, or offer for sale products, compounds, or intellectual property.

UnamortizedDebtIssuanceExpense.d: The remaining balance of debt issuance expenses that were capitalized and are being amortized against income over the lives of the respective bond issues. This does not include the amounts capitalized as part of the cost of the utility plant or asset.

CashDistributionMember.d: Distribution of cash made by the entity based on a contractual agreement such as a partnership or employment agreement.

OtherLiabilitiesDisclosureTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for other liabilities.

MortgageBackedSecuritiesIssuedByUSGovern.l: Mortgage-Backed Security, Issued by US Government-Sponsored Enterprise [Member]
MortgageBackedSecuritiesIssuedByUSGovern.d: Debt security collateralized by real estate mortgage loan issued by U.S. government-sponsored enterprise (GSE), including, but not limited to, Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC or Freddie Mac), Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA or Fannie Mae), and Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

MortgageBackedSecuritiesIssuedByPrivateE.l: Mortgage-Backed Securities, Issued by Private Enterprises [Member]
MortgageBackedSecuritiesIssuedByPrivateE.d: Debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans (mortgages), issued by non-governmental sponsored enterprises.

CashDividendsPaidToParentCompanyByConsol.l: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, Consolidated Subsidiaries
CashDividendsPaidToParentCompanyByConsol.d: This element represents disclosure of the aggregate cash dividends paid to the entity by consolidated subsidiaries.

CashDividendsPaidToParentCompanyByUncons.l: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, Unconsolidated Subsidiaries
CashDividendsPaidToParentCompanyByUncons.d: This element represents disclosure of the aggregate cash dividends paid to the entity by unconsolidated subsidiaries.

CashDividendsPaidToParentCompanyBy50Perc.l: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, 50 Percent or Less Owned Persons
CashDividendsPaidToParentCompanyBy50Perc.d: This element represents disclosure of the aggregate cash dividends paid to the entity by 50 percent or less owned persons accounted for using the equity method.

CashDividendsPaidToParentCompany.l: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, Subsidiaries and Equity Method Investees
CashDividendsPaidToParentCompany.d: This element represents disclosure of the total aggregate cash dividends paid to the entity by consolidated subsidiaries, by unconsolidated subsidiaries, and by 50 percent or less owned persons accounted for using the equity method.

CashDividendsPaidToParentCompanyAbstract.l: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, Subsidiaries and Equity Method Investees [Abstract]

UnbilledRevenuesMember.d: Unbilled amounts due for services rendered or products shipped. This element is distinct from unbilled contracts receivables because this is based on noncontract transactions.

RegulatoryClauseRevenuesUnderRecoveredMe.d: Rate action of a regulator resulting in capitalization or accrual of under-recovered regulatory clause revenue.

NuclearFuelNetOfAmortization.d: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet of nuclear fuel held as property plant and equipment. This amount is net of amortization based on the energy produced over the life of the fuel.

StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodValue.d: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased during the period and has not been retired and is not held in treasury. Some state laws may mandate the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodShares.d: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and have not been retired and are not held in treasury. Some state laws may govern the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

ReceivableWithImputedInterestDescription.d: The description of the receivable with imputed interest.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConversionOf.l: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Units
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConversionOf.d: Value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesConversionO.l: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Units
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesConversionO.d: The number of shares issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

IncreaseDecreaseInPensionAndPostretireme.l: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
IncreaseDecreaseInPensionAndPostretireme.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

IncreaseDecreaseInPensionAndPostretireme.l: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits [Abstract]

NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholde.l: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholde.d: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

DilutiveSecuritiesAbstract.l: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share [Abstract]

AmountOfDilutiveSecuritiesStockOptionsAn.l: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share, Options and Restrictive Stock Units
AmountOfDilutiveSecuritiesStockOptionsAn.d: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise of stock options or restrictive stock units (RSUs).

AmountOfDilutiveSecuritiesESOPConvertibl.l: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share, ESOP Convertible Preferred Stock
AmountOfDilutiveSecuritiesESOPConvertibl.d: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise of convertible preferred stock of an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

DilutiveSecurities.l: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share
DilutiveSecurities.d: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise stock options, restrictive stock units (RSUs), convertible preferred stock of an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), and other dilutive convertible securities.

NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholde.l: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted [Abstract]

EquityMethodInvestmentsIssuancesPolicy.l: Equity Method Investments Issuances, Policy [Policy Text Block]
EquityMethodInvestmentsIssuancesPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for income statement treatment of issuances of stock by an equity method investee.

StockRedeemedOrCalledDuringPeriodValue.l: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Value
StockRedeemedOrCalledDuringPeriodValue.d: Equity impact of the value of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

PaymentOfFinancingAndStockIssuanceCostsA.l: Payment of Financing and Stock Issuance Costs [Abstract]

PaymentOfFinancingAndStockIssuanceCosts.l: Payment of Financing and Stock Issuance Costs
PaymentOfFinancingAndStockIssuanceCosts.d: The total of the cash outflow during the period which has been paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt and the cost incurred directly for the issuance of equity securities.

CollaborativeArrangementDisclosureTextBl.d: The entire disclosure for collaborative arrangements in which the entity is a participant, including a) information about the nature and purpose of such arrangements; b) its rights and obligations thereunder; c) the accounting policy for collaborative arrangements; and d) the income statement classification and amounts attributable to transactions arising from the collaborative arrangement between participants.

CollaborativeArrangementNatureAndPurpose.d: Description of nature and purpose of collaborative arrangements.

CollaborativeArrangementRightsAndObligat.d: Description of rights and obligations under the collaborative arrangements.

CollaborativeArrangementAccountingPolicy.l: Collaborative Arrangement, Accounting Policy [Policy Text Block]
CollaborativeArrangementAccountingPolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for collaborative arrangements.

ComprehensiveIncomeMember.d: The change in equity (net assets) of a business enterprise during a period from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources. It includes all changes in equity during a period except those resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

DividendsPayableDateOfRecordDayMonthAndY.d: Date the holder must own the stock to be entitled to the dividend, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

InventoryShrinkagePolicy.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for inventory shortages, shrinkage, damaged goods, and defective goods.

DividendsPayableNature.d: Describes the declaration as being a special dividend (over and above the normal dividend); as the annual, semi-annual, quarterly dividend, or other normal periodic dividend; or as some other type of dividend.

InterestOnConvertibleDebtNetOfTax.l: Interest on Convertible Debt, Net of Tax
InterestOnConvertibleDebtNetOfTax.d: Amount, after tax, of interest recognized on convertible debt instrument excluding interest on principal required to be paid in cash.

ConvertiblePreferredDividendsNetOfTax.l: Convertible Preferred Dividends, Net of Tax
ConvertiblePreferredDividendsNetOfTax.d: The after-tax amount of any dividends on convertible preferred stock.

NoncashContributionExpense.d: Noncash charitable contributions made by the entity during the period.

IncomeTaxRefundsDiscontinuedOperations.d: The amount of cash received during the period as refunds for the overpayment of taxes from discontinued operations.

InterestPaidDiscontinuedOperations.d: The amount of cash paid during the current period for interest owed on debt associated with discontinued operations.

GainLossOnContractTermination.d: Gain (loss) related to the termination of a contract between the parties. The termination may be due to many causes including early termination of a lease by a lessee, a breach of contract by one party, or a failure to perform.

AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalStoc.l: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Issuance Costs
AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalStoc.d: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from direct costs associated with issuing stock. Includes, but is not limited to, legal and accounting fees and direct costs associated with stock issues under a shelf registration.

CostsAndExpenses.d: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

IncreaseDecreaseInRetainagePayable.d: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in retainage obligations due by the reporting entity that are payable within one year (or one business cycle).

AllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionI.l: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Investing Activities
AllowanceForFundsUsedDuringConstructionI.d: Cash inflow due to change during the period in the allowance for other funds used during construction classified as an investing activity.

FixturesAndEquipmentGross.d: Amount before accumulated depreciation of fixtures and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, machinery, equipment, and engines.

SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.l: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount, Current
SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.d: The amount that is required to be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if as of the reporting date, the holder of the share has exercised the right to or the shares are mandatorily redeemable within one year of the reporting date or operating cycle, if longer.

SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.l: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount, Noncurrent
SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.d: The amount that is required to be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if as of the reporting date, the holder of the share has exercised the right to or the shares are mandatorily redeemable after one year from the reporting date or operating cycle, if longer.

SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.l: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount [Abstract]

AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalIncr.l: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalIncr.d: Amount of decrease (increase) in additional paid in capital (APIC) for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock.

IncreaseInCarryingAmountOfRedeemablePref.l: Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
IncreaseInCarryingAmountOfRedeemablePref.d: Adjustment to retained earnings for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock that is classified as temporary equity.

PaymentsForCapitalImprovements.d: The cash outflow for acquisition of or capital improvements to properties held for investment (operating, managed, leased) or for use.

CashAndSecuritiesSegregatedUnderFederalA.l: Cash and Securities Segregated under Federal and Other Regulations Disclosures [Abstract]

DeferredRevenueLeasesNetNoncurrentAbstra.l: Deferred Lease Income, after Accumulated Amortization, Noncurrent [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

DeferredRevenueLeasesGrossNoncurrent.l: Deferred Lease Income, before Accumulated Amortization, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2026)
DeferredRevenueLeasesGrossNoncurrent.d: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of deferred lease income, classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, amount paid in advance by lessee.

DeferredRevenueLeasesGross.l: Deferred Lease Income, before Accumulated Amortization (Deprecated 2026)
DeferredRevenueLeasesGross.d: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of deferred lease income. Includes, but is not limited to, amount paid in advance by lessee.

DeferredRevenueLeasesNet.l: Deferred Lease Income, after Accumulated Amortization (Deprecated 2026)
DeferredRevenueLeasesNet.d: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of deferred lease income. Includes, but is not limited to, amount paid in advance by lessee.

DeferredRevenueLeasesNetAbstract.l: Deferred Lease Income, after Accumulated Amortization [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Other Postretirement Benefits, Individual Contracts, Type of Deferred Compensation [Axis]
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Information by type of deferred compensation related to other postretirement benefit arrangements that are not equivalent to a defined benefit other postretirement benefit plan. Includes, but is not limited to, employment contracts with one or more selected officers or key employees. Excludes equity-based compensation plans, defined benefit pension plans and defined benefit other postretirement benefit plans.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Equity-Based Arrangements, Individual Contracts, Type of Deferred Compensation [Axis]
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Information by type of deferred compensation related to equity-based payment arrangements. Includes, but is not limited to, employment contracts with one or more selected officers or key employees. Excludes broad group equity-based compensation plans, defined benefit pension plans, defined benefit other postretirement benefit plans and other deferred compensation that is not equivalent to a defined benefit pension plan or a defined benefit other postretirement benefit plan.

LossFromCatastrophes.d: The charge against earnings in the period for the uninsured portion of a loss from a fire, explosion, or natural disaster (hurricane, earthquake).

ProductLiabilityAccrualPeriodExpense.d: The amount of loss reported during the period pertaining to product liability.

ScenarioAdjustmentMember.d: Domain member used to indicate figures that are adjustments during a period or as of a point in time. This domain member would never be expected to appear in a relationship group without the "Scenario, Previously Reported" Member with the same parent.

PreferredUnitsPreferredPartnersCapitalAc.l: Preferred Units, Preferred Partners' Capital Accounts [Abstract]

GeneralAndLimitedPartnersCapitalAccountA.l: General and Limited Partners' Capital Account [Abstract]

PreferredUnitsDescriptionAndOtherDisclos.l: Preferred Units Description and Other Disclosure [Abstract]

CashFlowNoncashInvestingAndFinancingActi.l: Cash Flow, Noncash Investing and Financing Activities Disclosure [Abstract]

InterestExpenseJuniorSubordinatedDebentu.d: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on junior subordinated debentures. Includes amortization of expenses incurred in the issuance of subordinated notes and debentures.

UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.l: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Description
UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.d: Describes the nature of an unconditional purchase obligation that is not recognized as a liability on the balance sheet.

UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.l: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation
UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.d: Amount of unrecorded obligation to transfer funds in future for fixed or minimum amount or quantity of product and service at fixed or minimum price. Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced and take-or-pay and throughput contracts.

TreasuryStockValueAcquiredParValueMethod.l: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Par Value Method
TreasuryStockValueAcquiredParValueMethod.d: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the par value method.

TreasuryStockValueAcquiredCostMethod.l: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Cost Method
TreasuryStockValueAcquiredCostMethod.d: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the cost method.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding [Roll Forward]
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Period Increase (Decrease)
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: The increase or decrease in number of shares reserved for issuance under stock option agreements awarded under the plan that validly exist and are outstanding, including vested options.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Grant Date Intrinsic Value
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: The grant-date intrinsic value of options granted during the reporting period as calculated by applying the disclosed option pricing methodology.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Additional Disclosures [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Number of Shares [Roll Forward]
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Period Increase (Decrease)
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: The net total number of shares (or other type of equity) under an equity-based award plan, other than a stock option plan, that were granted, vested and forfeited during the reporting period.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Additional Disclosures [Abstract]

PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansReceivable.d: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with purchase (sale or collection) of loans receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

OtherNoncashIncomeTaxExpense.d: The portion of the noncash component of income tax expense for the period other than the portion from the net change in the entity's deferred tax assets and liabilities.

PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansReceivableAl.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans Receivable, Alternative [Abstract]

TradingAssetsExcludingDebtAndEquitySecur.l: Trading Assets, Excluding Debt and Equity Securities [Member]
TradingAssetsExcludingDebtAndEquitySecur.d: Investments which the entity trades for its own profit, which may include, but is not limited to, mortgage-backed and asset-backed securities, loans, interest rate swaps, credit derivatives, commodity contracts, foreign exchange contracts and equity swaps. Excludes debt and equity securities.

ConstructionLoan.d: This element represents the carrying value of a short-term real estate loan to finance building costs. The funds are disbursed as needed or in accordance with a prearranged plan; generally, a portion of the funds is disbursed at inception and the remainder as construction progresses. The money is repaid on completion of the project, usually from the proceeds of a mortgage loan. The rate is normally higher than the prime rate, and there is usually an origination fee. The effective yield on these

ConstructionLoanNoncurrent.d: This element represents the noncurrent portion of a long-term real estate loan to finance building costs. The funds are disbursed as needed or in accordance with a prearranged plan; generally, a portion of the funds is disbursed at inception and the remainder as construction progresses. The money is repaid on completion of the project (generally one to seven years), usually from the proceeds of a mortgage loan. The rate is normally higher than the prime rate, and there is usually an origination

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Weighted-average exercise price, at which grantee can acquire shares reserved for issuance, for fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Weighted-average exercise price, at which grantee can acquire shares reserved for issuance, for fully vested and expected to vest exercisable or convertible options. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Aggregate Intrinsic Value
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Amount by which current fair value of underlying stock exceeds exercise price of fully vested and expected to vest exercisable or convertible options. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Aggregate Intrinsic Value
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Amount by which current fair value of underlying stock exceeds exercise price of fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Number
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Number of fully vested and expected to vest exercisable options that may be converted into shares under option plan. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Number
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Number of fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding that can be converted into shares under option plan.
