OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.l: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent [Abstract]

OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsale.l: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsale.d: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to noncontrolling interest.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsale.l: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsale.d: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDerivativesQuali.l: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax, Parent [Abstract]
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent (Deprecated 2025)
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDerivativesQuali.d: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to parent entity.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDerivativesQuali.l: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2025)
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDerivativesQuali.d: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests.

LongtermDebtTypeDomain.d: Type of long-term debt arrangement, such as notes, line of credit, commercial paper, asset-based financing, project financing, letter of credit financing. These are debt arrangements that originally required repayment more than twelve months after issuance or greater than the normal operating cycle of the company, if longer.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTaxAttribut.l: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

OtherComprehensiveIncomeBeforeTaxPortion.l: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

OtherComprehensiveIncomeTaxPortionAttrib.l: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransfer.l: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred and Preacquisition Equity Interest in Acquiree [Abstract]

BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiabl.l: Business Combination, Recognized Asset Acquired to Liability Assumed, Excess (Less), and Goodwill [Abstract]
Business Combination, Recognized Asset Acquired to Liability Assumed, Excess (Less), and Goodwill
BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiabl.d: Amount of asset acquired in excess of (less than) liability assumed plus goodwill in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTaxAttributableT.l: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

DefinedBenefitPlanByPlanAssetCategoriesA.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Category [Axis]
DefinedBenefitPlanByPlanAssetCategoriesA.d: Information by defined benefit plan asset investment.

PlanAssetCategoriesDomain.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Category [Domain]

RealEstateMember.d: Property consisting of land, land improvement and buildings.

ResidentialRealEstateMember.d: Property that is used as a home.

DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOnPlanAsse.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss) on Plan Assets Still Held
DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOnPlanAsse.d: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) on assets still held.

DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOnPlanAsse.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss) on Plan Assets Sold
DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOnPlanAsse.d: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) on assets sold.

DefinedBenefitPlanActualReturnOnPlanAsse.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Purchase, Sale, and Settlement [Abstract]

DefinedBenefitPlanTransfersBetweenMeasur.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Assets Transferred into (out of) Level 3
DefinedBenefitPlanTransfersBetweenMeasur.d: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan, for assets transferred into (out of) Level 3 of fair value hierarchy. Includes, but is not limited to, transfer due to change in observability of significant inputs.

BusinessCombinationAcquiredReceivablesDe.l: Business Combination, Acquired Receivable, Purchased without Credit Deterioration, Description
BusinessCombinationAcquiredReceivablesDe.d: Description of receivable purchased without credit deterioration, acquired in business combination. Excludes purchased financial asset with credit deterioration.

BusinessCombinationStepAcquisitionEquity.l: Business Combination, Achieved in Stages, Description
BusinessCombinationStepAcquisitionEquity.d: In a business combination achieved in stages, this element represents a narrative description of the history, developments, or effect of the acquisition relative to the percentage of equity in the acquiree held by the acquirer immediately before the acquisition date. Such description may describe any gain recognized as a result of the acquisition.

PrepaidExpenseCurrentAndNoncurrent.d: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of expenditures made in advance of when the economic benefit of the cost will be realized, and which will be expensed in future periods with the passage of time or when a triggering event occurs.

PostemploymentBenefitsLiabilityCurrentAn.d: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement.

DefinedBenefitPlanAssetsForPlanBenefitsN.l: Assets for Plan Benefits, Defined Benefit Plan
DefinedBenefitPlanAssetsForPlanBenefitsN.d: Amount of asset, recognized in statement of financial position, for overfunded defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBene.d: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as noncurrent.
Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

DefinedBenefitPensionPlanLiabilitiesNonc.l: Liability, Defined Benefit Pension Plan, Noncurrent
DefinedBenefitPensionPlanLiabilitiesNonc.d: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan, classified as noncurrent. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPensionPlanCurrentAndNoncu.d: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

OtherPostretirementDefinedBenefitPlanLia.l: Liability, Other Postretirement Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent
OtherPostretirementDefinedBenefitPlanLia.d: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit other postretirement plan, classified as noncurrent. Excludes pension plan.

OtherPostretirementDefinedBenefitPlanLia.l: Liability, Other Postretirement Defined Benefit Plan
OtherPostretirementDefinedBenefitPlanLia.d: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit other postretirement plan. Excludes pension plan.

PensionAndOtherPostretirementAndPostempl.l: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Noncurrent
PensionAndOtherPostretirementAndPostempl.d: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits, classified as noncurrent.
Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits.

OtherPostretirementBenefitsPayableNoncur.d: Amount of liability, classified as noncurrent, for retirement benefits, classified as other.

OtherPostretirementBenefitsPayableCurren.d: Amount of liability for retirement benefits, classified as other.

DeferredCompensationLiabilityCurrentAndN.l: Deferred Compensation Liability, Current and Noncurrent [Abstract]

DeferredCompensationSharebasedArrangemen.l: Deferred Compensation Share-Based Arrangements, Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
DeferredCompensationSharebasedArrangemen.d: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for stock option plans and other equity-based compensation arrangements payable after one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).

DeferredCompensationSharebasedArrangemen.l: Deferred Compensation Share-Based Arrangements, Liability, Current and Noncurrent
DeferredCompensationSharebasedArrangemen.d: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for stock option plans and other equity-based compensation arrangements.

DeferredCompensationCashbasedArrangement.l: Deferred Compensation Cash-Based Arrangements, Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
DeferredCompensationCashbasedArrangement.d: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for deferred compensation arrangements payable after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Represents currently earned compensation under cash arrangements (such as a profit-sharing plan, rabbi trust, and employee contract--excluding equity-based arrangements) that is not actually paid until a later date.

OtherDeferredCompensationArrangementsLia.l: Other Deferred Compensation Arrangements, Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
OtherDeferredCompensationArrangementsLia.d: Amount of the liabilities, classified as other, for deferred compensation arrangements payable after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

OtherDeferredCompensationArrangementsLia.l: Other Deferred Compensation Arrangements, Liability, Current and Noncurrent
OtherDeferredCompensationArrangementsLia.d: Amount of the liabilities for deferred compensation arrangements classified as other.

DeferredCompensationLiabilityClassifiedN.d: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements payable beyond one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).

DeferredCompensationLiabilityCurrentAndN.l: Deferred Compensation Liability, Current and Noncurrent
DeferredCompensationLiabilityCurrentAndN.d: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements. Represents currently earned compensation under compensation arrangements that is not actually paid until a later date.

DeferredCompensationCashbasedArrangement.l: Deferred Compensation Cash-Based Arrangements, Liability, Current and Noncurrent
DeferredCompensationCashbasedArrangement.d: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for deferred compensation arrangements. Represents currently earned compensation under cash arrangements (such as a profit-sharing plan, rabbi trust, and employee contract--excluding equity-based arrangements) that is not actually paid until a later date.

TrucksMember.d: Vehicles primarily used for transporting cargo.

AutomobilesMember.d: Vehicles that are used primarily for transporting people.

ProductionTaxExpense.d: A tax assessed on oil and gas production.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharebasedCompens.l: Shares Granted or Issued, Share-Based Payment Arrangement [Abstract]

AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalShar.l: APIC, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalShar.d: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderati.l: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration [Abstract]

BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssets.d: Description of indemnification arrangement, basis for determining amount of payment related to indemnification asset recognized at acquisition date in business combination, and reason why range of outcomes in indemnification arrangement cannot be estimated.

BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssets.l: Business Combination, Indemnification Assets, Basis for Amount (Deprecated 2025)
BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssets.d: For indemnification assets recognized in connection with a business combination, this element represents a description of the basis for determining the amount of the asset recorded.

BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssets.l: Business Combination, Indemnification Asset, Range of Outcomes, Maximum, Amount
BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssets.d: Maximum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes for indemnification asset in business combination.

BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssets.l: Business Combination, Indemnification Asset, Range of Outcomes, Minimum, Amount
BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssets.d: Minimum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes for indemnification asset in business combination.

BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderati.l: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Range of Outcomes, Inestimable, Reason
BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderati.d: Description of reason why undiscounted range of outcomes cannot be estimated in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssets.l: Business Combination, Indemnification Assets, Range of Outcomes, Inestimable (Deprecated 2025)
BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssets.d: For indemnification assets recognized in connection with a business combination, if a range (undiscounted) of potential outcomes cannot be estimated, this element represents a statement of that fact and the reasons why a range cannot be estimated.

BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssets.l: Business Combination, Indemnification Assets, Range of Outcomes, Maximum Unlimited (Deprecated 2025)
BusinessCombinationIndemnificationAssets.d: For indemnification assets recognized in connection with a business combination, if the maximum (undiscounted) potential outcome is limitless, this element represents a statement of that fact.

StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedC.l: Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedC.d: Value, after forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

OtherAdditionalCapitalMember.d: This element represents a category to capture additional Paid-in Capital other than attributable to capital contributed by shareholders in excess of the par or stated value of the common or preferred stock issued by an entity. Certain entities report two components of additional Paid-in Capital consisting of (i) capital in excess of par or stated value and (ii) other additional capital. This member is only to be used if the entity distinguishes between additional Paid-in Capital and other additi

DefinedBenefitPlanPurchasesSalesAndSettl.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Purchase, Sale, and Settlement
DefinedBenefitPlanPurchasesSalesAndSettl.d: Amount, measured using unobservable input, of increase (decrease) in plan asset of defined benefit plan from purchase, sale and settlement of trade associated with underlying investment.

EquitySecuritiesIndustryMember.d: Industry sector consisting of government, private and corporate entities engaged in business activities, including but not limited to, commercial, industrial, agricultural, financial services, technology, healthcare and real estate.

DistributionsPerGeneralPartnershipUnitOu.l: Distributions Per General Partnership Unit Outstanding
DistributionsPerGeneralPartnershipUnitOu.d: Cash dividends declared or paid to each outstanding general partnership unit during the reporting period.

DistributionsPerLimitedPartnershipUnitOu.l: Distributions Per Limited Partnership Unit Outstanding, Basic
DistributionsPerLimitedPartnershipUnitOu.d: Cash dividends declared or paid to each outstanding limited partnership unit during the reporting period.

AmortizationOfESOPAward.d: Value of shares committed to be released under an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

DebtInstrumentThirdPartyCreditEnhancemen.d: Disclosure of the existence of a third-party credit enhancement on the entity's issued liability.

ProceedsFromSaleOfLandHeldforinvestment.d: The cash inflow from the sale of land held for investment; excludes sales of land held as inventory or productive use.

ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstateHeldfor.l: Proceeds from Sale, Real Estate, Other, Held-for-Investment
ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstateHeldfor.d: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate held for investment not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

DebtSecuritiesPayableMember.d: Financial obligations in a security form.

IncreaseDecreaseInTradingSecuritiesAbstr.l: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI [Abstract]

CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRight.l: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge, Fair Value
CustomerSecuritiesForWhichEntityHasRight.d: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of customer securities accepted as collateral by the entity that it is permitted by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge to counterparties as collateral.

PaymentsForProceedsFromProceedsFromSaleO.l: Payment for (Proceeds from) Real Estate, Held-for-Investment, Alternative [Abstract]

PaymentsForProceedsFromRealEstateHeldfor.l: Payment for (Proceeds from) Real Estate, Held-for-Investment
PaymentsForProceedsFromRealEstateHeldfor.d: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with the purchase (sale) of real estate held for investment, as opposed to operating, purposes.

ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoo.l: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, Impairment Loss [Abstract]

ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsFinitelived.d: Amount of impairment loss for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsIndefiniteli.l: Intangible Asset, Excluding Goodwill, Indefinite-Lived, Impairment Loss
ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsIndefiniteli.d: Amount of impairment loss for indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

StockholdersEquityOther.d: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

PartnersCapitalOther.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital classified as other.

DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePerce.l: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage [Abstract]

DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercenta.l: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

InvestmentsInAndAdvancesToAffiliatesSche.l: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, Schedule of Investments [Text Block]
InvestmentsInAndAdvancesToAffiliatesSche.d: The entire disclosure for the information summarizing investments in and advances to majority-owned subsidiaries, other controlled companies, and other affiliates. It reflects specified information about ownership, financial results from, and financial position in such entities.

OpenOptionContractsWrittenScheduleOfInve.d: Tabular disclosure of contract for right to buy or sell asset at fixed price by fixed date.

OtherThanSecuritiesInvestmentHoldingsSch.l: Other than Securities Investment Holdings, Schedule of Investments [Table Text Block]
OtherThanSecuritiesInvestmentHoldingsSch.d: Tabular disclosure of the information required in the supplementary schedule applicable to management investment companies summarizing unaffiliated investments that are not securities.

InvestmentHoldingsScheduleOfInvestmentsT.d: The entire disclosure for investments owned by investment company.

AntidilutiveSecuritiesExcludedFromComput.l: Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Net Income, Per Outstanding Unit, Amount
AntidilutiveSecuritiesExcludedFromComput.d: Securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic net Income or Loss per outstanding limited partnership unit in the future and that were not included in the computation of diluted net income per limited partnership unit, because to do so would increase net income per unit amounts or decrease loss per unit amounts for the period presented.

BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiabl.l: Business Combination, Recognized Asset Acquired to Liability Assumed, Excess (Less), and Goodwill, Less Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]
Business Combination, Recognized Asset Acquired to Liability Assumed, Excess (Less), and Goodwill, Less Noncontrolling Interest
BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiabl.d: Amount of asset acquired in excess of (less than) liability assumed plus goodwill in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, less fair value of noncontrolling interest in acquiree at acquisition date when acquirer holds less than 100 percent of equity interest in acquiree.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncenti.l: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Including Option Exercised
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncenti.d: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, option exercised.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncenti.l: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Including Option Exercised [Abstract]

TransfersAccountedForAsSecuredBorrowings.l: Transfers Accounted for as Secured Borrowings, Assets, Carrying Amount
TransfersAccountedForAsSecuredBorrowings.d: Carrying amount of financial assets accounted for as secured borrowings recognized in the transferor's statement of financial position at the end of each period presented.

TransfersAccountedForAsSecuredBorrowings.l: Transfers Accounted for as Secured Borrowings, Associated Liabilities, Carrying Amount
TransfersAccountedForAsSecuredBorrowings.d: Carrying amount of liabilities associated with financial assets accounted for as secured borrowings recognized in the transferor's statement of financial position at the end of each period presented.

NetIncomeLossAttributableToReportingEnti.l: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]

CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostPeriodIncr.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Period Increase (Decrease)
CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostPeriodIncr.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in capitalized exploratory well costs.

CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostAdditionsP.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Addition Pending Determination of Proved Reserve
CapitalizedExploratoryWellCostAdditionsP.d: Amount of addition to capitalized exploratory well cost pending determination of proved reserve in oil- and gas-producing activities.

ReclassificationToWellFacilitiesAndEquip.l: Oil and Gas, Capitalized Exploratory Well Cost, Reclassification Based on Determination of Proved Reserve
ReclassificationToWellFacilitiesAndEquip.d: Amount of reclassification of capitalized exploratory well cost to well, facility, and equipment based on determination of proved reserve in oil- and gas-producing activities.

ProductLiabilityContingencyThirdPartyRec.d: Amount of the estimated recovery from third parties recorded in the period pertaining to product liability damages from specified products.

RetainedEarningsUndistributedEarningsFro.l: Retained Earnings, Undistributed Earnings from Equity Method Investees
RetainedEarningsUndistributedEarningsFro.d: Amount of consolidated retained earnings that represent undistributed (not yet received) earnings from 50 percent or less owned persons accounted for by the equity method (equity method investees).

PaymentsForDelayedTaxExemptExchange.l: Payments for Delayed Tax Exempt Exchange
PaymentsForDelayedTaxExemptExchange.d: Cash outflow related to a property which is traded for the promise to provide a replacement like-kind property in the near future also known as a tax deferred exempt exchange.

ProceedsFromDelayedTaxExemptExchange.l: Proceeds from Delayed Tax Exempt Exchange
ProceedsFromDelayedTaxExemptExchange.d: Cash inflow related to a property which is traded for the promise to provide a replacement like-kind property in the near future also known as a tax deferred exempt exchange.

PaymentsForDepositsOnRealEstateAcquisiti.l: Payments for Deposits on Real Estate Acquisitions
PaymentsForDepositsOnRealEstateAcquisiti.d: Cash outflow related to amounts given in advance to show or confirm an intention to complete an acquisition of land, buildings, other structures, or any item classified as real estate.

ProceedsFromDepositsOnRealEstateSales.l: Proceeds from Deposits on Real Estate Sales
ProceedsFromDepositsOnRealEstateSales.d: Cash inflow related to amounts received in advance from a potential buyer showing or confirming an intention to complete an acquisition of land, buildings, other structures, or any item classified as real estate.

PaymentsToAcquireLimitedPartnershipInter.l: Payments to Acquire Limited Partnership Interests
PaymentsToAcquireLimitedPartnershipInter.d: Cash outflow related to the acquisition or continued holding of limited partnership interests held for investment purposes.

ProceedsFromLimitedPartnershipInvestment.d: Cash inflow received as distributions, returns of capital, or sale proceeds from partnership interests held for investment purposes.

PaymentsForMortgageDeposits.d: Amount of cash outflow for advance payment to show intention to complete mortgage financing.

ProceedsFromMortgageDeposits.d: Cash inflow received in association with a commitment to issue a mortgage.

PaymentsForNuclearFuel.d: Cash outflow associated with the purchase of any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

ProceedsFromNuclearFuel.d: Cash inflow resulting from the sale of any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

PaymentsForOtherDeposits.d: Amount of cash outflow for deposits classified as other.

ProceedsFromOtherDeposits.d: Amount of cash inflow for receipts of deposits classified as other.

PaymentsForPreviousAcquisition.d: Cash outflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

ProceedsFromPreviousAcquisition.d: Cash inflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

PaymentsForRemovalCosts.d: Cash outflow related to disposal costs of plants, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

ProceedsFromRemovalCosts.d: Cash inflow resulting from recoveries, by any means, against the cost of disposing of plant, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

ProceedsFromPaymentsForDepositsAppliedTo.l: Proceeds from (Payments for) Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements [Abstract]

ProceedsFromDepositsAppliedToDebtRetirem.l: Proceeds from Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements
ProceedsFromDepositsAppliedToDebtRetirem.d: Cash inflow received during the period as a deposit on account for application (deposits to retire or pay down) against an amount of debt owed to the entity.

PaymentsForDepositsAppliedToDebtRetireme.l: Payments for Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements
PaymentsForDepositsAppliedToDebtRetireme.d: Cash outflow during the period as a deposit on account for application (deposits to retire or pay down) against an amount of debt owed by the entity.

ProceedsFromCollectionOfPaymentsToFundLo.l: Proceeds from Collection of (Payments to Fund) Long-Term Loans to Related Parties [Abstract]

ProceedsFromCollectionOfLongtermLoansToR.l: Proceeds from Collection of Long-Term Loans to Related Parties
ProceedsFromCollectionOfLongtermLoansToR.d: The cash inflow associated with collection, whether partial or full, of long-term loans to a related party. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances to Affiliates.

PaymentsToFundLongtermLoansToRelatedPart.l: Payments to Fund Long-Term Loans to Related Parties
PaymentsToFundLongtermLoansToRelatedPart.d: The cash outflow associated with extending a long-term loan to a related party. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances to Affiliates.

SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeDeferred.l: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Deferred Income Tax Provision on Gain (Loss) Recognized, Amount
SubsidiaryOrEquityMethodInvesteeDeferred.d: The amount provided for deferred income taxes in relation to any gain (loss) recognized in income of the entity resulting from the issuance of shares by a subsidiary or equity method investee.

PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeFinancingAct.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Financing Activities [Abstract]

PaymentsForHedgeFinancingActivities.d: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

ProceedsFromHedgeFinancingActivities.d: The cash inflow from a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeInvestingAct.l: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Investing Activities [Abstract]

PaymentsForHedgeInvestingActivities.d: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

ProceedsFromHedgeInvestingActivities.d: The cash inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentation.l: Organization, Consolidation and Presentation of Financial Statements Disclosure and Significant Accounting Policies [Text Block]
OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentation.d: The entire disclosure for the organization, consolidation and basis of presentation of financial statements disclosure, and significant accounting policies of the reporting entity. May be provided in more than one note to the financial statements, as long as users are provided with an understanding of (1) the significant judgments and assumptions made by an enterprise in determining whether it must consolidate a VIE and/or disclose information about its involvement with a VIE, (2) the nature of

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest [Abstract]
Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.d: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

LongtermDebtPercentageBearingFixedIntere.l: Long-Term Debt, Percentage Bearing Fixed Interest, Amount
LongtermDebtPercentageBearingFixedIntere.d: The portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a set, unchanging rate.

LongtermDebtPercentageBearingVariableInt.l: Long-Term Debt, Percentage Bearing Variable Interest, Amount
LongtermDebtPercentageBearingVariableInt.d: The portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a rate subject to change from time to time.

UnamortizedCostsCapitalizedLessRelatedDe.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost in Excess of Cost Center Ceiling Limitation, Expense
UnamortizedCostsCapitalizedLessRelatedDe.d: Amount of expense for excess of unamortized cost capitalized within cost center, less related deferred income tax, over cost center ceiling limitation for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsCurrentAbstr.l: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current [Abstract]

PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsCurrent.l: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsCurrent.d: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsNoncurrentAb.l: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Noncurrent [Abstract]

OperatingLeasesOfLesseeContingentRentals.l: Operating Leases of Lessee, Contingent Rentals, Basis Spread on Variable Rate (Deprecated 2026)
OperatingLeasesOfLesseeContingentRentals.d: The percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the lessee's operating lease.

OperatingLeasesOfLessorContingentRentals.l: Operating Leases of Lessor, Contingent Rentals, Basis Spread on Variable Rate (Deprecated 2026)
OperatingLeasesOfLessorContingentRentals.d: The percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the lessor's operating lease.

CapitalLeasesOfLesseeContingentRentalsDe.l: Capital Leases of Lessee, Contingent Rentals, Description of Variable Rate Basis (Deprecated 2026)
CapitalLeasesOfLesseeContingentRentalsDe.d: Description of reference rate for variable rate of lessee's capital lease.

CapitalLeasesOfLesseeContingentRentalsBa.l: Capital Leases of Lessee, Contingent Rentals, Basis Spread on Variable Rate (Deprecated 2026)
CapitalLeasesOfLesseeContingentRentalsBa.d: The percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the lessee's capital lease.

CapitalLeasesOfLessorContingentRentalsDe.l: Capital Leases of Lessor, Contingent Rentals, Description of Variable Rate Basis (Deprecated 2026)
CapitalLeasesOfLessorContingentRentalsDe.d: Description of reference rate for variable rate of lessor's capital lease.

CapitalLeasesOfLessorContingentRentalsBa.l: Capital Leases of Lessor, Contingent Rentals, Basis Spread on Variable Rate (Deprecated 2026)
CapitalLeasesOfLessorContingentRentalsBa.d: The percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the lessor's capital lease (sales-type and direct financing leases).

LoansReceivableDescriptionOfVariableRate.l: Loans Receivable, Description of Variable Rate Basis (Deprecated 2026)
LoansReceivableDescriptionOfVariableRate.d: Description of reference rate used for variable rate of loan receivable.

LoansReceivableBasisSpreadOnVariableRate.l: Loans Receivable, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
LoansReceivableBasisSpreadOnVariableRate.d: Percentage added to reference rate used to compute variable rate on loan receivable.

DerivativeInstrumentsIncomeStatementLoca.l: Derivative Instruments, Income Statement Location of Gain (Loss) Reclassified from Accumulated OCI (Deprecated 2025)
DerivativeInstrumentsIncomeStatementLoca.d: The income statement location of the effective portion of net gain (loss) reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

PriceRiskCashFlowHedgeGainOrLossReclassi.l: Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Earnings, Net
PriceRiskCashFlowHedgeGainOrLossReclassi.d: The amount of net gains or losses on price risk cash flow hedges reclassified during the period to earnings from accumulated other comprehensive income.

ProceedsFromSaleOfLongtermInvestments.l: Proceeds from Sale of Long-Term Investments
ProceedsFromSaleOfLongtermInvestments.d: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

PaymentsToAcquireLongtermInvestments.d: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.

DefinedBenefitPlanEstimatedFutureEmploye.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Current Fiscal Year, Description
DefinedBenefitPlanEstimatedFutureEmploye.d: Description of contributions expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, range of expected contributions, required minimum contributions and whether expected contributions are discretionary or noncash.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.d: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances to member financial institutions.

InterestIncomeFederalHomeLoanBankAdvance.l: Interest Income, Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
InterestIncomeFederalHomeLoanBankAdvance.d: Amount of interest income from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances to member financial institutions.

PrepaymentFeesOnAdvancesNet.d: Amount of income earned, after hedging basis adjustments, from fees charged for prepayment of certain Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances before original maturity.

AffordableHousingProgramAssessments.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Affordable Housing Program Obligation, Assessment Expense
AffordableHousingProgramAssessments.d: Amount of expense for Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) obligation for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.l: Proceeds from FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities
ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.d: Amount of cash inflow from collection of advance by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.

PaymentsForFederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.l: Payments for FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities
PaymentsForFederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.d: Amount of cash outflow for disbursement to borrower related to advance, made by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.

PaymentsForAffordableHousingPrograms.l: Payment for Affordable Housing Program Obligation by Federal Home Loan Bank
PaymentsForAffordableHousingPrograms.d: Amount of cash outflow for payment made by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

AffordableHousingProgramObligation.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Affordable Housing Program Obligation
AffordableHousingProgramObligation.d: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) obligation for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

LoansFromOtherFederalHomeLoanBanks.l: Loans from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
LoansFromOtherFederalHomeLoanBanks.d: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) loans from another FHLBank.

LoansToOtherFederalHomeLoanBanks.l: Loans to Other Federal Home Loan Banks
LoansToOtherFederalHomeLoanBanks.d: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) loans to another FHLBank.

DepositsWithOtherFederalHomeLoanBanks.l: Deposits with Other Federal Home Loan Banks
DepositsWithOtherFederalHomeLoanBanks.d: Amount of interest-bearing funds deposited into another Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

PayablesForCongressionallyMandatedAssess.d: Amount payable for Congressionally mandated Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessments, for example, but not limited to, Resolution Funding Corporation (REFCORP) assessments.

PaymentsForCongressionallyMandatedFedera.l: Payments for Congressionally Mandated Federal Home Loan Bank Assessments
PaymentsForCongressionallyMandatedFedera.d: Amount of cash outflow for payments made by the Federal Home Loan Banks for Congressionally mandated assessments.

PaymentsForBondsTransferredToOtherOtherF.l: Payments for Bonds Transferred to Other Federal Home Loan Banks
PaymentsForBondsTransferredToOtherOtherF.d: Amount of cash outflow from transfers and assumptions of primary liability of consolidated obligations to another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

ProceedsFromBondsTransferredFromOtherOth.l: Proceeds from Bonds Transferred from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
ProceedsFromBondsTransferredFromOtherOth.d: Amount of cash inflow from transfers and assumptions of primary liability for consolidated obligations of another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

IncreaseDecreaseInLoansFromOtherFederalH.l: Increase (Decrease) in Loans from Federal Home Loan Banks
IncreaseDecreaseInLoansFromOtherFederalH.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in loans from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

IncreaseDecreaseInDepositsFromOtherFeder.l: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
IncreaseDecreaseInDepositsFromOtherFeder.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest-bearing deposits from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

IncreaseDecreaseInLoansToFederalHomeLoan.l: Increase (Decrease) in Loans to Federal Home Loan Banks
IncreaseDecreaseInLoansToFederalHomeLoan.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) loans to another FHLBank.

IncreaseDecreaseInDepositsWithOtherFeder.l: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits with Other Federal Home Loan Banks
IncreaseDecreaseInDepositsWithOtherFeder.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest-bearing funds deposited into another Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

FederalHomeLoanBankAssessments.d: Amount of Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessments and Congressionally mandated Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessments.

CongressionallyMandatedFederalHomeLoanBa.l: Congressionally Mandated Federal Home Loan Bank Assessments
CongressionallyMandatedFederalHomeLoanBa.d: Amount of expense for Congressionally mandated Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessments, for example, but not limited to, Resolution Funding Corporation (REFCORP) assessments.

OfficeOfFinanceAssessmentsCostAssessedOn.l: Office of Finance, Cost Assessed on Federal Home Loan Bank
OfficeOfFinanceAssessmentsCostAssessedOn.d: Amount of a Federal Home Loan Bank's (FHLBank) proportionate share of the costs of operating the Office of Finance.

RegulatorExpensesCostAssessedOnFederalHo.l: Regulator Expenses, Cost Assessed on Federal Home Loan Bank
RegulatorExpensesCostAssessedOnFederalHo.d: Amount of fees or assessments to fund the operations of the regulator of Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

InterestExpenseLoansFromOtherFederalHome.l: Interest Expense, Loans from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
InterestExpenseLoansFromOtherFederalHome.d: Amount of interest expense on loans received from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).

InterestExpenseDepositsFromOtherFederalH.l: Interest Expense, Deposits from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
InterestExpenseDepositsFromOtherFederalH.d: Amount of interest expense on interest-bearing deposits from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

InterestIncomeLoansToOtherFederalHomeLoa.l: Interest Income, Loans to Other Federal Home Loan Banks
InterestIncomeLoansToOtherFederalHomeLoa.d: Amount of interest income from loans to another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

InterestIncomeDepositsWithOtherFederalHo.l: Interest Income, Deposits with Other Federal Home Loan Banks
InterestIncomeDepositsWithOtherFederalHo.d: Amount of interest income from interest-bearing funds deposited into another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalStoc.l: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs
AdjustmentsToAdditionalPaidInCapitalStoc.d: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from issuance costs from a share-lending arrangement entered into, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.l: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Gross
DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.d: Amount of issuance costs recognized in a share-lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, before deduction of accumulated amortization or effects of subsequent adjustments.

DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.l: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Adjustment
DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.d: The amount of any adjustment recognized to the balance of unamortized issuance costs associated with a share-lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, due, for example, to default by the share borrower.

DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.l: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Accumulated Amortization [Roll Forward]
DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.l: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Accumulated Amortization
DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.d: The cumulative amount of amortization of deferred issuance costs associated with an own-share lending arrangement which has been periodically charged to earnings, generally as a component of interest expense, during the term of the arrangement.

DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.l: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Accumulated Amortization Expense, Period Increase (Decrease)
DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in the accumulated amortization of deferred issuance costs associated with an own-share lending arrangement.

DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.l: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Net
DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.d: Amount of issuance costs recognized in a share-lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, after deduction of accumulated amortization or the effects of subsequent adjustments.

OwnshareLendingArrangementDescription.d: A description of any outstanding share-lending arrangement on the entity's own stock including all significant terms such as the number of shares lent, the term of the arrangement, the circumstances under which cash settlement would be required, and any requirements for the counterparty (share borrower) to provide collateral.

OwnshareLendingArrangementSharesIssued.d: The number of shares issued in connection with an own-share lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

OwnshareLendingArrangementCollateral.d: The amount of collateral required to be received or received by the entity from the counterparty (share borrower) in connection with an own-share lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

OwnshareLendingArrangementReasons.d: Describes the entity's reasons for entering into an own-share lending arrangement, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

OwnshareLendingArrangementSharesOutstand.l: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Shares, Outstanding, Value
OwnshareLendingArrangementSharesOutstand.d: The fair value as of the date of the statement of financial position of shares outstanding in connection with an own-share lending arrangement, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

The number of shares outstanding as of the date of the statement of financial position in connection with an own-share lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

OwnshareLendingArrangementEarningsPerSha.l: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Earnings Per Share, Treatment
OwnshareLendingArrangementEarningsPerSha.d: Describes the entity's treatment of shares outstanding, in an own-share lending arrangement in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, for purposes of calculating earnings per share.

DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.l: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Net, Classification
DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.d: If not separately presented, identifies the caption on the statement of financial position in which the unamortized balance of recognized deferred issuance costs related to an own-share lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, is included.

OwnshareLendingArrangementDividendsNotRe.l: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Dividends, Not Reimbursed
OwnshareLendingArrangementDividendsNotRe.d: The amount of dividends paid to holders of record of shares of the entity's stock associated with an own-share lending arrangement in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, which will not be reimbursed by the counterparty (share borrower) to the arrangement.

OwnshareLendingArrangementCounterpartyDe.l: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Counterparty Default, Period of Default, Expense
OwnshareLendingArrangementCounterpartyDe.d: The amount of default related expense recognized in earnings in the period in which the entity concludes it is probable that the counterparty (share borrower) to a share-lending arrangement will default.

OwnshareLendingArrangementCounterpartyDe.l: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Counterparty Default, Changes in Value [Abstract]
Own-share Lending Arrangement, Counterparty Default, Changes in Value, Shares
OwnshareLendingArrangementCounterpartyDe.d: This item represents, in periods subsequent to the period in which the entity concludes it is probable that the counterparty (share borrower) to a share-lending arrangement will default, the amount of change in the fair value of the entity's shares, associated with an own-share lending arrangement, recognized in earnings for the period.

OwnshareLendingArrangementCounterpartyDe.l: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Counterparty Default, Changes in Value, Probable Recoveries
OwnshareLendingArrangementCounterpartyDe.d: This item represents, in periods subsequent to the period in which the entity concludes it is probable that the counterparty (share borrower) to a share-lending arrangement will default, the change in the amount of probable recoveries which the entity has recognized in earnings for the period.

OwnshareLendingArrangementCounterpartyDe.l: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Counterparty Default, Earnings Per Share, Shares
OwnshareLendingArrangementCounterpartyDe.d: In periods in which default, by a counterparty (share borrower) to a share-lending arrangement, is probable, but has not yet occurred, this item represents the number of the entity's shares related to the share-lending arrangement that will be reflected in basic and diluted earnings per share when the counterparty (share borrower) default does occur.

DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.l: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Accumulated Amortization Adjustment
DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated amortization of deferred issuance costs associated with a share-lending arrangement.

RevenueRecognitionMultipleDeliverableArr.d: Summarization of information required and determined to be disclosed concerning the recognition of revenue arrangements under which the entity does or will perform multiple revenue-generating activities, categorized by type of arrangement, including certain revenue arrangements that include software elements. This item does not include multiple-deliverable arrangements for industries that prepare disclosures under specific requirements (for instance, construction-type and production-type contrac

TypeOfArrangementAxis.l: Collaborative Arrangement and Arrangement Other than Collaborative [Axis]
TypeOfArrangementAxis.d: Information by collaborative arrangement and arrangement other than collaborative applicable to revenue-generating activity or operations.

RevenueRecognitionMultipleDeliverableArr.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

RevenueRecognitionMultipleDeliverableArr.l: Revenue Recognition, Multiple-deliverable Arrangements, Determination of Selling Price [Abstract] (Deprecated 2024)
Revenue Recognition, Multiple-deliverable Arrangements, Determination of Selling Price, Amount (Deprecated 2024)
RevenueRecognitionMultipleDeliverableArr.d: Represents the value established as the selling price of the significant unit of accounting used to allocate the consideration of the multiple-deliverable arrangement.

FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.l: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share [Table]
FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.d: Disclosure of information about investments in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share or equivalent measured at fair value on a recurring or nonrecurring basis.

FairValueMeasurementsFairValueHierarchyD.d: Categories used to prioritize the inputs to valuation techniques to measure fair value.

PrivateEquityFundsDomesticMember.d: Private equity fund investing in company domiciled in United States of America (US).

PrivateEquityFundsForeignMember.d: Private equity fund investing in company not domiciled in United States of America (US).

HedgeFundsEventDrivenMember.d: Investments in registered hedge funds that invest in equities and bonds of companies based on the impacts of economic, political, or government events.

HedgeFundsEquityMember.d: Investments in registered hedge funds that invest in equity securities, taking both long and short positions.

HedgeFundsGlobalOpportunityMember.d: Investments in registered hedge funds that primarily invest in foreign corporations or entities, as well as foreign currencies.

HedgeFundsMultistrategyMember.d: Investments in registered hedge funds structured to implement multiple investment strategies with the purpose of portfolio diversification.

RealEstateFundsMember.d: Investments in funds that invest in commercial or residential real estate.

VentureCapitalFundsMember.d: Funds that primarily invests in early stage enterprises or provides expansion capital in exchange for an equity stake and active management role in the invested enterprise.

FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.l: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share [Line Items]
FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.l: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Investee Significant Investment Strategies, Description
FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.d: This item describes the investment strategies of an investee for those certain investments for which net asset value per share is calculated (including by unit, membership interest, or other equity (ownership interest) unit measure) (alternative investments).

FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.l: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Unfunded Commitments
FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.d: The amount of unfunded commitments for which the entity is obligated, to those certain investments for which net asset value per share is calculated (including by unit, membership interest, or other equity (ownership interest) unit measure) (alternative investments).

FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.l: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Investment Redemption, Description
FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.d: Describes the terms and conditions for redemption of the entity's investment, or portion thereof (for example, quarterly redemption with 60 days notice), for each of those certain investments for which net asset value per share is calculated (including by unit, membership interest, or other equity (ownership interest) unit measure) (alternative investments), by major category.

FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.l: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Investment Redemption, Frequency
FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.d: States the frequency (for example, annually, semi-annually, quarterly) with which the entity can redeem its investment, or portion thereof, for each of those certain investments for which net asset value per share is calculated (including by unit, membership interest, or other equity (ownership interest) unit measure) (alternative investments), by major category.

FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.l: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Redemption Restriction [Abstract]
Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Redemption Restriction, Description
FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.d: Describes the circumstances in which an otherwise redeemable investment, comprising or included in the major category, of those certain investments for which net asset value per share is calculated (including by unit, membership interest, or other equity (ownership interest) unit measure) (alternative investments) is not redeemable (for example, investments subject to a lockup or gate).

FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.l: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Redemption Restriction, Other
FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.d: Description of other restriction on ability to sell investment for which net asset value per share is calculated at measurement date.

FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.l: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Planned Sale, Investments Not Identified [Abstract]
Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Planned Sale, Investments Not Identified, Value
FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.d: The total fair value for all investments, comprising or included in the major category, of those certain investments for which net asset value per share is calculated (including by unit, membership interest, or other equity (ownership interest) unit measure) (alternative investments) for which the entity has intentions to sell or liquidate, but the specific assets for sale or liquidation have not been identified (for example, the entity intends to sell $10,000,000 of its investments in private e

FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.l: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Planned Sale, Investments Not Identified, Number
FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.d: The total number of all investments, comprising or included in the major category, of those certain investments for which net asset value per share is calculated (including by unit, membership interest, or other equity (ownership interest) unit measure) (alternative investments) for which the entity has intentions to sell or liquidate, but the specific assets for sale or liquidation have not been identified (for example, the entity intends to sell 10 of its investments in hedge funds, but the in

FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.l: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Planned Sale, Investments Not Identified, Description
FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.d: Description of remaining actions required to complete the sale or liquidation of an investment in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share, including, but not limited to, by unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest, but has not yet identified the specific investment to be sold or liquidated.

OtherAssets.d: Amount of assets classified as other.

VariableInterestEntityNonexistenceFlag.d: Indicates whether variable interest entity (VIE) exists for which Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) disclosures are required to be made. Acceptable values are "Yes" and "No".

VariableInterestEntitySimilarEntityAggre.l: Variable Interest Entity, Similar Entity Aggregation, Description
VariableInterestEntitySimilarEntityAggre.d: Describes how the entity aggregates Variable Interest Entities (VIE) for disclosure purposes, distinguishing between (a) VIEs that are not consolidated because the enterprise is not the primary beneficiary but has a variable interest and (b) VIEs that are consolidated.

VariableInterestEntityPrimaryBeneficiary.l: Variable Interest Entity, Primary Beneficiary, Does Not Hold Majority Voting Interest, Disclosures [Abstract]

VariableInterestEntityCarryingAmountAsse.l: Variable Interest Entity, Carrying Amount, Assets and Liabilities, Qualitative Information
VariableInterestEntityCarryingAmountAsse.d: Provides qualitative information of the relationship between the Variable Interest Entity's (VIE) assets and liabilities that are included in the reporting entity's statement of financial position. For example, if the VIE's assets can be used only to settle obligations of the VIE, the qualitative information about the nature of the restrictions on those assets would be included in this item.

AdvancesFairValueDisclosure.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Fair Value Disclosure
AdvancesFairValueDisclosure.d: Fair value of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances carried under the fair value option.

VariableInterestEntityNotPrimaryBenefici.l: Variable Interest Entity, Not Primary Beneficiary, Disclosures [Abstract]

VariableInterestEntityReportingEntityInv.l: Variable Interest Entity, Reporting Entity Involvement, Maximum Loss Exposure [Abstract]
Variable Interest Entity, Reporting Entity Involvement, Maximum Loss Exposure, Determination Methodology and Factors [Abstract]

FairValueMeasurementsRecurringMember.d: Frequent fair value measurement. Includes, but is not limited to, fair value adjustment for impairment of asset, liability or equity, frequently measured at fair value.

FairValueMeasurementsNonrecurringMember.d: Infrequent fair value measurement. Includes, but is not limited to, fair value adjustment for impairment of asset, liability or equity, not frequently measured at fair value.

VariableInterestEntityReportingEntityInv.l: Variable Interest Entity, Reporting Entity Involvement, Maximum Loss Exposure, Nonquantifiable [Fixed List]
VariableInterestEntityReportingEntityInv.d: Indicates whether maximum exposure to loss from involvement with Variable Interest Entity (VIE) cannot be quantified. Acceptable values are "Yes" and "No".

VariableInterestEntityNonconsolidatedCom.l: Variable Interest Entity, Nonconsolidated, Comparison of Carrying Amount of Assets and Liabilities to Maximum Loss Exposure [Abstract]
Variable Interest Entity, Nonconsolidated, Comparison of Carrying Amount of Assets and Liabilities to Maximum Loss Exposure, Explanation, Qualitative Information
VariableInterestEntityNonconsolidatedCom.d: Description of the differences between the carrying amounts of assets and liabilities in the reporting entity's statement of financial position that relate to the reporting entity's variable interest in the Variable Interest Entity (VIE), where the reporting entity is not the VIE's primary beneficiary, and the reporting entity's maximum exposure to loss as a result of its involvement with the VIE.

VariableInterestEntityVIEOrPotentialVIEI.l: Variable Interest Entity or Potential VIE, Information Unavailability, Disclosures [Abstract]

VariableInterestEntityMeasureOfActivityA.l: Variable Interest Entity, Measure of Activity [Abstract]

DeferredFinanceCostsOwnshareLendingArran.l: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Net [Abstract]

ContractuallySpecifiedServicingFeesLateF.l: Contractually Specified Servicing Fee, Late Fee, and Ancillary Fee Earned in Exchange for Servicing Financial Asset
ContractuallySpecifiedServicingFeesLateF.d: Amount of contractually specified servicing fee, late fee, and ancillary fee recognized as income for servicing asset and servicing liability.

ServicingAssetAtFairValueChangesInFairVa.l: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Valuation Inputs or Changes in Assumptions [Abstract]
Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Valuation Inputs
ServicingAssetAtFairValueChangesInFairVa.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes in the inputs used to calculate the fair value of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

AssetAtFairValueChangesInFairValueResult.l: Asset at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Assumptions
AssetAtFairValueChangesInFairValueResult.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes in the assumptions or model used to calculate the fair value of a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueOtherChang.l: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Other Changes that Affect Balance, Amount
ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueOtherChang.d: Amount of other increase (decrease) to contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueOtherChang.l: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Other Changes that Affect Balance, Description
ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValueOtherChang.d: Description of other increase (decrease) to contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentOfRecogni.l: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Additions (Deductions) for Expenses (Recoveries) [Abstract]
Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Additions for Expenses
ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentOfRecogni.d: Amount of increase in the valuation allowance for impairment of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer from charges to expense.

ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentOfRecogni.l: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Deductions for Recoveries
ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentOfRecogni.d: Amount of decrease in the valuation allowance for impairment of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer from recoveries recognized.

ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentOfRecogni.l: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Sales and Disposals [Abstract]
Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Sales
ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentOfRecogni.d: Reduction in valuation allowance of servicing assets based on sale of the related asset.

ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentOfRecogni.l: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Disposals
ValuationAllowanceForImpairmentOfRecogni.d: Reduction in valuation allowance of servicing assets based on disposal of the related asset.

CashFlowsBetweenTransferorAndTransfereeB.d: Cash flows between transferee and transferor in payment of the transferor's beneficial interest related to a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction.

QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.l: Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement [Table]
QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.d: Disclosure of information about transferor's continuing involvement with transferred financial asset in securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, and similar transfer.

QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.l: Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Transferred Financial Assets, by Transfer or Transferee [Axis] (Deprecated 2026)
QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.d: Information by transfer or transferee for transferor's continuing involvement in transferred financial asset.

QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.l: Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement in Transferred Financial Assets, Transfer or Transferee [Domain] (Deprecated 2026)
QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.d: This item contains a description of the individual transfer (for example, a description of the transaction) or transferee (for example, name of a variable interest entity), to which the entity (transferor) continues to have involvement with the financial assets transferred.

QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.l: Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement [Line Items]
QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.l: Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Reasons
QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.d: Description of transferor's reason for transferring financial asset and ongoing involvement with financial asset transferred.

QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.l: Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Risks
QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.d: Describes the risks related to the transferred financial assets to which the transferor continues to be exposed because of its continuing involvement. Such description may include, but not be limited to, the extent to which the transferor's risk profile has changed as a result of the transfer of the financial assets (including, but not limited to, credit risk, interest rate risk, other risks).

QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.l: Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Arrangements of Financial Support, Amount
QualitativeAndQuantitativeInformationTra.d: The transferor's maximum amount of exposure to loss as a result of its continuing involvement in transferred financial assets.

DefinedBenefitPlanCostOfProvidingSpecial.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Cost of Providing Special and Contractual Termination Benefits
DefinedBenefitPlanCostOfProvidingSpecial.d: Amount of cost of providing special or contractual termination benefits payable from defined benefit plan.

LossContingencyDamagesSoughtValue.d: The value (monetary amount) of the award the plaintiff seeks in the legal matter.

ProductLiabilityContingencyThirdPartyRec.l: Product Liability Contingency, Third-Party Recovery, Percentage
ProductLiabilityContingencyThirdPartyRec.d: Percentage of the estimated recovery from third parties recorded in the period pertaining to product liability damages from specified products.

PurchaseCommitmentExcludingLongtermCommi.l: Purchase Commitment, Excluding Long-Term Purchase Commitment [Table]
PurchaseCommitmentExcludingLongtermCommi.d: Disclosure of information about purchase arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, term of arrangement with supplier, minimum quantity required, milestone, period covered by arrangement, and committed amount. Excludes long-term purchase arrangement and unconditional purchase obligation.
Information by arrangement, in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services from one or more suppliers.

This item is intended to be populated, by the entity, with Members identifying each purchase commitment about which information required or determined to be disclosed is being provided. If only one such commitment exists, this item may be used to capture such information; if multiple commitments exist, this item is the dimensional default, which will aggregate such information, as appropriate.

PurchaseCommitmentExcludingLongtermCommi.l: Purchase Commitment, Excluding Long-Term Commitment [Line Items]
PurchaseCommitmentExcludingLongtermCommi.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

SupplyCommitmentTable.d: Disclosure of information about supply arrangement in which resource is committed to supply product or service or both, to customer. Includes, but is not limited to, identification of committed product and service, purchasing party, price, effect on price for failing to deliver required quantity, cancellation right, and termination provision.

SupplyCommitmentAxis.d: Information by arrangements in which the entity has committed resources to supply goods or services to a customer.

SupplyCommitmentLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

LoansReceivableBasisSpreadOnVariableRate.l: Loans Receivable, Basis Spread on Variable Rate, During Period
LoansReceivableBasisSpreadOnVariableRate.d: The percentage points added to the reference rate or index during the adjustment period to compute the variable [fully indexed] rate on the loans receivable realized during the reporting period. This may be an effective margin for the period depending on the specific terms of the underlying loan agreement (for example, an annual disclosure for a loan with a quarterly adjustment period).

LoansReceivableWithVariableRatesOfIntere.l: Loans Receivable with Variable Rates of Interest [Abstract]

TreasuryStockRetiredParValueMethodAmount.l: Treasury Stock, Retired, Par Value Method, Amount
TreasuryStockRetiredParValueMethodAmount.d: Amount of decrease of par value, additional paid in capital (APIC) and retained earnings of common and preferred stock retired from treasury when treasury stock is accounted for under the par value method.

TreasuryStockRetiredCostMethodAmount.l: Treasury Stock, Retired, Cost Method, Amount
TreasuryStockRetiredCostMethodAmount.d: Amount of decrease of par value, additional paid in capital (APIC) and retained earnings of common and preferred stock retired from treasury when treasury stock is accounted for under the cost method.

TreasuryStockTransactionsExcludingValueO.l: Treasury Stock Transactions, Excluding Value of Shares Reissued [Abstract]
