BusinessCombinationLiabilitiesArisingFro.d: Amount of liability arising from contingency in business combination, measured at other than acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

TransferOfInvestments.d: Value of investments transferred from the entity's investments in noncash transactions.

TransferOfOtherRealEstate.l: Real Estate Owned, Transfer from Real Estate Owned
TransferOfOtherRealEstate.d: Value transferred out of real estate owned (REO) in noncash transactions.

MortgageLoanRelatedToPropertySales1.l: Mortgage Loan Related to Property Sales
MortgageLoanRelatedToPropertySales1.d: Mortgage loan related to property sales in noncash investing and financing activities.

ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquityFor.l: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Forward Rate Per Share
ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquityFor.d: The per share price of the Company's stock at which the contract holder of the freestanding contract has the right to purchase or sell the Company's stock at a future date.

CashCashEquivalentsAndShortTermInvestmen.l: Cash, Cash Equivalent, and Short-Term Investment [Text Block]
CashCashEquivalentsAndShortTermInvestmen.d: The entire disclosure of cash, cash equivalent, and short-term investment.

PensionAndOtherPostretirementAndPostempl.l: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Current
PensionAndOtherPostretirementAndPostempl.d: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits, classified as current.

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCo.l: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture [Abstract]
Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCo.d: Value, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCo.l: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCo.d: Value of forfeited shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedC.l: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture [Abstract]
Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedC.d: Number, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedC.l: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedC.d: Number of shares (or other type of equity) forfeited during the period.

OilAndGasProducingPropertiesOfRateRegula.l: Oil and Gas, Property Subject to Cost-of-Service Rate-Making, Unamortized Cost
OilAndGasProducingPropertiesOfRateRegula.d: Amount of unamortized cost for cost-of-service rate-making on oil- and gas-producing property.

CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedPropertiesExcl.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization [Abstract]

AcquisitionCostsCumulative.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Acquisition Cost
AcquisitionCostsCumulative.d: Amount of capitalized acquisition cost excluded from amortization for investment in unproved property and development project in oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes exploration and development costs and capitalized interest.

ExplorationCostsCumulative.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Exploration Cost
ExplorationCostsCumulative.d: Amount of capitalized exploration cost excluded from amortization for investment in unproved property and development project in oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and development costs and capitalized interest.

DevelopmentCostsCumulative.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization, Development Cost
DevelopmentCostsCumulative.d: Amount of capitalized development cost excluded from amortization for investment in unproved property and development project in oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and exploration costs and capitalized interest.

ProductionCostsCumulative.d: The capitalized costs incurred (excluded from amortization), as of the date of the balance sheet, to operate and maintain wells and related equipment and facilities, including depreciation and applicable operating costs of support equipment and facilities and other costs of operating and maintaining those wells and related equipment and facilities. They become part of the cost of oil and gas produced. Examples of production costs (sometimes called lifting costs) are: costs of labor to operate th

CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedPropertiesExcl.l: Oil and Gas, Full Cost Method, Capitalized Cost Excluded from Amortization
CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedPropertiesExcl.d: Amount of capitalized cost excluded from amortization for investment in unproved property and development project for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Includes, but is not limited to, acquisition, exploration, and development costs for development project and capitalized interest.

StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedC.l: Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture [Abstract]
Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedC.d: Value, before forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedC.l: Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedC.d: Value of forfeited shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Net of Forfeitures [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Gross
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Gross number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartne.l: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted, Net of Tax [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

WeightedAverageNumberOfLimitedPartnershi.l: Weighted Average Number of Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit Outstanding, Basic and Diluted
WeightedAverageNumberOfLimitedPartnershi.d: The average number of limited partnership and general partnership units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating basic and diluted earnings per limited partnership and general partnership unit.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOut.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2026)
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOut.d: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each basic and diluted limited partnership and general partnership unit when the per unit amount is the same for both basic and diluted units.

IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.l: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted (Deprecated 2026)
IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.d: The amount of income (loss) derived from discontinued operations during the period, net of related tax effect, per each basic and diluted limited partnership and general partnership unit when the per unit amount is the same for both basic and diluted units.

NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartne.l: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2026)
NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartne.d: The amount of net income or loss for the period per each limited partnership and general partnership unit in instances when basic and diluted earnings per unit are the same amount and aggregated on the face of the financial statements. Basic earnings per unit is the amount of net income or loss for the period per unit outstanding during the reporting period. Diluted earnings per unit includes the amount of net income or loss for the period available to each limited and general partnership unit o

NoncollaborativeArrangementTransactionsM.d: Arrangement other than collaborative applicable to revenue-generating activity or operations.

AdditionalCashFlowElementsAndSupplementa.l: Additional Cash Flow Elements and Supplemental Cash Flow Information [Abstract]

UnallocatedFinancingReceivablesMember.d: Financing receivables that have not been allocated to a portfolio segment.

DilutiveSecuritiesEffectOnBasicEarningsP.l: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share, Dilutive Convertible Securities
DilutiveSecuritiesEffectOnBasicEarningsP.d: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise of dilutive convertible securities excluding adjustments related to ESOP convertible preferred stock, stock options, and restrictive stock units.

DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Alternative [Abstract]
Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Subject to Expiration
DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards that are subject to expiration dates.

DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Not Subject to Expiration
DeferredTaxAssetsOperatingLossCarryforwa.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards that are not subject to expiration dates.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate, Minimum
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: The estimated measure of the minimum percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, ov

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate, Maximum
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: The estimated measure of the maximum percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, ov

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate, Minimum
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: The minimum risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate, Maximum
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: The maximum risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

ScheduleOfOtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense.l: Schedule of Other Nonoperating Income (Expense) [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfOtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense.d: Tabular disclosure of the components of non-operating income or non-operating expense that may include amounts earned from dividends, interest on securities, gains (losses) on securities sold, equity earnings of unconsolidated affiliates, net gain (loss) on sales of business, interest expense and other miscellaneous income or expense items.

NumberOfBusinessesAcquired.l: Business Combination, Number of Businesses Acquired
NumberOfBusinessesAcquired.d: Number of businesses acquired in business combination.

TierTwoRiskBasedCapital.l: Banking Regulation, Tier 2 Risk-Based Capital, Actual
TierTwoRiskBasedCapital.d: Amount of Tier 2 risk-based capital as defined by regulatory framework.

PreferredStockDividendsPerShareDeclared.l: Preferred Stock, Dividends Per Share, Declared
PreferredStockDividendsPerShareDeclared.d: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of preferred stock outstanding.

PreferredStockDividendsPerShareCashPaid.l: Preferred Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
PreferredStockDividendsPerShareCashPaid.d: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of preferred stock outstanding.

ScheduleOfDerivativeAssetsAtFairValueTab.l: Schedule of Derivative Assets at Fair Value [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfDerivativeAssetsAtFairValueTab.d: Tabular disclosure of derivative assets at fair value.

ScheduleOfDerivativeLiabilitiesAtFairVal.l: Schedule of Derivative Liabilities at Fair Value [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfDerivativeLiabilitiesAtFairVal.d: Tabular disclosure of derivative liabilities at fair value.

ResultsOfOperationsExpenseFromOilAndGasP.l: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Expense [Abstract]

ScheduleOfDefinedBenefitPlanAmountsRecog.l: Schedule of Defined Benefit Plan Amounts Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfDefinedBenefitPlanAmountsRecog.d: Tabular disclosure of the changes in plan assets and benefit obligations recognized in other comprehensive income (loss) during the period.

ScheduleOfEarningsPerShareBasicAndDilute.l: Schedule of Earnings Per Share, Basic and Diluted [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfEarningsPerShareBasicAndDilute.d: Tabular disclosure of an entity's basic and diluted earnings per share calculations, including a reconciliation of numerators and denominators of the basic and diluted per-share computations for income from continuing operations.

PreferredStockDividendsIncomeStatementIm.l: Preferred Stock Dividends, Income Statement Impact
PreferredStockDividendsIncomeStatementIm.d: The amount of preferred stock dividends that is an adjustment to net income apportioned to common stockholders.

PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInC.l: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital [Abstract]

ResultsOfOperationsExpenseFromOilAndGasP.l: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Expense
ResultsOfOperationsExpenseFromOilAndGasP.d: Amount of cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities. Excludes general corporate overhead and interest cost.

HedgingDesignationDomain.d: Designation of purpose of derivative instrument.

RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsCashAndC.d: Type of cash and cash equivalent. Cash is currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

InvestmentTypeCategorizationMember.d: Asset obtained to generate income or appreciate in value.

DerivativeAssetNotionalAmount.d: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative asset.

DerivativeLiabilityNotionalAmount.d: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative liability.

SupplyCommitmentArrangementMember.d: This item is intended to be populated, by the entity, with Members identifying each supply commitment about which information required or determined to be disclosed is being provided. If only one such commitment exists, this item may be used to capture such information; if multiple commitments exist, this item is the dimensional default, which will aggregate such information, as appropriate.

SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.l: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Nature of Event
SignificantChangeInUnrecognizedTaxBenefi.d: This element provides a description of the nature of the event that could occur within twelve months of the reporting date that would cause a significant increase or decrease in the related unrecognized tax benefit.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOut.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOut.d: Per unit ownership amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, after tax, available to each outstanding limited partnership and general partnership unit.

IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.l: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic
IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.d: The amount of income (loss) from disposition of discontinued operations available to each limited partnership and general partnership unit during the reporting period, net of tax.

MainlineMember.d: Significant, primary, generally longer routes of a carrier that it operates under its own brand, depart from or arrive to major cities or destinations, which are not defined by the entity as regional.

RegionalCarrierMember.d: Carrier either owned by, affiliated with, or under contractual arrangement with a primary "mainline" carrier, or its brand, that provides commuter or feeder services to such "mainline" carrier.

RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationM.l: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Minimum Quantity Required
RecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationM.d: The minimum number of units that must be purchased, in connection with an unconditional purchase obligation that has been recognized for financial reporting purposes.

UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.l: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Minimum Quantity Required
UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.d: The minimum number of units that must be purchased, in connection with an unconditional purchase obligation that has not been recognized for financial reporting purposes.

UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.l: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Period Quantity Purchased
UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.d: The number of units that have been purchased during the period, in connection with an unconditional purchase obligation that has not been recognized for financial reporting purposes.

UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.l: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Maximum Quantity
UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.d: Maximum number of units that may be acquired, in connection with an unconditional purchase obligation that has not been recognized for financial reporting purposes.

UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.l: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Fiscal Year Maturity [Abstract]
Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.d: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

CapacityMember.d: Ability to manufacture, produce, carry (as in transport), convey, hold, store, or accommodate.

DeferredTaxAssetsFrequentFlierLiability.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Frequent Flier Liability
DeferredTaxAssetsFrequentFlierLiability.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from frequent flier obligations.

CapitalLeasedAssetsNumberOfUnits.l: Capital Leased Assets, Number of Units (Deprecated 2026)
CapitalLeasedAssetsNumberOfUnits.d: The number of units (items of property) under capital lease arrangements.

PropertySubjectToOrAvailableForOperating.l: Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Number of Units
PropertySubjectToOrAvailableForOperating.d: The number of units (items of property) under operating lease arrangements.

FrequentFlierProgramPolicyPolicyTextBloc.l: Frequent Flier Program, Policy [Policy Text Block]
FrequentFlierProgramPolicyPolicyTextBloc.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for frequent flier or other similar programs provided by the entity.

MaintenanceCostPolicyPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of the accounting policy for maintenance costs. Does not include planned major maintenance activities.

CommissionsExpensePolicyPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for commissions incurred in relation to revenue generating activities or operations.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentSalvageValue.l: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Salvage Value
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentSalvageValue.d: The estimated or actual value of the asset at the end of its useful life or when it is no longer serviceable (cannot be used for its original purpose).

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentSalvageValuePer.l: Property, Plant and Equipment, Salvage Value, Percentage
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentSalvageValuePer.d: Stated as a percentage, the estimated or actual value of the asset at the end of its useful life or when it is no longer serviceable (cannot be used for its original purpose) divided by its [historical] capitalized cost.

FuelCostsGrossOfHedging.d: The cost for fuel, incurred during the period, before considering the impacts of any related hedging activities.

DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountPerce.l: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Percent of Required Need, Coverage
DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountPerce.d: The percentage of expected requirements covered by the aggregate notional amount of derivative contracts expressed in nonmonetary units. For example, the number of barrels specified in a fuel oil forward purchase contract as a percentage of expected need.

DerivativeAssetNumberOfInstrumentsHeld.l: Derivative Asset, Number of Instruments Held
DerivativeAssetNumberOfInstrumentsHeld.d: The number of derivative instruments of a particular derivative asset or group of derivative assets held by the entity.

DerivativeLiabilityNumberOfInstrumentsHe.l: Derivative Liability, Number of Instruments Held
DerivativeLiabilityNumberOfInstrumentsHe.d: The number of derivative instruments of a particular derivative liability or group of derivative liabilities held by the entity.

CreditDefaultSwapBuyingProtectionMember.d: Credit derivative contract between credit default swap buyer and third party in which periodic payment is made to third party and third party guarantees to reimburse if original borrower defaults.

CreditDefaultSwapSellingProtectionMember.d: Credit derivative contract between credit default swap buyer and third party in which periodic payment is received from credit default swap buyer and guarantee is made to reimburse credit default swap buyer if original borrower defaults.

DerivativeAssetFairValueGrossLiability.l: Derivative Asset, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Liability Offset
DerivativeAssetFairValueGrossLiability.d: Fair value of liability associated with financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset.

DerivativeLiabilityFairValueGrossAsset.l: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Asset Offset
DerivativeLiabilityFairValueGrossAsset.d: Fair value of asset associated with financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset.

DerivativeAssetFairValueNetAbstract.l: Derivative Asset, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, before Offset of Collateral [Abstract]

DerivativeLiabilityFairValueNetAbstract.l: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, before Offset of Collateral [Abstract]

DistributionsPerLimitedPartnershipAndGen.l: Distributions Per Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Outstanding, Basic
DistributionsPerLimitedPartnershipAndGen.d: Cash dividends declared or paid to each outstanding limited partnership and general partnership unit during the reporting period.

CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferAccretable.l: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer, Accretable Yield
CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferAccretable.d: The aggregate excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in the loan. This relates to loans with deteriorating of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNonaccreta.l: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer, Nonaccretable Difference
CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNonaccreta.d: The amount of the loan's contractually required payments receivable in excess of the amount of its cash flows expected to be collected. This relates to loans with deteriorating of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

FairValueAssetsAndLiabilitiesMeasuredOnR.l: Fair Value, Assets and Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings [Abstract]
Fair Value, Assets and Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
FairValueAssetsAndLiabilitiesMeasuredOnR.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from asset and liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

FairValueMeasurementWithUnobservableInpu.l: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) [Abstract]

AccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilitiesFair.l: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure [Abstract]

HedgingDesignationAxis.d: Information by designation of purpose of derivative instrument.

InvestmentIncomeMember.d: Primary financial statement caption encompassing investment income.

ProceedsFromAccountsReceivableSecuritiza.d: Proceeds from securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfAccountsReceivab.l: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Accounts Receivable Securitization
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfAccountsReceivab.d: Proceeds from (repayments of) securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

RepaymentsOfAccountsReceivableSecuritiza.d: Repayments of securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfAccountsReceivab.l: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Accounts Receivable Securitization [Abstract]

AvailableforsaleSecuritiesFailedAuctionV.d: The value of securities held, for which the interest rate resets through an auction process, that are categorized neither as trading nor held-to-maturity, that failed to be liquidated through auction.

AvailableforsaleSecuritiesSoldAtPar.l: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Sold at Par Value
AvailableforsaleSecuritiesSoldAtPar.d: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with interest rate reset through auction process, sold at par value.

HeldtomaturitySecuritiesDebtMaturitiesDa.d: Date of maturity of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in YYYY-MM-DD format.

HeldtomaturitySecuritiesSoldAtPar.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Sold at Par Value
HeldtomaturitySecuritiesSoldAtPar.d: Amount of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with interest rate reset through auction process, sold at par value.

EquipmentTrustCertificateMember.d: A debt security issued by a trust that purchases equipment that is then leased to the entity. The revenue stream of the leased asset services the debt. When the trust retires or otherwise satisfies the certificates, title to the asset will generally pass to the lessee. This form of financing, for example, is commonly used by, but not limited to, airlines and railroads for the purchase of aircraft or rolling stock, respectively.

EnhancedEquipmentTrustCertificateMember.d: A debt security that is separated into two or more distinct debt instruments, each with unique terms, issued by separate trusts that purchase equipment that is then leased to the entity. The revenue stream of the leased asset services the debt. When the trusts retire or otherwise satisfy the certificates, title to the asset will generally pass to the lessee. This form of financing, for example, is commonly used by, but not limited to, airlines and railroads for the purchase of aircraft or rollin

ScheduleOfOperatingLeasedAssetsTable.d: Disclosure of information about long-lived, depreciable assets that are subject to operating lease agreements and are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services. Examples may include land, buildings, machinery and equipment, and other types of furniture and equipment including, but not limited to, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment and software.

OperatingLeasedAssetsLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

GeneralFairValueHedgeInformationMinimumR.l: General Fair Value Hedge Information, Minimum R Square, Percentage (Deprecated 2026)
GeneralFairValueHedgeInformationMinimumR.d: The correlation coefficient between the hypothetical instrument and the hedged item used in determination of the effectiveness of a hedging relationship.

DerivativeInstrumentsGainLossReclassific.l: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Reclassification from Accumulated OCI to Income, Estimated Net Amount to be Transferred
DerivativeInstrumentsGainLossReclassific.d: The estimated value of gains (losses), net anticipated to be transferred in the future from accumulated other comprehensive income into earnings.

DerivativeCostOfHedgeNetOfCashReceivedAb.l: Derivative, Cost of Hedge Net of Cash Received [Abstract]

DerivativeCostOfHedge.d: The premium (cost) of a hedge, expensed during the period.

DerivativeCashReceivedOnHedge.d: The amount of cash received during the period on settlement of a hedge.

DerivativeCostOfHedgeNetOfCashReceived.l: Derivative, Cost of Hedge Net of Cash Received
DerivativeCostOfHedgeNetOfCashReceived.d: The premium (cost) of a hedge, net of any cash received on settlement during the period.

SharebasedCompensationSharesAuthorizedUn.l: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
SharebasedCompensationSharesAuthorizedUn.d: Weighted average exercise price as of the balance sheet date for those equity-based payment arrangements exercisable and outstanding.

SharebasedCompensationSharesAuthorizedUn.l: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
SharebasedCompensationSharesAuthorizedUn.d: The weighted average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees could acquire the underlying shares with respect to all outstanding stock options which are in the customized range of exercise prices.

SharebasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Intrinsic Value
SharebasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Amount of difference between fair value of the underlying shares reserved for issuance and exercise price of vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable.

OffBalanceSheetCreditExposurePolicyPolic.l: Off-Balance-Sheet Credit Exposure, Policy [Policy Text Block]
OffBalanceSheetCreditExposurePolicyPolic.d: Description of accounting policies and methodologies used to estimate the entity's liability for off-balance sheet credit exposures and related charges for those credit exposures.

ScheduleOfSharebasedCompensationRestrict.l: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Restricted Stock and Restricted Stock Unit, Activity [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfSharebasedCompensationRestrict.d: Disclosure of the number and weighted-average grant date fair value for restricted stock and restricted stock units that were outstanding at the beginning and end of the year, and the number of restricted stock and restricted stock units that were granted, vested, or forfeited during the year.

InvestmentsClassifiedByContractualMaturi.l: Investments Classified by Contractual Maturity Date [Table Text Block]
InvestmentsClassifiedByContractualMaturi.d: Tabular disclosure of maturities of an entity's investments as well as any other information pertinent to the investments.

AdjustmentsForChangeInAccountingPrincipl.d: Information by type of change in accounting principle. Excludes change from amendment to accounting standards.

AdjustmentsForNewAccountingPronouncement.d: Information by amendment to accounting standards.

FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.l: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Individually Evaluated
FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.d: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable evaluated on individual basis. Excludes financing receivable evaluated on collective basis.

BasisOfAccountingPolicyPolicyTextBlock.l: Basis of Accounting, Policy [Policy Text Block]
BasisOfAccountingPolicyPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for basis of accounting, or basis of presentation, used to prepare the financial statements (for example, US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, Other Comprehensive Basis of Accounting, IFRS).

SettlementOfAssetRetirementObligationsTh.l: Settlement of Asset Retirement Obligations Through Noncash Payments, Amount
SettlementOfAssetRetirementObligationsTh.d: Amount of asset retirement obligations settled through noncash transactions. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement from service of a tangible long-lived asset.

ServicingAsset.d: Aggregate amount of servicing assets that are subsequently measured at fair value and servicing assets that are subsequently measured using the amortization method.

ServicingLiability.d: Aggregate amount of servicing liabilities that are subsequently measured at fair value and servicing liabilities that are subsequently measured using the amortization method.

FairValueAssetsAndLiabilitiesMeasuredOnR.l: Fair Value Measurements, Recurring and Nonrecurring [Table Text Block]
FairValueAssetsAndLiabilitiesMeasuredOnR.d: Tabular disclosure of financial instrument measured at fair value on recurring or nonrecurring basis. Includes, but is not limited to, instrument classified in shareholders' equity.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNetIncludingAnd.l: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net, Including and Excluding Capital Leased Asset [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGrossExcludingC.l: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Excluding Capital Leased Assets (Deprecated 2026)
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGrossExcludingC.d: Gross amount of long-lived physical assets excluding assets held under lease agreements used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

AccumulatedDepreciationDepletionAndAmort.l: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Excluding Capital Leased Assets (Deprecated 2026)
AccumulatedDepreciationDepletionAndAmort.d: Cumulative amount of depreciation, depletion and amortization (related to property, plant and equipment, but not including land or leased assets).

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNetExcludingCap.l: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net, Excluding Capital Leased Assets (Deprecated 2026)
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNetExcludingCap.d: Amount, net of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization, of long-lived physical assets excluding assets held under lease agreements used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNetExcludingCap.l: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net, Excluding Capital Leased Assets [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

ScheduleOfBusinessInsuranceRecoveriesTab.d: Disclosure of information about business interruption insurance recoveries. Includes, but is not limited to, the nature of the event resulting in business interruption loss, amount of business interruption insurance recoveries recognized, and line item in the statement of income in which those recoveries are classified.

BusinessInterruptionLossDomain.d: Type or name of business interruption loss.

BusinessInterruptionLossLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

BusinessInsuranceRecoveriesTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for business interruption insurance recoveries. Includes, but is not limited to, the nature of the event resulting in business interruption losses, amount of business interruption insurance recoveries recognized, and line item in the statement of income in which those recoveries are classified.

ProgramRightsObligationsCurrent.d: Amount of obligations related to rights to programming, including, but not limited to, feature films and episodic series, acquired under license agreements that will be paid within the next twelve months.

ProgramRightsObligationsNoncurrent.d: Amount of obligations related to rights to programming, including, but not limited to, feature films and episodic series, acquired under license agreements that will be paid after one year.

ProgramRightsObligations.d: Total amount of obligations related to rights to programming, including, but not limited to, feature films and episodic series, acquired under license agreements.

ProceedsFromLoanOriginations1.d: Cash inflow associated with loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property) or lease origination.

ProceedsFromLoanAndLeaseOriginationsAndP.l: Proceeds from Loan and Lease Originations and Principal Collections
ProceedsFromLoanAndLeaseOriginationsAndP.d: Cash inflow related to a loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property), lease origination, and principal collections.

ScheduleOfUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsExcludi.l: Schedule of Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Excluding Amounts Pertaining to Examined Tax Returns Roll Forward [Table Text Block] (Deprecated 2024)
ScheduleOfUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsExcludi.d: Tabular disclosure of the change in unrecognized tax benefits, excluding amounts pertaining to examined tax returns.

RestructuringReserveAcceleratedDepreciat.l: Restructuring and Related Cost, Accelerated Depreciation
RestructuringReserveAcceleratedDepreciat.d: Amount of accelerated depreciation charged against earnings associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring plan.

OtherRestructuringMember.d: Restructuring and related activities classified as other.

DefinedBenefitPlanEstimatedFutureEmploye.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions [Abstract]

AuctionRateSecuritiesNoncurrent.d: Amount of securities that are debt instruments (corporate or municipal bonds) that typically have long-term nominal maturities for which the interest rate is reset through an auction process.

ContingentConvertiblePreferredStockMembe.d: Preferred stock that may be exchanged into common shares or other types of securities based on a contingency.

DefinedBenefitPlanAssetsTransferredToFro.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Assets Transferred to (from) Plan
DefinedBenefitPlanAssetsTransferredToFro.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from assets transferred into (from) plan.

DefinedContributionPlanEmployerMatchingC.l: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Matching Contribution, Percent of Employees' Gross Pay
DefinedContributionPlanEmployerMatchingC.d: Percentage of employees' gross pay for which the employer contributes a matching contribution to a defined contribution plan.

RelatedPartyTransactionArmsLengthBasisOf.l: Related Party Transaction, Arms Length, Basis of Transactions
RelatedPartyTransactionArmsLengthBasisOf.d: Description of the basis for substantiating that a related party transaction was carried out at an arm's-length basis.

DefinedContributionPlanEmployersMatching.l: Defined Contribution Plan, Employers Matching Contribution, Annual Vesting Percentage
DefinedContributionPlanEmployersMatching.d: Percentage of employer's matching contributions to a defined contribution plan that vests in a given year.

DefinedContributionPlanEmployerDiscretio.l: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Discretionary Contribution Amount
DefinedContributionPlanEmployerDiscretio.d: Amount of discretionary contributions made by an employer to a defined contribution plan.

DefinedContributionPlanAdministrativeExp.d: Amount of administrative expense incurred by defined contribution plan.

RelatedPartyTransactionPurchasesFromRela.l: Related Party Transaction, Purchases from Related Party
RelatedPartyTransactionPurchasesFromRela.d: Purchases during the period (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party.

DefinedBenefitPlanOtherChanges.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Other Change
DefinedBenefitPlanOtherChanges.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from change, classified as other.

DebtInstrumentCollateralFee.d: Amount of fees associated with providing collateral for the debt instrument.

CashAvailableForDistributions.d: Amount of cash eligible for distribution to members or limited partners of limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP), subject to reserves to be maintained as defined in operating or partnership agreement, or in a credit facility agreement.

StockOrUnitsAvailableForDistributions.l: Stock or Units Available for Distributions
StockOrUnitsAvailableForDistributions.d: Number of stock or units eligible for distribution to members or limited partners of the limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

OtherCurrentAssetsTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for other current assets.

ScheduleOfOtherCurrentAssetsTableTextBlo.l: Schedule of Other Current Assets [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfOtherCurrentAssetsTableTextBlo.d: Tabular disclosure of the carrying amounts of other current assets.

UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.l: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Change of Amount as Result of Variable Components
UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligatio.d: Amount of change that payments under a contractual obligation might vary as facts and circumstances change.

DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherCompre.l: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax [Abstract]
Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), after Tax
DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherCompre.d: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherCompre.l: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax
DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherCompre.d: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

DefinedBenefitPlanAdministrationExpenses.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Administration Expense
DefinedBenefitPlanAdministrationExpenses.d: Amount of administration expense of defined benefit plan which decreases plan assets. Excludes plan administration expense paid by employer.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amortization of Present Value of Regulated Asset for Plant Abandonment
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Amortization of the present value amount of future cost recoveries related to plant abandonment in regulated industries.

OptionIndexedToIssuersEquitySettlementAl.l: Option Contract Indexed to Equity, Settlement, Cash, Amount
OptionIndexedToIssuersEquitySettlementAl.d: Amount that would be paid upon settlement of option contract indexed to equity.

OptionIndexedToIssuersEquitySettlementAl.l: Option Contract Indexed to Equity, Settlement, Number of Shares
OptionIndexedToIssuersEquitySettlementAl.d: Number of shares as a settlement alternative for each freestanding option contract.

ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquitySet.l: Forward Contract Indexed to Equity, Settlement, Cash, Amount
ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquitySet.d: Amount that would be paid upon settlement of forward contract indexed to equity.

ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquitySet.l: Forward Contract Indexed to Equity, Settlement, Number of Shares
ForwardContractIndexedToIssuersEquitySet.d: Number of shares as a settlement alternative for each freestanding forward contract.

PublicUtilitiesAmountOfAllowanceForFunds.l: Public Utilities, Amount of Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Equity Costs Capitalized Only for Rate-making Purposes
PublicUtilitiesAmountOfAllowanceForFunds.d: Amount of costs of debt and equity financing capitalized for setting rates but not capitalized for financial statement purposes.

EnvironmentalExitCostsReasonablyPossible.l: Environmental Exit Costs, Reasonably Possible Additional Loss
EnvironmentalExitCostsReasonablyPossible.d: Estimate of reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of amount accrued for remediation, site restoration, postclosure, monitoring commitments, or other exit costs associated with the sale, disposal or abandonment of a particular property resulting from unanticipated contamination of the assets.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Disclosures, Repayment and Penalties
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtOb.d: Amount of repayments and penalties incurred in the satisfaction or roll-over of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) advance.

EnvironmentalCostsRecognizedCapitalizedI.l: Environmental Costs Recognized, Capitalized in Period
EnvironmentalCostsRecognizedCapitalizedI.d: Amount of environmental remediation costs capitalized. These expenditures may relate to long-lived improvements in operating facilities.

DeferredSalesCommission.d: Carrying amount of advanced commission payments.

DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherCompre.l: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), after Tax
DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedOtherCompre.d: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

StraightLineRent.d: Difference between actual rental income due and rental income recognized on a straight-line basis.

EnvironmentalCostsRecognizedRecoveryCred.d: Amount of expense recovery for known and estimated future costs arising from requirement to perform environmental remediation.

EnvironmentalCostsRecognizedCapitalized.d: Amount of costs recognized in the balance sheet for known or estimated future costs arising from requirements to perform activities to remediate one or more sites.

NonredeemableNoncontrollingInterest.d: Portion of equity (net assets) in a subsidiary not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity which is not redeemable by the parent entity.

InventoryNetOfAllowancesCustomerAdvances.l: Inventory, Net of Allowances, Customer Advances and Progress Billings
InventoryNetOfAllowancesCustomerAdvances.d: Amount, after deduction of valuation reserves, other allowances, and customer advances received on long-term contracts or programs, of inventory expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within the normal operating cycle.

InventoryNetOfAllowancesCustomerAdvances.l: Inventory, Net of Allowances, Customer Advances and Progress Billings [Abstract]

RestructuringPlanDomain.d: Identification of the individual restructuring plans.

ProductLiabilityContingencyLossInestimab.l: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Inestimable Statement (Deprecated 2024)
ProductLiabilityContingencyLossInestimab.d: Statement to the effect that an estimate of the probable or reasonably possible loss or range of loss for product liability damages cannot be made.

EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPWeightedAv.l: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Weighted Average Purchase Price of Shares Purchased
EmployeeStockOwnershipPlanESOPWeightedAv.d: Weighted average purchase price of capital shares purchased through an employee stock ownership plan.

ExchangeableDebtMember.d: Debt instrument that permits the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring assets upon an event that is certain to occur.

ScheduleOfIndefiniteLivedIntangibleAsset.d: Tabular disclosure of indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.
Disclosure of information about indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

ScheduleOfFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTab.d: Tabular disclosure of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.
Disclosure of information about finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

GainLossOnDispositionOfRealEstateDiscont.l: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Real Estate, Discontinued Operations
GainLossOnDispositionOfRealEstateDiscont.d: Amount of difference between the carrying amount and the sales price of real estate properties sold as part of discontinued operations.

OtherAdjustmentsToIncomeDiscontinuedOper.l: Other Adjustments to Income, Discontinued Operations
OtherAdjustmentsToIncomeDiscontinuedOper.d: Amount of noncash income (expense), classified as other, from discontinued operations.

FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedD.l: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, Derivatives and Other Contracts
FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedD.d: Fair value of obligations arising from derivatives and other contracts sold short.

NoncontrollingInterestInVariableInterest.l: Noncontrolling Interest in Variable Interest Entity
NoncontrollingInterestInVariableInterest.d: Portion of equity (net assets) in a variable interest entity (VIE) not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity. That is, this is the portion of equity in a VIE that is attributable to the noncontrolling interest (previously referred to as minority interest).

RiskWeightedAssets.d: Amount of risk-weighted assets as defined by regulatory framework.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsRollForward.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsPeriodIncreas.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Outstanding [Roll Forward]
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Outstanding, Number
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Number of equity instruments other than options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested instruments.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Granted
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Net number of non-option equity instruments granted to participants.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Cash Awards Granted, Percentage
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Commitment made to pay deferred cash remuneration expressed as a percentage of the individual's base salary.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Exercised
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Number of non-option equity instruments exercised by participants.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Forfeitures and Expirations [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Forfeitures
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements that were cancelled as a result of occurrence of a terminating event.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Expirations
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements for which rights to exercise lapsed.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Forfeitures and Expirations
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements that were either cancelled or expired.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Other
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Other increase (decrease) in number of shares reserved for issuance under non-option equity instrument agreements that is not separately disclosed.

TransmissionServiceAgreementMember.d: Agreement between a transmission customer and the transmission provider for service.

InsuranceContractsAcquiredInBusinessComb.l: Insurance Contracts Acquired in Business Combination [Member]
InsuranceContractsAcquiredInBusinessComb.d: Written contracts detailing the terms and conditions of insurance acquired in a business combination.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Other, Description
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Description of reason for increase (decrease), classified as other, in number of awards under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

NonrecurringAdjustmentAxis.l: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Nonrecurring Adjustment [Axis]
NonrecurringAdjustmentAxis.d: Information by nonrecurring adjustment directly attributable to business combination included in reported pro forma revenue and earnings.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Weighted average fair value as of the grant date of equity-based award plans other than stock (unit) option plans that were not exercised or put into effect as a result of the occurrence of a terminating event.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of award forfeited under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

DeferredTaxAssetsNetOfValuationAllowance.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance [Abstract]

StraightLineRentAdjustments.d: Amount of the adjustment to rental revenues to measure escalating leasing revenues on a straight line basis.

ScheduleOfRevenueSourcesHealthCareOrgani.l: Schedule of Revenue Sources, Health Care Organization [Table Text Block] (Deprecated 2024)

ScheduleOfRevenueSourcesHealthCareOrgani.l: Schedule of Revenue Sources, Health Care Organization [Table] (Deprecated 2024)

HealthCareOrganizationRevenueNetOfPatien.l: Health Care Organization, Revenue Net of Patient Service Revenue Provisions [Abstract] (Deprecated 2024)

HealthCareOrganizationPatientServiceReve.d: Amount of the provision for bad debts related to patient service revenue.

HealthCareOrganizationPatientServiceReve.d: Amount of patient service revenue, net of contractual allowances and discounts, less the related provision for bad debts.

HealthCareOrganizationRevenueNetOfPatien.d: Amount of patient service revenue recognized, net of contractual allowances and discounts, less the provision for bad debts related to patient service revenue plus all other revenue.

HealthCareOrganizationAllowanceForDoubtf.l: Health Care Organization, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Percentage of Accounts Receivable (Deprecated 2024)
HealthCareOrganizationAllowanceForDoubtf.d: Ratio of the allowance for doubtful accounts to accounts receivable, expressed as a percentage, for health care organizations.

ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithNoRelated.l: Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Unpaid Principal Balance
ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithNoRelated.d: Amount of unpaid principal balance of impaired financing receivables for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithRelatedAl.l: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Unpaid Principal Balance
ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithRelatedAl.d: Unpaid principal balance of impaired financing receivables for which there is a related allowance for credit losses.

ImpairedFinancingReceivableUnpaidPrincip.l: Impaired Financing Receivable, Unpaid Principal Balance [Abstract]

ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithNoRelated.l: Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Average Recorded Investment
ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithNoRelated.d: Amount of average investment of impaired financing receivables for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithRelatedAl.l: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Average Recorded Investment
ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithRelatedAl.d: Amount of average investment of impaired financing receivables for which there is a related allowance for credit losses.

ImpairedFinancingReceivableAverageRecord.l: Impaired Financing Receivable, Average Recorded Investment [Abstract]

ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithNoRelated.l: Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Recorded Investment
ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithNoRelated.d: Amount of investment in impaired financing receivables for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithRelatedAl.l: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Recorded Investment
ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithRelatedAl.d: Amount of investment in impaired financing receivables for which there is a related allowance for credit losses.

ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithNoRelated.d: Amount of interest income, recognized on accrual basis, on financing receivables that are recognized as impaired, for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithNoRelated.d: Amount of interest income, recognized on cash basis, on financing receivables, for which there is no related allowance for credit losses and are recognized as impaired.

ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithRelatedAl.d: Amount of interest income on financing receivables, for which there is a related allowance for credit losses, recognized on a cash-basis method of accounting that the financing receivables were impaired.

ImpairedFinancingReceivableInterestIncom.l: Impaired Financing Receivable, Interest Income, Cash Basis Method [Abstract]

HealthCareOrganizationDisclosuresforCert.l: Health Care Organization, Disclosures for Certain Health Care Entities [Abstract] (Deprecated 2024)

DeferredCostsAndOtherAssets.d: Amount of deferred cost assets and assets classified as other.

IndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsPurchaseA.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in indefinite-lived intangible asset from measurement period adjustment. Excludes goodwill.

EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNon.d: Amount of cost to be recognized for option under share-based payment arrangement.

CausesOfIncreaseDecreaseInLiabilityForUn.d: Description of whether additional premiums or return premiums have been accrued as a result of the change in incurred claims and claim adjustment expenses.

ComprehensiveIncomePolicyPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for comprehensive income.

DebtInstrumentSinkingFundPayment.d: Amount paid into a fund, which is used to retire the debt instrument.

DebtInstrumentCumulativeSinkingFundPayme.l: Debt Instrument, Cumulative Sinking Fund Payments
DebtInstrumentCumulativeSinkingFundPayme.d: Cumulative amount paid into a fund, which is used to retire the debt instrument.

ImpairmentOrDisposalOfLongLivedAssetsInc.l: Long-Lived Asset, Including Intangible Asset and Goodwill, Impairment and Disposal [Policy Text Block]
ImpairmentOrDisposalOfLongLivedAssetsInc.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for the impairment and disposal of long-lived assets including goodwill and other intangible assets.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTranslationAn.l: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Foreign Currency Translation and Measurement Period Adjustments
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsTranslationAn.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.
