NumberOfPropertiesSubjectToGroundLeases.l: Number of Properties Subject to Ground Leases
NumberOfPropertiesSubjectToGroundLeases.d: Number of separate real estate development properties located on land subject to ground leases.

AboveMarketLeasesMember.d: Leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at above market lease rate.

AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivableRo.l: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss [Roll Forward]
AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivableRo.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivablePe.l: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivablePe.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.l: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.d: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from recovery.

LeasingCommissionsExpense.d: Amount of commissions expense incurred because the lessor of real estate obtained a lessee for a rental property through a real estate agent.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Rental Income
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount of rental income attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountAttributabl.l: Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Attributable to Parent
TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountAttributabl.d: Carrying amount, attributable to parent, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the hol

TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountIncludingPo.d: Carrying amount, attributable to parent and noncontrolling interests, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeem

ExcessStockNumberOfSharesParValueAndOthe.l: Excess Stock, Number of Shares, Par Value and Other Disclosure [Abstract]

ExcessStockSharesAuthorized.d: Maximum number of excess stock shares permitted to be issued.

ExcessStockSharesIssued.d: Number of excess stock shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders.

ExcessStockSharesOutstanding.d: Number of shares of excess stock held by shareholders.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price [Abstract]
Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price [Abstract]

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementsByShar.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementsByShar.d: Weighted average per share amount at which grantees can acquire shares of common stock by exercise of options.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementsByShar.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementsByShar.d: Weighted average price at which option holders acquired shares when converting their stock options into shares.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementsByShar.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementsByShar.d: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options that were terminated.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementsByShar.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementsByShar.d: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options of the plan that expired.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementsByShar.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangements by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Other Share Increase (Decrease) in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementsByShar.d: Weighted average price at which grantees could acquire or could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to any other type of change in shares reserved for issuance.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Period Increase (Decrease), Weighted Average Exercise Price
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Change in the weighted average exercise price of options outstanding.

CumulativeDividends.d: Amount of cumulative cash dividends distributed to shareholders.

PerformanceSharesMember.d: Share-based payment arrangement awarded for meeting performance target.

PhantomShareUnitsPSUsMember.d: Share-based payment arrangement awarded as phantom share or unit.

HealthCareOrganizationPatientServiceReve.l: Health Care Organization, Patient Service Revenue Less Provision for Bad Debts [Abstract] (Deprecated 2024)

EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNon.l: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount [Abstract]

SaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpenses.l: Sale of Trust Assets to Pay Expenses
SaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpenses.d: Amount of sale of trust assets (includes, but is not limited to, gold and silver) to pay trust expenses.

GainLossOnSaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpenses.l: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Trust Assets to Pay Expenses
GainLossOnSaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpenses.d: Gain (loss) related to the sale of trust assets (includes, but is not limited to, gold and silver) to pay trust expenses.

GainLossOnSaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpenses.l: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Trust Assets to Pay Expenses [Abstract]

CostOfTrustAssetsSoldToPayExpenses.l: Cost, Trust Asset Sold to Pay Expense
CostOfTrustAssetsSoldToPayExpenses.d: Cost of trust assets sold to pay trust expenses (includes commodities, but is not limited to, gold and silver).

DefinedBenefitPlanFundedPercentage.d: Percentage of plan assets to benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

OtherCreditDerivativesMember.d: Credit derivative contract classified as other.

AccumulatedDistributionsInExcessOfNetInc.l: Accumulated Distributions in Excess of Net Income [Abstract]

CumulativeEarningsDeficit.d: Amount of cumulative earnings (deficits) for relevant time periods.

CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNotAccount.l: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Allowance for Loan Losses, Decreases
CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNotAccount.d: Amount of reduction in the reserve for loans impairments as a result of current information and events which result in it being probable that estimated cash flows will be significantly higher than previously expected or because actual cash flows are significantly greater than cash flows previously expected for loans not accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that was acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at ac

CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNotAccount.l: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Provision for Loan Losses
CertainLoansAcquiredInTransferNotAccount.d: Amount of expense related to loan loss not accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

PaymentsForLeasingCostsCommissionsAndTen.l: Payment for Initial Direct Cost and Leasehold Improvement for Lease, Investing Activity [Abstract]

PaymentsForLeasingCosts.l: Payment for Initial Direct Cost, Lease, Investing Activity
PaymentsForLeasingCosts.d: Amount of cash outflow for initial direct cost of lease incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

PaymentsForTenantImprovements.l: Payment for Leasehold Improvement, Lessor, Investing Activity
PaymentsForTenantImprovements.d: Amount of cash outflow for cost of leasehold improvement to premises leased to tenant incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

PaymentsForLeaseCommissions.l: Payment for Lease Commission, Investing Activity
PaymentsForLeaseCommissions.d: Amount of cash outflow for lease commission incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmoun.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Reported Amount, Covered and Not Covered [Abstract]
Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Reported Amount, Covered and Not Covered
LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmoun.d: Amount after allowance and deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums over and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Includes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Outstanding, Weighted-Average Remaining Contractual Term
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Weighted-average contractual term remaining for equity-based award excluding option, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

BalanceSheetLocationAxis.l: Statement of Financial Position Location, Balance [Axis] (Deprecated 2026)
BalanceSheetLocationAxis.d: Information by location in statement of financial position where disaggregated cumulative balance is reported.

ContractualObligationDueInSecondAndThird.l: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two and Three [Abstract]

ContractualObligationDueInSecondYear.l: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
ContractualObligationDueInSecondYear.d: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

ContractualObligationDueInThirdYear.l: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
ContractualObligationDueInThirdYear.d: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

ContractualObligationDueInSecondAndThird.l: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two and Three
ContractualObligationDueInSecondAndThird.d: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in second and third fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

ContractualObligationDueInFourthAndFifth.l: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four and Five [Abstract]

ContractualObligationDueInFourthYear.l: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
ContractualObligationDueInFourthYear.d: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

ContractualObligationDueInFifthYear.l: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
ContractualObligationDueInFifthYear.d: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

ContractualObligationDueInFourthAndFifth.l: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four and Five
ContractualObligationDueInFourthAndFifth.d: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fourth and fifth fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

ContractualObligationDueAfterFifthYear.l: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
ContractualObligationDueAfterFifthYear.d: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

ContractualObligation.d: Amount of contractual obligation, including, but not limited to, long-term debt, lease obligation, purchase obligation, and other commitments.

SubsequentEventEffectOfChangeInTaxStatus.l: Subsequent Event, Effect of Change in Tax Status
SubsequentEventEffectOfChangeInTaxStatus.d: Monetary effect of a change in the tax status effective after year-end but before the financial statements for the reporting period are issued or available to be issue by the entity.

DividendsAxis.d: Information by event wherein earnings are distributed to shareholder.

DividendsDomain.d: Event wherein earnings are distributed to shareholder.

LitigationStatusAxis.d: Information by status of pending, threatened, or settled litigation.

LitigationStatusDomain.d: Status of pending, threatened, or settled litigation.

PendingLitigationMember.d: Risk of loss associated with the outcome of pending litigation against the entity, for example, but not limited to, litigation in arbitration or within the trial process.

ThreatenedLitigationMember.d: Risk of loss associated with the outcome of threatened litigation against the entity.

PlanNameAxis.d: Information by plan name for share-based payment arrangement.

PlanNameDomain.d: Plan name for share-based payment arrangement.

AwardTypeAxis.d: Information by type of award under share-based payment arrangement.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmoun.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Reported Amount, Covered [Abstract]

LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmo.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Covered
LoansAndLeasesReceivableGrossCarryingAmo.d: Aggregate gross carrying amount of loans and leases receivable covered by loss sharing agreements.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableAllowanceCovered.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance, Covered
LoansAndLeasesReceivableAllowanceCovered.d: Amount of allowance for loan and lease losses covered by loss sharing agreements.

LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmoun.l: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Reported Amount, Covered
LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmoun.d: Net carrying amount of loans and leases receivable covered by loss sharing agreements.

OtherRealEstateCovered.d: Carrying amount of other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

ScheduleOfCashAndCashEquivalentsTable.d: Disclosure of information about cash and cash equivalent by type. Excludes restricted cash and cash equivalent.

CashAndCashEquivalentsAxis.d: Information by type of cash and cash equivalent balance.

CashAndCashEquivalentsLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

LossContingencyDamagesAwardedValue.d: Amount of damages awarded to the plaintiff in the legal matter.

LossContingencyDamagesPaidValue.d: Amount of damages paid to the plaintiff in the legal matter.

ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithRelatedAl.l: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Interest Income, Accrual Method
ImpairedFinancingReceivableWithRelatedAl.d: Amount of interest income, recognized on accrual basis, on financing receivables, for which there is a related allowance for credit losses and are recognized as impaired.

SubsequentEventMember.d: Identifies event that occurred after the balance sheet date but before financial statements are issued or available to be issued.

IncomeStatementLocationAxis.d: Information by location in statement of income where disaggregated amount is reported.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLocationAxis.d: Information by location in other comprehensive income.

IncomeStatementLocationDomain.d: Location in statement of income where disaggregated amount is reported.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Common Stock Reserved for Future Issuance
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Number of common shares reserved for future issuance related to deferred compensation arrangements with individuals.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Allocated Share-Based Compensation Expense
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Amount of expense recognized from equity-based compensation arrangements (for example, shares of stock, unit, stock options or other equity instruments), awarded to key employees or individuals. Excludes amount related to plans that cover generally all employees (for example, but not limited to, qualified pension plans).

TreasuryLockMember.d: Customized agreement that fixes the yield or price on a specified treasury security for a specific period.

FairValueOptionDifferencesBetweenFairVal.l: Fair Value Option, Differences Between Fair Values and Contractual Cash Flows (Deprecated 2025)
FairValueOptionDifferencesBetweenFairVal.d: Information regarding the differences between fair value and contractual cash flows.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Percentage of Outstanding Stock Maximum
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Maximum number of shares that may be issued in accordance with the plan as a proportion of outstanding capital stock.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Number of Additional Shares Authorized
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Number of additional shares authorized for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Accelerated Cost
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Amount of additional cost recognized for award under share-based payment arrangement from occurrence of event accelerating recognition of cost.

AmountRecognizedInNetPeriodicBenefitCost.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Amount Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit) and Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax [Abstract]
Defined Benefit Plan, Amount Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit) and Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax
AmountRecognizedInNetPeriodicBenefitCost.d: Amount recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) and other comprehensive (income) loss.

PreferredStockLiquidationPreferenceValue.d: Value of the difference between preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the preferred shares.

InterestIncomeOther.d: Amount of interest income earned from interest bearing assets classified as other.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetUsefulLife.d: Useful life of finite-lived intangible asset, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

AcquiredFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsWeigh.l: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Acquired, Weighted-Average Amortization Period
AcquiredFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsWeigh.d: Weighted-average period of amortization for finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

FairValueAssumptionDateOfSecuritizationO.l: Fair Value Assumption, Date of Securitization or Asset-Backed Financing Arrangement, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Servicing Assets or Liabilities, Weighted-Average Life
FairValueAssumptionDateOfSecuritizationO.d: Weighted-average life of securitized asset for initial fair value measurement, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

OilAndGasPropertyAbstract.l: Oil and Gas, Joint Interest Billing, Receivable [Abstract]

OilAndGasPropertiesPolicyPolicyTextBlock.l: Oil and Gas, Property [Policy Text Block]
OilAndGasPropertiesPolicyPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for oil and gas property which may include the basis of such assets, depreciation methods used and estimated useful lives, the entity's capitalization policy, including its accounting treatment for costs incurred for repairs and maintenance activities, whether such asset balances include capitalized interest and the method by which such is calculated, how disposals of such assets are accounted for and how impairment of such assets is assessed and recognized.

OilAndGasPropertiesTextBlock.l: Oil and Gas, Property and Equipment [Text Block]
OilAndGasPropertiesTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for properties used in normal conduct of oil and gas exploration and producing operations. This disclosure may include property accounting policies and methodology, a schedule of property, plant and equipment gross, additions, deletions, transfers and other changes, depreciation, depletion and amortization expense, net, accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization expense and useful lives.

EnergyRelatedDerivativeMember.d: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to energy, for example, but not limited to, crude oil, electricity and natural gas.

DeferredTaxAssetsStateTaxes.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from state taxes.

DeferredTaxAssetsInvestments.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from investments (excludes investments in subsidiaries and equity method investments).

CoalContractMember.d: Derivative instrument whose primary underlying risk is tied to coal.

AcquisitionRelatedCostsMember.l: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Nonrecurring Adjustment, Acquisition-Related Cost [Member]
AcquisitionRelatedCostsMember.d: Nonrecurring adjustment for acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination included in reported pro forma earnings.

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesDeferredExpenseRes.l: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals
DeferredTaxLiabilitiesDeferredExpenseRes.d: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from reserves and accruals.

UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreasesResultin.l: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Foreign Currency Translation
UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreasesResultin.d: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from foreign currency translation.

UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreasesResultin.l: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Foreign Currency Translation
UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreasesResultin.d: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from foreign currency translation.

SettlementWithTaxingAuthorityMember.d: Settlement reached with a taxing authority.

DepreciationDepletionAndAmortizationPoli.l: Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization [Policy Text Block]
DepreciationDepletionAndAmortizationPoli.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for depreciation, depletion, and amortization of property and equipment costs, including methods used and estimated useful lives and how impairment of such assets is assessed and recognized.

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesPrepaidExpenses.d: Amount of deferred tax consequences attributable to taxable temporary differences derived from prepaid expenses.

CapitalLossCarryforwardMember.d: Deductions derived from capital losses that cannot be utilized on the tax return during a period that have been carried forward to reduce taxable income or taxes payable in a future year.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredStockPref.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock, Preference Stock, and Warrants [Abstract]
Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock, Preference Stock, and Warrants
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredStockPref.d: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholder, which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation and from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at a predetermined price.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStockDividen.l: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStockDividen.d: Amount of cash inflow from capital contributions to an entity associated with a dividend reinvestment plan.

UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreasesResultin.l: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Acquisition
UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncreasesResultin.d: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from acquisitions.

UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreasesResultin.l: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Acquisition
UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsDecreasesResultin.d: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from acquisitions.

PreferredPartnerMember.d: Partner with preferential rights over the limited partner in areas that could include, but are not limited to, liquidation, redemption, conversion, tax status of distribution or sharing in distributions.

OtherOwnershipInterestMember.d: Holder of an ownership interest in a partnership who is not classified as a general partner, preferred partner, or limited partner.

NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyT.l: New Accounting Pronouncements, Policy [Policy Text Block]
NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyT.d: Disclosure of accounting policy pertaining to new accounting pronouncements that may impact the entity's financial reporting. Includes, but is not limited to, quantification of the expected or actual impact.

ReceivablesFromStockholderMember.d: Category of equity that is due from owners or affiliates of the reporting entity (including due from officers or directors) resulting from the sale of stock before the cash payment is received.

FederalHomeLoanBankStockAndFederalReserv.l: Federal Home Loan Bank Stock and Federal Reserve Bank Stock [Abstract]
Federal Home Loan Bank Stock and Federal Reserve Bank Stock
FederalHomeLoanBankStockAndFederalReserv.d: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) and Federal Reserve Bank stock.

IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuingOperati.l: Income Tax (Expense) Benefit, Continuing Operations, Government Grants
IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuingOperati.d: Amount of tax (expense) benefit from continuing operations attributable to government grants to the extent recognized as a reduction of income tax expense.

GainLossOnRepurchaseOfDebtInstrument.l: Gain (Loss) on Repurchase of Debt Instrument
GainLossOnRepurchaseOfDebtInstrument.d: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the repurchase price of a debt instrument initially issued by the entity and the net carrying amount of the debt at the time of its repurchase.

IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuingOperati.l: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Adjustment of Deferred Tax (Asset) Liability
IncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuingOperati.d: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from continuing operations attributable to an adjustment of a deferred tax liability or asset for enacted changes in tax laws or rates or a change in the tax status of the entity.

PriorPeriodReclassificationAdjustmentDes.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for reclassification affecting comparability of financial statement. Excludes amendment to accounting standards, other change in accounting principle, and correction of error.

ScheduleOfCarryingValuesAndEstimatedFair.l: Schedule of Carrying Values and Estimated Fair Values of Debt Instruments [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfCarryingValuesAndEstimatedFair.d: Tabular disclosure of information pertaining to carrying amount and estimated fair value of short-term and long-term debt instruments or arrangements, including but not limited to, identification of terms, features, and collateral requirements.

DebtInstrumentRepurchaseAmount.d: Fair value amount of debt instrument that was repurchased.

InterestCapitalizationPolicyPolicyTextBl.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for interest capitalization.

ConcentrationRiskCreditRisk.l: Concentration Risk, Credit Risk, Policy [Policy Text Block]
ConcentrationRiskCreditRisk.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for credit risk. Includes, but is not limited to, policy for entering into master netting arrangement or similar agreement to mitigate credit risk of financial instrument.

StockAndWarrantsIssuedDuringPeriodValueP.l: Stock and Warrants Issued During Period, Value, Preferred Stock and Warrants
StockAndWarrantsIssuedDuringPeriodValueP.d: Value of preferred stock and warrants for common stock issued.

AccruedLiabilitiesAndOtherLiabilities.d: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid nor invoiced, and liabilities classified as other.

ManagementFeePayable.d: Amount of fee payable for management of fund or trust.

DomesticLineOfCreditMember.d: Contractual arrangement with a lender under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time, and under which borrowings outstanding may be either short-term or long-term, depending upon the particulars, inside the reporting entity's home country.

ForeignLineOfCreditMember.d: Contractual arrangement with a lender under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time, and under which borrowings outstanding may be either short-term or long-term, depending upon the particulars, outside the reporting entity's home country.

RevolvingCreditFacilityMember.d: Arrangement in which loan proceeds can continuously be obtained following repayments, but the total amount borrowed cannot exceed a specified maximum amount.

CreditFacilityAxis.d: Information by type of credit facility. Credit facilities provide capital to borrowers without the need to structure a loan for each borrowing.

CreditFacilityDomain.d: Type of credit facility. Credit facilities provide capital to borrowers without the need to structure a loan for each borrowing.

GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness.d: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.

NetIncomeLossAttributableToNonredeemable.l: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
NetIncomeLossAttributableToNonredeemable.d: Portion of net income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest.

DeferredTaxAssetsPropertyPlantAndEquipme.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Property, Plant and Equipment
DeferredTaxAssetsPropertyPlantAndEquipme.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

DeferredTaxLiabilitiesInvestments.d: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from investments (excludes investments in subsidiaries and equity method investments).

DeferredTaxAssetsGoodwillAndIntangibleAs.l: Deferred Tax Assets, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
DeferredTaxAssetsGoodwillAndIntangibleAs.d: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

MarketDataRevenue.d: Amount of revenue from market data services, including, but not limited to, information about current quotes and most recent prices for a specific security.

DebtInstrumentRepurchasedFaceAmount.d: Face (par) amount of the original debt instrument that was repurchased.

DebtorReorganizationItemsInterestIncomeO.l: Debtor Reorganization Items, Interest Income on Accumulated Cash
DebtorReorganizationItemsInterestIncomeO.d: Amount of interest income on accumulated cash, reported as a reorganization item.

DeferredIncomeTaxesAndOtherLiabilitiesAb.l: Deferred Income Taxes and Other Liabilities [Abstract]

DerivativeCreditRiskValuationAdjustmentD.l: Derivative Credit Risk Valuation Adjustment, Derivative Assets
DerivativeCreditRiskValuationAdjustmentD.d: Amount of credit risk valuation adjustment to derivative assets to properly reflect the credit quality of the counterparties.

DerivativeCreditRiskValuationAdjustmentD.l: Derivative Credit Risk Valuation Adjustment, Derivative Liabilities
DerivativeCreditRiskValuationAdjustmentD.d: Amount of credit risk valuation adjustment to derivative liabilities to properly reflect the credit quality of the entity.

MajorCustomersPolicyPolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for major customers. Major customers are those that the loss of such customers would have a material adverse effect on the entity.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinalization.d: Amount, before tax, of increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinalization.l: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Settlement and Curtailment Gain (Loss), after Tax
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinalization.d: Amount, after tax, of increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

AssetsFairValueAdjustment.d: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which an asset could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

LiabilitiesFairValueAdjustment.d: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which a liability could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

EquityFairValueAdjustment.d: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which an instrument classified in shareholders' equity could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

TypesOfCommercialAircraftTableTextBlock.l: Types of Commercial Aircraft [Table Text Block]
TypesOfCommercialAircraftTableTextBlock.d: Tabular disclosure of information by type of commercial aircraft.

TypesOfCommercialAircraftTable.d: Disclosure of information about type of commercial aircraft.

AirlineDestinationTableTextBlock.d: Tabular disclosure of airline-related information by geographic areas as defined by the U.S. Department of Transportation.

AirlineDestinationTable.d: Disclosure of information about airline by destination as defined by U.S. Department of Transportation.

TransferToInvestments.d: Value of investments transferred to the entity's investments in noncash transactions.

TransferToOtherRealEstate.l: Real Estate Owned, Transfer to Real Estate Owned
TransferToOtherRealEstate.d: Value transferred from mortgage loans to real estate owned (REO) in noncash transactions.

NetSharesReclassifiedToMandatorilyRedeem.l: Net Shares Reclassified to Mandatorily Redeemable Capital Stock, Value
NetSharesReclassifiedToMandatorilyRedeem.d: Value of net shares reclassified to mandatorily redeemable capital stock.

NetSharesReclassifiedToMandatorilyRedeem.l: Net Shares Reclassified to Mandatorily Redeemable Capital Stock, Shares
NetSharesReclassifiedToMandatorilyRedeem.d: Net number of shares reclassified to mandatorily redeemable capital stock.

OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueI.l: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two and Three [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)
Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two and Three (Deprecated 2026)
OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueI.d: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second and third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueI.l: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four and Five [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)
Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four and Five (Deprecated 2026)
OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueI.d: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth and fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

OtherRealEstateNonCoveredRollForward.l: Other Real Estate, Non Covered [Roll Forward]
OtherRealEstateNonCoveredRollForward.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

ContractualObligationDueInNextTwelveMont.l: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
ContractualObligationDueInNextTwelveMont.d: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

DiscontinuedOperationAmountsOfMaterialCo.l: Discontinued Operation, Amounts of Material Contingent Liabilities Remaining
DiscontinuedOperationAmountsOfMaterialCo.d: Amounts of material contingent liabilities, for example, but not limited to, product or environmental liabilities or litigation, that remain with the entity despite the disposal of the disposal group that is classified as a component of the entity.

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetWeightedAverag.l: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Renewed or Extended, before Next Renewal or Extension, Weighted-Average Period
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetWeightedAverag.d: Weighted-average period before next renewal or extension for finite-lived intangible asset that has been renewed or extended, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Excludes capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

HealthCareOrganizationReceivableAndReven.l: Health Care Organization, Receivable and Revenue Disclosures [Line Items] (Deprecated 2024)
HealthCareOrganizationReceivableAndReven.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

NonrecurringAdjustmentDomain.l: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Nonrecurring Adjustment [Domain]
NonrecurringAdjustmentDomain.d: Nonrecurring adjustment directly attributable to business combination included in reported pro forma revenue and earnings.

PurchaseObligationDueInFourthAndFifthYea.l: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four and Five [Abstract]

PurchaseObligationDueInSecondAndThirdYea.l: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two and Three [Abstract]

ProceedsFromSaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpens.l: Proceeds from Sale of Trust Assets to Pay Expenses
ProceedsFromSaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpens.d: Amount of cash inflows from the sale of trust assets to pay trust expenses.

ScheduleOfUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsRollFor.l: Schedule of Unrecognized Tax Benefits Roll Forward [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfUnrecognizedTaxBenefitsRollFor.d: Tabular disclosure of the change in unrecognized tax benefits.

FairValueMeasurementWithUnobservableInpu.l: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
FairValueMeasurementWithUnobservableInpu.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

FairValueMeasurementWithUnobservableInpu.l: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
FairValueMeasurementWithUnobservableInpu.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

AssetsDisposedOfByMethodOtherThanSaleInP.l: Long-Lived Asset, Disposed of Other than by Sale, Gain (Loss) from Disposal
AssetsDisposedOfByMethodOtherThanSaleInP.d: Amount of gain (loss) from disposal other than by sale of long-lived asset. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange or distribution to owner in spinoff.

DefinedBenefitPlanRecognizedNetGainLossD.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Settlement
DefinedBenefitPlanRecognizedNetGainLossD.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk related to obligation and assets used to effect settlement.

FDICIndemnificationAssetCashPaymentsRece.l: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Cash Payments Received
FDICIndemnificationAssetCashPaymentsRece.d: Amount of decreases to the indemnification asset due to cash payments received relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC).

IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfInterestRat.l: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedging Instruments
IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfInterestRat.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the fair value of interest rate derivatives designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfPriceRiskFa.l: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Price Risk Fair Value Hedging Instruments
IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfPriceRiskFa.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the fair value of price risk derivatives designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

NondebtorReorganizationItemsNetGainLossO.l: Nondebtor Reorganization Items, Net (Gain) Loss on Settlement of Other Claims
NondebtorReorganizationItemsNetGainLossO.d: Amount of gain (loss) on settlement of other claims for entities not in bankruptcy, reported as a reorganization item.

EffectsOfUnrealizedHoldingGainLossOnPres.l: Effects of Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss) on Present Value of Future Insurance Profits
EffectsOfUnrealizedHoldingGainLossOnPres.d: Amount of adjustment to reflect the effect that would have been recognized had the unrealized holding gain (loss) actually been realized on the present value of future insurance profits being amortized using the gross profit method and the present value of future profits recognized as a result of a purchase of an insurance entity holding long-duration contracts.

DebtorReorganizationItemsGainLossOnAsset.l: Debtor Reorganization Items, Gain (Loss) on Asset Sales, Net
DebtorReorganizationItemsGainLossOnAsset.d: Amount of gain (loss) on asset sales, reported as a reorganization item.

DebtorReorganizationItemsNetGainLossOnRe.l: Debtor Reorganization Items, Net Gain (Loss) on Rejection of Leases and Other Executory Contracts
DebtorReorganizationItemsNetGainLossOnRe.d: Amount of gain (loss) on rejection of leases and other executory contracts, reported as a reorganization item.

DefinedBenefitPlanRecognizedNetGainLossD.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Settlement and Curtailment
DefinedBenefitPlanRecognizedNetGainLossD.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from settlement and curtailment.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Acquisition Adjustments, Related Accumulated Depreciation
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Amount of increase (decrease) for acquisition adjustments on accumulated depreciation included in long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale for utilities.

DebtorReorganizationItemsGainLossOnSettl.l: Debtor Reorganization Items, Gain (Loss) on Settlement of Other Claims, Net
DebtorReorganizationItemsGainLossOnSettl.d: Amount of net gain (loss) on settlement of other claims for entities in bankruptcy, reported as a reorganization item.

ChangeInUnrealizedGainLossOnForeignCurre.l: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedging Instruments
ChangeInUnrealizedGainLossOnForeignCurre.d: Amount of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedge recognized in earnings to extent that fair value hedge was determined to be effective.

DerivativeInstrumentsAndHedgesLiabilitie.l: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Liabilities, Noncurrent [Abstract]

HedgingLiabilitiesNoncurrent.d: Fair value of liability arising from a financial instrument or contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

EnergyMarketingContractLiabilitiesNoncur.d: Fair value of liability arising from energy marketing activities (trading activities), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Examples of energy marketing activities include, but are not limited to, trading of electricity, coal, natural gas and oil using financial instruments, including, but not limited to, forward contracts, options and swaps.

DerivativeInstrumentsAndHedgesLiabilitie.l: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Liabilities, Noncurrent
DerivativeInstrumentsAndHedgesLiabilitie.d: Fair value of liability arising from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments, financial instrument or contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), energy marketing activities (trading activities), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Examples of energy marketing activities include, but are not limited to, trading of electricity, coal, natural gas and oil using financial instruments, including, but

ChangeInUnrealizedGainLossOnHedgedItemIn.l: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Hedged Item in Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge
ChangeInUnrealizedGainLossOnHedgedItemIn.d: Amount of the increase (decrease) in fair value of the hedged item in a foreign currency fair value hedge which was recognized in earnings, net of offsets by the gain (loss) on the hedging instrument to the extent that the fair value hedge was determined to be effective.

IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfHedgedItemI.l: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge
IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfHedgedItemI.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) included in earnings related to the fair value of the hedged item in an interest rate fair value hedge, offset by the gain (loss) on the hedging instrument to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfHedgedItemI.l: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Price Risk Fair Value Hedge
IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueOfHedgedItemI.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings related to the fair value of the hedged item in a price risk fair value hedge, offset by the gain (loss) on the hedging instrument to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.d: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Acquisition Adjustments
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Amount of acquisition adjustments included in property, plant and equipment (PPE) for utilities.

TimeDepositMaturitiesAfterNextRollingTwe.l: Time Deposit Maturities, after Next Rolling 12 Months [Abstract]

GainLossOnSalesOfAssetsAndAssetImpairmen.l: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges
GainLossOnSalesOfAssetsAndAssetImpairmen.d: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired, and gain (loss) from the write down of assets from their carrying value to fair value.

AirlineDestinationDisclosureLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

DomesticDestinationMember.d: Domestic destinations determined principally based on geographic region as defined by the U.S. Department of Transportation.

PacificDestinationMember.d: Pacific destinations determined principally based on geographic region as defined by the U.S. Department of Transportation.

AtlanticDestinationMember.d: Atlantic destinations determined principally based on geographic region as defined by the U.S. Department of Transportation.

LatinAmericaDestinationMember.d: Latin America destinations determined principally based on geographic region as defined by the U.S. Department of Transportation.

DefinedBenefitPlanActuarialGainLoss.d: Amount of gain (loss) from change in actuarial assumptions which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Assumptions include, but are not limited to, interest, mortality, employee turnover, salary, and temporary deviation from substantive plan.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Period Increase (Decrease)
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Increase (decrease) in the number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements.

AssetsThatContinueToBeRecognizedSecuriti.l: Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Securitized or Asset-Backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together, Net Credit Losses During Period

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Exercise Price
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Agreed-upon price for the exchange of the underlying asset relating to the share-based payment award.

AcquiredFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetWeight.l: Intangible Asset, Finite-Lived, Acquired, before Renewal or Extension, Weighted-Average Period
AcquiredFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetWeight.d: Weighted-average period before next renewal or extension for finite-lived intangible asset with renewal or extension terms acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. InsuredFinancialObligationsWithCreditDet.l: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contract, Credit Deterioration, Weighted-Average Remaining Contract Period
InsuredFinancialObligationsWithCreditDet.d: Weighted-average contract period remaining for financial guarantee insurance contract, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

OtherRealEstateNonCoveredRollForwardTabl.d: Tabular disclosure of the change in other real estate not covered under loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC). Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

DepreciationAndAmortizationDiscontinuedO.d: Amount of deprecation and amortization expense attributable to property, plant and equipment and intangible assets of discontinued operations.

ScheduleOfCommonStockOutstandingRollForw.l: Schedule of Common Stock Outstanding Roll Forward [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfCommonStockOutstandingRollForw.d: Tabular disclosure of the change in common stock outstanding.

ScheduleOfStockOptionsRollForwardTableTe.l: Schedule of Stock Options Roll Forward [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfStockOptionsRollForwardTableTe.d: Tabular disclosure of the change in stock options.

ScheduleOfUnvestedRestrictedStockUnitsRo.l: Schedule of Unvested Restricted Stock Units Roll Forward [Table Text Block]
ScheduleOfUnvestedRestrictedStockUnitsRo.d: Tabular disclosure of the change in restricted stock units (RSUs).

CostsIncurredOilAndGasPropertyAcquisitio.l: Oil and Gas, Cost Incurred, Property Acquisition, Exploration, and Development Costs [Abstract]
Oil and Gas, Cost Incurred, Property Acquisition, Exploration, and Development Costs
CostsIncurredOilAndGasPropertyAcquisitio.d: Amount of property acquisition, exploration, and development costs incurred in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes capitalized cost and cost charged to expense.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Common, Useful Life
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Useful life of asset common to business unit owned by public utility, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Distribution, Useful Life
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Useful life of utility distribution asset owned by public utility, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Equipment, Useful Life
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Useful life of equipment owned by public utility, classified as other, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Fuel, Useful Life
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Useful life of asset related to fuel owned by public utility, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Generation, Useful Life
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Useful life of utility generation asset owned by public utility, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utility, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Other, Useful Life
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Useful life of property, plant, and equipment owned by public utility, classified as other, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Transmission and Distribution, Useful Life
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Useful life of utility transmission and distribution equipment owned by public utility, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Transmission, Useful Life
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Useful life of utility transmission equipment owned by public utility, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.l: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Vehicles, Useful Life
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.d: Useful life of vehicle owned by public utility, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

IntermediateLifePlantsUsefulLife.d: Useful life of intermediate-life plant, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

LossContingencyReceivable.d: Amount of receivable related to a loss contingency accrual. For example, an insurance recovery receivable.

LossContingencyReceivableCurrent.d: Amount of receivable related to a loss contingency accrual that is expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. For example, an insurance recovery receivable.

LossContingencyReceivableNoncurrent.d: Amount of receivable related to a loss contingency accrual that is expected to be collected after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. For example, an insurance recovery receivable.

DebtInstrumentRepurchaseDate.d: Date the debt instrument was repurchased, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

MaximumLengthOfTimeForeignCurrencyCashFl.l: Cash Flow Hedge, Foreign Currency, Hedging Exposure, Maximum Period
MaximumLengthOfTimeForeignCurrencyCashFl.d: Maximum period of hedging exposure to variability in future cash flow for forecasted transaction of foreign currency cash flow hedge, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Excludes forecasted transaction for payment of variable interest on existing financial instrument.

LossContingencyAccrualProvision.d: Amount charged against operating income increasing loss contingency liability, after adjustments to reduce previously estimated charges.

FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.d: Tabular disclosure of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) using recurring unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.d: Disclosure of information about financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) using recurring unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.l: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.d: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income from derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.d: Fair value of financial instrument classified as derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Purchases
FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.d: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.l: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Sales
FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.d: Amount of sales of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.l: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Issues
FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.d: Amount of issuances of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.d: Amount of settlements of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability, measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.l: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Purchases, Sales, Issues, Settlements
FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.d: Amount of purchases, (sales), issuances and (settlements) of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.l: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers, Net [Abstract]
