UnusualOrInfrequentItemNetGainLoss.d: Amount of (gain) loss for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or occurs infrequently, or both.

AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossB.l: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossB.d: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners (distributions to owners).

AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossRecoveryOfBa.l: Allowance for Loan and Lease Loss, Recovery of Bad Debts
AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossRecoveryOfBa.d: Amount of recovery of loans and lease receivables which had previously been fully or partially written-off as bad debts.

DepositAssetsEffectOfIncreaseDecreaseInI.l: Deposit Assets, Effect of (Increase) Decrease in Interest Accrual Assumption on Expected Recovery Amounts
DepositAssetsEffectOfIncreaseDecreaseInI.d: Amount of (increase) decrease in expense due to change in the interest accrual assumption on deposit assets.

DepositLiabilitiesEffectOfIncreaseDecrea.l: Deposit Liabilities, Effect of (Increase) Decrease in Interest Accrual Assumption on Expected Recovery Amounts
DepositLiabilitiesEffectOfIncreaseDecrea.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in expense due to change in the interest accrual assumption on expected recoveries.

DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountEnerg.l: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Energy Measure
DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountEnerg.d: Nominal energy measure used to calculate payments on a derivative instrument.

UnderlyingDerivativeEnergyMeasure.d: Specified interest rate, security price, commodity price, foreign exchange rate, index of prices or rates for a derivative contract measured in energy volume but not the derivative contract itself.

FinitelivedIntangibleAssetsAcquired1.d: Amount of increase in finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

CorporateNonSegmentMember.l: Segment Reporting, Reconciling Item, Corporate Nonsegment [Member]
CorporateNonSegmentMember.d: Corporate headquarters or functional department that may not earn revenues or may earn revenues that are only incidental to the activities of the entity and is not considered an operating segment.

IndefinitelivedIntangibleAssetsAcquired.d: Amount of increase in indefinite-lived asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation. Excludes goodwill.

UnusualOrInfrequentItemNetGainLossAbstra.l: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Net (Gain) Loss [Abstract]

IncreaseDecreaseInUnearnedPremiumsNet.d: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of decrease (increase) in unearned premiums.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOut.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding General Partnership Unit, Net of Tax
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOut.d: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations available to general partnership (GP) unit-holder in a publicly trade limited partnership (LP) or master limited partnership (MLP).

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOut.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerOut.d: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder in a publicly trade limited partnership (LP) or master limited partnership (MLP).

NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingGeneralPartne.l: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding General Partnership Unit, Net of Tax
NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingGeneralPartne.d: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to general partnership (GP) unit-holder.

NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartne.l: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartne.d: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to outstanding limited partnership (LP) unit-holder.

NetIncomeLossNetOfTaxPerOutstandingLimit.l: Net Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted
NetIncomeLossNetOfTaxPerOutstandingLimit.d: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder and units that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for dilutive potential units outstanding.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsNetOfT.l: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsNetOfT.d: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder and units that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for dilutive potential units outstanding.

NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartne.l: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartne.d: Net income (loss) allocated to each outstanding limited partnership and general partnership unit.

ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.l: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement [Abstract]
Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement [Table]
ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.d: Disclosure of information about contractual obligation with joint and several liability, including but not limited to, debt arrangements, settled litigation, and judicial rulings.

ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.l: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement [Line Items]
ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.l: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Description
ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.d: Description of the nature of the arrangement, including, but not limited to, how the liability arose, the relationships with other co-obligors, and the terms and conditions of the arrangement.

ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.l: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Amount Outstanding
ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.d: Amount outstanding, before the effects of recovery, of obligation under the joint and several liability arrangement.

ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.l: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Amount Recognized
ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.d: Amount of joint and several liability recognized in the balance sheet.

ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.l: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Amount Receivable
ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.d: Amount of receivable from other entities recognized in the balance sheet resulting from the joint and several liability arrangement.

ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.l: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Corresponding Entry, Asset
ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.d: Amount of asset in corresponding entry for joint and several liability arrangement.

SettledLitigationMember.d: Agreement reached between parties in a litigation that occurs without judicial intervention, supervision or approval.

JudicialRulingMember.d: Litigation outcome that occurs as a result of judicial intervention, supervision, or approval.

LiquidationBasisOfAccountingTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for the liquidation basis of accounting.

LiquidationBasisOfAccountingAdoption.l: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Adoption, Description
LiquidationBasisOfAccountingAdoption.d: Description of fact and circumstance surrounding adoption of liquidation basis of accounting and determination that liquidation is imminent.

LiquidationBasisOfAccountingLiquidationP.l: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Liquidation Plan, Description
LiquidationBasisOfAccountingLiquidationP.d: Description of plan for liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting. Includes, but is not limited to, manner by which asset and other item, expected to be sold in liquidation that had not been previously recognized as asset, are expected to be disposed of and manner by which liability is expected to be settled.

LiquidationBasisOfAccountingMethodsAndAs.l: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Methods and Assumptions
LiquidationBasisOfAccountingMethodsAndAs.d: Description of the methods and assumptions used to measure assets and liabilities, including subsequent changes to those methods and assumptions.

LiquidationBasisOfAccountingCostsAndInco.l: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Costs and Incomes (Deprecated 2026)
LiquidationBasisOfAccountingCostsAndInco.d: Description of costs and incomes accrued in the statement of net assets in liquidation and the period over which those costs are expected to be paid or income earned.

LiquidationBasisOfAccountingAccruedCosts.l: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Estimated Accrued Cost, Disposal of Asset and Other Item Expected to be Sold
LiquidationBasisOfAccountingAccruedCosts.d: Amount of estimated accrued cost to dispose of asset and other item expected to be sold in liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting.

LiquidationBasisOfAccountingRemeasuremen.l: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Estimated Accrued Cost, Disposal of Asset and Other Item Expected to be Sold, Remeasurement, Gain (Loss)
LiquidationBasisOfAccountingRemeasuremen.d: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement of estimated accrued cost to dispose of asset and other item expected to be sold in liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting.

LiquidationBasisOfAccountingRemeasuremen.l: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Asset, Remeasurement, Gain (Loss)
LiquidationBasisOfAccountingRemeasuremen.d: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement of asset for change in carrying value under liquidation basis of accounting.

LiquidationBasisOfAccountingRemeasuremen.l: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Other Item Previously Not Recognized, Remeasurement, Gain (Loss)
LiquidationBasisOfAccountingRemeasuremen.d: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement of other item not previously recognized but expected to either be sold or used to settle liability in liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting.

LiquidationBasisofAccountingItemsPreviou.l: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Other Item Previously Not Recognized
LiquidationBasisofAccountingItemsPreviou.d: Amount of other item not previously recognized but expected to be either sold or used to settle liability in liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting.

ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherAssetsInvestingAc.l: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets, Investing Activities
ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherAssetsInvestingAc.d: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets recognized in investing activities.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Consideration
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount of consideration received or receivable for the disposal of assets and liabilities, including discontinued operation.

DerivativeAssetFairValueGrossAssetInclud.l: Derivative Asset, Gross Asset Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
DerivativeAssetFairValueGrossAssetInclud.d: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

DerivativeAssetNotSubjectToMasterNetting.l: Derivative Asset, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction (Deprecated 2025)
DerivativeAssetNotSubjectToMasterNetting.d: Fair value of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from derivative assets.

DerivativeLiabilityFairValueGrossLiabili.l: Derivative Liability, Gross Liability Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
DerivativeLiabilityFairValueGrossLiabili.d: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

DerivativeLiabilityNotSubjectToMasterNet.l: Derivative Liability, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction (Deprecated 2025)
DerivativeLiabilityNotSubjectToMasterNet.d: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from derivative liabilities.

SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.l: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.d: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.l: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction (Deprecated 2025)
SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.d: Amount of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from securities purchased under agreements to resell.

SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchas.l: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchas.d: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchas.l: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction (Deprecated 2025)
SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchas.d: Amount of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

SecuritiesBorrowedGrossIncludingNotSubje.l: Securities Borrowed, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
SecuritiesBorrowedGrossIncludingNotSubje.d: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

SecuritiesBorrowedNotSubjectToMasterNett.l: Securities Borrowed, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction (Deprecated 2025)
SecuritiesBorrowedNotSubjectToMasterNett.d: Amount of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from securities borrowed.

SecuritiesLoanedGrossIncludingNotSubject.l: Securities Loaned, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
SecuritiesLoanedGrossIncludingNotSubject.d: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

SecuritiesLoanedNotSubjectToMasterNettin.l: Securities Loaned, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction (Deprecated 2025)
SecuritiesLoanedNotSubjectToMasterNettin.d: Amount of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from securities loaned.

DerivativeAssetSecuritiesPurchasedUnderA.l: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
DerivativeAssetSecuritiesPurchasedUnderA.d: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

DerivativeAssetSecuritiesPurchasedUnderA.l: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction (Deprecated 2025)
DerivativeAssetSecuritiesPurchasedUnderA.d: Amount of derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed.

DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAg.l: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAg.d: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAg.l: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction (Deprecated 2025)
DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAg.d: Amount of derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

DerivativeAssetFairValueGrossAssetInclud.l: Derivative Asset, Gross Asset Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement [Abstract]

DerivativeLiabilityFairValueGrossLiabili.l: Derivative Liability, Gross Liability Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement [Abstract]

SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.l: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement [Abstract]

SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchas.l: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement [Abstract]

SecuritiesBorrowedGrossIncludingNotSubje.l: Securities Borrowed, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement [Abstract]

SecuritiesLoanedGrossIncludingNotSubject.l: Securities Loaned, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement [Abstract]

FederalFundsEffectiveSwapRateMember.l: Fed Funds Effective Rate Overnight Index Swap Rate [Member]
FederalFundsEffectiveSwapRateMember.d: Fixed rate on U.S. dollar, constant-notional interest rate swap having its variable-rate leg referenced to Federal Funds effective rate with no additional spread over Federal Funds effective rate on that variable-rate leg.

FiscalPeriodDuration.d: Duration of fiscal period, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Includes, but is not limited to, number of weeks in one year or interim period.

DerivativeAssetFairValueGrossLiabilityAn.l: Derivative Asset, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Gross Liability and Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash, Offset [Abstract]
Derivative Asset, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Gross Liability and Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash, Offset
DerivativeAssetFairValueGrossLiabilityAn.d: Fair value of liability associated with financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, and obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements.

DerivativeLiabilityFairValueGrossAssetAn.l: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Gross Asset and Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash, Offset [Abstract]
Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Gross Asset and Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash, Offset
DerivativeLiabilityFairValueGrossAssetAn.d: Fair value of asset associated with financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, and right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements.

DerivativeAssetSecuritiesPurchasedUnderA.l: Derivative Asset, Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, and Security Borrowed, Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]
Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed [Abstract]
Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement [Abstract]

DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAg.l: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]
Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned [Abstract]
Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement [Abstract]

SaleLeasebackTransactionNetProceedsInves.l: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Proceeds, Investing Activities (Deprecated 2026)
SaleLeasebackTransactionNetProceedsInves.d: Amount of cash inflow after closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in investing activities.

SaleLeasebackTransactionNetProceedsFinan.l: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Proceeds, Financing Activities (Deprecated 2026)
SaleLeasebackTransactionNetProceedsFinan.d: Amount of cash inflow after closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in financing activities.

SaleLeasebackTransactionGrossProceedsInv.l: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Gross Proceeds, Investing Activities (Deprecated 2026)
SaleLeasebackTransactionGrossProceedsInv.d: Amount of cash inflow before closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in investing activities.

SaleLeasebackTransactionGrossProceedsFin.l: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Gross Proceeds, Financing Activities (Deprecated 2026)
SaleLeasebackTransactionGrossProceedsFin.d: Amount of cash inflow before closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in financing activities.

SaleLeasebackTransactionNetProceedsInves.l: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Proceeds, Investing Activities [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

SaleLeasebackTransactionNetProceedsFinan.l: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Proceeds, Financing Activities [Abstract] (Deprecated 2026)

SaleLeasebackTransactionTransactionCosts.l: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Transaction Costs, Investing Activities (Deprecated 2026)
SaleLeasebackTransactionTransactionCosts.d: Amount of cash outflow for transaction costs in a sale-leaseback recognized in investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, closing and debt issuance costs.

SaleLeasebackTransactionTransactionCosts.l: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Transaction Costs, Financing Activities (Deprecated 2026)
SaleLeasebackTransactionTransactionCosts.d: Amount of cash outflow for transaction costs in a sale-leaseback recognized in financing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, closing and debt issuance costs.

LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsIn.l: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation, Including Current Maturities
LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsIn.d: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, including portion classified as current.

SharebasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Expensed and Capitalized, Amount
SharebasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Amount of cost expensed and capitalized for award under share-based payment arrangement.

OverAllotmentOptionMember.d: Right given to the underwriter to sell additional shares over the initial allotment.

AvailableForSaleDebtSecuritiesAccumulate.l: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Loss, before Tax
AvailableForSaleDebtSecuritiesAccumulate.d: Amount, before tax, of unrealized loss in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

AvailableForSaleDebtSecuritiesAccumulate.l: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain, before Tax
AvailableForSaleDebtSecuritiesAccumulate.d: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesAccumulatedUnrec.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Accumulated Unrecognized Loss
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesAccumulatedUnrec.d: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesAccumulatedUnrec.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Accumulated Unrecognized Gain
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesAccumulatedUnrec.d: Amount of accumulated unrecognized gain on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesContinuousUnreal.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Accumulated Loss
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesContinuousUnreal.d: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous loss position for 12 months or longer.

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesContinuousUnreal.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Accumulated Loss
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesContinuousUnreal.d: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous loss position for less than 12 months.

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesContinuousUnreal.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Unrealized Loss Position, Accumulated Loss
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesContinuousUnreal.d: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in unrealized loss position.

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesContinuousUnreal.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Unrealized Loss Position, Accumulated Loss [Abstract]

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesAbstract.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value to Amortized Cost, after Allowance for Credit Loss [Abstract]

AvailableForSaleSecuritiesContinuousUnre.l: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Loss Position, Accumulated Loss [Abstract]

AvailableForSaleSecuritiesAccumulatedGro.l: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain (Loss), before Tax [Abstract]

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesTextBlock.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances [Text Block]
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesTableTextBloc.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances [Table Text Block]
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesTableTextBloc.d: Tabular disclosure of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesTable.d: Disclosure of information about advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesOptionAxis.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Option [Axis]
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesOptionAxis.d: Information by option for advance made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank). Includes, but is not limited, to callable, putable, and convertible options.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesOptionDomain.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Option [Domain]
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesOptionDomain.d: Options related to the advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), including but not limited to callable, putable and convertible options.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesCallableOptio.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Callable Option [Member]
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesCallableOptio.d: Right but not the obligation the borrower has to return the advance to the Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) at par without prepayment penalty.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesPutableOption.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Putable Option [Member]
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesPutableOption.d: Right, but not the obligation, Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) has to require the borrower to return the advance at par.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesLineItems.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances [Line Items]
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesLineItems.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturityPerio.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Fixed Interest Rate, Maturity Period
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturityPerio.d: Period of maturity for fixed-interest-rate advance made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturityPerio.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Variable Interest Rate, Maturity Period
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesMaturityPerio.d: Period of maturity for variable-interest-rate advance made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesInterestRate.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Interest Rate
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesInterestRate.d: Interest rate of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesInterestRateO.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Interest Rate on Affordable Housing Program Subsidized Loans
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesInterestRateO.d: Interest rate of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) on Affordable Housing Program (AHP) subsidized loans.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesParValue.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Par Value
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesParValue.d: Par amount of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesOutstandingGr.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Outstanding, Greater than One Billion Dollars Per Borrower, Amount
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesOutstandingGr.d: Amount of advances outstanding made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) in excess of one billion U.S. dollars per borrower.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesFixedRateAfte.d: Par amount of advance made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with fixed interest rate maturing after next fiscal year following current fiscal year. FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesFixedRate.d: Par amount of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with fixed interest rate.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesFloatingRateU.d: Par amount of advance made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with floating interest rate maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesFloatingRateA.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Floating Rate, after Year One

AffordableHousingProgramObligationPeriod.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) obligation for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesConvertibleOp.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Convertible Option [Member]
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesConvertibleOp.d: Option Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) has to convert an advance from one interest-payment term structure to another.

DeferredBonusAndProfitSharingArrangement.l: Deferred Bonus and Profit Sharing Arrangement, Individual Contract, Type of Deferred Compensation [Domain]
DeferredBonusAndProfitSharingArrangement.d: Deferred compensation that is not equivalent to a defined benefit pension plan or a defined benefit other postretirement benefit plan. Includes, but is not limited to, employment contracts with one or more selected officers or key employees. Excludes equity-based compensation plans, defined benefit pension plans and defined benefit other postretirement benefit plans.

OtherPostretirementBenefitsIndividualCon.l: Other Postretirement Benefits, Individual Contracts, Type of Deferred Compensation [Domain]
OtherPostretirementBenefitsIndividualCon.d: Deferred compensation related to other postretirement benefit arrangements that are not equivalent to a defined benefit other postretirement benefit plan. Includes, but is not limited to, employment contracts with one or more selected officers or key employees. Excludes equity-based compensation plans, defined benefit pension plans and defined benefit other postretirement benefit plans.

EquityBasedArrangementsIndividualContrac.l: Equity-Based Arrangements, Individual Contracts, Type of Deferred Compensation [Domain]
EquityBasedArrangementsIndividualContrac.d: Deferred compensation related to equity-based payment arrangements. Includes, but is not limited to, employment contracts with one or more selected officers or key employees. Excludes broad group equity-based compensation plans, defined benefit pension plans, defined benefit other postretirement benefit plans and other deferred compensation that is not equivalent to a defined benefit pension plan or a defined benefit other postretirement benefit plan.

ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.l: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement [Table Text Block]
ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.d: Tabular disclosure of contractual obligation or group of similar obligations with joint and several liability for which the total amount of the obligation is fixed, including but not limited to, debt arrangements, settled litigation, and judicial rulings.

LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustm.l: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Current Year
LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustm.d: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle claims incurred in the current period and related claims settlement costs.

LiabilityForClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExp.l: Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense [Line Items]
LiabilityForClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExp.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

ReinsuranceRecoverableForUnpaidClaimsAnd.l: Reinsurance Recoverable for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustments
ReinsuranceRecoverableForUnpaidClaimsAnd.d: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts for losses reported to the ceding insurer but not yet paid and amounts expected for incurred losses and settlement expenses, which have not yet been reported to the ceding insurer.

LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustm.l: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Business Combination
LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustm.d: Amount, after deduction of reinsurance recovery, of increase (decrease) in cost of settling unpaid claim acquired in business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, claim incurred but not reported.

LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustm.l: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims
LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustm.d: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of expense (reversal of expense) for claims incurred and costs incurred in the claim settlement process.

LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustm.l: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Prior Years
LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustm.d: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle claims incurred in prior periods and related claims settlement costs.

LiabilityForClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExp.l: Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense [Table]
LiabilityForClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExp.d: Disclosure of information about the liability for claims and claims adjustment expense.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill, Noncurrent
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as goodwill attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as goodwill attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Noncurrent
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as property, plant and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Current
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as property, plant and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant, and Equipment
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as property, plant, and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Intangible Assets, Noncurrent
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as intangible assets, excluding goodwill, attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Intangible Assets, Current
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as intangible assets, excluding goodwill, attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Intangible Assets
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as intangible assets, excluding goodwill, attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Inventory, Noncurrent
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as inventory attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Inventory
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as inventory attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.l: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment, Net Gain (Loss) Attributable to Parent [Member]
AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) related to gain (loss) component of defined benefit plans attributable to the parent.

AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.d: Accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss related to prior service cost (credit) component of defined benefit plans attributable to the parent.

AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) related to transition asset (obligation) component of defined benefit plans attributable to the parent.
