FederalHomeLoanBankRiskBasedCapitalRequi.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Risk-Based Capital, Required
FederalHomeLoanBankRiskBasedCapitalRequi.d: Minimum amount of risk-based capital required for Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), set by the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA).

FederalHomeLoanBankRegulatoryCapitalRequ.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Regulatory Capital, Required
FederalHomeLoanBankRegulatoryCapitalRequ.d: Minimum amount of regulatory capital required for Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), set by the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA).

FederalHomeLoanBankLeverageCapitalRequir.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Leverage Capital, Required
FederalHomeLoanBankLeverageCapitalRequir.d: Minimum amount of leverage capital required for Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), set by the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA).

FederalHomeLoanBankRiskBasedCapitalActua.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Risk-Based Capital, Actual
FederalHomeLoanBankRiskBasedCapitalActua.d: Amount of risk-based capital of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), set by the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA).

FederalHomeLoanBankRegulatoryCapitalRati.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Regulatory Capital Ratio, Actual
FederalHomeLoanBankRegulatoryCapitalRati.d: Regulatory capital ratio of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), calculated per regulations of the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA).

FederalHomeLoanBankRegulatoryCapitalActu.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Regulatory Capital, Actual
FederalHomeLoanBankRegulatoryCapitalActu.d: Amount of regulatory capital of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), set by the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA).

FederalHomeLoanBankLeverageCapitalActual.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Leverage Capital, Actual
FederalHomeLoanBankLeverageCapitalActual.d: Amount of leveraged capital of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), set by the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA).

MandatorilyRedeemableCapitalStockTableTe.l: Mandatorily Redeemable Capital Stock [Table Text Block]
MandatorilyRedeemableCapitalStockTableTe.d: Tabular disclosure of mandatorily redeemable capital stock.

FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.l: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Maturity, Year One
FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.d: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.l: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Maturity, Year Two
FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.d: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.l: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Maturity, Year Three
FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.d: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.l: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Maturity, Year Four
FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.d: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.l: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Maturity, Year Five
FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.d: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.l: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Past Contractual Redemption Date, Due to Outstanding Activity
FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.d: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock past the contractual redemption date due to outstanding activity.

FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.l: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Past Contractual Redemption Date, Due to Regulatory Action (Deprecated 2026)
FinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRe.d: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock past the contractual redemption date due to regulatory action.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Maximum Contractual Term
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Maximum term of contract for deferred compensation arrangement, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

SecretariatOfTheFederalRevenueBureauOfBr.l: Secretariat of the Federal Revenue Bureau of Brazil [Member]
SecretariatOfTheFederalRevenueBureauOfBr.d: Designated tax department of the government of Brazil.

OfficeOfTheTaxCommissionerBermudaMember.l: Office of the Tax Commissioner, Bermuda [Member]
OfficeOfTheTaxCommissionerBermudaMember.d: Designated tax department of the government of Bermuda.

AdministrationOfTheTreasuryBelgiumMember.d: Designated tax department of the government of Belgium.

MinistryOfTheEconomyFinanceAndIndustryFr.l: Ministry of the Economy, Finance and Industry, France [Member]
MinistryOfTheEconomyFinanceAndIndustryFr.d: Designated tax department of the government of France.

HerMajestysRevenueAndCustomsHMRCMember.d: Designated tax department of the government of United Kingdom.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Requisite Service Period
DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.d: Minimum period when individual is required to perform service to be fully vested under deferred compensation arrangement, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

ContinuingInvolvementWithTransferredFina.l: Continuing Involvement with Transferred Financial Assets, Principal Amount Outstanding
ContinuingInvolvementWithTransferredFina.d: Principal amount of transferred financial assets in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the assets underlying the transaction. Continuing involvement includes, but is not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in transferred financial assets.

FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.l: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Investment Redemption, Notice Period
FairValueInvestmentsEntitiesThatCalculat.d: Period required for notice to be delivered before investment, calculated using net asset value (NAV) per share, can be redeemed, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days. Includes, but is not limited to, investment calculated using unit, membership interest, other equity or ownership interest, and alternative investment.

DerivativeAssetNotOffsetPolicyElectionDe.l: Derivative Asset, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Deduction of Financial Instrument Not Offset
DerivativeAssetNotOffsetPolicyElectionDe.d: Fair value of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative asset.

SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.l: Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Deduction of Financial Instrument Not Offset
SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.d: Amount of fund outstanding loaned in form of security resale agreement for purchase and resale of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from security purchased under agreement to resell.

SecuritiesBorrowedNotOffsetPolicyElectio.l: Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Deduction of Financial Instrument Not Offset
SecuritiesBorrowedNotOffsetPolicyElectio.d: Amount of security borrowed from entity in exchange for collateral, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from security borrowed.

DerivativeAssetSecuritiesPurchasedUnderA.l: Derivative Asset, Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, and Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Deduction of Financial Instrument Not Offset
DerivativeAssetSecuritiesPurchasedUnderA.d: Amount of derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed.

DerivativeLiabilityNotOffsetPolicyElecti.l: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Deduction of Financial Instrument Not Offset
DerivativeLiabilityNotOffsetPolicyElecti.d: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative liability.

SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellNot.l: Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Deduction of Financial Instrument Not Offset
SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToResellNot.d: Amount of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from security sold under agreement to repurchase.

SecuritiesLoanedNotOffsetPolicyElectionD.l: Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Deduction of Financial Instrument Not Offset
SecuritiesLoanedNotOffsetPolicyElectionD.d: Amount of security loaned to entity in exchange for collateral, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from security loaned.

DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAg.l: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Deduction of Financial Instrument Not Offset
DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAg.d: Amount of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned.

DerivativeAssetFairValueOffsetAgainstCol.l: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election (Deprecated 2025)
DerivativeAssetFairValueOffsetAgainstCol.d: Fair value, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, offset against an obligation to return collateral.

SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.l: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election (Deprecated 2025)
SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.d: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, offset against an obligation to return collateral.

SecuritiesBorrowedOffsetAgainstCollatera.l: Securities Borrowed, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election (Deprecated 2025)
SecuritiesBorrowedOffsetAgainstCollatera.d: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral, offset against an obligation to return collateral under a master netting arrangement.

DerivativeAssetSecuritiesPurchasedUnderA.l: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election (Deprecated 2025)
DerivativeAssetSecuritiesPurchasedUnderA.d: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed, offset against an obligation to return collateral under a master netting arrangement.

DerivativeLiabilityFairValueOffsetAgains.l: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election (Deprecated 2025)
DerivativeLiabilityFairValueOffsetAgains.d: Fair value, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, offset against the right to receive collateral.

SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchas.l: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election (Deprecated 2025)
SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchas.d: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, offset against a right to receive collateral.

SecuritiesLoanedOffsetAgainstCollateralN.l: Securities Loaned, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election (Deprecated 2025)
SecuritiesLoanedOffsetAgainstCollateralN.d: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral, offset against a right to receive collateral.

DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAg.l: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election (Deprecated 2025)
DerivativeLiabilitySecuritiesSoldUnderAg.d: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned, offset against a right to receive collateral.

StockRepurchaseProgramRemainingAuthorize.l: Share Repurchase Program, Remaining Authorized, Amount
StockRepurchaseProgramRemainingAuthorize.d: Amount remaining authorized for purchase of share under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.l: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Share-Based Liabilities Paid
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.d: Amount of cash paid to settle liability for award under share-based payment arrangement.

UnderlyingDerivativeFlowRate.d: Specified interest rate, security price, commodity price, foreign exchange rate, index of prices or rates for a derivative contract measured in flow rate but not the derivative contract itself.

DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountFlowR.l: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Flow Rate
DerivativeNonmonetaryNotionalAmountFlowR.d: Nominal flow rate used to calculate payments on a derivative instrument.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Pension Plan Benefit Obligation, Current
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as defined benefit plan benefit obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Pension Plan Benefit Obligation, Noncurrent
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as defined benefit plan benefit obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Postretirement Plan Benefit Obligation, Current
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as defined benefit non-pension postretirement plan obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Postretirement Plan Benefit Obligation, Noncurrent
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as defined benefit non-pension postretirement plan obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Income Tax Payable, Noncurrent
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as income tax obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Income Tax Payable
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as income tax obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

DefinedContributionPlanDisclosuresTableT.l: Defined Contribution Plan Disclosures [Table Text Block]
DefinedContributionPlanDisclosuresTableT.d: Tabular disclosure of defined contribution pension plans or defined contribution other postretirement plans, separately for pension plans and other postretirement benefit plans.

DefinedContributionPlanTable.d: Disclosure of information about defined contribution pension plans or defined contribution other postretirement plans, separately for pension plans and other postretirement benefit plans.

DefinedContributionPlanDisclosureLineIte.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets, Noncurrent
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

AvailableForSaleSecuritiesFairValueToAmo.l: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value to Amortized Cost, after Allowance for Credit Loss [Abstract]

ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.l: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Recourse Provision, Description
ObligationWithJointAndSeveralLiabilityAr.d: Description of the nature of a recourse provision that would enable recovery from other entities of the amounts paid, including, but not limited to, limitations on recoverable amounts.

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesEarlierOfCont.l: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Earlier of Contractual Maturity or Next Put or Convert Date, in Next Rolling 12 Months
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesEarlierOfCont.d: Par amount of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with the earlier of contractual maturity or next put or convert date within the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

TaxPeriodAxis.d: Information by period subject to enacted tax law.

ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarr.l: Class of Warrant or Right, Exercise Price of Warrants or Rights
ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarr.d: Exercise price per share or per unit of warrants or rights outstanding.

OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityStrikePrice1.l: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Strike Price
OptionIndexedToIssuersEquityStrikePrice1.d: Exercise or strike price stated in the contract for options indexed to the issuer's equity shares.

AmortizationMethodQualifiedAffordableHou.l: Investment, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Amount
AmortizationMethodQualifiedAffordableHou.d: Amount of investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

AmortizationMethodQualifiedAffordableHou.l: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Applied, Amortization Expense
AmortizationMethodQualifiedAffordableHou.d: Amount of amortization expense for investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program accounted for using proportional amortization method.

IncomeLossFromAffordableHousingProjectsE.l: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Equity Method Investment, Income (Loss) from Tax Credit Investment
IncomeLossFromAffordableHousingProjectsE.d: Amount of income tax credit and other income tax benefit generated by equity method investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

AffordableHousingProjectInvestmentWriteD.l: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Impairment Loss
AffordableHousingProjectInvestmentWriteD.d: Amount of impairment loss for investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

AffordableHousingProjectInvestmentNature.l: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Nature of Impairment Loss
AffordableHousingProjectInvestmentNature.d: Description of nature of impairment loss for investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

AffordableHousingTaxCreditsAndOtherTaxBe.l: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Income Tax Credit and Other Income Tax Benefit, before Amortization Expense
AffordableHousingTaxCreditsAndOtherTaxBe.d: Amount, before amortization expense, of income tax credit and other tax benefit generated by investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

ScheduleOfCapitalizationTable.d: Disclosure of information about capitalization which comprises long-term debt and equity instruments.

QualifiedAffordableHousingProjectInvestm.l: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected, Commitment
QualifiedAffordableHousingProjectInvestm.d: Amount of commitment and contingent commitment, including amount of delayed equity contribution, for investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, commitment and contingent commitment related to investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

InvestmentsInAffordableHousingProjectsAb.l: Investment Program, Proportional Amortization Method, Elected [Line Items]

MortgageLoansInProcessOfForeclosureAmoun.l: Mortgage Loans in Process of Foreclosure, Amount
MortgageLoansInProcessOfForeclosureAmoun.d: Recorded investment of consumer mortgage loan receivables secured by residential real estate properties for which formal foreclosure proceedings are in process.

DisposalGroupClassificationDomain.d: Component or group of components disposed of, including but not limited to, disposal group held-for-sale or disposed of by sale, disposed of by means other than sale, and discontinued operations.

DiscontinuedOperationsHeldForSaleOrDispo.l: Discontinued Operations, Held-for-Sale or Disposed of by Sale [Member]
DiscontinuedOperationsHeldForSaleOrDispo.d: Component or group of components representing strategic shift that has or will have major effect on operation and financial result, classified as held-for-sale or disposed of by sale, and business and nonprofit activity on acquisition and upon joint venture formation, classified as held-for-sale.

DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfByMeansO.l: Discontinued Operations, Disposed of by Means Other than Sale [Member]
DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfByMeansO.d: Component or group of components representing strategic shift that has or will have major effect on operation and financial result, disposed of by means other than sale.

DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfByMeansO.l: Discontinued Operations, Disposed of by Means Other than Sale, Spinoff [Member]
DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfByMeansO.d: Component or group of components representing strategic shift that has or will have major effect on operation and financial result, disposed of in spinoff.

DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfByMeansO.l: Discontinued Operations, Disposed of by Means Other than Sale, Abandonment [Member]
DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfByMeansO.d: Component or group of components representing strategic shift that has or will have major effect on operation and financial result, disposed of by means of abandonment.

DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfByMeansO.l: Discontinued Operations, Disposed of by Means Other than Sale, Exchange [Member]
DiscontinuedOperationsDisposedOfByMeansO.d: Component or group of components representing strategic shift that has or will have major effect on operation and financial result, disposed of in exchange.

DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOperationsMe.d: Disposal group that is not classified as discontinued operations.

DisposalGroupHeldForSaleOrDisposedOfBySa.l: Disposal Group, Held-for-Sale or Disposed of by Sale, Not Discontinued Operations [Member]
DisposalGroupHeldForSaleOrDisposedOfBySa.d: Disposal group that either has been sold or is classified as held-for-sale. Excludes disposals classified as discontinued operations.

DisposalGroupDisposedOfByMeansOtherThanS.l: Disposal Group, Disposed of Other than by Sale, Not Discontinued Operation [Member]
DisposalGroupDisposedOfByMeansOtherThanS.d: Disposal group that is disposed of other than by sale. For example, but not limited to, abandonment, in an exchange measured based on the recorded amount of the nonmonetary asset relinquished, or in a distribution to owners in a spinoff. Excludes disposals classified as discontinued operations.

DisposalGroupDisposedOfByMeansOtherThanS.l: Disposal Group, Disposed of Other than by Sale, Not Discontinued Operation, Spinoff [Member]
DisposalGroupDisposedOfByMeansOtherThanS.d: Disposal group that is disposed of in a spinoff. Excludes disposals classified as discontinued operations.

DisposalGroupDisposedOfByMeansOtherThanS.l: Disposal Group, Disposed of Other than by Sale, Not Discontinued Operation, Abandonment [Member]
DisposalGroupDisposedOfByMeansOtherThanS.d: Disposal group that is disposed of by means of abandonment. Excludes disposals classified as discontinued operations.

DisposalGroupDisposedOfByMeansOtherThanS.l: Disposal Group, Disposed of Other than by Sale, Not Discontinued Operation, Exchange [Member]
DisposalGroupDisposedOfByMeansOtherThanS.d: Disposal group that is disposed of in an exchange measured based on the recorded amount of the nonmonetary asset relinquished. Excludes disposals classified as discontinued operations.

DiscontinuedOperationPeriodOfContinuingI.l: Discontinued Operation, Period of Continuing Involvement after Disposal
DiscontinuedOperationPeriodOfContinuingI.d: Period of expected continuing involvement with discontinued operation after disposal date, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

DiscontinuedOperationIntraEntityAmountsD.l: Discontinued Operation, Intra-Entity Amounts, Discontinued Operation after Disposal, Revenue
DiscontinuedOperationIntraEntityAmountsD.d: Amount of revenue in continuing operations related to continuing involvement in a discontinued operation after disposal that before the disposal was eliminated as intra-entity transactions.

DiscontinuedOperationIntraEntityAmountsD.l: Discontinued Operation, Intra-Entity Amounts, Discontinued Operation after Disposal, Expense
DiscontinuedOperationIntraEntityAmountsD.d: Amount of expense in continuing operations related to continuing involvement in a discontinued operation after the disposal that before the disposal was eliminated as intra-entity transactions.

DiscontinuedOperationEquityMethodInvestm.l: Discontinued Operation, Equity Method Investment Retained after Disposal, Ownership Interest before Disposal
DiscontinuedOperationEquityMethodInvestm.d: Percentage, before disposal, of ownership interest of discontinued operation in which equity method investment is retained.

DiscontinuedOperationEquityMethodInvestm.l: Discontinued Operation, Equity Method Investment Retained after Disposal, Ownership Interest after Disposal
DiscontinuedOperationEquityMethodInvestm.d: Percent, after disposal, of ownership interest of a discontinued operation in which an equity method investment is retained.

IncomeLossFromIndividuallySignificantCom.l: Income (Loss) from Individually Significant Component Disposed of or Held-for-Sale, Excluding Discontinued Operations, Attributable to Parent, before Income Tax [Abstract]
Income (Loss) from Individually Significant Component Disposed of or Held-for-Sale, Excluding Discontinued Operations, before Income Tax
IncomeLossFromIndividuallySignificantCom.d: Amount before tax of income (loss) from an individually significant component disposed of or held-for-sale including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Excludes discontinued operations.

IncomeLossFromIndividuallySignificantCom.l: Income (Loss) from Individually Significant Component Disposed of or Held-for-Sale, Excluding Discontinued Operations, Attributable to Parent, before Income Tax
IncomeLossFromIndividuallySignificantCom.d: Amount before tax of income (loss) from an individually significant component disposed of or held-for-sale attributable to parent. Excludes discontinued operations.

IncomeLossFromIndividuallySignificantCom.l: Income (Loss) from Individually Significant Component Disposed of or Held-for-Sale, Excluding Discontinued Operations, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Income Tax
IncomeLossFromIndividuallySignificantCom.d: Amount before tax of income (loss) from an individually significant component disposed of or held-for-sale attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes discontinued operations.

DiscontinuedOperationAlternativeCashFlow.l: Discontinued Operation, Alternative Cash Flow Information [Abstract]

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Inventory, Current
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as inventory attributable to disposal group, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

TradeReceivablesHeldForSaleNetNotPartOfD.l: Accounts Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance
TradeReceivablesHeldForSaleNetNotPartOfD.d: Amount, after valuation allowance, of accounts receivable held for sale and not part of disposal group.

LoansReceivableHeldForSaleNetNotPartOfDi.l: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance
LoansReceivableHeldForSaleNetNotPartOfDi.d: Amount, after valuation allowance, of financing receivable held for sale and not part of disposal group. Excludes loan covered under loss sharing agreement and loan classified as investment in debt security.

TradeAndLoansReceivablesHeldForSaleNetNo.l: Accounts and Financing Receivables, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance
TradeAndLoansReceivablesHeldForSaleNetNo.d: Amount, after valuation allowance, of accounts and financing receivables held for sale and not part of disposal group. Excludes loan covered under loss sharing agreement and loan classified as investment in debt security.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Capital Leased Assets, Current (Deprecated 2026)
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as capital leased assets attributable to disposal group, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Capital Leased Assets, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2026)
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as capital leased assets attributable to disposal group, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.l: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Capital Leased Assets (Deprecated 2026)
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperat.d: Amount classified as capital leased assets attributable to disposal group.

AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupC.l: Asset, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Current [Abstract]
Asset, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Other, Current
AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupC.d: Amount of other assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group, expected to be sold within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupC.l: Asset, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Current
AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupC.d: Amount of assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group, expected to be sold within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupA.l: Asset, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group [Abstract]

AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupO.l: Asset, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Other
AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroupO.d: Amount of other assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group.

AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroup.l: Asset, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group
AssetsHeldForSaleNotPartOfDisposalGroup.d: Amount of assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group.

CapitalExpenditureDiscontinuedOperations.d: Amount of capital expenditure attributable to discontinued operations.

DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.l: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, before Income Tax, Attributable to Parent [Abstract]
Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, before Income Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.d: Amount before tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until its disposal.

DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.l: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, before Income Tax, Attributable to Parent
DiscontinuedOperationIncomeLossFromDisco.d: Amount before tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation attributable to the parent. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until its disposal.

IncomeLossOfDiscontinuedOperationEquityM.l: Discontinued Operation, Equity Method Investment Retained after Disposal, Income (Loss) of Equity Method Investee, before Income Tax
IncomeLossOfDiscontinuedOperationEquityM.d: Amount before tax of income (loss) of the investee in which an equity method investment is retained after disposal of discontinued operation.

IncomeLossFromOngoingEquityMethodInvestm.l: Income (Loss) from Ongoing Equity Method Investment in Discontinued Operation after Disposal
IncomeLossFromOngoingEquityMethodInvestm.d: Amount of share in income (loss) of the equity method investee after the disposal of the discontinued operation.

FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.l: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
FairValueNetDerivativeAssetLiabilityMeas.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income for derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

GuaranteedInsuranceContractTypeOfBenefit.l: Guaranteed Insurance Contract, Type of Benefit [Axis]
GuaranteedInsuranceContractTypeOfBenefit.d: Information by benefit for guaranteed benefit obligations in traditional and nontraditional long-duration contracts with policy and contract holders.

GuaranteedInsuranceContractTypeOfBenefit.l: Guaranteed Insurance Contract, Type of Benefit [Domain]
GuaranteedInsuranceContractTypeOfBenefit.d: Benefit for guaranteed benefit obligations in traditional and nontraditional long-duration contracts with policy and contract holders.

GuaranteedInsuranceContractTypeOfGuarant.l: Guaranteed Insurance Contract, Type of Guarantee [Axis]
GuaranteedInsuranceContractTypeOfGuarant.d: Information by guarantee for guaranteed benefit obligations in traditional and nontraditional long-duration contracts with policy and contract holders.

GuaranteedInsuranceContractTypeOfGuarant.l: Guaranteed Insurance Contract, Type of Guarantee [Domain]
GuaranteedInsuranceContractTypeOfGuarant.d: Guarantee for guaranteed benefit obligations in traditional and nontraditional long-duration contracts with policy and contract holders.

ReturnOfNetDepositMember.d: Guarantee for a return of net deposit on a guaranteed benefit obligation in traditional and nontraditional long-duration contracts with policy and contract holders.

ReturnOfHighestAnniversaryValueMember.d: Guarantee for a return of the highest anniversary value on a guaranteed benefit obligation in traditional and nontraditional long-duration contracts with policy and contract holders.

NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeGuar.l: Net Amount at Risk by Product and Guarantee, Guaranteed Minimum Return Rate
NetAmountAtRiskByProductAndGuaranteeGuar.d: Rate of guaranteed minimum return on deposits made to contracts reported in separate accounts maintained by an insurance entity.

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsTabl.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits [Table Text Block]
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsTabl.d: Tabular disclosure of present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

ReinsuranceRecoverableMember.l: Reinsurance Recoverable Including Reinsurance Premium Paid [Member]
ReinsuranceRecoverableMember.d: Reinsurance recoverable, after valuation allowance, under reinsurance contracts. Examples include, but are not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported losses, loss adjustment expense, premium paid, policy benefits and policy reserves.

ReinsurerConcentrationRiskMember.d: Concentration risk of a reinsurer to a specified benchmark, such as reinsurance recoverables.

CommonStockSharesAuthorizedUnlimited.l: Common Stock, Shares Authorized, Unlimited [Fixed List]
CommonStockSharesAuthorizedUnlimited.d: Indicates whether number of common shares permitted to be issued is unlimited. Acceptable value is "Unlimited".

PreferredStockSharesAuthorizedUnlimited.l: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized, Unlimited [Fixed List]
PreferredStockSharesAuthorizedUnlimited.d: Indicates whether number of nonredeemable preferred shares, or preferred stock redeemable solely at option of issuer, permitted to be issued is unlimited. Acceptable value is "Unlimited".

InternalInvestmentGradeMember.d: Credit rating classification developed by the entity in which the probability of default is low and full and timely repayments are expected.

InternalNoninvestmentGradeMember.d: Credit rating classification developed by the entity in which the probability of default is high and full and timely repayments are not expected.

CriticizedMember.d: Credit rating classification which identifies weaknesses related to credit risk. Includes, but is not limited to, special mention, substandard and doubtful classifications. Excludes noncriticized classification.

PrimeMember.d: Credit rating classification of borrowers with strong credit histories and who have a low risk of default and qualify for the prime rate.

SubprimeMember.d: Credit rating classification of borrowers with weak credit histories, including but not limited to, payment delinquencies, bankruptcies, foreclosures and high default rates.

LoanRestructuringModificationNameAxis.d: Information by name of loan modification, for example, but not limited to, modifications under government programs.

LoanRestructuringModificationNameDomain.d: Name of loan modification, for example, but not limited to, modifications under government programs.

InterestRateBelowMarketReductionMember.d: Loan modification for a reduction of stated interest rate to a rate lower than the current market rate for new debt with similar risk.

ContractualInterestRateReductionMember.d: Loan modification for a reduction of contractual interest rate.

LoanRestructuringModificationAxis.d: Information by concessions made to the terms of loan contracts.

LoanRestructuringModificationDomain.d: Concessions made to the terms of loan contracts, including but not limited to, interest rate reductions, maturity extensions, principal forgiveness, and payment deferral.

ExtendedMaturityMember.d: Loan modification for an extension of the term of a loan in which it must be paid.

PrincipalForgivenessMember.d: Loan modification for a reduction in the amount of unpaid principal on a loan.

PaymentDeferralMember.d: Loan modification for a temporary postponement of loan payments.

LoanRestructuringTrialModificationsAmoun.d: Amount of financing receivable modified on trial basis.

LienCategoryAxis.d: Information by category of lien, for example, but not limited to, senior or junior.

LienCategoryDomain.d: Legal claim on the property of another party to secure the payment of a debt or the satisfaction of an obligation by category, for example, but not limited to, senior or junior.

SeniorLienMember.d: Legal right, before the claims of other creditors, of a creditor to possess property or other collateral in satisfaction of an outstanding debt in the event of borrower default or bankruptcy. Excludes first mortgage loans.

JuniorLienMember.d: Legal right, after the claims of senior lien holders are satisfied, for a creditor to possess property or other collateral in satisfaction of an outstanding debt in the event of borrower default or bankruptcy. Excludes second mortgage loans.

LoanToValueAxis.d: Information by debt-to-value ratio, for example, but not limited to, 80 percent to 100 percent. Element name and standard label in Debt-to-Value [numeric lower end] to [numeric higher end] Percent [Member] or Debt-to-Value Greater Than [low end numeric value] Percent [Member] or Debt-to-Value Less Than [high end numeric value] Percent [Member] formats.

LoanToValueDomain.d: Debt-to-value (DTV) ratio, for example, but not limited to, 80 percent to 100 percent. Element name and standard label in DTV [numeric lower end] to [numeric higher end] Percent [Member] or DTV Greater Than [low end numeric value] Percent [Member] or DTV Less Than [high end numeric value] Percent [Member] formats.

CoreMember.d: Identification of assets, liabilities, and operations which are strategic or central to an entity's ongoing business.

FinancingReceivablePortfolioSegmentAxis.d: Information by the level at which an entity develops and documents a systematic methodology to determine its allowance for credit losses.

FinancingReceivablePortfolioSegmentDomai.d: Level at which an entity develops and documents a systematic methodology to determine its allowance for credit losses.

HomeEquityLoanMember.d: Loan based on the equity of the borrower's residential property in which the borrower receives the loan amount upfront. Excludes home equity lines of credit.

RealEstateLoanMember.d: Loan to finance the purchase of real estate, including but not limited to, land or building.

UnfundedLoanCommitmentMember.d: Undisbursed funds of a credit facility in which the borrower may draw upon.

GainLossOnDispositionOfOtherFinancialAss.l: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Financial Assets
GainLossOnDispositionOfOtherFinancialAss.d: Amount of gain (loss) on disposal of other assets utilized in financial service operations.

TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.l: Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales [Table Text Block]
TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.d: Tabular disclosure of derecognized financial assets from transactions which comprise an initial transfer and an agreement entered into in contemplation of the initial transfer resulting in retention of substantially all of the exposure to the economic return throughout the term of the transaction.

TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.l: Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales [Table]
TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.d: Disclosure of information about derecognized financial assets from transactions which comprise an initial transfer and an agreement entered into in contemplation of the initial transfer resulting in retention of substantially all of the exposure to the economic return throughout the term of the transaction.

FinancialAssetsSoldUnderAgreementToRepur.l: Financial Assets Sold under Agreement to Repurchase [Member]
FinancialAssetsSoldUnderAgreementToRepur.d: Agreement under which the transferor transfers a financial asset to a transferee in exchange for cash and concurrently agrees to reacquire that financial asset at a future date.

SecuritiesLoanedMember.d: Securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral.

SaleAndTotalReturnSwapMember.d: Swap agreement in which one party makes payments based on a set rate while the other party makes payments based on the return of an underlying asset.

TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.l: Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales [Line Items]
TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.l: Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales, Amount Derecognized
TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.d: Amount of derecognized financial assets from transactions which comprise an initial transfer and an agreement entered into in contemplation of the initial transfer resulting in retention of substantially all of the exposure to the economic return throughout the term of the transaction, at the date of derecognition.

TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.l: Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales, Cash Proceeds Received for Assets Derecognized, Amount
TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.d: Amount, before counterparty netting, of cash proceeds received in transfers of derecognized financial assets from transactions which comprise an initial transfer and an agreement entered into in contemplation of the initial transfer resulting in retention of substantially all of the exposure to the economic return throughout the term of the transaction.

TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.l: Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales, Fair Value of Derecognized Assets
TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.d: Fair value of derecognized financial assets from transactions which comprise an initial transfer and an agreement entered into in contemplation of the initial transfer resulting in retention of substantially all of the exposure to the economic return throughout the term of the transaction.

TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.l: Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales, Description of Change in Amount
TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.d: Description of change to the amount of derecognized financial assets from transactions which comprise an initial transfer and an agreement entered into in contemplation of the initial transfer resulting in retention of substantially all of the exposure to the economic return throughout the term of the transaction.

TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.l: Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales, Description of Arrangements
TransferOfFinancialAssetsAccountedForAsS.d: Description of the arrangements that result in the transferor retaining substantially all of the exposure to the economic return on the transferred financial assets accounted for as sales and the risks related to those arrangements.

TransferOfCertainFinancialAssetsAccounte.l: Transfer of Certain Financial Assets Accounted for as Secured Borrowings [Table Text Block]
TransferOfCertainFinancialAssetsAccounte.d: Tabular disclosure of the nature and risks of short-term collateralized financing obtained through repurchase agreements, securities lending transactions and repurchase-to-maturity transactions, accounted for as secured borrowings.

TransferOfCertainFinancialAssetsAccounte.l: Transfer of Certain Financial Assets Accounted for as Secured Borrowings [Table]
TransferOfCertainFinancialAssetsAccounte.d: Disclosure of information about the nature and risks of short-term collateralized financing obtained through repurchase agreements, securities lending transactions and repurchase-to-maturity transactions, accounted for as secured borrowings.

TransferOfCertainFinancialAssetsAccounte.l: Transfer of Certain Financial Assets Accounted for as Secured Borrowings [Line Items]
TransferOfCertainFinancialAssetsAccounte.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

SecuredBorrowingsGrossIncludingNotSubjec.l: Secured Borrowings, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement [Abstract]

FinancialAssetsSoldUnderAgreementsToRepu.l: Financial Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
FinancialAssetsSoldUnderAgreementsToRepu.d: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a financial asset repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same financial asset at a date certain for a specified price. Includes repurchase-to-maturity transactions and liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

SecuredBorrowingsGrossIncludingNotSubjec.l: Secured Borrowings, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
SecuredBorrowingsGrossIncludingNotSubjec.d: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of financial assets loaned to entities in exchange for collateral and funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a financial asset repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same financial assets at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

SecuredBorrowingsGrossIncludingNotSubjec.l: Secured Borrowings, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Reconciliation [Abstract]

SecuritiesLoanedAndSecuritiesSoldUnderAg.l: Securities Loaned and Securities Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
SecuritiesLoanedAndSecuritiesSoldUnderAg.d: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral and funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

SecuredBorrowingsGrossDifferenceAmount.d: Amount of secured borrowings in excess of (less than) the liability for repurchase agreements and securities lending transactions, before offset, included in offsetting disclosures.

SecuritiesLoanedIncludingNotSubjectToMas.l: Securities Loaned, Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement and Assets other than Securities Transferred
SecuritiesLoanedIncludingNotSubjectToMas.d: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of financial assets loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and financial assets transferred other than securities that qualify as secured borrowings.

DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInFairValueOfPla.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Change in Fair Value of Plan Assets, Level 3 Reconciliation [Roll Forward]
DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInFairValueOfPla.d: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInFairValueOfPla.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Period Increase (Decrease)
DefinedBenefitPlanChangeInFairValueOfPla.d: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan.

FinancialInstrumentPerformanceStatusAxis.d: Information by category of performance or non-performance status of financial instruments.

FinancialInstrumentPerformanceStatusDoma.d: Category of performance or non-performance status of financial instruments, including but not limited to, financing receivables, loans, debt, and investments.

FinancingReceivablesPeriodPastDueAxis.d: Information by period in which financial asset is past due or not past due.

FinancingReceivablesPeriodPastDueDomain.d: Period in which financial asset is past due or not past due. For past due, element name and standard label in Financial Asset, [numeric lower end] to [numeric higher end] [date measure] Past Due [Member] or Financial Asset, Greater than [low end numeric value] [date measure] Past Due [Member] or Financial Asset, Less than [high end numeric value] [date measure] Past Due [Member] formats.

RepurchaseAgreementsSecuritiesLendingTra.l: Repurchase Agreements, Securities Lending Transactions, and Repurchase-to-Maturity Transactions Accounted for as Secured Borrowings, Description of Potential Risks
RepurchaseAgreementsSecuritiesLendingTra.d: Description of potential risks associated with the agreements and related collateral pledged, including obligations arising from a decline in the fair value of the collateral pledged and how risks are managed.

GovernmentGuaranteedMortgageLoansUponFor.l: Government Guaranteed Mortgage Loans upon Foreclosure Receivable [Member]
GovernmentGuaranteedMortgageLoansUponFor.d: Government-guaranteed mortgage loan receivables on foreclosed real estate. Government guarantee programs include, but are not limited to, guarantees offered by the Federal Housing Administration (FHA) and the US Department of Veterans Affairs.

DeferredIncomeTaxAssetsNet.d: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting.

AociIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncon.l: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AociIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncon.d: Accumulated change in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

AccumulatedNetInvestmentGainLossIncludin.l: AOCI, Accumulated Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Including Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AccumulatedNetInvestmentGainLossIncludin.d: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.

AccumulatedOtherthanTemporaryImpairmentI.l: Accumulated Other-than-Temporary Impairment Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AccumulatedOtherthanTemporaryImpairmentI.d: Accumulated other comprehensive loss resulting from other-than-temporary impairments (OTTI) of debt securities if a portion of an other-than-temporary impairment has not been recognized in earnings, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

AccumulatedNetGainLossFromCashFlowHedges.l: Accumulated Net Gain (Loss) from Cash Flow Hedges Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member] (Deprecated 2025)
AccumulatedNetGainLossFromCashFlowHedges.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) resulting from gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

AccumulatedForeignCurrencyAdjustmentIncl.l: Accumulated Foreign Currency Adjustment Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AccumulatedForeignCurrencyAdjustmentIncl.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) resulting from foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.l: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.d: Accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss related to defined benefit plans including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.l: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment, Net Gain (Loss) Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) related to gain (loss) component of defined benefit plans including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.l: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment, Net Prior Service Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.d: Accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss related to prior service cost (credit) component of defined benefit plans including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.l: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment, Net Transition Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) related to transition asset (obligation) component of defined benefit plans including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

AociAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest.d: Accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

AccumulatedNetInvestmentGainLossAttribut.l: AOCI, Accumulated Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AccumulatedNetInvestmentGainLossAttribut.d: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to noncontrolling interest.

AccumulatedNetGainLossFromCashFlowHedges.l: Accumulated Net Gain (Loss) from Cash Flow Hedges Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member] (Deprecated 2025)
AccumulatedNetGainLossFromCashFlowHedges.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) resulting from gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges, attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

AccumulatedForeignCurrencyAdjustmentAttr.l: Accumulated Foreign Currency Adjustment Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AccumulatedForeignCurrencyAdjustmentAttr.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) resulting from foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.l: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.d: Accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss related to defined benefit plans attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.l: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment, Net Gain (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) related to gain (loss) component of defined benefit plans attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.l: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment, Net Prior Service Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.d: Accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss related to prior service cost (credit) component of defined benefit plans attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.l: Accumulated Defined Benefit Plans Adjustment, Net Transition Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AccumulatedDefinedBenefitPlansAdjustment.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) related to transition asset (obligation) component of defined benefit plans attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

CreditScoreFicoAxis.d: Information by credit scores as defined by Fair Isaac Corporation (FICO), for example, but not limited to, greater than 740.

CreditScoreFicoDomain.d: Credit rating as defined by Fair Isaac Corporation (FICO), for example, but not limited to, greater than 740. Element name and standard label in FICO Score [numeric lower end] to [numeric higher end] [Member] format for ranges. Element name and standard label in FICO Score Greater Than [low end numeric value] [Member] or FICO Score Less Than [high end numeric value] [Member] formats for greater than or less than disclosures.

LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironmentalClai.l: Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims, Net, Payment for Claims
LiabilityForAsbestosAndEnvironmentalClai.d: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle insured claims and pay costs incurred in the claims settlement process attributable to asbestos and environmental claims.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostUnrealizedI.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Unrealized Investment Gain (Loss)
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostUnrealizedI.d: Amount of unrealized investment gain (loss) which decreases (increases) deferred policy acquisition cost.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostForeignCurr.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostForeignCurr.d: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) deferred policy acquisition costs.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Amortization Expense, Effect of Adjustments to Estimated Gross Profit or Estimated Gross Margin
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAmortizatio.d: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of amortization expense) of deferred policy acquisition costs from a revision in estimated gross profit or estimated gross margin.

ClosedBlockDividendObligationIncreaseDec.l: Closed Block Dividend Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Effect of Operating Results
ClosedBlockDividendObligationIncreaseDec.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in the closed block dividend obligation from the effect on dividends to policyholders on the net results of operations for the period of the closed block.

FinancialSupportForNonconsolidatedLegalE.l: Financial Support for Nonconsolidated Legal Entity [Table]
FinancialSupportForNonconsolidatedLegalE.d: Disclosure of information about financial support provided to a nonconsolidated legal entity that is required to comply with or operate in accordance with requirements that are similar to those included in Rule 2a-7 of the Investment Company Act of 1940 for registered money market funds.

FinancialSupportToNonconsolidatedLegalEn.l: Financial Support to Nonconsolidated Legal Entity [Axis]
FinancialSupportToNonconsolidatedLegalEn.d: Information by financial support arrangement provided to a nonconsolidated legal entity that is required to comply with or operate in accordance with requirements that are similar to those included in Rule 2a-7 of the Investment Company Act of 1940 for registered money market funds.

FinancialSupportForNonconsolidatedLegalE.l: Financial Support for Nonconsolidated Legal Entity [Abstract]

FinancialSupportCapitalContributionsMemb.d: Assets contributed to an entity by a shareholder, partner or owner, increasing his or her equity interest in the entity. Excludes pari passu investments.

FinancialSupportPurchaseAgreementOfFinan.l: Financial Support, Purchase Agreement of Financial Assets [Member]
FinancialSupportPurchaseAgreementOfFinan.d: Agreement to purchase financial assets for amounts greater than fair value.

FinancialSupportWaivedFeesMember.d: Fees which are no longer required to be paid.

FinancialSupportForNonconsolidatedLegalE.l: Financial Support for Nonconsolidated Legal Entity [Line Items]
FinancialSupportForNonconsolidatedLegalE.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

NonconsolidatedLegalEntityFinancialSuppo.l: Nonconsolidated Legal Entity, Financial Support Amount
NonconsolidatedLegalEntityFinancialSuppo.d: Amount of financial support provided to a nonconsolidated legal entity that is required to comply with or operate in accordance with requirements that are similar to those included in Rule 2a-7 of the Investment Company Act of 1940 for registered money market funds.

ParticipatingLifeInsurancePolicyMember.d: Contract providing death benefits that entitle the policyholder to a portion of earnings or surplus through policy dividends.

NonparticipatingLifeInsurancePolicyMembe.d: Contract providing death benefits that do not entitle the policyholder to a portion of earnings or surplus through policy dividends.

DisabilityInsurancePolicyMember.d: Contract that provides a benefit in the event the policyholder is incapable of working.

FixedAnnuityMember.d: Contract that provides a guaranteed stream of fixed payments.

TimeDepositsTable.d: Disclosure of information about deposit liability.

TimeDepositsAtOrAboveFDICInsuranceLimit.l: Time Deposits, at or Above FDIC Insurance Limit
TimeDepositsAtOrAboveFDICInsuranceLimit.d: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations that meet or exceed the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit.

NewAccountingPronouncementOrChangeInAcco.l: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Prior Period Not Restated [true false]
NewAccountingPronouncementOrChangeInAcco.d: Indicates (true false) whether prior period was not restated when there is change in accounting principle or adoption of new accounting pronouncement. Excludes correction of error.

BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiabl.l: Business Combination, Recognized Liability Assumed, Deferred Tax Liability
BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiabl.d: Amount of deferred tax liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiabl.l: Business Combination, Recognized Asset Acquired, Deferred Tax Asset
BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiabl.d: Amount of deferred tax asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

FinancialSupportToNonconsolidatedLegalEn.l: Financial Support to Nonconsolidated Legal Entity [Domain]
FinancialSupportToNonconsolidatedLegalEn.d: Financial support arrangement provided to a nonconsolidated legal entity that is required to comply with or operate in accordance with requirements that are similar to those included in Rule 2a-7 of the Investment Company Act of 1940 for registered money market funds.

MutualFundMember.d: Regulated investment instrument that pools funds from multiple investors to invest principally in a portfolio of securities and money market instruments to match the investment objective.

BalancedFundsMember.d: Regulated investment instrument that pools funds from multiple investors to invest principally in a portfolio of securities and money market instruments to match a moderate investment objective.

GoodwillOtherIncreaseDecrease.d: Amount of increase (decrease) of asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized, classified as other.

LossContingencyAccrualPayments.d: Amount of cash outflow reducing loss contingency liability.

LossContingencyReceivableProceeds.d: Amount of cash inflow from the collection of receivables related to a loss contingency.

DeferredFinanceCostsOwnShareLendingArran.l: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Amortization Expense
DeferredFinanceCostsOwnShareLendingArran.d: Amount of expense for amortization of deferred issuance costs associated with an own-share lending arrangement.

LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePaymentsUn.l: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Payments under Bankruptcy Court Order for Other Liabilities
LiabilitiesSubjectToCompromisePaymentsUn.d: Amount of cash outflow to creditors related to liabilities subject to compromise pursuant to bankruptcy court orders for liabilities classified as other.

TranslationAdjustmentFunctionalToReporti.l: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Gain (Loss), Reclassified to Earnings, Net of Tax
TranslationAdjustmentFunctionalToReporti.d: Amount of reclassification from other comprehensive income (loss) to earnings, after tax, related to translation from the functional currency to reporting currency, as a result of the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity.

DerivativesUsedInNetInvestmentHedgeTaxEx.l: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Tax Expense (Benefit)
DerivativesUsedInNetInvestmentHedgeTaxEx.d: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from transactions on foreign currency derivatives that are designated as, and are effective as, economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity.

DerivativesUsedInNetInvestmentHedgeGainL.l: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassified to Earnings, Net of Tax
DerivativesUsedInNetInvestmentHedgeGainL.d: Amount, after tax, of reclassification from other comprehensive income (loss) to earnings from the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity.

NonconsolidatedLegalEntityFinancialSuppo.l: Nonconsolidated Legal Entity, Financial Support Cumulative Amount
NonconsolidatedLegalEntityFinancialSuppo.d: Amount of cumulative financial support provided to a nonconsolidated legal entity that is required to comply with or operate in accordance with requirements that are similar to those included in Rule 2a-7 of the Investment Company Act of 1940 for registered money market funds.

TimeDepositsGreaterThan100000Statement.l: Time Deposit, Greater than $100,000, Statement [true false] (Deprecated 2025)
TimeDepositsGreaterThan100000Statement.d: Indicates (true false) whether majority of time deposits were in amounts in excess of $100,000.

PrepaidStoredValueProductsBreakageMethod.d: Description of methodology used to recognize unredeemed portion of dollar value of prepaid stored-value products.

NetAssetValuePerShare.d: Net asset value per share or per unit of investments in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Investment includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain hedge funds, venture capital funds, private equity funds, real estate partnerships or funds. Excludes fair value disclosure.

RiskWeightedAssetsCalculationMethodology.l: Banking Regulation, Risk-Weighted Assets Calculation Methodology [Axis]
RiskWeightedAssetsCalculationMethodology.d: Information by approach for calculating risk-weighted assets as defined by regulatory framework.

RiskWeightedAssetsCalculationMethodology.d: Approach for calculating risk-weighted assets as defined by regulatory framework.

AdvancedApproachMember.d: Approach for calculating risk-weighted asset using advanced approach as defined by regulatory framework.

CommonEquityTierOneCapitalRequiredForCap.d: Amount of minimum Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

CommonEquityTierOneCapitalRequiredToBeWe.l: Banking Regulation, Common Equity Tier 1 Risk-Based Capital, Well Capitalized, Minimum
CommonEquityTierOneCapitalRequiredToBeWe.d: Amount of minimum Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

FinancingReceivableNonaccrualPercentPast.l: Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual, Percent Past Due
FinancingReceivableNonaccrualPercentPast.d: Percentage of nonaccrual financing receivable balance outstanding that is past due.

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.d: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during next fiscal year following current fiscal year. PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year Two
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.d: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year Three
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.d: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year Four
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.d: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year Five
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.d: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Remainder of Fiscal Year
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.d: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized in remainder of current fiscal year.
