PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsGros.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Gross
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsGros.d: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAccu.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Accumulated Amortization
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAccu.d: Amount of accumulated amortization of present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsWeig.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Weighted Average Amortization Period
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsWeig.d: Weighted average amortization period of present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense, Accrued Interest
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.d: Amount of amortization expense for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination from accrued interest on unamortized balance.

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense [Abstract]
Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense, Excluding Accrued Interest [Abstract]
Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense, Excluding Accrued Interest
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.d: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of amortization expense) for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination, excluding accrued interest on unamortized balance.

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense, Realized Gain (Loss)
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.d: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of amortization expense) for future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination from realized investment gain (loss).

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense, Assumption Change
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsAmor.d: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of amortization expense) for future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination from assumption change.

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsFore.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsFore.d: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAmortizati.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Amortization Expense, Accrued Interest
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAmortizati.d: Amount of amortization expense for deferred policy acquisition costs from accrued interest on unamortized balance.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAmortizati.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Amortization Expense, Excluding Accrued Interest [Abstract]
Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Amortization Expense, Excluding Accrued Interest
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAmortizati.d: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of amortization expense) for deferred policy acquisition costs, excluding accrued interest on unamortized balance.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsImpairment.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Impairment Loss
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsImpairment.d: Amount of impairment loss for deferred policy acquisition costs.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense, Excluding Accrued Interest [Abstract]
Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense, Realized Gain (Loss)

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense, Assumption Change
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.d: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of amortization expense) of deferred policy acquisition costs and future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination, from assumption change.

ReinsuranceRecoverableForPaidAndUnpaidCl.l: Reinsurance Recoverable for Paid and Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustments [Member]
ReinsuranceRecoverableForPaidAndUnpaidCl.d: Reinsurance recoverable, after valuation allowance, under reinsurance contract. Includes, but is not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported loss, loss adjustment expense, policy benefits and policy reserves.

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsPerc.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Percentage, Year One
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsPerc.d: Percentage of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during next fiscal year following current fiscal year. PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsPerc.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Percentage, Year Two
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsPerc.d: Percentage of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsPerc.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Percentage, Year Three
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsPerc.d: Percentage of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsPerc.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Percentage, Year Four
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsPerc.d: Percentage of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsPerc.l: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Percentage, Year Five
PresentValueOfFutureInsuranceProfitsPerc.d: Percentage of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

RetirementPlanSponsorLocationDomain.d: Location of employer sponsoring plan designed to provide retirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

DomesticPlanMember.d: Location of employer sponsoring plan, designed to provide retirement benefits, determined as principal place of business. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

ForeignPlanMember.d: Location of employer sponsoring plan, designed to provide retirement benefits, not determined as principal place of business. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

RetirementPlanTaxStatusAxis.d: Information by tax status of plan designed to provide retirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

RetirementPlanTaxStatusDomain.d: Tax status of plan designed to provide retirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

NonqualifiedPlanMember.d: Plan without tax-exempt status in accordance with applicable tax provision of designated taxing authority. RetirementPlanFundingStatusDomain.d: Status of funding for defined benefit plan designed to provide retirement benefits.

UnderfundedPlanMember.d: Defined benefit plan in which retirement benefits are payable directly from plan assets segregated and restricted to provide such benefits and for which benefit obligation exceeds plan assets available to provide retirement benefits.

UnfundedPlanMember.d: Defined benefit plan in which retirement benefits are payable directly from general assets of employer sponsoring plan.

Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense, Excluding Accrued Interest
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndPresent.d: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of amortization expense) for deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination, excluding accrued interest on unamortized balance.

ContractWithCustomerAssetAccumulatedAllo.d: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

ContractWithCustomerAssetAccumulatedAllo.d: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

ContractWithCustomerAssetGrossNoncurrent.l: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
ContractWithCustomerAssetGrossNoncurrent.d: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

ContractWithCustomerAssetCreditLossExpen.l: Contract with Customer, Asset, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
ContractWithCustomerAssetCreditLossExpen.d: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

ContractWithCustomerAssetReclassifiedToR.l: Contract with Customer, Asset, Reclassified to Receivable
ContractWithCustomerAssetReclassifiedToR.d: Amount of decrease in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time from transfer to receivable due to right to consideration becoming unconditional.

ContractWithCustomerAssetGrossCurrent.l: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
ContractWithCustomerAssetGrossCurrent.d: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

ContractWithCustomerTimingOfSatisfaction.d: Description of effect, from relationship that timing of satisfaction of performance obligation has on timing of payment, on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time and on obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

ContractWithCustomerAssetGross.d: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer, when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

ContractWithCustomerAssetNet.l: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss
ContractWithCustomerAssetNet.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

ContractWithCustomerAssetNetCurrentAbstr.l: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current [Abstract]

ContractWithCustomerAssetNetCurrent.l: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
ContractWithCustomerAssetNetCurrent.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

ContractWithCustomerAssetNetNoncurrent.l: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
ContractWithCustomerAssetNetNoncurrent.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

ContractWithCustomerRefundLiabilityNoncu.l: Contract with Customer, Refund Liability, Noncurrent
ContractWithCustomerRefundLiabilityNoncu.d: Amount of liability for consideration received or receivable from customer which is not included in transaction price, when consideration is expected to be refunded to customer, classified as noncurrent.

ContractWithCustomerRefundLiability.d: Amount of liability for consideration received or receivable from customer which is not included in transaction price, when consideration is expected to be refunded to customer.

RevenueFromContractWithCustomerTextBlock.l: Revenue from Contract with Customer [Text Block]
RevenueFromContractWithCustomerTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure of revenue from contract with customer to transfer good or service and to transfer nonfinancial asset. ContractWithCustomerRightToRecoverProduc.d: Amount of right to recover product from customer on settling refund liability, classified as current.

ContractWithCustomerRightToRecoverProduc.l: Contract with Customer, Right to Recover Product, Noncurrent
ContractWithCustomerRightToRecoverProduc.d: Amount of right to recover product from customer on settling refund liability, classified as noncurrent.

ContractWithCustomerRightToRecoverProduc.l: Contract with Customer, Right to Recover Product
ContractWithCustomerRightToRecoverProduc.d: Amount of right to recover product from customer on settling refund liability.

RevenuePracticalExpedientRemainingPerfor.d: Indicates (true false) whether optional exemption was applied not to disclose amount of transaction price allocated to and explanation of expected timing of revenue recognition for remaining performance obligation, when contract has expected duration of one year or less or right to consideration corresponds directly to performance completed.

RevenuePracticalExpedientRemainingPerfor.l: Revenue, Practical Expedient, Remaining Performance Obligation, Description
RevenuePracticalExpedientRemainingPerfor.d: Description of consideration that is not included in transaction price and not allocated to remaining performance obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, variable consideration that is constrained.

CapitalizedContractCostAmortization.d: Amount of amortization expense for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

CapitalizedContractCostImpairmentLoss.d: Amount of impairment loss for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

CapitalizedContractCostGross.d: Amount, before accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

CapitalizedContractCostAccumulatedAmorti.d: Amount of accumulated amortization of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

CapitalizedContractCostAccumulatedImpair.d: Amount of accumulated impairment loss for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

RevenuePerformanceObligationDescriptionO.l: Revenue, Performance Obligation, Description of Good or Service
RevenuePerformanceObligationDescriptionO.d: Description of good or service to be transferred in contract with customer. Includes, but is not limited to, arrangement for another party to transfer good or service to customer.

RevenuePerformanceObligationDescriptionO.l: Revenue, Performance Obligation, Description of Timing
RevenuePerformanceObligationDescriptionO.d: Description of timing for satisfying performance obligation in contract with customer. Includes, but is not limited to, as services are rendered, and upon shipment, delivery or completion of service.

RevenuePerformanceObligationDescriptionO.l: Revenue, Performance Obligation, Description of Payment Terms
RevenuePerformanceObligationDescriptionO.d: Description of payment terms in contract with customer. Includes, but is not limited to, timing of payment, existence of financing component, variability of consideration and constraint on variable consideration.

RevenuePerformanceObligationDescriptionO.l: Revenue, Performance Obligation, Description of Returns and Other Similar Obligations
RevenuePerformanceObligationDescriptionO.d: Description of obligation for returns, refunds, and other similar obligations in contract with customer.

RevenuePerformanceObligationDescriptionO.l: Revenue, Performance Obligation, Description of Warranty
RevenuePerformanceObligationDescriptionO.d: Description of warranty and related obligation in contract with customer.

RevenuePerformanceObligationSatisfiedAtP.l: Revenue, Performance Obligation Satisfied at Point in Time, Transfer of Control
RevenuePerformanceObligationSatisfiedAtP.d: Description of judgment made in evaluating when customer obtains control of promised good or service for performance obligation satisfied at point in time.

RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligationExp.d: Disclosure of information about expected timing for satisfying remaining performance obligation.

RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligationExp.l: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Expected Timing of Satisfaction [Line Items]
RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligationExp.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligationExp.l: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Expected Timing of Satisfaction, Explanation
RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligationExp.d: Description of when remaining performance obligation is expected to be recognized as revenue.

Other than Temporary Impairment Loss, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Tax, Attributable to Parent, Held-to-Maturity Securities [Abstract]

Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable
SalesTypeAndDirectFinancingLeasesLeaseRe.d: Present value of lease payments not yet received by lessor and amount expected to be derived from underlying asset, following end of lease term guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor, from sales-type and direct financing leases.

DefinedBenefitPlanBenefitObligationBenef.d: Amount of payment to participant of defined benefit plan which decreases benefit obligation. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription drug benefits, health care benefits, life insurance benefits, and legal, educational and advisory services.

DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsForeignCurre.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsForeignCurre.d: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) plan assets of defined benefit plan.

DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsBenefitsPaid.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Benefits Paid
DefinedBenefitPlanPlanAssetsBenefitsPaid.d: Amount of payment to participant under defined benefit plan which decreases plan assets. For pension plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, pension benefits and death benefits. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription drug benefits, health care benefits, life insurance benefits, and legal, educational and advisory services.

DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfTransiti.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Transition Asset (Obligation)
DefinedBenefitPlanAmortizationOfTransiti.d: Amount of transition asset (obligation) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit of defined benefit plan.

DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndiv.l: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Contributions by Employer

DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedAmortizationOf.d: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedAmortizationOf.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization of Prior Service Cost (Credit), Next Fiscal Year
DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedAmortizationOf.d: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedAmortizationOf.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization of Transition Asset (Obligation), Next Fiscal Year
DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedAmortizationOf.d: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedAmortizationNe.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization, Next Fiscal Year
DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedAmortizationNe.d: Amount of cost (credit) included in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedFutureEmployer.d: Amount of contribution expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes contribution previously paid by employer in current fiscal year.

DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedFutureEmployer.l: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Current Fiscal Year
DefinedBenefitPlanExpectedFutureEmployer.d: Amount of contributions received and expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in current fiscal year.

DefinedContributionPlanNumberOfEmployees.l: Defined Contribution Plan, Number of Employees
DefinedContributionPlanNumberOfEmployees.d: Number of employees eligible to participate in defined contribution plan.

NetIncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsA.d: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from discontinued operations available to common shareholders.

NetIncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsA.d: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) from discontinued operations available to common shareholders.

Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from continuing operations, allocated to common stock and participating securities, as if earnings and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares, had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

DefinedBenefitPlanAccumulatedBenefitObli.d: Amount of (increase) decrease in accumulated benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from effects of settlement and curtailment.

WeightedAverageRateInterestBearingDomest.d: Weighted average interest rate calculated over time for domestic deposit liability.

InvestmentCompanyDescriptionOfFinancialC.d: Description of reason for and circumstance of financial support by investment company to investee.

InvestmentCompanyInvestmentIncomeLossPer.d: Per-basic-share or unit amount, after investment expense, of dividend and interest investment income (loss) from investment held by investment company.

InvestmentCompanyGainLossOnInvestmentPer.d: Per share or unit amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

InvestmentCompanyRealizedAndUnrealizedGa.l: Investment Company, Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss), Description of Difference
InvestmentCompanyRealizedAndUnrealizedGa.d: Description of reason for difference between realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment per share or unit and change in gain (loss) on investment.

InvestmentCompanyInvestmentIncomeLossFro.l: Investment Company, Investment Income (Loss) from Operations, Per Share
InvestmentCompanyInvestmentIncomeLossFro.d: Per share or unit amount of investment income (loss) and realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

InvestmentCompanyTaxReturnOfCapitalDistr.d: Per share or unit amount of capital distribution in excess of tax basis earnings.

RevenueFromContractWithCustomerDurationE.d: Indicates duration of contract with customer. Includes, but is not limited to, short-term and long-term contracts.

RevenueFromContractWithCustomerBasisOfPr.l: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Basis of Pricing [Extensible Enumeration]
RevenueFromContractWithCustomerBasisOfPr.d: Indicates basis of pricing for contract representing right to consideration in exchange for product and service transferred to customer.

RevenueFromContractWithCustomerGeographi.l: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Geographical [Extensible Enumeration]
RevenueFromContractWithCustomerGeographi.d: Indicates geographical component for sale of product and rendering of service in contract with customer.

RevenueFromContractWithCustomerProductAn.l: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Product and Service [Extensible Enumeration]
RevenueFromContractWithCustomerProductAn.d: Indicates product and service for revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised product and service to customer.

ConstructionContractCostProgressPaymentO.l: Construction Contract Cost, Progress Payment Offset
ConstructionContractCostProgressPaymentO.d: Amount of progress payment netted against construction contract cost.

RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomer.l: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer
RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomer.d: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606.

RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomerOther.l: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer, Other
RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomerOther.d: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606, classified as other.

ContractWithCustomerReceivableCreditLoss.l: Contract with Customer, Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
ContractWithCustomerReceivableCreditLoss.d: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional.

RevenueFromContractWithCustomerProductAn.l: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Product and Service Benchmark [Member]
RevenueFromContractWithCustomerProductAn.d: Revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised product and service to customer for specified product or service, when it serves as benchmark in concentration of risk calculation.

RevenueFromContractWithCustomerSegmentBe.l: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Segment Benchmark [Member]
RevenueFromContractWithCustomerSegmentBe.d: Revenue from specified business segment for satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised product and service to customer, when it serves as benchmark in concentration of risk calculation.

DeferredIncome.d: Amount of deferred income excluding obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

DeferredIncomeCurrent.d: Amount of deferred income excluding obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

DeferredIncomeNoncurrent.d: Amount of deferred income excluding obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

RevenueTransactionPriceMeasurementTaxExc.l: Revenue, Transaction Price Measurement, Tax Exclusion [true false]
RevenueTransactionPriceMeasurementTaxExc.d: Indicates (true false) whether accounting policy was elected to exclude from measurement of transaction price tax assessed by governmental authority that was both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, and collected from customer. Includes, but is not limited to, sales, use, value-added, and excise tax.

AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitAfter.l: AOCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, after Tax
AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitAfter.d: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

AociMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificC.l: AOCI, Market Risk Benefit, Instrument-Specific Credit Risk, after Tax
AociMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificC.d: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity protecting contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposing insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpec.l: AOCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, before Tax
AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpec.d: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from increase (decrease) in expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpec.l: AOCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, before Tax
AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpec.d: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in expected future policy benefit component of liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitBefor.l: AOCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, before Tax
AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitBefor.d: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

AociMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificC.l: AOCI, Market Risk Benefit, Instrument-Specific Credit Risk, before Tax
AociMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificC.d: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity protecting contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposing insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

FinancingReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCre.l: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Fee and Loan in Process
FinancingReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCre.d: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, fee, and loan in process, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

FinancingReceivableLoanInProcess.d: Amount of undisbursed portion of financing receivable balance. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

FinancingReceivableCoveredAfterAllowance.l: Financing Receivable, Covered, after Allowance for Credit Loss [Abstract]

FinancingReceivableCoveredBeforeAllowanc.l: Financing Receivable, Covered, before Allowance for Credit Loss
FinancingReceivableCoveredBeforeAllowanc.d: Amount, before allowance, of finance receivable covered by loss sharing agreement.

FinancingReceivableCoveredAllowanceForCr.l: Financing Receivable, Covered, Allowance for Credit Loss
FinancingReceivableCoveredAllowanceForCr.d: Amount of allowance for finance receivable covered by loss sharing agreement.

FinancingReceivableCoveredAfterAllowance.l: Financing Receivable, Covered, after Allowance for Credit Loss
FinancingReceivableCoveredAfterAllowance.d: Amount, after allowance, of finance receivable covered by loss sharing agreement.

AccountsAndFinancingReceivableAllowanceF.l: Accounts and Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
AccountsAndFinancingReceivableAllowanceF.d: Amount of allowance for credit loss of accounts and financing receivables. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

FinancingReceivableDeferredIncome.d: Amount of fee received for commitment to originate or purchase financing receivable where likelihood of commitment being exercised is remote, to be recognized as service income.

AccountsAndNontradeReceivableTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for accounts receivable, contract receivable, receivable held-for-sale, and nontrade receivable.

PremiumReceivableCreditLossExpenseRevers.d: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on premium receivable.

FinancingReceivableChangeInMethodCreditL.l: Financing Receivable, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
FinancingReceivableChangeInMethodCreditL.d: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on financing receivable from change in methodology. Excludes net investment in lease.

AccountsReceivableChangeInMethodCreditLo.l: Accounts Receivable, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
AccountsReceivableChangeInMethodCreditLo.d: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable from change in methodology.

DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityChangeInMeth.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityChangeInMeth.d: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), from change in methodology.

SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseChange.l: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseChange.d: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease, from change in methodology.

NetInvestmentInLeaseChangeInMethodCredit.l: Net Investment in Lease, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
NetInvestmentInLeaseChangeInMethodCredit.d: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, from change in methodology.

DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.l: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.d: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on net investment in direct financing lease, from change in methodology.

ReinsuranceRecoverableChangeInMethodCred.l: Reinsurance Recoverable, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
ReinsuranceRecoverableChangeInMethodCred.d: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on reinsurance recoverable, from change in methodology.

SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.l: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.d: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on security purchased under agreement to resell, from change in methodology.

SecuritiesBorrowedChangeInMethodCreditLo.l: Securities Borrowed, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
SecuritiesBorrowedChangeInMethodCreditLo.d: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on securities borrowed, from change in methodology.

OffBalanceSheetCreditLossLiabilityChange.l: Off-Balance-Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
OffBalanceSheetCreditLossLiabilityChange.d: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on off-balance sheet commitment, from change in methodology. DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityPurchase.d: Amount of increase from purchase of debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

NetInvestmentInLeasePurchase.d: Amount of increase from purchase of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeasePurcha.l: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Purchase
SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeasePurcha.d: Amount of increase from purchase of net investment in sales-type lease.

DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.l: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Purchase
DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.d: Amount of increase from purchase of net investment in direct financing lease.

SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseSale.l: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Sale

DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.l: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Sale
DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.d: Amount of decrease from sale of net investment in direct financing lease.

FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.d: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

Includes, but is not limited to, methodology used to estimate allowance for credit loss, how writeoff of uncollectible amount is recognized, and determination of past due status and nonaccrual status.

NetInvestmentInLeaseCreditQualityIndicat.d: Tabular disclosure of credit quality indicator for net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.d: Disclosure of information about credit quality indicator for net investment in direct financing lease.

DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.d: Tabular disclosure of credit quality indicator for net investment in direct financing lease.

ReinsuranceRecoverableCreditQualityIndic.l: Reinsurance Recoverable, Credit Quality Indicator [Table Text Block]
ReinsuranceRecoverableCreditQualityIndic.d: Tabular disclosure of credit quality indicator for reinsurance recoverable.

DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityCreditQualit.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

FinancingReceivableCreditQualityIndicato.d: Indicates frequency credit quality indicator is updated for financing receivable.

ProceedsDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSalePr.d: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), previously written off.

ProceedsDebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityPrev.l: Proceeds, Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Previously Written off, Recovery
ProceedsDebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityPrev.d: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), previously written off.

SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLease90Days.l: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, 90 Days or More Past Due, Still Accruing
SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLease90Days.d: Amount of net investment in sales-type lease, 90 days or more past due and still accruing.

ReinsuranceRecoverableThresholdPeriodPas.l: Reinsurance Recoverable, Threshold Period Past Due, Writeoff
ReinsuranceRecoverableThresholdPeriodPas.d: Threshold period when reinsurance recoverable is considered past due to write off as uncollectible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAllowa.l: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAllowa.d: Amount of writeoff of net investment in sales-type lease, charged against allowance for credit loss.

TransferToFromPolicyholderAccountBalance.l: Transfer to (from) Policyholder Account Balance (to) from Separate Account
TransferToFromPolicyholderAccountBalance.d: Amount of transfer to (from) liability for policyholder account balance (to) from liability for separate account.

ShortDurationInsuranceContractAccidentYe.d: Accident year 2019 in which covered event occurs under terms of short-duration insurance contract.

SeparateAccountLiabilityGeographicalExte.d: Indicates geographical component for separate account liability.

SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementToResel.l: Securities Purchased under Agreement to Resell, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementToResel.d: Amount of writeoff of security purchased under agreement to resell, charged against allowance for credit loss.

SecuritiesBorrowedAllowanceForCreditLoss.l: Securities Borrowed, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
SecuritiesBorrowedAllowanceForCreditLoss.d: Amount of writeoff of security borrowed, charged against allowance for credit loss.

SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.l: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Decrease
SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.d: Amount of decrease from sale of security purchased under agreement to resell.

SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.l: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Increase
SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.d: Amount of increase from purchase of security purchased under agreement to resell.

SecuritiesBorrowedDecrease.d: Amount of decrease in security borrowed from settlement of transaction.

SecuritiesBorrowedIncrease.d: Amount of increase in security borrowed from entering into new transaction.

SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseThresh.l: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Threshold Period Past Due, Writeoff
SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseThresh.d: Threshold period when net investment in sales-type lease is considered past due to write off as uncollectible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturity90DaysOrMore.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, 90 Days or More Past Due, Still Accruing
DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturity90DaysOrMore.d: Amount of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), 90 days or more past due and still accruing.

AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsurance.l: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Original Discount Rate, before Cash Flow and Reinsurance
AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsurance.d: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and current period update of cash flow assumption, of present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment, discounted at original rate. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

AccountsReceivableNoncurrent90DaysOrMore.l: Accounts Receivable, Noncurrent, 90 Days or More Past Due, Still Accruing
AccountsReceivableNoncurrent90DaysOrMore.d: Amount of accounts receivable, classified as noncurrent, 90 days or more past due and still accruing.

AccountsReceivableNoncurrentThresholdPer.l: Accounts Receivable, Noncurrent, Threshold Period Past Due, Writeoff
AccountsReceivableNoncurrentThresholdPer.d: Threshold period when accounts receivable, classified as noncurrent, is considered past due to write off as uncollectible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSa.l: AOCI, Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, with Allowance for Credit Loss, Parent [Member]
AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSa.d: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with allowance for credit loss, attributable to parent.

AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSa.l: AOCI, Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, with Allowance for Credit Loss, Including Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSa.d: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with allowance for credit loss, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.

AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSa.l: AOCI, Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, with Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSa.d: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with allowance for credit loss, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSa.l: AOCI, Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, without Allowance for Credit Loss, Parent [Member]
AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSa.d: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), without allowance for credit loss, attributable to parent.

AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSa.l: AOCI, Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, without Allowance for Credit Loss, Including Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSa.d: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), without allowance for credit loss, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.

AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSa.l: AOCI, Gain (Loss), Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, without Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AociGainLossDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSa.d: Accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), without allowance for credit loss, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsurance.l: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Geographical [Extensible Enumeration]
AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsurance.d: Indicates geographical component for present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitNonco.l: AOCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitNonco.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitParen.l: AOCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Parent [Member]
AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitParen.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, attributable to parent.

AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitInclu.l: AOCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Including Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AociLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitInclu.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.

AociMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificC.l: AOCI, Market Risk Benefit, Instrument-Specific Credit Risk, Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AociMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificC.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity protecting contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposing insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

AociMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificC.l: AOCI, Market Risk Benefit, Instrument-Specific Credit Risk, Parent [Member]
AociMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificC.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity protecting contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposing insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk, attributable to parent.

AociMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificC.l: AOCI, Market Risk Benefit, Instrument-Specific Credit Risk, Including Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
AociMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificC.d: Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity protecting contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposing insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk, including attributable to noncontrolling interest.

CostOfGoodsAndServiceExcludingDepreciati.l: Cost of Goods and Service, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization [Abstract]

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAndPresentV.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost and Present Value of Future Insurance Profit, Geographical [Extensible Enumeration]
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostAndPresentV.d: Indicates geographical component for deferred policy acquisition cost and present value of future insurance profit.

DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostGeographica.l: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Geographical [Extensible Enumeration]
DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostGeographica.d: Indicates geographical component for deferred policy acquisition cost.

ContractWithCustomerAssetAllowanceForCre.l: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
ContractWithCustomerAssetAllowanceForCre.d: Amount of writeoff of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, charged against allowance for credit loss.

ContractWithCustomerAssetThresholdPeriod.l: Contract with Customer, Asset, Threshold Period Past Due, Writeoff
ContractWithCustomerAssetThresholdPeriod.d: Threshold period when right to consideration in exchange for product or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, is considered past due to write off as uncollectible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

CostOfGoodsAndServiceExcludingDepreciati.l: Cost of Goods and Service, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization
CostOfGoodsAndServiceExcludingDepreciati.d: Cost of product sold and service rendered, excluding depreciation, depletion, and amortization.

DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAllowanceF.l: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAllowanceF.d: Amount of writeoff of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllowanceFor.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllowanceFor.d: Amount of writeoff of investment in debt security, measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), charged against allowance for credit loss.

DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityThresholdPer.l: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Threshold Period Past Due, Writeoff
DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityThresholdPer.d: Threshold period when investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) is considered past due to write off as uncollectible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

DeferredSaleInducementCostGeographicalEx.l: Deferred Sale Inducement Cost, Geographical [Extensible Enumeration]
DeferredSaleInducementCostGeographicalEx.d: Indicates geographical component for deferred sale inducement cost.

DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.l: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, 90 Days or More Past Due, Still Accruing
DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.d: Amount of net investment in direct financing lease, 90 days or more past due and still accruing.

FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.l: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff, after Recovery
FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.d: Amount, after recovery, of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

FinancingReceivableCoveredAndNotCoveredA.l: Financing Receivable, Covered and Not Covered, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Fee, Premium, and Discount
FinancingReceivableCoveredAndNotCoveredA.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss and unamortized deferred fee, premium, and discount, of financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and financing receivable not covered under loss sharing agreement.

FinancingReceivableCoveredAndNotCoveredA.l: Financing Receivable, Covered and Not Covered, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Fee, Premium, and Discount [Abstract]

FinancingReceivableThresholdPeriodPastDu.l: Financing Receivable, Threshold Period Past Due, Writeoff
FinancingReceivableThresholdPeriodPastDu.d: Threshold period when financing receivable is considered past due to write off as uncollectible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

InsuranceContractAcquisitionCostPolicyTe.l: Insurance Contract, Acquisition Cost [Policy Text Block]
InsuranceContractAcquisitionCostPolicyTe.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for cost related directly to successful acquisition of new and renewal of insurance contract. Information includes, but is not limited to, input, judgment, assumption, and method used to determine amortization amount, and change in input, judgment, and assumption. Cost, includes but is not limited to, deferred policy acquisition cost, deferred sale inducement cost, and present value of future profit of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

InsuranceContractAcquisitionCostTextBloc.d: The entire disclosure for cost related directly to successful acquisition of new and renewal of insurance contract. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred policy acquisition cost, deferred sale inducement cost, and present value of future profit of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitAdverseDe.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Adverse Development, Expense
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitAdverseDe.d: Amount of expense for adverse development on liability of future policy benefit from net premium exceeding gross premium.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedF.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, Original Discount Rate, before Cash Flow and Reinsurance
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedF.d: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and current period update of cash flow assumption, of expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit, discounted at original rate.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedN.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, Original Discount Rate, before Cash Flow and Reinsurance
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedN.d: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and current period update of cash flow assumption, of expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit, discounted at original rate.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGeographi.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Geographical [Extensible Enumeration]
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGeographi.d: Indicates geographical component for liability for future policy benefit.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitActivityT.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Activity [Table Text Block]
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitActivityT.d: Tabular disclosure of beginning balance to ending balance for liability for future policy benefit, with separate presentation of expected future net premium and expected future benefit.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitAfterRein.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, after Reinsurance
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitAfterRein.d: Amount, after effect of reinsurance, of liability for future policy benefit.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitAfterRein.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, after Reinsurance [Abstract]

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitNoChangeI.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, No Change in Expense Assumption, Policy Election [true false]
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitNoChangeI.d: Indicates (true false) whether accounting policy was elected not to update expense assumption used in measuring liability for future policy benefit. Assumption includes, but is not limited to, estimate for termination or settlement cost and cost after premium-paying period of insurance contract.

LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitReinsuran.l: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Reinsurance Recoverable, after Allowance
LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitReinsuran.d: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, recoverable under reinsurance of liability for future policy benefit.

MarketRiskBenefitGeographicalExtensibleL.d: Indicates geographical component for contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

MeasurementInputInsurancePolicyTermMembe.d: Measurement input using duration of time in which insurance policy is in effect.

NetInvestmentInLease90DaysOrMorePastDueS.l: Net Investment in Lease, 90 Days or More Past Due, Still Accruing
NetInvestmentInLease90DaysOrMorePastDueS.d: Amount of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, 90 days or more past due and still accruing.

NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceForCreditLo.l: Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceForCreditLo.d: Amount of writeoff of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, charged against allowance for credit loss.

NetInvestmentInLeaseThresholdPeriodPastD.l: Net Investment in Lease, Threshold Period Past Due, Writeoff
NetInvestmentInLeaseThresholdPeriodPastD.d: Threshold period when net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases is considered past due to write off as uncollectible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.l: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment and Tax
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.d: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.l: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment and Tax [Abstract]
OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment and Tax, Parent
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.d: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, attributable to parent.

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.l: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment and Tax, Noncontrolling Interest
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.d: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.l: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment and Tax, Parent [Abstract]
OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.d: Amount, after tax and before reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.l: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification Adjustment and Tax
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.d: Amount, before tax and reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.l: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.d: Amount, before reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.l: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.d: Amount, before tax and after reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.l: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax [Abstract]
OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax, Noncontrolling Interest
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.d: Amount, before tax and after reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.l: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax, Parent
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.d: Amount, before tax and after reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, attributable to parent.

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.l: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax, Parent [Abstract]
OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.d: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) for gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.l: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.d: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) for gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.l: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.d: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) (AOCI) for gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

FinancingReceivableNonaccrualStatusLineI.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.l: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.d: Amount of writeoff of net investment in direct financing lease, charged against allowance for credit loss.

DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.l: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Nonaccrual, No Allowance
DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.d: Amount of net investment in direct financing lease on nonaccrual status with no allowance for credit loss.

DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.l: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Past Due Threshold Period for Writeoff
DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.d: Threshold period when net investment in direct financing lease is considered past due to write off as uncollectible, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

FairValueDisclosureAssetAndLiabilityNotM.l: Fair Value Disclosure, Asset and Liability, Not Measured at Fair Value [Line Items]
FairValueDisclosureAssetAndLiabilityNotM.d: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

FairValueAssetLiabilityRecurringBasisSti.l: Fair Value, Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
FairValueAssetLiabilityRecurringBasisSti.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from asset (liability) measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

FairValueAssetLiabilityRecurringBasisSti.l: Fair Value, Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), OCI
FairValueAssetLiabilityRecurringBasisSti.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from asset (liability) measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

FairValueAssetLiabilityRecurringBasisSti.l: Fair Value, Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Statement of Other Comprehensive Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
FairValueAssetLiabilityRecurringBasisSti.d: Indicates line item in statement in which other comprehensive income (OCI) is reported that includes unrealized gain (loss) from asset (liability) measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

FairValueAssetLiabilityRecurringBasisSti.l: Fair Value, Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), OCI [Abstract]
Fair Value, Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
FairValueAssetLiabilityRecurringBasisSti.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes unrealized gain (loss) from asset (liability) measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

FairValueAssetRecurringBasisStillHeldUnr.l: Fair Value, Asset, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Statement of Other Comprehensive Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
FairValueAssetRecurringBasisStillHeldUnr.d: Indicates line item in statement in which other comprehensive income (OCI) is reported that includes unrealized gain (loss) from asset measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

FairValueAssetRecurringBasisStillHeldUnr.l: Fair Value, Asset, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), OCI
FairValueAssetRecurringBasisStillHeldUnr.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

FairValueAssetRecurringBasisStillHeldUnr.l: Fair Value, Asset, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
FairValueAssetRecurringBasisStillHeldUnr.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes unrealized gain (loss) from asset measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

FairValueInvestmentNetAssetValuePerShare.l: Fair Value, Investment, Net Asset Value Per Share, Liquidating Investment, Period Unknown [true false]
FairValueInvestmentNetAssetValuePerShare.d: Indicates (true false) whether timing of expected liquidation is unknown for underlying asset of investment measured at net asset value per share or unit that can never be redeemed with investee.

FairValueLiabilityRecurringBasisStillHel.l: Fair Value, Liability, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), OCI
FairValueLiabilityRecurringBasisStillHel.d: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

FairValueLiabilityRecurringBasisStillHel.l: Fair Value, Liability, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Statement of Other Comprehensive Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
FairValueLiabilityRecurringBasisStillHel.d: Indicates line item in statement in which other comprehensive income (OCI) is reported that includes unrealized gain (loss) from liability measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.
