EnvironmentalLossContingencyStatementOfF.d: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes accrual for environmental loss contingency.

EnvironmentalLossContingencyCurrentState.l: Environmental Loss Contingency, Current, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
EnvironmentalLossContingencyCurrentState.d: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes accrual for environmental loss contingency classified as current.

EnvironmentalLossContingencyNoncurrentSt.l: Environmental Loss Contingency, Noncurrent, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
EnvironmentalLossContingencyNoncurrentSt.d: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes accrual for environmental loss contingency classified as noncurrent.

ServicingAssetAtFairValueChangeInFairVal.l: Servicing Asset, Fair Value, Change in Fair Value, Valuation Input, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
ServicingAssetAtFairValueChangeInFairVal.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes increase (decrease) in fair value from change in input used to calculate fair value of contract to service financial asset under which benefit of servicing is expected to more than adequately compensate servicer.

ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueChangeInFai.l: Servicing Liability, Fair Value, Change in Fair Value, Valuation Input, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueChangeInFai.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes increase (decrease) in fair value from change in input used to calculate fair value of contract to service financial asset under which estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fee, late fee, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate servicer.

DiscontinuedOperationGainLossOnDisposalS.l: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
DiscontinuedOperationGainLossOnDisposalS.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes gain (loss) from disposal of discontinued operation.

ImpairmentLongLivedAssetHeldForUseStatem.l: Long-Lived Asset, Held and Used, Impairment Loss, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
ImpairmentLongLivedAssetHeldForUseStatem.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes impairment loss for long-lived asset held and used. Includes, but is not limited to, impairment loss for long-lived asset to be disposed of other than by sale.

RestructuringIncurredCostStatementOfInco.l: Restructuring Charges, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
RestructuringIncurredCostStatementOfInco.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes restructuring charges.

EnvironmentalRemediationExpenseStatement.l: Environmental Remediation Expense, before Recovery, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
EnvironmentalRemediationExpenseStatement.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes environmental remediation expense before recovery.

GainOnBusinessInterruptionInsuranceRecov.l: Gain on Business Interruption Insurance Recovery, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
GainOnBusinessInterruptionInsuranceRecov.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes gain from business interruption insurance recovery.

ServicingAssetAtFairValueOtherChangeInFa.l: Servicing Asset, Fair Value, Change in Fair Value, Other, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
ServicingAssetAtFairValueOtherChangeInFa.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes increase (decrease) in fair value classified as other for contract to service financial asset under which benefit of servicing is expected to more than adequately compensate servicer.

ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueOtherChange.l: Servicing Liability, Fair Value, Change in Fair Value, Other, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueOtherChange.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes increase (decrease) in fair value classified as other for contract to service financial asset under which estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fee, late fee, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate servicer.

GainLossHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyin.l: Gain (Loss), Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
GainLossHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyin.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes gain (loss) recognized in earnings when hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as fair value hedge.

DerivativeExcludedComponentGainLossState.l: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain (Loss), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
DerivativeExcludedComponentGainLossState.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes gain (loss) recognized in earnings from excluded component of derivative hedge.

DerivativeExcludedComponentGainStatement.l: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
DerivativeExcludedComponentGainStatement.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes gain recognized in earnings from excluded component of derivative hedge.

DerivativeExcludedComponentLossStatement.l: Derivative, Excluded Component, Loss, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
DerivativeExcludedComponentLossStatement.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes loss recognized in earnings from excluded component of derivative hedge.

OciCashFlowHedgeReclassificationForDisco.l: OCI, Cash Flow Hedge, Reclassification for Discontinuance, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
OciCashFlowHedgeReclassificationForDisco.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes reclassification from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from discontinuance of cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

GainHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyingAsF.l: Gain, Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
GainHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyingAsF.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes gain recognized in earnings when hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as fair value hedge.

LossHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyingAsF.l: Loss, Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
LossHedgedFirmCommitmentNotQualifyingAsF.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes loss recognized in earnings when hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as fair value hedge.

IncomeLossOngoingEquityMethodInvestmentI.l: Income (Loss), Equity Method Investment in Discontinued Operation after Disposal, Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]
IncomeLossOngoingEquityMethodInvestmentI.d: Indicates line item in statement of income or comprehensive income that includes share in income (loss) of equity method investee after disposal of discontinued operation.

EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationBeat.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, BEAT, Percent
EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationBeat.d: Percentage of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to base erosion and anti-abuse tax (BEAT).

EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationGilt.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, NCTI, Percent
EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationGilt.d: Percentage of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to net controlled foreign corporation (CFC) tested income (NCTI) (formerly referred to as global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI)).

EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationFdii.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, FDDEI, Percent
EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationFdii.d: Percentage of reported income tax benefit from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to foreign-derived deduction eligible income (FDDEI) (formerly referred to as foreign-derived intangible income (FDII)).

EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationBeat.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, BEAT, Amount
EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationBeat.d: Amount of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to base erosion and anti-abuse tax (BEAT).

EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationGilt.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, NCTI, Amount
EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationGilt.d: Amount of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to net controlled foreign corporation (CFC) tested income (NCTI) (formerly referred to as global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI)).

EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationFdii.l: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, FDDEI, Amount
EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationFdii.d: Amount of reported income tax benefit from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to foreign-derived deduction eligible income (FDDEI) (formerly referred to as foreign-derived intangible income (FDII)).

GovernmentAssistanceTextBlock.d: The entire disclosure for government assistance.

GovernmentAssistancePolicyTextBlock.d: Disclosure of accounting policy for government assistance.

GovernmentAssistanceAmount.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance.

GovernmentAssistanceStatementOfIncomeOrC.l: Government Assistance, Income, Increase (Decrease), Statement of Income or Comprehensive Income [Extensible Enumeration]

GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumulative.d: Amount of asset from government assistance.

GovernmentAssistanceStatementOfFinancial.l: Government Assistance, Asset, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
GovernmentAssistanceStatementOfFinancial.d: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes asset from government assistance.

GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumulativeCurr.d: Amount of asset from government assistance, classified as current.

GovernmentAssistanceCurrentStatementOfFi.l: Government Assistance, Asset, Current, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
GovernmentAssistanceCurrentStatementOfFi.d: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes asset from government assistance, classified as current.

GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumulativeNonc.d: Amount of asset from government assistance, classified as noncurrent.

GovernmentAssistanceNoncurrentStatementO.l: Government Assistance, Asset, Noncurrent, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
GovernmentAssistanceNoncurrentStatementO.d: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes asset from government assistance, classified as noncurrent.

FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.l: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Fee, and Loan in Process
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.d: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, fee, and loan in process, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.l: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss, by Origination Year [Abstract]

DerivativeAssetAfterOffsetSubjectToMaste.l: Derivative Asset, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]
Derivative Asset, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
DerivativeAssetAfterOffsetSubjectToMaste.d: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

DerivativeAssetFairValueAfterOffsetAndDe.l: Derivative Asset, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]
Derivative Asset, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
DerivativeAssetFairValueAfterOffsetAndDe.d: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

SecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellA.l: Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]
Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
SecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellA.d: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of fund outstanding loaned in form of security resale agreement for purchase and resale of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security purchased under agreement to resell not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

SecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellA.l: Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]
Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
SecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellA.d: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of fund outstanding loaned in form of security resale agreement for purchase and resale of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Excludes security purchased under agreement to resell not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

SecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetSubjectToMast.l: Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]
Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
SecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetSubjectToMast.d: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of security borrowed from entity in exchange for collateral. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security borrowed not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

SecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetAndDeductionS.l: Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]
Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
SecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetAndDeductionS.d: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of security borrowed from entity in exchange for collateral. Excludes security borrowed not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

DerivativeAssetSecurityPurchasedUnderAgr.l: Derivative Asset, Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, and Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]
Derivative Asset, Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, and Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
DerivativeAssetSecurityPurchasedUnderAgr.d: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes asset not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

DerivativeAssetSecurityPurchasedUnderAgr.l: Derivative Asset, Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, and Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]
Derivative Asset, Security Purchased under Agreement to Resell, and Security Borrowed, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
DerivativeAssetSecurityPurchasedUnderAgr.d: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed. Excludes asset not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

DerivativeLiabilityAfterOffsetSubjectToM.l: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]
Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
DerivativeLiabilityAfterOffsetSubjectToM.d: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

DerivativeLiabilityFairValueAfterOffsetA.l: Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]
Derivative Liability, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
DerivativeLiabilityFairValueAfterOffsetA.d: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

SecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseAf.l: Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]
Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
SecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseAf.d: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security sold under agreement to repurchase not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

SecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseAf.l: Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]
Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
SecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseAf.d: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Excludes security sold under agreement to repurchase not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

SecurityLoanedAfterOffsetSubjectToMaster.l: Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]
Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
SecurityLoanedAfterOffsetSubjectToMaster.d: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of security loaned to entity in exchange for collateral. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security loaned not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

SecurityLoanedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSub.l: Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]
Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
SecurityLoanedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSub.d: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of security loaned to entity in exchange for collateral. Excludes security loaned not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

DerivativeLiabilitySecuritySoldUnderAgre.l: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset [Abstract]
Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset
DerivativeLiabilitySecuritySoldUnderAgre.d: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes liability not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

DerivativeLiabilitySecuritySoldUnderAgre.l: Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction [Abstract]
Derivative Liability, Security Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, and Security Loaned, Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, after Offset and Deduction
DerivativeLiabilitySecuritySoldUnderAgre.d: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned. Excludes liability not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllowanceFor.d: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and beneficial interest, purchased with credit deterioration.

OciEquityMethodInvestmentBeforeTaxParent.d: Amount, before tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI, attributable to parent.

OciEquityMethodInvestmentTaxParent.d: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI, attributable to parent.

OciEquityMethodInvestmentAfterTaxParent.d: Amount, after tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI, attributable to parent.

OciEquityMethodInvestmentBeforeTaxNoncon.d: Amount, before tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

OciEquityMethodInvestmentTaxNoncontrolli.d: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

OciEquityMethodInvestmentAfterTaxNoncont.l: OCI, Equity Method Investment, after Tax, Noncontrolling Interest
OciEquityMethodInvestmentAfterTaxNoncont.d: Amount, after tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

HedgedAssetStatementOfFinancialPositionE.l: Hedged Asset, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]

HedgedLiabilityStatementOfFinancialPosit.l: Hedged Liability, Statement of Financial Position [Extensible Enumeration]
HedgedLiabilityStatementOfFinancialPosit.d: Indicates line item in statement of financial position that includes hedged liability.

FinancingReceivableAccruedInterestModifi.d: Amount of accrued interest on financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

FinancingReceivableModificationToTotalFi.l: Financing Receivable, Modified in Period, to Total Financing Receivables, Percentage
FinancingReceivableModificationToTotalFi.d: Percentage of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty to total financing receivables.

FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.l: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Modified, Accumulated
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.d: Accumulated amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.l: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Modified in Period, Amount
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.d: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

FinancingReceivableModificationToTotalFi.l: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Modified in Period, to Total Financing Receivables, Percentage
FinancingReceivableModificationToTotalFi.d: Percentage, excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty to total financing receivables.

FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.l: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Modified, Increase (Decrease) from Modification
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.d: Amount of increase (decrease) in amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

FinancingReceivableModifiedPastDueTableT.l: Financing Receivable, Modified, Past Due [Table Text Block]
FinancingReceivableModifiedPastDueTableT.d: Tabular disclosure of aging analysis for financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

FinancingReceivableModifiedPastDueTable.d: Disclosure of information about aging analysis for financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

CashHeldInForeignCurrency.d: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, held in foreign currency. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CashNotHeldInForeignCurrency.d: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, not held in foreign currency. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

meta:RecordedValueTrait.d: Characteristics of the measurement used for the reported or recorded value.

meta:RelatedPartyTrait.d: Characteristics of related and nonrelated parties. Related party includes, but is not limited to, affiliate, other entity for which investment is accounted for under equity method, trust for benefit of employee, principal owner, management, and member of immediate family, and other party that may be prevented from pursuing separate interests because of control, significant influence, or ownership interest.

meta:Remeasurement.d: Recalculated or adjusted value to reflect changes in underlying conditions, such as currency exchange rates, interest rates, or fair market values.

meta:ReportedAtFairValue.d: Reported or recorded amount at which an asset (or liability) could be bought (or incurred) or sold (or settled) in a current transaction between willing parties, that is, other than in a forced or liquidation sale.

meta:RestrictedMember.d: Assets that are subject to specific limitations or conditions on their use imposed by external parties, such as lenders, donors, or regulators, or management.

meta:RestrictionDomain.d: Whether assets that are subject to specific limitations or conditions on their use imposed by external parties, such as lenders, donors, or regulators, or management.

meta:RestrictionTrait.d: Characteristics of whether assets that are subject to specific limitations or conditions on their use imposed by external parties, such as lenders, donors, or regulators, or management.

meta:RevenueMember.d: Inflows or other enhancements of an assets of an entity or settlements of its liabilities from delivering or producing goods, rendering services, or carrying out other activities.

meta:RevolvingLoanMember.d: Flexible credit structure that the borrower can access, repay, and borrow again repeatedly, up to a certain limit, during the loan's term.

meta:SalesTypeLeaseMember.d: From the perspective of a lessor, a lease that meets one or more of the criteria in paragraph 842-10-25-2 and is not an operating lease in accordance with paragraph 842-10-25-3A.

meta:SeniorSubordinatedDebtMember.d: Middle priority tier that is lower priority than unsubordinated debt but higher than junior subordinated debt.

meta:StatisticalMeasurementTrait.d: Characteristic of statistical measurement. Includes, but is not limited to, minimum, maximum, weighted average, arithmetic average, and median.

meta:TaxBenefitsMember.d: A reduction in tax liability that results from deductions, credits, exemptions, or other provisions that decrease the amount of tax owed.

meta:TaxCarryforwardMember.d: Unused tax benefit that an entity is allowed to apply against future taxable revenue to reduce their tax burden.

meta:TaxComponentsDomain.d: Elements related to the taxation of an entity's income, transactions, and financial activities.

meta:TaxComponentsTrait.d: Characteristics of elements related to the taxation of an entity's income, transactions, and financial activities.

meta:TaxContingencyMember.d: Potential tax obligation that may arise due to uncertainty in the interpretation or application of tax laws.

meta:TaxCreditMember.d: Direct reduction of the amount of taxed owed by an entity.

meta:TaxDeductibleExpenseMember.d: Expense that is deductible for tax purposes.

meta:TaxDeductibleNonExpenseItemMember.d: Item that reduces taxable income for tax purposes but is not an expense for financial reporting.

meta:TaxExpenseMember.d: The cost of taxes incurred by an entity, whether based on income, asset value, or other taxable activities.

meta:TaxSettlementMember.d: Tax obligation that has been resolved with the taxing authority.

meta:TaxableRevenueMember.d: Portion of income that is subject to taxation.

meta:TemporaryEquityMember.d: Instruments which are neither purely equity nor purely liabilities.

meta:TermLoanMember.d: Loan structure that provides a fixed amount of money that the borrower receives upfront and repays in fixed installments over a set period

meta:ThresholdDomain.d: Identifies the existence of a predetermined limit, boundary, or level that determines when a specific financial condition, requirement, or action is triggered.

meta:ThresholdMember.d: Existence of a predetermined limit, boundary, or level that determines when a specific financial condition, requirement, or action is triggered.

meta:ThresholdTrait.d: Characteristic of a predetermined limit, boundary, or level that determines when a specific financial condition, requirement, or action is triggered.

meta:UnrealizedMember.d: An unrealized gain or loss reflects the change in fair value of an asset or liability still held at the reporting date, recognized in net income or OCI based on its classification.

meta:UnrestrictedMember.d: Assets that are not subject to specific limitations or conditions on their use imposed by external parties, such as lenders, donors, or regulators, or management.

meta:UseDomain.d: How assets are used or consumed and how liabilities are settled.

meta:UseTrait.d: Characteristics of how assets are used or consumed and how liabilities are settled.

meta:VariableRateMember.d: Interest rate that fluctuates based on an underlying benchmark over the life of a financial instrument.
